qe: In which year were the provincial elections held under the Government of India Act 1935?
qh: भारत शासन अधिनियम 1935 के तहत प्रांतीय चुनाव किस वर्ष आयोजित किए गए थे?
e: 1937 ke shuruati mahinon mein chunav hue aur julai 1937 mein kangres ne kai pranton mein mantrimandal banae. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bharat shasan adhiniyam 1935 ke tahat prantiy chunav kis varsh ayojit kie gae the? Isliye sahi nateeja 1937 nikalta hai. 1935, 1936, 1939 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 1937 hi hai. Exam point: 1937 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In how many provinces did Congress initially form its ministries after the 1937 elections?
qh: 1937 के चुनावों के बाद कांग्रेस ने शुरुआत में कितने प्रांतों में अपने मंत्रिमंडल गठित किए थे?
e: shuruat mein madras, banbai, madhy prant, udaisa, bihar aur sanyukt prant mein kangres ki sarakarein banin. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1937 ke chunavon ke bad kangres ne shuruat mein kitane pranton mein apane mantrimandal gathit kie the? Isi tathya par 6 tika hua hai. 8, 5, 11 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 6 hi hai. Exam point: 6 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which 'Parliamentary Sub-Committee' did Congress form to control its ministries?
qh: कांग्रेस ने अपने मंत्रिमंडलों पर नियंत्रण रखने के लिए किस 'संसदीय उप-समिति' का गठन किया था?
e: is samiti mein saradar patel, maulana ajad aur do. rajeindr prasad shamil the taki satta ke karan vaicharik bhatakav n ho. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kangres ne apane mantrimandalon par niyantran rakhane ke lie kis 'sansadiy up-samiti' ka gathan kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par patel-ajad-prasad samiti (Patel-Azad-Prasad Committee) sahi nikalta hai. svaraj dal, gandhi seva sangh, neharu-bos samiti mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan patel-ajad-prasad samiti (Patel-Azad-Prasad Committee) hi milti hai. Exam point: patel-ajad-prasad samiti (Patel-Azad-Prasad Committee) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What kind of 'Crown' did Gandhi call the power in the context of Congress rule?
qh: गांधीजी ने कांग्रेस शासन के संदर्भ में सत्ता को किस प्रकार का ताज (Crown) कहा था?
e: 7 agast 1937 ko 'harijan' mein gandhiji ne likha ki yah pad kanton bhara taj hai kyonki unhein usi shasan ke bhitar rahakar sangharsh karana tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki gandhiji ne kangres shasan ke sandarbh mein satta ko kis prakar ka taj (Crown) kaha tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par kanton bhara taj (Crown of Thorns) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp vijay ka pratik, sone ka taj, asthayi upahar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad kanton bhara taj (Crown of Thorns) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kanton bhara taj (Crown of Thorns) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which book of Jawaharlal Nehru is the changed 'psychological atmosphere' of the 1937 rule described?
qh: जवाहरलाल नेहरू की किस पुस्तक में 1937 के शासन के दौरान बदले हुए 'मनोवैज्ञानिक माहौल' का वर्णन मिलता है?
e: neharu ne likha ki kaise jel mein rahane vale log ab aseinbali mein baithe the aur pulis unaki seva mein kh i thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki javaharalal neharu ki kis pustak mein 1937 ke shasan ke dauran badale hue 'manovaijnanik mahaul' ka varnan milata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bharat ek khoj (Discovery of India) hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp ekata ka marg, meri kahani, vishv itihas ki jhalak bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar bharat ek khoj (Discovery of India) hi hai. Exam point: bharat ek khoj (Discovery of India) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: By what name is the strategy adopted by Congress during 1937-39 known?
qh: कांग्रेस की 1937-39 के दौरान अपनाई गई रणनीति को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: yah niti darshati hai ki andolan ke bad ek thaharav (shanti) ka samay ata hai taki agale sangharsh ki taiyari ki ja sake. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kangres ki 1937-39 ke dauran apanai gai rananiti ko kis nam se jana jata hai? Isi aadhar par sangharsh-shanti-sangharsh (Struggle-Truce-Struggle) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - sakriy sahayog, purn bahishkar, satyagrah - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar sangharsh-shanti-sangharsh (Struggle-Truce-Struggle) hi hai. Exam point: sangharsh-shanti-sangharsh (Struggle-Truce-Struggle) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Despite provincial autonomy under the 1935 Act, who held the real control?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता (Provincial Autonomy) के बावजूद वास्तविक नियंत्रण किसके पास था?
o: ब्रिटिश गवर्नर और वायसराय के पास (British Governors & Viceroy)
e: gavarnaron ke pas visheshadhikar (Veto powers) the, jisase ve kabhi bhi mantriyon ke nirnayon ko palat sakate the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 1935 ke adhiniyam ke tahat prantiy svayattata (Provincial Autonomy) ke bavajud vastavik niyantran kisake pas tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par british gavarnar aur vayasaray ke pas (British... sahi nikalta hai. kisi ke pas nahin, bharatiy mantriyon ke pas, janata ke pas in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan british gavarnar aur vayasaray ke pas (British... hi milti hai. Exam point: british gavarnar aur vayasaray ke pas (British Governors & Viceroy) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Through which newspaper did Gandhi advise Congress ministers to avoid the lure of office?
qh: गांधीजी ने अपने किस समाचार पत्र के माध्यम से कांग्रेसी मंत्रियों को पद के लोभ से बचने की सलाह दी थी?
e: gandhiji ne harijan mein lekh likhakar mantriyon ko sadagi banae rakhane aur aupaniveshik manasikata se dur rahane ko kaha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki gandhiji ne apane kis samachar patr ke madhyam se kangresi mantriyon ko pad ke lobh se bachane ki salah di thi? Isliye antim jawab harijan ke roop mein milta hai. Galti yang indiya, navajivan, indiyan opiniyan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se harijan sahi hai. Exam point: harijan - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which two other provinces did Congress later form coalition governments?
qh: बाद के चरण में कांग्रेस ने किन दो अन्य प्रांतों में भी अपनी गठबंधन सरकारें बनाई थीं?
e: shuruati 6 pranton ke bad pashchimottar simant prant aur asam mein bhi kangres ne sarakar banai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bad ke charan mein kangres ne kin do any pranton mein bhi apani gathabandhan sarakarein banai thin? Isliye antim jawab pashchimottar prant aur asam (NWFP & Assam) ke roop mein milta hai. madras aur barma, bangal aur panjab, sindh aur asam is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar pashchimottar prant aur asam (NWFP & Assam) hi hai. Exam point: pashchimottar prant aur asam (NWFP & Assam) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the main impact on the general public when Congress came to power in 1937?
qh: 1937 में कांग्रेस के शासन में आने से आम जनता पर क्या मुख्य प्रभाव पड़ा?
o: राजकीय भय कम हो गया और आत्मविश्वास बढ़ा (Reduction in state fear & increased confidence)
लोग राजनीति से दूर हो गए
e: janata ko mahasus hua ki ab unaka apana shasan hai, jisase unake bhitar se british satta ka dar kam hua. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1937 mein kangres ke shasan mein ane se am janata par kya mukhy prabhav p a? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par rajakiy bhay kam ho gaya aur atmavishvas b a (Reduction in state fear & increased confidence) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. log rajaniti se dur ho gae, angrej bharat chho kar chale gae, taiks b gae is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab rajakiy bhay kam ho gaya aur atmavishvas b a (Reduction in state fear & increased confidence) hai. Exam point: rajakiy bhay kam ho gaya aur atmavishvas... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What kind of governance system was proposed by the Government of India Act 1935?
qh: भारत शासन अधिनियम 1935 ने किस प्रकार की शासन व्यवस्था का प्रस्ताव रखा था?
e: is adhiniyam mein ek akhil bharatiy sangh (All India Federation) banane ka pravadhan tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki bharat shasan adhiniyam 1935 ne kis prakar ki shasan vyavastha ka prastav rakha tha? Isliye antim jawab sanghiy vyavastha (Federal System) ke roop mein milta hai. rajashahi, sainik shasan, ekatmak vyavastha anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sanghiy vyavastha (Federal System) hi milti hai. Exam point: sanghiy vyavastha (Federal System) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the full name of the sub-committee member 'Prasad'?
qh: संसदीय उप-समिति के सदस्य 'प्रसाद' का पूर्ण नाम क्या था?
e: do. rajeindr prasad us tin sadasyiy samiti ke sadasy the jo mantrimandalon ke karyon ki dekharekh karati thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki sansadiy up-samiti ke sadasy 'prasad' ka purn nam kya tha? samiti gram ke aam logon ki sabha thi. Isi tathya par do. rajeindr prasad (Dr. Rajendra Prasad) tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - jagadish prasad, mahadev prasad, sachchidanand prasad - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar do. rajeindr prasad (Dr. Rajendra Prasad) hai. Exam point: do. rajeindr prasad (Dr. Rajendra Prasad) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main election issue of Congress during the 1937 elections?
qh: 1937 के चुनावों के दौरान कांग्रेस का मुख्य चुनावी मुद्दा क्या था?
o: 1935 के अधिनियम को खारिज करना और नई संविधान सभा की मांग (Rejecting 1935 Act & demanding Constituent Assembly)
e: kangres ne is adhiniyam ko thopa hua manakar isaka virodh kiya tha aur apani sarakar ke madhyam se ise viphal karana chahati thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1937 ke chunavon ke dauran kangres ka mukhy chunavi mudda kya tha? constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi baat se 1935 ke adhiniyam ko kharij karana aur nai sanvidhan sabha ki mang (Rejecting 1935 Act & demanding Constituent Assembly) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - keval vyapar b ana, angrejon se mitrata, 1935 ke adhiniyam ka samarthan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav 1935 ke adhiniyam ko kharij karana aur nai sanvidhan sabha ki mang (Rejecting 1935 Act & demanding Constituent Assembly) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 1935 ke adhiniyam ko kharij karana aur nai sanvidhan sabha ki mang (Rejecting 1935 Act & demanding Constituent Assembly) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What caused the end of the 28-month Congress rule?
qh: कांग्रेस शासन के 28 माह का अंत किस कारण से हुआ था?
o: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध में भारत को बिना पूछे शामिल करने के विरोध में इस्तीफा (Resignation against unilateral involvement in WWII)
e: 1939 mein jab british sarakar ne bharatiyon ki sahamati ke bina unhein yuddh mein jhonk diya, to kangres mantrimandalon ne istipha de diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kangres shasan ke 28 mah ka ant kis karan se hua tha? In tathyon ke chalte dvitiy vishv yuddh mein bharat ko bina puchhe shamil karane ke virodh mein istipha (Resignation against unilateral involvement in WWII) hi sahi hai. Galti gandhiji ki giraphtari, antarik kalah, chunav harane ke karan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab dvitiy vishv yuddh mein bharat ko bina puchhe shamil karane ke virodh mein istipha (Resignation against unilateral involvement in WWII) hai. Exam point: dvitiy vishv yuddh mein bharat ko bina... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What instruction was given to Congress ministers regarding their government salary?
qh: कांग्रेस मंत्रियों को सरकारी वेतन के संबंध में क्या निर्देश दिया गया था?
o: न्यूनतम वेतन (500 रु) स्वीकार करना (Accepting minimum salary of Rs 500)
e: tyag aur sadagi ka udaharan pesh karane ke lie mantriyon ne apana vetan ghatakar 500 rupaye kar diya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki kangres mantriyon ko sarakari vetan ke sanbandh mein kya nirdesh diya gaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par nyunatam vetan (500 ru) svikar karana (Accepting minimum salary of Rs 500) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp adhikatam vetan lena, vetan n lena, british mudra mein vetan lena bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se nyunatam vetan (500 ru) svikar karana (Accepting minimum salary of Rs 500) sahi hai. Exam point: nyunatam vetan (500 ru) svikar karana (Accepting... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the 'Karachi Session' of the INC held?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का 'कराची अधिवेशन' किस वर्ष आयोजित किया गया था?
e: 29 march 1931 ko karachi mein kangres ki baithak hui, jisamein gandhi-iravin samajhaute ko manjuri di gai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki bharatiy rashtriy kangres ka 'karachi adhiveshan' kis varsh ayojit kiya gaya tha? Isliye antim jawab 1931 ke roop mein milta hai. 1929, 1932, 1930 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1931 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1931 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who presided over the Karachi Session (1931)?
qh: कराची अधिवेशन (1931) की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
e: saradar vallabhabhai patel ne karachi adhiveshan ki adhyakshata ki thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki karachi adhiveshan (1931) ki adhyakshata kisane ki thi? Isi baat se saradar vallabhabhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp mahatma gandhi, subhash chandr bos, javaharalal neharu bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad saradar vallabhabhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: saradar vallabhabhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why did youth show 'black flags' to Gandhi on his way to Karachi?
qh: गांधीजी को कराची जाते समय युवाओं ने 'काले झंडे' क्यों दिखाए थे?
o: भगत सिंह, राजगुरु और सुखदेव की फांसी न रुक पाने के कारण (Failure to stop the execution of Bhagat Singh & others)
e: 23 march 1931 ko hui krantikariyon ki phansi se desh ke yuva gandhiji se naraj the. Prashn yah batata hai ki gandhiji ko karachi jate samay yuvaon ne 'kale jhande' kyon dikhae the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bhagat sinh, rajaguru aur sukhadev ki phansi n ruk pane ke karan (Failure to stop the execution of Bhagat Singh & others) hi sahi baithta hai. jel jane ke dar se, videshi vastron ke karan, namak kar ke karan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav bhagat sinh, rajaguru aur sukhadev ki phansi n ruk pane ke karan (Failure to stop the execution of Bhagat Singh & others) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: bhagat sinh, rajaguru aur sukhadev ki phansi n ruk pane ke karan (Failure to stop the execution of Bhagat Singh & others) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which session did Congress first pass a resolution on 'Fundamental Rights'?
qh: कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में पहली बार 'मौलिक अधिकार' (Fundamental Rights) से संबंधित प्रस्ताव पारित किया गया था?
e: karachi adhiveshan mein maulik adhikaron aur rashtriy arthik karyakramon par mahatvapurn prastav parit kie gae. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki kangres ke kis adhiveshan mein pahali bar 'maulik adhikar' (Fundamental Rights) se sanbandhit prastav parit kiya gaya tha? Isi baat se karachi 1931 sahi sabit hota hai. lakhanau 1936, phaijapur 1937, lahaur 1929 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se karachi 1931 sahi hai. Exam point: karachi 1931 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which Round Table Conference did Gandhi participate as the sole representative of Congress?
qh: गांधीजी ने कांग्रेस के एकमात्र प्रतिनिधि के रूप में किस गोलमेज सम्मेलन में भाग लिया था?
e: gandhiji ne sitanbar 1931 mein landan mein ayojit 'dvitiy golamej sammelan' mein bhag liya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki gandhiji ne kangres ke ekamatr pratinidhi ke rup mein kis golamej sammelan mein bhag liya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par dvitiy (Second) hi sahi baithta hai. tritiy, tinon mein, pratham is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se dvitiy (Second) sahi hai. Exam point: dvitiy (Second) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who called Gandhi a 'Half-naked Fakir' in London?
qh: गांधीजी को लंदन में 'अधनंगा फकीर' (Half-naked Fakir) किसने कहा था?
e: british neta vinstan charchil ne gandhiji ke sade pahanave aur british samrat ke samakaksh baithane par yah tippani ki thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhiji ko landan mein 'adhananga phakir' (Half-naked Fakir) kisane kaha tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par vinstan charchil (Winston Churchill) sahi nikalta hai. raimje maikadonald, lord vilingatan, lord iravin anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad vinstan charchil (Winston Churchill) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: vinstan charchil (Winston Churchill) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Gujarati poet told Gandhi before his London trip- 'Drink even the last cup of poison, Bapu'?
qh: लंदन जाने से पहले किस गुजराती कवि ने गांधीजी से कहा था- 'जहर का आखिरी घूंट भी पी जाना बापू'?
e: kavi meghani ne gandhiji ko kathin varta ke lie protsahit karate hue yah prasiddh pankti kahi thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki landan jane se pahale kis gujarati kavi ne gandhiji se kaha tha- 'jahar ka akhiri ghunt bhi pi jana bapu'? Isi tathya par jhaverachand meghani (Jhaverchand Meghani) tika hua hai. Galti ravindranath taigor, narasi mehata, sarojini nayadu chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. qe: Who played the role of mediators during the Gandhi-Irwin Pact?
qh: गांधी-इरविन समझौते के दौरान मध्यस्थ (Mediators) की भूमिका किसने निभाई थी?
o: तेज बहादुर सप्रू और एम.आर. जयकर (Sapru & Jayakar)
e: tej bahadur sapru aur jayakar ke prayason se hi gandhi aur iravin varta ki mej par ae. Is sawaal mein tej bahadur sapru aur em.ar. jayakar (Sapru & Jayakar) ki baat hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par tej bahadur sapru aur em.ar. jayakar (Sapru & Jayakar) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp jinna aur malaviy, bhagat sinh aur batukeshvar datt, neharu aur patel bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar tej bahadur sapru aur em.ar. jayakar (Sapru & Jayakar) hi hai. Exam point: tej bahadur sapru aur em.ar. jayakar (Sapru & Jayakar) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which event was termed as a 'Himalayan Blunder' by Gandhi?
qh: किस घटना को 'असहयोग आंदोलन की हिमालय जैसी भूल' कहा गया था?
o: पूर्ण अनुशासन के बिना जन-संघर्ष शुरू करना (Launching struggle without discipline)
e: gandhiji ne mana ki janata ko puri tarah ahinsak banae bina savinay avajna shuru karana b i bhul thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kis ghatana ko 'asahayog andolan ki himalay jaisi bhul' kaha gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par purn anushasan ke bina jan-sangharsh shuru karana... sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - andolan shuru karana, jel jana, dandi yatra - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan purn anushasan ke bina jan-sangharsh shuru karana (Launching struggle without discipline) hi milti hai. Exam point: purn anushasan ke bina jan-sangharsh shuru karana (Launching struggle without discipline) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which demand of Gandhi was rejected by the government in the pact?
qh: गांधी-इरविन समझौते में गांधीजी की किस मांग को सरकार ने अस्वीकार कर दिया था?
o: पुलिस ज्यादतियों की जाँच (Inquiry into police excesses)
e: sarakar ne andolan ke dauran pulis dvara kie gae atyacharon ki sarvajanik janch ki mang thukara di thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki gandhi-iravin samajhaute mein gandhiji ki kis mang ko sarakar ne asvikar kar diya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par pulis jyadatiyon ki janch (Inquiry into police... sahi nikalta hai. namak banana, dharana dena, kaidiyon ki rihai is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav pulis jyadatiyon ki janch (Inquiry into police excesses) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: pulis jyadatiyon ki janch (Inquiry into police... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was declared as the main goal of Congress in the 1929 Lahore session?
qh: 1929 के लाहौर अधिवेशन में कांग्रेस का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या घोषित किया गया था?
e: lahaur adhiveshan mein javaharalal neharu ki adhyakshata mein 'purn svaraj' ka sankalp liya gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1929 ke lahaur adhiveshan mein kangres ka mukhy lakshy kya ghoshit kiya gaya tha? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. In tathyon ke chalte purn svaraj (Purna Swaraj / Complete Independence) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - adhirajy ka darja, svashasan, sanvaidhanik sudhar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar purn svaraj (Purna Swaraj / Complete Independence) hi hai. Exam point: purn svaraj (Purna Swaraj / Complete Independence) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Why was the Simon Commission called the 'White Commission'?
qh: साइमन कमीशन (Simon Commission) को 'श्वेत आयोग' (White Commission) क्यों कहा गया?
o: इसमें एक भी भारतीय सदस्य नहीं था (No Indian member was included)
e: kamishan ke sabhi 7 sadasy angrej the, isalie isaka bharat mein k a virodh hua. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki saiman kamishan (Simon Commission) ko 'shvet ayog' (White Commission) kyon kaha gaya? In tathyon ke chalte isamein ek bhi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha (No Indian member was included) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - angreji bhasha ke karan, yurop mein banane ke karan, shanti ke karan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad isamein ek bhi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: isamein ek bhi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha (No Indian member was included) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: When did Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt throw bombs in the Assembly?
qh: भगत सिंह और बटुकेश्वर दत्त ने असेंबली में बम कब फेंका था?
e: damanakari pablik sephti bil ke virodh mein unhonne bahari sarakar ko sunane ke lie bam pheinka tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki bhagat sinh aur batukeshvar datt ne aseinbali mein bam kab pheinka tha? Isliye sahi nateeja 8 aprail 1929 (8th April 1929) nikalta hai. 1925, 1931, 1928 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar 8 aprail 1929 (8th April 1929) hi hai. Exam point: 8 aprail 1929 (8th April 1929) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: When was Gandhi sentenced to 6 years for sedition for his articles in 'Young India'?
qh: गांधीजी को 'यंग इंडिया' में उनके लेखों के लिए राजद्रोह के तहत 6 साल की सजा कब हुई थी?
e: asahayog andolan ki vapasi ke bad march 1922 mein unhein giraphtar kiya gaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki gandhiji ko 'yang indiya' mein unake lekhon ke lie rajadroh ke tahat 6 sal ki saja kab hui thi? Isliye antim jawab 1922 ke roop mein milta hai. 1919, 1942, 1930 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 1922 hi hai. Exam point: 1922 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many selected followers accompanied Gandhi on the Dandi March?
qh: गांधीजी की दांडी यात्रा में उनके साथ कुल कितने चुने हुए अनुयायी थे?
e: gandhiji ne apane sabaramati ashram ke 78 sahayogiyon ke sath 240 mil ki yatra shuru ki thi. Is sawaal mein 78 ki baat hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 78 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti 500, 10, 100 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 78 hi milti hai. Exam point: 78 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the primary feature of the Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms?
qh: मोंटेग्यू-चेम्सफोर्ड सुधार (1919) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: प्रांतों में द्वैध शासन (Dyarchy in provinces)
e: 1919 ke ekt ne pranton mein shasan ke vishayon ko do bhagon (hastantarit aur arakshit) mein banta tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki montegyu-chemsaphord sudhar (1919) ka mukhy uddeshy kya tha? dyarchy mein soobon ki satta do hisson - hastantarit tatha aarakshit - mein banti thi. Isi karan se pranton mein dvaidh shasan (Dyarchy in provinces) sahi uttar hai. purn svaraj, ekata, sati pratha ka ant alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar pranton mein dvaidh shasan (Dyarchy in provinces) baithta hai. Exam point: pranton mein dvaidh shasan (Dyarchy in provinces) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In his 11 demands, what percentage cut in military spending did Gandhi ask for?
qh: गांधीजी ने अपनी 11 सूत्रीय मांगों में सेना के खर्च में कितने प्रतिशत कटौती की मांग की थी?
e: gandhiji ne sainy vyay aur sivil seva ke vetan mein 50% katauti ki mang rakhi thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gandhiji ne apani 11 sutriy mangon mein sena ke kharch mein kitane pratishat katauti ki mang ki thi? Isliye sahi nateeja 50% nikalta hai. 25%, 10%, 100% ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 50% baithta hai. Exam point: 50% - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who formed the 'Swaraj Party' after the suspension of Non-Cooperation?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के स्थगित होने के बाद 'स्वराज पार्टी' का गठन किसने किया था?
o: सी.आर. दास और मोतीलाल नेहरू (C.R. Das & Motilal Nehru)
e: 1923 mein gaya adhiveshan ke bad parishadon mein pravesh ke uddeshy se is parti ka gathan hua. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki asahayog andolan ke sthagit hone ke bad 'svaraj parti' ka gathan kisane kiya tha? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isi aadhar par si.ar. das aur motilal neharu (C.R. Das & Motilal Nehru) chuna jaata hai. jinna, patel aur bos, gandhi aur neharu in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad si.ar. das aur motilal neharu (C.R. Das & Motilal Nehru) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: si.ar. das aur motilal neharu (C.R. Das... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were considered the 'two keys' to breaking Gandhi's movements?
qh: गांधीजी के आंदोलन को तोड़ने की 'दो चाबियाँ' (Two Keys) क्या मानी जाती थीं?
o: हिंसा का भड़कना और स्वेच्छा से वापसी (Outbreak of violence & voluntary withdrawal)
e: gandhiji ka andolan ya to hinsa hone par rukata tha ya unake dvara khud vapas lene par. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gandhiji ke andolan ko todane ki 'do chabiyan' (Two Keys) kya mani jati thin? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi tathya par hinsa ka bhadakana aur svechchha se vapasi... tika hua hai. paise aur pad, jhuth aur chhal, hathiyar aur sena ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar hinsa ka bhadakana aur svechchha se vapasi... hi hai. Exam point: hinsa ka bhadakana aur svechchha se vapasi (Outbreak of violence & voluntary withdrawal) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Under which pact did Gandhi suspend the movement to go to London in 1931?
qh: 1931 में लंदन जाने के लिए गांधीजी ने किस समझौते के तहत आंदोलन स्थगित किया?
e: is samajhaute ke bad savinay avajna andolan ko dusare charan ke lie sthagit kar diya gaya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1931 mein landan jane ke lie gandhiji ne kis samajhaute ke tahat andolan sthagit kiya? Isliye sahi nateeja gandhi-iravin samajhauta (Gandhi-Irwin Pact) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - shimala paikt, puna paikt, lakhanau paikt - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav gandhi-iravin samajhauta (Gandhi-Irwin Pact) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: gandhi-iravin samajhauta (Gandhi-Irwin Pact) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Gandhi compared 1924 arrests to which 'Black Act'?
qh: गांधीजी ने किस 'काले कानून' की तुलना में 1924 की गिरफ्तारियों की आलोचना की थी?
e: gandhiji ka manana tha ki damanakari manobhav rolet ekt ke samay jaise hi the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gandhiji ne kis 'kale kanun' ki tulana mein 1924 ki giraphtariyon ki alochana ki thi? Isliye antim jawab rolet ekt (Rowlatt Act) ke roop mein milta hai. pres ekt, varnakular ekt, ilbart bil alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar rolet ekt (Rowlatt Act) hi hai. Exam point: rolet ekt (Rowlatt Act) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Whom did Gandhi blame for 'Spiritual Fall'?
qh: गांधीजी ने 'अध्यात्मिक अधोपतन' (Spiritual Fall) के लिए किसे जिम्मेदार ठहराया?
o: ब्रिटिश हुकूमत और थोपी गई पाश्चात्य संस्कृति (British rule & imposed Western culture)
e: gandhiji ka manana tha ki british shasan ne bharat ki sanskritik aur adhyatmik j en khokhali kar di hain. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gandhiji ne 'adhyatmik adhopatan' (Spiritual Fall) ke lie kise jimmedar thaharaya? Isi tathya par british hukumat aur thopi gai pashchaty sanskriti... tika hua hai. prakriti ko, bharatiyon ko, dharmik netaon ko anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar british hukumat aur thopi gai pashchaty sanskriti (British rule & imposed Western culture) hai. Exam point: british hukumat aur thopi gai pashchaty sanskriti (British rule & imposed Western culture) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many people per village did Gandhi imagine joining the movement from India's 7 lakh villages?
qh: गांधीजी ने सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन की सफलता के लिए देश के 7 लाख गाँवों से औसतन कितने लोगों के जुड़ने की कल्पना की थी?
e: gandhiji ka manana tha ki yadi har ganv se keval 10 log bhi ju en, to 70 lakh ki bhi sarakar ko bebas kar degi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki gandhiji ne savinay avajna andolan ki saphalata ke lie desh ke 7 lakh ganvon se ausatan kitane logon ke ju ne ki kalpana ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 10 log (10 people) hi sahi baithta hai. 50 log, 1000 log, 100 log ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 10 log (10 people) hai. Exam point: 10 log (10 people) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the distance covered by Gandhi from Sabarmati to Dandi to break the salt law?
qh: गांधीजी ने नमक कानून तोड़ने के लिए साबरमती से दांडी तक की कितनी दूरी तय की थी?
e: gandhiji ne apane 78 anuyayiyon ke sath 240 mil ki lanbi padayatra 24 dinon mein puri ki thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gandhiji ne namak kanun to ne ke lie sabaramati se dandi tak ki kitani duri tay ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 240 mil (240 Miles) hi sahi baithta hai. 500 mil, 100 mil, 150 mil anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 240 mil (240 Miles) hai. Exam point: 240 mil (240 Miles) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In the Ahmedabad Mill strike, what percentage of wage hike did Gandhi consider 'truthful' (justified)?
qh: अहमदाबाद मिल आंदोलन में गांधीजी ने मजदूरों के लिए कितने प्रतिशत वेतन वृद्धि की मांग को 'सत्य' (उचित) माना था?
e: majadur 50% mang rahe the, par gandhiji ne arthik vishleshan ke bad 35% ko uchit aur nyayasangat mana. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki ahamadabad mil andolan mein gandhiji ne majaduron ke lie kitane pratishat vetan vriddhi ki mang ko 'saty' (uchit) mana tha? Isi baat se 35% sahi sabit hota hai. 20%, 50%, 75% is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 35% hi hai. Exam point: 35% - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who led the Salt Satyagraha on the Tanjore coast in Tamil Nadu?
qh: तमिलनाडु में तंजावुर तट पर नमक सत्याग्रह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: si. rajagopalachari ne trichanapalli se vedaranyam tak namak yatra ka netritv kiya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki tamilanadu mein tanjavur tat par namak satyagrah ka netritv kisane kiya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi tathya par chakravarti rajagopalachari (C. Rajagopalachari) tika hua hai. ke. kelappan, javaharalal neharu, sarojini nayadu mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar chakravarti rajagopalachari (C. Rajagopalachari) hi hai. Exam point: chakravarti rajagopalachari (C. Rajagopalachari) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: From where to where did the Vaikom leaders organize the salt march in Kerala?
qh: वायकोम सत्याग्रह के नेताओं ने केरल में कहाँ से कहाँ तक नमक यात्रा आयोजित की थी?
e: keral mein ke. kelappan jaise netaon ne kalikat se payanur tak ki yatra kar namak kanun to a. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki vayakom satyagrah ke netaon ne keral mein kahan se kahan tak namak yatra ayojit ki thi? Isliye sahi nateeja kalikat se payanur (Calicut to Payyanur) nikalta hai. Galti dandi se surat, kochchi se madras, ahamadabad se dandi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar kalikat se payanur (Calicut to Payyanur) hi hai. Exam point: kalikat se payanur (Calicut to Payyanur) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who led the Civil Disobedience Movement in the North-West Frontier Province (Peshawar)?
qh: उत्तर-पश्चिमी सीमांत प्रांत (Peshawar) में सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
o: खान अब्दुल गफ्फार खान (Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan)
e: khan abdul gaphphar khan ko 'simant gandhi' kaha jata hai, unhonne 'lal kurti' andolan chalaya tha. Yahaan civil se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. civil disobedience mein kanoon todkar sarkari kaam rokne ki appeal thi. Isi aadhar par khan abdul gaphphar khan (Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan) chuna jaata hai. liyakat ali, shaukat ali, mohammad ali jinna anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar khan abdul gaphphar khan (Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan) baithta hai. Exam point: khan abdul gaphphar khan (Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the main center of the 'Red Shirts' movement during the CDM?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के दौरान 'लाल कुर्ती' (Red Shirts) आंदोलन का मुख्य केंद्र क्या था?
e: peshavar mein khudai khidamatagaron ne lal kurti pahanakar ahinsak virodh ka adbhut udaharan pesh kiya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki savinay avajna andolan ke dauran 'lal kurti' (Red Shirts) andolan ka mukhy keindr kya tha? Isi baat se peshavar (Peshawar) sahi sabit hota hai. banbai, madras, bangal is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad peshavar (Peshawar) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: peshavar (Peshawar) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Approximately how many village officials resigned during Gandhi's Dandi March?
qh: गांधीजी की दांडी यात्रा के दौरान लगभग कितने सरकारी अधिकारियों (Gram Adhikari) ने अपने पदों से इस्तीफा दे दिया था?
e: yatra ke prabhav mein akar gujarat ke lagabhag 300 gramin adhikariyon ne sarakari naukariyon ka tyag kar diya tha. Is sawaal mein 300 ki baat hai. Isi baat se 300 sahi sabit hota hai. Galti 1000, 100, 50 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 300 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 300 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who led the non-violent raid on the Dharsana Salt Works?
qh: धरसाना (Dharsana) नमक कारखाने पर अहिंसक धावे का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: gandhiji ki giraphtari ke bad sarojini nayadu, imam sahab aur manilal ne dharasana mein netritv sanbhala. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki dharasana (Dharsana) namak karakhane par ahinsak dhave ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Isi karan se sarojini nayadu (Sarojini Naidu) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp javaharalal neharu, subhash chandr bos, vallabhabhai patel bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar sarojini nayadu (Sarojini Naidu) hai. Exam point: sarojini nayadu (Sarojini Naidu) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date did Gandhi violate the salt law by picking up a handful of salt at Dandi?
qh: गांधीजी ने किस तिथि को दांडी में मुट्ठी भर नमक उठाकर नमक कानून का उल्लंघन किया था?
e: 6 aprail 1930 ki subah gandhiji ne aupacharik rup se namak kanun to a aur savinay avajna shuru ki. Is prashn ka kendra 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) hai. Isi tathya par 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) tika hua hai. 26 janavari 1930, 12 march 1930, 13 aprail 1930 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) sahi hai. Exam point: 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the literal meaning of 'Civil Disobedience'?
qh: 'सविनय अवज्ञा' (Civil Disobedience) शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: विनयपूर्वक आज्ञा को न मानना (Disobeying orders politely)
e: savinay ka arth hai vinay ke sath aur avajna ka arth hai ajna n manana. gandhiji ne ise british kanunon ke khilaph ek ahinsak hathiyar banaya. Is prashn ka vishay civil hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par vinayapurvak ajna ko n manana (Disobeying orders... sahi nikalta hai. hinsak virodh karana, chupachap baithana, kanun ka palan karana mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad vinayapurvak ajna ko n manana (Disobeying orders politely) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: vinayapurvak ajna ko n manana (Disobeying orders... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many points of demand did Gandhi ji place before Irwin before starting the movement?
qh: गांधीजी ने सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन शुरू करने से पहले इरविन के सामने कितनी सूत्रीय मांगें रखी थीं?
e: gandhiji ne apani 11 sutriy mangon ko apani patrika 'yang indiya' (harijan ke sandarbh mein charcha) ke madhyam se lord iravin ke samane rakha tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhiji ne savinay avajna andolan shuru karane se pahale iravin ke samane kitani sutriy mangein rakhi thin? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 11 sahi nikalta hai. 15, 20, 5 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 11 hi milti hai. Exam point: 11 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which main object did Gandhi ji choose as a symbol for the Civil Disobedience Movement?
qh: गांधीजी ने सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के लिए किस मुख्य वस्तु को प्रतीक के रूप में चुना?
e: namak ek aisi vastu thi jo amir aur garib donon se judai thi, isalie gandhiji ne ise andolan ka mukhy mudda banaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gandhiji ne savinay avajna andolan ke lie kis mukhy vastu ko pratik ke rup mein chuna? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par namak (Salt) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. kapada, pani, anaj mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav namak (Salt) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: namak (Salt) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On which date did the Salt Satyagraha (Dandi March) start from Sabarmati Ashram?
qh: नमक सत्याग्रह (दांडी यात्रा) की शुरुआत साबरमती आश्रम से किस तिथि को हुई थी?
e: gandhiji ne 12 march 1930 ko apane 78 anuyayiyon ke sath sabaramati se dandi ki yatra shuru ki thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki namak satyagrah (dandi yatra) ki shuruat sabaramati ashram se kis tithi ko hui thi? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye antim jawab 12 march 1930 (12th March 1930) ke roop mein milta hai. 6 aprail 1930, 15 agast 1929, 26 janavari 1930 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 12 march 1930 (12th March 1930) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 12 march 1930 (12th March 1930) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many selected followers were with Gandhi ji in the Dandi March?
qh: गांधीजी के साथ दांडी यात्रा में कितने चुने हुए अनुयायी (Followers) शामिल थे?
e: shuruat mein gandhiji ke sath sabaramati ashram ke 78 sadasy the, jo bad mein ek vishal janasamuh mein badal gaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhiji ke sath dandi yatra mein kitane chune hue anuyayi (Followers) shamil the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 78 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 50, 72, 100 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 78 baithta hai. Exam point: 78 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the total approximate distance from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi?
qh: साबरमती आश्रम से दांडी तक की कुल दूरी लगभग कितनी थी?
e: yah yatra lagabhag 240 mil (385 kimi) lanbi thi, jise 24 dinon mein pura kiya gaya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki sabaramati ashram se dandi tak ki kul duri lagabhag kitani thi? Isi tathya par 240 mil (240 Miles) tika hua hai. 500 mil, 300 mil, 100 mil mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 240 mil (240 Miles) hi hai. Exam point: 240 mil (240 Miles) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On which date did Gandhi ji break the salt law in Dandi?
qh: गांधीजी ने किस तिथि को दांडी में नमक कानून तोड़ा था?
e: 6 aprail 1930 ki subah gandhiji ne samudr tat par mutthi bhar namak uthakar namak kanun ka ullanghan kiya tha. Yah prashn 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) se juda hai. Isliye sahi nateeja 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) nikalta hai. 1 mai 1930, 12 march 1930, 20 march 1930 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) sahi hai. Exam point: 6 aprail 1930 (6th April 1930) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the Viceroy of India during the Civil Disobedience Movement?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के दौरान भारत का वायसराय कौन था?
e: lord iravin us samay bharat ke vayasaray the jinhonne gandhiji ki 11 mangon ko najarandaj kar diya tha. Yah prashn civil se juda hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par lord iravin (Lord Irwin) sahi nikalta hai. Galti lord chemsaphord, lord mauntabetan, lord karjan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar lord iravin (Lord Irwin) hi hai. Exam point: lord iravin (Lord Irwin) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In Gandhi's 11 demands, what percentage of military expenditure reduction was requested?
qh: गांधीजी की 11 सूत्रीय मांगों में सेना पर होने वाले व्यय को कितने प्रतिशत कम करने की बात कही गई थी?
e: gandhiji ne sena ke kharch aur sivil seva ke vetan mein 50% ki katauti ki mang ki thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gandhiji ki 11 sutriy mangon mein sena par hone vale vyay ko kitane pratishat kam karane ki bat kahi gai thi? Isi karan se 50% sahi uttar hai. 75%, 10%, 25% alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 50% hai. Exam point: 50% - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Where was the 1929 Congress session held, in which 'Purna Swaraj' was aimed?
qh: 1929 का कांग्रेस अधिवेशन, जिसमें 'पूर्ण स्वराज' का लक्ष्य रखा गया, कहाँ हुआ था?
e: lahaur adhiveshan (1929) mein javaharalal neharu ki adhyakshata mein 'purn svaraj' ka prastav parit kiya gaya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1929 ka kangres adhiveshan, jisamein 'purn svaraj' ka lakshy rakha gaya, kahan hua tha? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isi karan se lahaur (Lahore) sahi uttar hai. banbai, kalakatta, madras ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad lahaur (Lahore) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: lahaur (Lahore) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: According to Gandhi, why should the British government not have the right to tax salt?
qh: गांधीजी के अनुसार, ब्रिटिश सरकार को नमक पर कर लगाने का अधिकार क्यों नहीं होना चाहिए था?
o: क्योंकि नमक मानवीय अस्तित्व की बुनियादी जरूरत है (It is a basic human necessity)
क्योंकि नमक केवल अमीर खाते थे
e: namak bhojan ka anivary hissa tha aur is par kar lagana gandhiji ki drishti mein amanaviy tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gandhiji ke anusar, british sarakar ko namak par kar lagane ka adhikar kyon nahin hona chahie tha? Isi karan se kyonki namak manaviy astitv ki buniyadi jarurat hai (It is a basic human necessity) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - kyonki namak hanikarak hai, kyonki namak mahanga tha, kyonki namak keval amir khate the - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar kyonki namak manaviy astitv ki buniyadi jarurat... hi hai. Exam point: kyonki namak manaviy astitv ki buniyadi jarurat... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What medium did Gandhi ji use for his demands to warn the government?
qh: गांधीजी ने अपनी मांगों के लिए किस माध्यम का उपयोग किया ताकि सरकार को चेतावनी दी जा सके?
o: यंग इंडिया/हरिजन पत्रिका और पत्र (Young India/Harijan & Letters)
e: unhonne apani patrikaon aur vayasaray ko likhe patron ke madhyam se sarvajanik rup se apani yojanaen spasht ki thin. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gandhiji ne apani mangon ke lie kis madhyam ka upayog kiya taki sarakar ko chetavani di ja sake? Isliye sahi nateeja yang indiya/harijan patrika aur patr (Young India/Harijan & Letters) nikalta hai. gupt sandesh, telivijan, rediyo mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav yang indiya/harijan patrika aur patr (Young India/Harijan & Letters) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: yang indiya/harijan patrika aur patr (Young India/Harijan... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which two main weapons did the British use to break Gandhi's non-violent movement?
qh: गांधीजी के अहिंसक आंदोलन को तोड़ने के लिए ब्रिटिश सरकार किन दो मुख्य हथियारों का प्रयोग करती थी?
o: हिंसा भड़काना और उपेक्षा (Instigating violence & Neglect)
e: sarakar chahati thi ki andolan mein hinsa ho jae taki use kuchalane ka bahana mile. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gandhiji ke ahinsak andolan ko to ne ke lie british sarakar kin do mukhy hathiyaron ka prayog karati thi? Isi baat se hinsa bh kana aur upeksha (Instigating violence & Neglect) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - sena aur pulis, puraskar aur lalach, batachit aur sandhi - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar hinsa bh kana aur upeksha (Instigating violence & Neglect) baithta hai. Exam point: hinsa bh kana aur upeksha (Instigating violence & Neglect) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the next step of the movement after breaking the salt law?
qh: नमक कानून तोड़ने के बाद आंदोलन का अगला चरण क्या था?
o: पूरे देश में सविनय अवज्ञा का प्रसार (Spread of Civil Disobedience across India)
e: dandi mein kanun tutane ke bad, pure desh mein logon ne namak banana aur sarakari kanunon ka ullanghan karana shuru kar diya. Prashn yah batata hai ki namak kanun to ne ke bad andolan ka agala charan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par pure desh mein savinay avajna ka prasar... sahi nikalta hai. Galti andolan band karana, videsh jana, chunav l na chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan pure desh mein savinay avajna ka prasar (Spread of Civil Disobedience across India) hi milti hai. Exam point: pure desh mein savinay avajna ka prasar... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many Indian members were included in the Simon Commission?
qh: साइमन कमीशन में कितने भारतीय सदस्य शामिल थे?

Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki saiman kamishan mein kitane bharatiy sadasy shamil the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 0 (Zero) hi sahi baithta hai. 3, 5, 7 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar 0 (Zero) hi hai. Exam point: 0 (Zero) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the demand regarding 'political prisoners' in Gandhi's list?
qh: गांधीजी की मांगों में 'राजनीतिक कैदियों' के संदर्भ में क्या मांग थी?
o: उन्हें जेल से मुक्त करना (To release them)
e: gandhiji ne mang ki thi ki ahinsak andolanon ke dauran pakadae gae sabhi rajanitik kaidiyon ko riha kiya jae. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gandhiji ki mangon mein 'rajanitik kaidiyon' ke sandarbh mein kya mang thi? Isi aadhar par unhein jel se mukt karana (To release them) chuna jaata hai. unhein k i saja dena, unhein sarakari naukari dena, unhein videsh bhejana in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab unhein jel se mukt karana (To release... hai. Exam point: unhein jel se mukt karana (To release them) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Whom did Gandhi ji blame for 'Spiritual Fall'?
qh: गांधीजी ने 'अध्यात्मिक अधोपतन' (Spiritual Fall) के लिए किसे जिम्मेदार ठहराया था?
o: ब्रिटिश शिक्षा और आधुनिकता (British education and modernization)
e: british shasan dvara thopi gai adhunikata aur sanskriti ko gandhiji ne naitik patan ka karan mana. Yah prashn british shiksha aur adhunikata (British education and modernization) se juda hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par british shiksha aur adhunikata (British education and... sahi nikalta hai. bharatiyon ko, dharm ko, prachin sanskriti ko alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab british shiksha aur adhunikata (British education and... hai. Exam point: british shiksha aur adhunikata (British education and modernization) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which state was 'Sabarmati Ashram' located during the movement?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के दौरान 'साबरमती आश्रम' किस राज्य में स्थित था?
e: sabaramati ashram gujarat ke ahamadabad mein sthit hai, jahan se dandi yatra shuru hui thi. Is prashn ka kendra gujarat hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par gujarat sahi nikalta hai. Galti bihar, maharashtr, uttar pradesh chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan gujarat hi milti hai. Exam point: gujarat - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: For how many days did Gandhi's Dandi March last?
qh: गांधीजी की दांडी यात्रा कितने दिनों तक चली थी?
e: 12 march se shuru hokar 6 aprail tak, yah yatra kul 24 dinon tak chali thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki gandhiji ki dandi yatra kitane dinon tak chali thi? Yahi wajah hai ki 24 din (24 Days) sahi hai. Vikalp 40 din, 10 din, 30 din bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se 24 din (24 Days) sahi hai. Exam point: 24 din (24 Days) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main objective of the Civil Disobedience Movement?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
e: 1929 ke lahaur prastav ke bad, is andolan ka antim lakshy bharat ke lie purn svatantrata prapt karana tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki savinay avajna andolan ka mukhy uddeshy kya tha? civil disobedience mein kanoon todkar sarkari kaam rokne ki appeal thi. Isi aadhar par purn svaraj (Complete Independence) chuna jaata hai. Galti naukari pana, videsh yatra, kuchh riyayatein pana chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav purn svaraj (Complete Independence) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: purn svaraj (Complete Independence) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main purpose of the British government using the term 'terrorist' for revolutionary activities?
qh: क्रांतिकारी गतिविधियों के संदर्भ में 'आतंकवादी' शब्द का ब्रिटिश सरकार द्वारा प्रयोग किए जाने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: जनता की नजर में क्रांतिकारियों को अपराधी सिद्ध करना (To criminalize revolutionaries in public eye)
e: british sarakar krantikariyon ke bhay ko dabane aur unhein samaj mein badanam karane ke lie is shabd ka prayog karati thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki krantikari gatividhiyon ke sandarbh mein 'atankavadi' shabd ka british sarakar dvara prayog kie jane ka mukhy uddeshy kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par janata ki najar mein krantikariyon ko aparadhi... sahi nikalta hai. krantikariyon ka samman karana, shanti banae rakhana, unhein puraskar dena mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar janata ki najar mein krantikariyon ko aparadhi siddh karana (To criminalize revolutionaries in public eye) hai. qe: In which year were the revolutionaries released in India after World War I?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के बाद भारत में क्रांतिकारियों की रिहाई किस वर्ष की गई थी?

qe: What kind of feeling arose among young revolutionaries after the sudden suspension of the Non-Cooperation Movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के अचानक स्थगन से युवा क्रांतिकारियों में किस प्रकार की भावना पैदा हुई?

Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki asahayog andolan ke achanak sthagan se yuva krantikariyon mein kis prakar ki bhavana paida hui? Isi karan se gahari nirasha aur ahinsa se mohabhang (Deep disappointment & disillusionment with non-violence) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp utsah, angrejon ke prati prem, alasy bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav gahari nirasha aur ahinsa se mohabhang (Deep disappointment & disillusionment with non-violence) hi thehrta hai. qe: In which city was the 'Hindustan Republican Association' (HRA) founded in 1924?
qh: 1924 में 'हिंदुस्तान रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन' (HRA) की स्थापना किस शहर में हुई थी?
e: ramaprasad bismil, yogesh chatarji aur sachindranath sanyal ne kanapur mein HRA ki ninv rakhi thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1924 mein 'hindustan ripablikan esosieshan' (HRA) ki sthapana kis shahar mein hui thi? Sabhi baaton ke baad kanapur (Kanpur) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kanapur (Kanpur) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which famous revolutionary's book 'Bandi Jiwan' became a 'textbook' for revolutionaries?
qh: किस प्रसिद्ध क्रांतिकारी की पुस्तक 'बंदी जीवन' (Bandi Jiwan) क्रांतिकारियों के लिए एक 'पाठ्यपुस्तक' बन गई थी?
e: sachindranath sanyal ki 'bandi jivan' ne yuvaon mein kranti ki jvala ko prajvalit karane mein mahatvapurn bhumika nibhai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kis prasiddh krantikari ki pustak 'bandi jivan' (Bandi Jiwan) krantikariyon ke lie ek 'pathyapustak' ban gai thi? In tathyon ke chalte sachindranath sanyal (Sachindra Nath Sanyal) hi sahi hai. chandrashekhar ajad, bhagat sinh, rajaguru is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab sachindranath sanyal (Sachindra Nath Sanyal) hai. Exam point: sachindranath sanyal (Sachindra Nath Sanyal) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date did the Kakori Train Action occur?
qh: काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन (जिसे पहले काकोरी कांड कहा जाता था) किस तिथि को हुआ था?
e: HRA ke krantikariyon ne saharanapur-lakhanau lain par kakori mein sarakari khajana lutane ke lie tren roki thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki kakori tren ekshan (jise pahale kakori kand kaha jata tha) kis tithi ko hua tha? Isi karan se 9 agast 1925 (9th August 1925) sahi uttar hai. 5 pharavari 1922, 23 march 1931, 13 aprail 1919 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 9 agast 1925 (9th August 1925) hi milti hai. Exam point: 9 agast 1925 (9th August 1925) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who among these was NOT sentenced to death for the Kakori Train Action?
qh: इनमें से किस क्रांतिकारी को काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन के लिए फाँसी की सजा नहीं हुई थी?
e: ajad kabhi pulis ki pak mein nahin ae, jabaki bismil, ashaphak, lahidai aur roshan sinh ko phansi hui. Exam point: chandrashekhar ajad (Chandrashekhar Azad) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which year was HRA renamed to 'Hindustan Socialist Republican Association' (HSRA)?
qh: HRA का नाम बदलकर 'हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन' (HSRA) किस वर्ष किया गया?
e: chandrashekhar ajad aur bhagat sinh ke netritv mein dilli ke phirojashah kotala mein parti ko punargathit kiya gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki HRA ka nam badalakar 'hindustan soshalist ripablikan esosieshan' (HSRA) kis varsh kiya gaya? Isliye sahi nateeja 1928 nikalta hai. 1925, 1932, 1930 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1928 hai. Exam point: 1928 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the main purpose of adding the word 'Socialist' to HSRA?
qh: HSRA के गठन में 'सोशलिस्ट' (समाजवादी) शब्द जोड़ने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: शोषण मुक्त और समतावादी समाज की स्थापना (Establishment of an egalitarian society)

Prashn yah batata hai ki HSRA ke gathan mein 'soshalist' (samajavadi) shabd jo ne ka mukhy uddeshy kya tha? Isi baat se shoshan mukt aur samatavadi samaj ki sthapana (Establishment of an egalitarian society) sahi sabit hota hai. keval nam badalana, punjipatiyon ka samarthan, videshi nivesh alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar shoshan mukt aur samatavadi samaj ki sthapana (Establishment of an egalitarian society) hi hai. Exam point: shoshan mukt aur samatavadi samaj ki sthapana... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which line was the train coming that revolutionaries targeted during Kakori Action?
qh: काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन के दौरान क्रांतिकारियों ने किस स्टेशन से आने वाली ट्रेन को निशाना बनाया था?
e: 8-daun tren saharanapur se lakhanau ki or ja rahi thi jab use kakori mein roka gaya. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar saharanapur-lakhanau (Saharanpur-Lucknow) hai. Exam point: saharanapur-lakhanau (Saharanpur-Lucknow) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What kind of state did HRA aim to make India?
qh: एच.आर.ए. (HRA) का मुख्य लक्ष्य भारत को किस प्रकार का राज्य बनाना था?

Galti rusi kranti ka prabhav, majadur sanghon ka uday, samyavadi vicharon ka prasar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Exam point: gandhi ji ki purn saphalata (Complete success... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

Exam point: chandrashekhar ajad (Chandrashekhar Azad) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Through which organization was Bhagat Singh mobilizing the youth of Punjab?
qh: भगत सिंह किस क्रांतिकारी संगठन के माध्यम से पंजाब के युवाओं को संगठित कर रहे थे?

In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad gorakhapur, phaijabad, naini aur gonda (Gorakhpur, Faizabad, Naini & Gonda) hi theek uttar hai. (HSRA) ka punargathan dilli ke kis maidan mein hua tha? Galti keval manoranjan ke lie, bhay phailane ke lie, netaon ko marane ke lie chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. qe: Why did Gandhi decide to support Swarajists despite being against their policies?
qh: गांधी जी ने स्वराजियों (Swarajists) की नीतियों का विरोधी होने के बावजूद उनका साथ देना क्यों स्वीकार किया?

e: gandhi ji nahin chahate the ki kangres mein dobara 1907 jaisa vibhajan ho, jisase british sarakar ko phayada mile. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhi ji ne svarajiyon (Swarajists) ki nitiyon ka virodhi hone ke bavajud unaka sath dena kyon svikar kiya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par rashtriy ekata banae rakhane aur sarakar ka manobal n b ne dene ke lie (To maintain unity & not boost govt morale) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. angrejon ke dabav mein, paise ki kami ke karan, ve thak chuke the anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. qe: Which prominent leaders were arrested by the govt in Oct 1924 as part of suppression?

o: सुभाष चंद्र बोस और एस.सी. मित्र (Subhas Chandra Bose & S.C. Mitra)
e: sarakar ne svarajiyon ki b ti lokapriyata se darakar subhash chandr bos sahit kai netaon ko giraphtar kiya tha. qe: In 'Young India', Gandhi compared the 1924 arrests to which act?
qh: गांधी जी ने 'यंग इंडिया' में किस कानून की तुलना में 1924 की गिरफ्तारियों की आलोचना की थी?
e: gandhi ji ne kaha ki rolet ekt ke manobhav aj bhi british sarakar mein jinda hain. Yah prashn rolet ekt (Rowlatt Act) se juda hai. Isi karan se rolet ekt (Rowlatt Act) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - sati nishedh kanun, ilbart bil, varnakular pres ekt - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan rolet ekt (Rowlatt Act) hi milti hai. Exam point: rolet ekt (Rowlatt Act) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who presided over the 1924 Belgaum session of Congress?
qh: दिसंबर 1924 के 'बेलगाँव अधिवेशन' की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
e: belaganv adhiveshan ekamatr kangres adhiveshan tha jisaki adhyakshata svayan mahatma gandhi ne ki thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki disanbar 1924 ke 'belaganv adhiveshan' ki adhyakshata kisane ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par mahatma gandhi hi sahi baithta hai. chittaranjan das, motilal neharu, sarojini nayadu anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan mahatma gandhi hi milti hai. Exam point: mahatma gandhi - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How many seats did the Swaraj Party win out of 101 in the 1923 elections?
qh: स्वराज पार्टी ने 1923 के केंद्रीय विधायी चुनावों में 101 में से कितनी सीटों पर जीत दर्ज की थी?
e: svarajiyon ne 42 siton par jit hasil kar parishad ke bhitar ek majabut vipaksh ki bhumika nibhai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki svaraj parti ne 1923 ke keindriy vidhayi chunavon mein 101 mein se kitani siton par jit darj ki thi? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isi karan se 42 sahi uttar hai. Galti 20, 60, 10 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 42 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 42 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was elected as the Speaker of the Central Legislative Assembly in 1925?
qh: 1925 में केंद्रीय विधानसभा (Central Legislative Assembly) का अध्यक्ष किसे चुना गया था?
e: vitthal bhai patel keindriy vidhanasabha ke pahale bharatiy adhyaksh (Speaker) bane, jo svarajiyon ki b i upalabdhi thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1925 mein keindriy vidhanasabha (Central Legislative Assembly) ka adhyaksh kise chuna gaya tha? In tathyon ke chalte vitthal bhai patel (Vithalbhai Patel) hi sahi hai. Vikalp madan mohan malaviy, motilal neharu, si.ar. das bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se vitthal bhai patel (Vithalbhai Patel) sahi hai. Exam point: vitthal bhai patel (Vithalbhai Patel) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which pillar of the Swaraj Party passed away on June 16, 1925?
qh: स्वराज पार्टी के किस प्रमुख स्तंभ का निधन 16 जून 1925 को हो गया था?
e: si.ar. das ke nidhan ke bad svaraj parti netritv ke sankat se ghir gai aur kamajor p gai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki svaraj parti ke kis pramukh stanbh ka nidhan 16 jun 1925 ko ho gaya tha? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isi aadhar par chittaranjan das (C.R. Das) chuna jaata hai. tilak, lala lajapat ray, motilal neharu in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad chittaranjan das (C.R. Das) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: chittaranjan das (C.R. Das) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Why did Swarajists' success prove to be merely 'on paper' despite their work?
qh: स्वराजियों द्वारा परिषद में किए गए कार्यों के बावजूद उनकी सफलता 'कागजी' क्यों साबित हुई?
o: वायसराय के विशेषाधिकारों (Veto Power) के कारण (Due to Viceroy's Veto powers)
e: parishad dvara kharij kie gae kanunon ko vayasaray apane visheshadhikar se dobara lagu kar deta tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki svarajiyon dvara parishad mein kie gae karyon ke bavajud unaki saphalata 'kagaji' kyon sabit hui? Isi karan se vayasaray ke visheshadhikaron (Veto Power) ke karan (Due to Viceroy's Veto powers) sahi uttar hai. janata ne sath nahin diya, ve anap the, ve kam nahin karate the is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar vayasaray ke visheshadhikaron (Veto Power) ke karan (Due to Viceroy's Veto powers) hai. Exam point: vayasaray ke visheshadhikaron (Veto Power) ke karan... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was C.R. Das elected as Mayor in the 1923-24 local elections?
qh: 1923-24 के स्थानीय निकाय चुनावों में सी.आर. दास को कहाँ का मेयर चुना गया था?
e: si.ar. das kalakatta ke meyar chune gae, jabaki neharu ilahabad ke aur rajeindr prasad patana ke meyar bane. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1923-24 ke sthaniy nikay chunavon mein si.ar. das ko kahan ka meyar chuna gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kalakatta (Calcutta) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - ahamadabad, ilahabad, patana - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar kalakatta (Calcutta) hai. Exam point: kalakatta (Calcutta) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which year did the Swaraj Party finally decide to withdraw from the legislatures?
qh: स्वराज पार्टी ने अंततः किस वर्ष विधानमंडलों से हटने का फैसला किया?
e: antarik matabhedon aur sarakari chalon ke karan march 1926 mein svarajiyon ne parishad chho ne ka nirnay liya. Prashn yah batata hai ki svaraj parti ne antatah kis varsh vidhanamandalon se hatane ka phaisala kiya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1926 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1922, 1930, 1924 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1926 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1926 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the argument of 'No-Changers' against entering councils?
qh: कांग्रेस के भीतर 'अपरिवर्तनवादी' (No-Changers) गुट का परिषदों में प्रवेश को लेकर क्या तर्क था?
o: इससे रचनात्मक कार्य प्रभावित होंगे और राजनीतिक भ्रष्टाचार बढ़ेगा (Affect constructive work & increase corruption)
वे केवल आराम करना चाहते थे
e: aparivartanavadiyon ka manana tha ki parishad mein jane se rashtravadi utsah kam hoga aur sarakar pad ka lalach dekar netaon ko bhrasht kar sakati hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kangres ke bhitar 'aparivartanavadi' (No-Changers) gut ka parishadon mein pravesh ko lekar kya tark tha? Isliye antim jawab isase rachanatmak kary prabhavit honge aur rajanitik... ke roop mein milta hai. ve angrejon ke mitr the, ve chunav se darate the, ve keval aram karana chahate the alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab isase rachanatmak kary prabhavit honge aur rajanitik... hai. Exam point: isase rachanatmak kary prabhavit honge aur rajanitik bhrashtachar b ega (Affect constructive work & increase corruption) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the main objective of Swarajists behind entering the councils?
qh: 'परिवर्तनवादी' (Pro-Changers) या स्वराजियों का परिषद में जाने के पीछे मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: सरकारी कार्यों में बाधा डालना और गलत कानूनों का विरोध करना (Obstruct govt work & oppose wrong laws)
e: svarajiyon ka manana tha ki parishad ke bhitar jakar hi ve sarakar ki 'dhol ki pol' khol sakate hain aur unake damanakari karyon mein badha dal sakate hain. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 'parivartanavadi' (Pro-Changers) ya svarajiyon ka parishad mein jane ke pichhe mukhy uddeshy kya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki sarakari karyon mein badha dalana aur galat kanunon ka virodh karana (Obstruct govt work & oppose wrong laws) sahi hai. vetan prapt karana, angrejon ki seva karana, videshi yatra karana is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se sarakari karyon mein badha dalana aur galat kanunon ka virodh karana (Obstruct govt work & oppose wrong laws) sahi hai. Exam point: sarakari karyon mein badha dalana aur galat... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the biggest fear in the nationalist camp during 1923?
qh: राष्ट्रवादी खेमे में 1923 के दौरान किस बात का सबसे बड़ा भय व्याप्त था?
o: कांग्रेस का दोबारा विभाजन (Re-split of Congress)
e: 1907 ke surat vibhajan ki yadein ta a thin, isalie netaon ko dar tha ki pro-cheinjars aur no-cheinjars ke vivad se parti phir n tut jae. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rashtravadi kheme mein 1923 ke dauran kis bat ka sabase b a bhay vyapt tha? Isi karan se kangres ka dobara vibhajan (Re-split of Congress) sahi uttar hai. akal ka, japan ke akraman ka, mahamari ka is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kangres ka dobara vibhajan (Re-split of Congress) hi milti hai. Exam point: kangres ka dobara vibhajan (Re-split of Congress) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was the Special Session of Congress held in September 1923?

Isi tathya par dilli (Delhi) tika hua hai. kalakatta, banbai, madras is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar dilli (Delhi) hai. Exam point: dilli (Delhi) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was Gandhi released from jail due to his poor health?

Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gandhi ji ko unake kharab svasthy ke karan kis varsh jel se riha kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1924 hi sahi baithta hai. Galti 1926, 1922, 1923 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1924 baithta hai. Exam point: 1924 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Initially, what was Gandhi's stance towards Swarajists after his release?
qh: जेल से रिहाई के बाद शुरुआती दौर में स्वराजियों के प्रति गांधी जी का क्या रुख था?
o: वे उनके विचार से असहमत थे (He disagreed with their view)
e: gandhi ji shuru mein parishad pravesh ke vichar se sahamat nahin the kyonki yah unake ahinsak asahayog ke siddhanton ke viparit tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki jel se rihai ke bad shuruati daur mein svarajiyon ke prati gandhi ji ka kya rukh tha? Isi tathya par ve unake vichar se asahamat the (He... tika hua hai. Isliye sahi uttar ve unake vichar se asahamat the (He disagreed with their view) hi hai. Exam point: ve unake vichar se asahamat the (He disagreed with their view) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How did the Viceroy describe the difference between Gandhi and Swarajists in his letter?
qh: ब्रिटिश वायसराय ने गृह सचिव को लिखे पत्र में गांधी और स्वराजियों के बीच के मतभेद को क्या बताया?
e: vayasaray ko ummid thi ki gandhi aur svarajiyon ke bich b ti khai se rashtravadi andolan kamajor hoga aur ve isaka phayada utha paenge. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki british vayasaray ne grih sachiv ko likhe patr mein gandhi aur svarajiyon ke bich ke matabhed ko kya bataya? Isliye sahi nateeja b ti hui khai (A widening chasm/gulf) nikalta hai. ek chhoti si bahas, ek mahan ekata, vyaparik samajhauta is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav b ti hui khai (A widening chasm/gulf) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: b ti hui khai (A widening chasm/gulf) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What kind of relationship did Gandhi eventually establish with the Swarajists?
qh: गांधी जी ने अंततः स्वराजियों के साथ किस प्रकार का संबंध बनाया?
o: समन्वय और एकता का (Coordination and Unity)
e: gandhi ji ne apani duradarshita dikhate hue svarajiyon ke sath samanvay banaya taki british sarakar vibhajan ka phayada n utha sake. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gandhi ji ne antatah svarajiyon ke sath kis prakar ka sanbandh banaya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par samanvay aur ekata ka (Coordination and Unity) hi sahi baithta hai. shatrutapurn, parti chho di, duri bana li is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar samanvay aur ekata ka (Coordination and Unity) hi hai. Exam point: samanvay aur ekata ka (Coordination and Unity) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which activities were emphasized during the Congress meeting in Bardoli?
qh: बारदोली में कांग्रेस की बैठक के दौरान किन कार्यों पर विशेष बल दिया गया?
o: रचनात्मक कार्य जैसे स्वदेशी और अस्पृश्यता निवारण (Constructive work like Swadeshi & removal of untouchability)
e: rachanatmak karyon ke antargat khadi ka prachar, jativad ka virodh aur shiksha jaise muddon par jor diya gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki baradoli mein kangres ki baithak ke dauran kin karyon par vishesh bal diya gaya? swadeshi ka matlab desi maal apnana tatha videshi maal ka bahishkar tha. Yahi wajah hai ki rachanatmak kary jaise svadeshi aur asprishyata nivaran (Constructive work like Swadeshi & removal of untouchability) sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - keval karon ki charcha, shastr prashikshan, british sena mein bharti - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad rachanatmak kary jaise svadeshi aur asprishyata nivaran (Constructive work like Swadeshi & removal of untouchability) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: rachanatmak kary jaise svadeshi aur asprishyata nivaran (Constructive work like Swadeshi & removal of untouchability) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What loss did Swarajists predict if they boycotted the councils?
qh: स्वराजियों का मानना था कि परिषद का बहिष्कार करने से क्या नुकसान होगा?
o: गैर-कांग्रेसी और ब्रिटिश समर्थक सीटों पर कब्जा कर लेंगे (Pro-British elements would take the seats)
e: unaka tark tha ki yadi ve nahin jaenge, to khali siton par sarakar ke chapalus baith jaenge jo damanakari kanunon ko asani se pas kar deinge. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki svarajiyon ka manana tha ki parishad ka bahishkar karane se kya nukasan hoga? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par gair-kangresi aur british samarthak siton par kabja kar leinge (Pro-British elements would take the seats) hi sahi baithta hai. bhojan nahin milega, janata naraj hogi, paise kam ho jaenge mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab gair-kangresi aur british samarthak siton par kabja... hai. Exam point: gair-kangresi aur british samarthak siton par kabja... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How many years of imprisonment was Gandhi sentenced to in 1922?
qh: गांधी जी को 1922 में कितने वर्ष की सजा सुनाई गई थी?
e: gandhi ji ko rajadroh ke arop mein 6 sal ki saja hui thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gandhi ji ko 1922 mein kitane varsh ki saja sunai gai thi? Isliye antim jawab 6 varsh (6 Years) ke roop mein milta hai. 2 varsh, 4 varsh, 10 varsh anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 6 varsh (6 Years) hai. Exam point: 6 varsh (6 Years) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which famous agreement did Gandhi sign in 1924 for unity with Swarajists?
qh: गांधी जी ने 1924 में स्वराजियों के साथ एकता के लिए किस प्रसिद्ध समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
e: gandhi-das samajhaute ke madhyam se gandhi ji ne svarajiyon ko kangres ke abhinn ang ke rup mein manyata di. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gandhi ji ne 1924 mein svarajiyon ke sath ekata ke lie kis prasiddh samajhaute par hastakshar kie? Isi tathya par gandhi-das samajhauta (Gandhi-Das Pact) tika hua hai. Vikalp puna paikt, shimala samajhauta, lakhanau paikt bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan gandhi-das samajhauta (Gandhi-Das Pact) hi milti hai. Exam point: gandhi-das samajhauta (Gandhi-Das Pact) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who among these is known as a 'No-Changer' leader?
qh: इनमें से कौन 'नो-चेंजर' (No-Changer) नेता के रूप में जाने जाते हैं?
o: सरदार वल्लभ भाई पटेल (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel)
e: saradar patel, rajeindr prasad aur rajagopalachari gandhivadi bahishkar ki niti ke pakshadhar the. Is sawaal mein saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) ki baat hai. Isi karan se saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) sahi uttar hai. vitthal bhai patel, motilal neharu, si.ar. das is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) hi milti hai.
