qh: केंद्रीय विधानसभा (Central Legislative Assembly) में स्वराज दल के नेता कौन थे?
e: motilal neharu ne keindriy aseinbali mein svaraj dal ka shanadar netritv kiya tha. Is prashn ka dayra motilal neharu (Motilal Nehru) tak phaila hua hai. Isi tathya par motilal neharu (Motilal Nehru) tika hua hai. chittaranjan das, vitthal bhai patel, madan mohan malaviy ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab motilal neharu (Motilal Nehru) hai. Exam point: motilal neharu (Motilal Nehru) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was Vithalbhai Patel's biggest legislative achievement for the Swarajists?
qh: विट्ठल भाई पटेल का स्वराज दल के लिए सबसे बड़ा विधाई गौरव क्या था?
o: असेंबली का अध्यक्ष चुना जाना (Elected as Speaker of the Assembly)
e: 1925 mein ve keindriy vidhanasabha ke pahale bharatiy adhyaksh (Speaker) chune gae the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki vitthal bhai patel ka svaraj dal ke lie sabase bada vidhai gaurav kya tha? Isliye antim jawab aseinbali ka adhyaksh chuna jana (Elected as... ke roop mein milta hai. taiks kam karana, istipha dena, jel jana is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab aseinbali ka adhyaksh chuna jana (Elected as... hai. Exam point: aseinbali ka adhyaksh chuna jana (Elected as... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which province did the Swaraj Party get an absolute majority in the 1923 elections?
qh: 1923 के चुनावों में स्वराज पार्टी को किस प्रांत में पूर्ण बहुमत मिला था?
e: madhy prant mein unhein spasht bahumat mila aur bangal mein ve sabase badae dal ke rup mein ubhare. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1923 ke chunavon mein svaraj parti ko kis prant mein purn bahumat mila tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par madhy prant (Central Provinces) hi sahi baithta hai. panjab, madras, banbai alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad madhy prant (Central Provinces) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: madhy prant (Central Provinces) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which famous Bill did the Swarajists succeed in defeating in the assembly?
qh: स्वराज दल ने किस प्रसिद्ध विधेयक (Bill) को असेंबली में गिराने में सफलता पाई थी?
e: 1928 mein unhonne damanakari pablik sephti bil ko girakar sarakar ko chunauti di thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki svaraj dal ne kis prasiddh vidheyak (Bill) ko aseinbali mein girane mein saphalata pai thi? Isi karan se pablik sephti bil (Public Safety Bill) sahi uttar hai. namak bil, raulet bil, ilbart bil in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar pablik sephti bil (Public Safety Bill) baithta hai. Exam point: pablik sephti bil (Public Safety Bill) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was one of the main reasons for the decline of the Swaraj Party?
qh: स्वराज पार्टी के पतन का एक मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: सी.आर. दास का निधन (Death of C.R. Das)
e: 1925 mein chittaranjan das ki mrityu ke bad parti netritv kamajor p gaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki svaraj parti ke patan ka ek mukhy karan kya tha? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isliye sahi nateeja si.ar. das ka nidhan (Death of C.R. Das) nikalta hai. Galti gandhi ji ka virodh, paise ki kami, angrejon se dar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar si.ar. das ka nidhan (Death of C.R. Das) baithta hai. Exam point: si.ar. das ka nidhan (Death of C.R. Das) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was the Sabarmati Ashram located during the halt of the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन की शिथिलता के समय साबरमती आश्रम कहाँ स्थित था?
e: gandhi ji ne ahamadabad mein sabaramati nadi ke kinare apana mukhyalay banaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki asahayog andolan ki shithilata ke samay sabaramati ashram kahan sthit tha? Isi karan se ahamadabad (Ahmedabad) sahi uttar hai. Galti rajakot, surat, badauda chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ahamadabad (Ahmedabad) hi milti hai. Exam point: ahamadabad (Ahmedabad) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Why were Swarajists called a new form of 'Legislative Non-Cooperation'?
qh: स्वराजियों को 'विधायी असहयोग' का नया रूप क्यों कहा गया?
o: क्योंकि वे परिषद के भीतर जाकर असहयोग करना चाहते थे (Non-cooperation from within)
e: unaka manana tha ki parishad ke bhitar bajat rokana aur sarakari nitiyon ka virodh karana bhi asahayog hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki svarajiyon ko 'vidhayi asahayog' ka naya rup kyon kaha gaya? Isi tathya par kyonki ve parishad ke bhitar jakar asahayog... tika hua hai. kyonki ve vaphadar the, ve chunav nahin l te the, ve chup rahate the ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kyonki ve parishad ke bhitar jakar asahayog... hai. Exam point: kyonki ve parishad ke bhitar jakar asahayog karana chahate the (Non-cooperation from within) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What did Gandhi consider his 'Himalayan Blunder'?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन की 'हिमालय जैसी भूल' (Himalayan Blunder) गांधी जी ने किसे माना था?
o: पूरी तैयारी के बिना जनता को संघर्ष में उतारना (Launching struggle without mass training)
e: bina ahinsa ki uchit shiksha ke jan-andolan chhedana unaki najar mein badai galati thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki asahayog andolan ki 'himalay jaisi bhul' (Himalayan Blunder) gandhi ji ne kise mana tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par puri taiyari ke bina janata ko sangharsh... sahi nikalta hai. jel jana, chauri-chaura ko rokana, andolan shuru karana in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar puri taiyari ke bina janata ko sangharsh mein utarana (Launching struggle without mass training) baithta hai. Exam point: puri taiyari ke bina janata ko sangharsh... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the status of the labor movement between 1930-1936?
qh: 1930 से 1936 के बीच मजदूर आंदोलन की स्थिति कैसी थी?
o: शिथिल और कम प्रभावी (Sluggish and less effective)
e: is kalakhand mein majadur andolan mein thodai shithilata ai thi, kyonki mukhy netritv bikhara hua tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1930 se 1936 ke bich majadur andolan ki sthiti kaisi thi? Isliye sahi nateeja shithil aur kam prabhavi (Sluggish and less effective) nikalta hai. Vikalp puri tarah samapt, atyant ugr, british sarakar ki samarthak bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad shithil aur kam prabhavi (Sluggish and less effective) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: shithil aur kam prabhavi (Sluggish and less... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the workers boycott during the Civil Disobedience Movement?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन (Civil Disobedience) के दौरान मजदूरों ने किसका बहिष्कार किया?
o: औपनिवेशिक संस्थानों और विदेशी मिलों का (Colonial institutions & foreign mills)
e: majaduron ne aupaniveshik shasan ke pratik sansthanon aur videshi milon mein kam band kar virodh jataya. Is prashn ka kendra civil hai. civil disobedience mein kanoon todkar sarkari kaam rokne ki appeal thi. Isliye antim jawab aupaniveshik sansthanon aur videshi milon ka (Colonial... ke roop mein milta hai. keval bharatiy malikon ka, svadeshi vastuon ka, aspatalon ka mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab aupaniveshik sansthanon aur videshi milon ka (Colonial institutions & foreign mills) hai. Exam point: aupaniveshik sansthanon aur videshi milon ka (Colonial institutions & foreign mills) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Whom did Congress give a key place in its 1937 election manifesto?
qh: 1937 के चुनावों के दौरान कांग्रेस ने अपने घोषणा पत्र में किसे महत्वपूर्ण स्थान दिया?
o: मजदूरों और उनकी मांगों को (Workers and their demands)
e: kangres ne majaduron ki mangon ko apane ghoshana patr mein shamil kar unhein rashtriy rajaniti ki mukhyadhara se joda. Yahaan majaduron aur unaki mangon ko (Workers and their demands) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isliye antim jawab majaduron aur unaki mangon ko (Workers and... ke roop mein milta hai. sena ke vistar ko, videshi vyapariyon ko, keval rajaon ko in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar majaduron aur unaki mangon ko (Workers and their demands) hi hai. Exam point: majaduron aur unaki mangon ko (Workers and their demands) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: How many trade unions were there by 1937-1939, up from 271?
qh: 1937-1939 के बीच ट्रेड यूनियनों की संख्या 271 से बढ़कर कितनी हो गई थी?
e: kangres mantrimandalon ke gathan ke bad majadur andolanon ko naya utsah mila aur yuniyanon ki sankhya b kar 562 ho gai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1937-1939 ke bich tred yuniyanon ki sankhya 271 se b kar kitani ho gai thi? Isi tathya par 562 tika hua hai. 300, 1000, 450 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 562 hai. Exam point: 562 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date did World War II formally begin?
qh: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध (World War II) की औपचारिक शुरुआत किस तिथि को हुई थी?
e: 3 sitanbar 1939 ko jarmani ke polaind par hamale ke sath hi dvitiy vishv yuddh shuru ho gaya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki dvitiy vishv yuddh (World War II) ki aupacharik shuruat kis tithi ko hui thi? Isi tathya par 3 sitanbar 1939 (3rd September 1939) tika hua hai. 26 janavari 1930, 1 sitanbar 1941, 15 agast 1947 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 3 sitanbar 1939 (3rd September 1939) hi milti hai. Exam point: 3 sitanbar 1939 (3rd September 1939) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many workers went on strike against the war on Oct 2, 1939?
qh: 2 अक्टूबर 1939 को युद्ध के विरोध में कितने मजदूरों ने हड़ताल की थी?
e: yuddh ke virodh mein banbai ke lagabhag 90,000 majaduron ne vishal hadatal ayojit ki thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 2 aktubar 1939 ko yuddh ke virodh mein kitane majaduron ne hadatal ki thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 90,000 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp 5,000, 10,000, 1 lakh bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 90,000 hi hai. Exam point: 90,000 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In 1941, Nazis attacked which country, changing the communists' stance?
qh: 1941 में नाजियों (जर्मनी) ने किस देश पर हमला किया, जिससे साम्यवादियों का रुख बदल गया?
e: rus par hamale ke bad samyavadiyon ne yuddh ko 'jan-yuddh' kahana shuru kiya aur angrejon ka samarthan kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1941 mein najiyon (jarmani) ne kis desh par hamala kiya, jisase samyavadiyon ka rukh badal gaya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par soviyat sangh / rus (Soviet Union / Russia) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. amerika, bharat, chin is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se soviyat sangh / rus (Soviet Union / Russia) sahi hai. Exam point: soviyat sangh / rus (Soviet Union / Russia) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the Quit India Movement begin?
qh: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन (Quit India Movement) किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ था?
e: agast 1942 mein gandhi ji ke ahvan par 'karo ya maro' ke nare ke sath yah andolan shuru hua. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bharat chho o andolan (Quit India Movement) kis varsh shuru hua tha? quit india ka naara angrezi raj ko turant chhodne ki maang thi. Isi baat se 1942 sahi sabit hota hai. 1920, 1945, 1930 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1942 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1942 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Workers of which steel company struck for 13 days during Quit India?
qh: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के दौरान किस स्टील कंपनी के मजदूरों ने 13 दिन की हड़ताल की थी?
e: jamashedapur mein tata stil ke majaduron ne 13 dinon tak kam band rakha aur kaha ki jab tak rashtriy sarakar nahin banegi, kam nahin kareinge. Prashn yah batata hai ki bharat chho o andolan ke dauran kis stil kanpani ke majaduron ne 13 din ki hadatal ki thi? quit india ka naara angrezi raj ko turant chhodne ki maang thi. Isi tathya par tata stil / jamashedapur (Tata Steel /... tika hua hai. sel (SAIL), jindal stil, bhilai stil anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar tata stil / jamashedapur (Tata Steel / Jamshedpur) baithta hai. Exam point: tata stil / jamashedapur (Tata Steel / Jamshedpur) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In 1945, workers protested against which INA case?
qh: 1945 में किस आजाद हिंद फौज (INA) के मुकदमे के विरोध में मजदूर सड़कों पर उतरे थे?
e: lal kile mein chal rahe aienae ke aphasaron ke mukadame ne pure desh mein ekata ki lahar paida ki. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1945 mein kis ajad hind phauj (INA) ke mukadame ke virodh mein majadur sadakon par utare the? In tathyon ke chalte lal kila mukadama (Red Fort Trials) hi sahi hai. chauri-chaura, kakori, merath shadyantr mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se lal kila mukadama (Red Fort Trials) sahi hai. Exam point: lal kila mukadama (Red Fort Trials) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year and where did the Naval Mutiny take place?
qh: नौसैनिक विद्रोह (Naval Mutiny) किस वर्ष और कहाँ हुआ था?
e: 18 pharavari 1946 ko banbai mein nausainikon ne angrejon ke khilaph vidroh kar diya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki nausainik vidroh (Naval Mutiny) kis varsh aur kahan hua tha? Isi baat se 1946, banbai (1946, Bombay) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti 1947, madras, 1945, kalakatta, 1942, dilli chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1946, banbai (1946, Bombay) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1946, banbai (1946, Bombay) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Why did Indian workers refuse to load ration for ships going to Indonesia?
qh: इंडोनेशिया जाने वाले जहाजों में रसद (Ration) भरने से भारतीय मजदूरों ने क्यों मना कर दिया?
o: इंडोनेशिया के राष्ट्रवादी आंदोलन के समर्थन में (Support of Indonesian Nationalists)
e: bharatiy majadur indoneshiya mein dach samrajyavad ke khilaph l rahe rashtravadiyon ke paksh mein the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki indoneshiya jane vale jahajon mein rasad (Ration) bharane se bharatiy majaduron ne kyon mana kar diya? Isi karan se indoneshiya ke rashtravadi andolan ke samarthan mein (Support of Indonesian Nationalists) sahi uttar hai. jahaj kharab the, ve thak gae the, paise kam the mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se indoneshiya ke rashtravadi andolan ke samarthan mein (Support of Indonesian Nationalists) sahi hai. Exam point: indoneshiya ke rashtravadi andolan ke samarthan mein (Support of Indonesian Nationalists) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the core principle of Communism?
qh: साम्यवाद (Communism) का मूल सिद्धांत क्या है?
o: संसाधनों का समान वितरण (Equal distribution of resources)
e: samyavad samaj mein sansadhanon par sabaka saman adhikar aur vargahin samaj ki vakalat karata hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki samyavad (Communism) ka mul siddhant kya hai? Isi baat se sansadhanon ka saman vitaran (Equal distribution of resources) sahi sabit hota hai. niji sanpatti ka vistar, videshi nivesh, rajashahi ka samarthan anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar sansadhanon ka saman vitaran (Equal distribution of resources) hai. Exam point: sansadhanon ka saman vitaran (Equal distribution of resources) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What did Lala Lajpat Rai call Capitalism and Imperialism?
qh: लाला लाजपत राय ने पूंजीवाद (Capitalism) और साम्राज्यवाद (Imperialism) को क्या बताया?
o: एक ही सिक्के के दो पहलू / जुड़वां बच्चे (Twin children of the same system)
e: lala ji ka manana tha ki punjivad hi samrajyavad aur shoshan ki janani hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki lala lajapat ray ne punjivad (Capitalism) aur samrajyavad (Imperialism) ko kya bataya? Isi tathya par ek hi sikke ke do pahalu /... tika hua hai. varadan, dushman, mitr ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar ek hi sikke ke do pahalu / ju van bachche (Twin children of the same system) hai. Exam point: ek hi sikke ke do pahalu / ju van bachche (Twin children of the same system) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which year was AITUC founded?
qh: अखिल भारतीय ट्रेड यूनियन कांग्रेस (AITUC) की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: 31 aktubar 1920 ko lala lajapat ray ki adhyakshata mein etak ki sthapana hui. Is prashn ka kendra 1920 hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1920 hi sahi baithta hai. 1935, 1885, 1905 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar 1920 hai. Exam point: 1920 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein. Is vishay mein poochhe jaane wale anya bindu bhi isi tathya se jude hote hain, isliye ek baar samajh lene par kaee prashnon ke jawab aasan ho jate hain.

qe: In which country did the Industrial Revolution start first?
qh: औद्योगिक क्रांति (Industrial Revolution) की शुरुआत सबसे पहले किस देश में हुई थी?
e: 18vin shatabdi ke uttarardh mein inglaind mein mashinikaran aur audyogik kranti ki shuruat hui. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki audyogik kranti (Industrial Revolution) ki shuruat sabase pahale kis desh mein hui thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par inglaind (England) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. amerika, bharat, rus in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad inglaind (England) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: inglaind (England) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which year were the elections held in provinces after the Act of 1935?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1935 के बाद प्रांतों में चुनाव किस वर्ष हुए थे?
e: 1937 ke chunavon mein kangres ne shanadar pradarshan kiya aur kai pranton mein sarakar banai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki bharat sarakar adhiniyam 1935 ke bad pranton mein chunav kis varsh hue the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1937 hi sahi baithta hai. 1935, 1942, 1945 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se 1937 sahi hai. Exam point: 1937 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How big was the strike in Bombay on Feb 22, 1946, in support of the mutiny?
qh: नौसैनिक विद्रोह के समर्थन में 22 फरवरी 1946 को बंबई में कितनी बड़ी हड़ताल हुई?
e: nausainikon ke samarthan mein banbai ke lakhon majadur sadakon par utar ae, jisamein khuni jhadapein bhi huin. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki nausainik vidroh ke samarthan mein 22 pharavari 1946 ko banbai mein kitani badai hadatal hui? Yahi wajah hai ki 2-3 lakh majadur (2-3 Lakh workers) sahi hai. shuny, 10,000 log, keval sainik alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 2-3 lakh majadur (2-3 Lakh workers) hai. Exam point: 2-3 lakh majadur (2-3 Lakh workers) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main reason for rising inflation in India after WWII?
qh: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के बाद भारत में महंगाई बढ़ने का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: युद्ध के कारण संसाधनों की कमी और रिसेशन (Resource shortage & recession due to war)
e: yuddh ke karan vastuon ki kami ho gai aur kimaton mein bhari uchhal aya, jisase majadur varg pareshan tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki dvitiy vishv yuddh ke bad bharat mein mahangai b ne ka mukhy karan kya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par yuddh ke karan sansadhanon ki kami aur riseshan (Resource shortage & recession due to war) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. atyadhik utpadan, kam taiks, svatantrata is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad yuddh ke karan sansadhanon ki kami aur... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: yuddh ke karan sansadhanon ki kami aur riseshan (Resource shortage & recession due to war) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who called Gandhi a 'Half-naked Fakir'?
qh: गांधी जी को 'अधनंगा फकीर' (Half-naked Fakir) किसने कहा था?
e: gandhi ji ke sade pahanave ke karan british neta charchil ne unhein chi ane ke lie yah shabd kahe the. Is prashn ka vishay vinstan charchil (Winston Churchill) hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par vinstan charchil (Winston Churchill) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. lord karjan, klimeint etali, mauntabetan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar vinstan charchil (Winston Churchill) hi hai. Exam point: vinstan charchil (Winston Churchill) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Why is the Quit India Movement called 'Spontaneous'?
qh: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन को 'स्वतः स्फूर्त' (Spontaneous) क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: नेताओं की गिरफ्तारी के बाद जनता ने स्वयं कमान संभाली (Masses took charge after leaders' arrest)
यह अंग्रेजों ने शुरू किया था
e: 9 agast ko sabhi badae netaon ki giraphtari ke bad am janata ne svayan is andolan ko age b aya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bharat chho o andolan ko 'svatah sphurt' (Spontaneous) kyon kaha jata hai? quit india ka naara angrezi raj ko turant chhodne ki maang thi. Isliye sahi nateeja netaon ki giraphtari ke bad janata ne svayan kaman sanbhali (Masses took charge after leaders' arrest) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - yah angrejon ne shuru kiya tha, yah keval dilli mein tha, yah bahut shant tha - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav netaon ki giraphtari ke bad janata ne svayan kaman sanbhali (Masses took charge after leaders' arrest) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: netaon ki giraphtari ke bad janata ne svayan kaman sanbhali (Masses took charge after leaders' arrest) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Why did the USSR join the 'Allied Powers' in 1941?
qh: 1941 में 'मित्र राष्ट्रों' (Allied Powers) का साथ सोवियत संघ ने क्यों दिया?
o: जर्मनी द्वारा उन पर हमला करने के कारण (Due to German attack)
e: jarmani (dhuri rashtr) ne soviyat sangh par hamala kiya, jisake bad vah mitr rashtron ke sath a gaya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1941 mein 'mitr rashtron' (Allied Powers) ka sath soviyat sangh ne kyon diya? Isliye sahi nateeja jarmani dvara un par hamala karane ke karan (Due to German attack) nikalta hai. japan ke dar se, paise ke lie, ve angrejon ke mitr the alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar jarmani dvara un par hamala karane ke... hi hai. Exam point: jarmani dvara un par hamala karane ke karan (Due to German attack) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which new aspects were added to labor demands along with 'economic' ones?
qh: मजदूर वर्ग की मांगों में 'आर्थिक' के साथ कौन से नए पहलू जुड़ गए थे?
o: मानवतावादी और राजनीतिक अधिकार (Humanitarian & Political rights)
e: majadur ab keval vetan hi nahin, balki samman aur rajanitik bhagidari bhi mang rahe the. Is prashn ka dayra manavatavadi aur rajanitik adhikar (Humanitarian & Political rights) tak phaila hua hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par manavatavadi aur rajanitik adhikar (Humanitarian & Political... sahi nikalta hai. keval dharmik, videshi nagarikata, sainik seva is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav manavatavadi aur rajanitik adhikar (Humanitarian & Political rights) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: manavatavadi aur rajanitik adhikar (Humanitarian & Political rights) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What percentage bonus did Gandhi demand in the Ahmedabad Mill Strike?
qh: अहमदाबाद मिल हड़ताल (1918) में गांधी जी ने कितने प्रतिशत बोनस की मांग की थी?
e: mil malikon ke 20% ke mukabale gandhi ji ne majaduron ke lie 35% bonas ki mang svikar karavai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki ahamadabad mil hadatal (1918) mein gandhi ji ne kitane pratishat bonas ki mang ki thi? Isi karan se 35% sahi uttar hai. 10%, 50%, 20% in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav 35% hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 35% - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did 'Raksha Bandhan' symbolize during the Swadeshi movement?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन (1905) के दौरान 'रक्षाबंधन' किस बात का प्रतीक था?
o: हिंदू-मुस्लिम और मजदूर-किसान एकता (Unity of all sections against partition)
e: bangal vibhajan ke virodh mein taigor ne ekata pradarshit karane ke lie rakshabandhan manane ka ahvan kiya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki svadeshi andolan (1905) ke dauran 'rakshabandhan' kis bat ka pratik tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par hindu-muslim aur majadur-kisan ekata (Unity of all sections against partition) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti bhai-bahan ka pyar, yuddh ki taiyari, videshi tyauhar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se hindu-muslim aur majadur-kisan ekata (Unity of all sections against partition) sahi hai. Exam point: hindu-muslim aur majadur-kisan ekata (Unity of all... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which national event gave momentum to labor movements in the first decade of the 20th century?
qh: 20वीं शताब्दी के पहले दशक में मजदूर आंदोलनों को गति किस राष्ट्रीय घटना से मिली?
e: 1905 ke bangal vibhajan ke bad shuru hue svadeshi andolan ne majaduron ko rashtravad se jodane mein badai bhumika nibhai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 20vin shatabdi ke pahale dashak mein majadur andolanon ko gati kis rashtriy ghatana se mili? swadeshi ka matlab desi maal apnana tatha videshi maal ka bahishkar tha. Isliye sahi nateeja svadeshi andolan (Swadeshi Movement) nikalta hai. bharat chhodao andolan, savinay avajna, 1857 ka vidroh ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab svadeshi andolan (Swadeshi Movement) hai. Exam point: svadeshi andolan (Swadeshi Movement) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did workers do as a symbol of boycotting foreign goods during the Swadeshi movement?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन के दौरान श्रमिकों ने विदेशी वस्तुओं के बहिष्कार के प्रतीक के रूप में क्या किया?
o: विदेशी मिलों में हड़ताल और वंदे मातरम का नारा (Strike in foreign mills & Vande Mataram slogan)
e: majaduron ne videshi milon mein kam roka aur british satta ko chunauti dene ke lie vande mataram ka nara lagaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki svadeshi andolan ke dauran shramikon ne videshi vastuon ke bahishkar ke pratik ke rup mein kya kiya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par videshi milon mein hadatal aur vande mataram ka nara (Strike in foreign mills & Vande Mataram slogan) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti kam ke ghante b ae, videsh yatra ki, angreji sikhi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad videshi milon mein hadatal aur vande mataram... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: videshi milon mein hadatal aur vande mataram... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which festival was observed in Bengal during the Swadeshi movement to show unity?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन के दौरान बंगाल में एकता प्रदर्शित करने के लिए कौन सा त्यौहार मनाया गया?
e: ravindranath taigor ke sujhav par hindu-muslim aur majaduron-netaon ke bich ekata ke lie rakshabandhan manaya gaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki svadeshi andolan ke dauran bangal mein ekata pradarshit karane ke lie kaun sa tyauhar manaya gaya? swadeshi ka matlab desi maal apnana tatha videshi maal ka bahishkar tha. Isi aadhar par rakshabandhan (Raksha Bandhan) chuna jaata hai. holi, id, dipavali is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar rakshabandhan (Raksha Bandhan) hi hai. Exam point: rakshabandhan (Raksha Bandhan) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which Howrah shipyard did workers strike against the ban on saying 'Vande Mataram'?
qh: हावड़ा के किस शिपयार्ड में मजदूरों ने 'वंदे मातरम' कहने पर प्रतिबंध के खिलाफ हड़ताल की थी?
e: havada ke barn shipayard mein majaduron ne sarakari sabhaon mein jane se rokane aur naron par pratibandh ke khilaph kam band kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki havada ke kis shipayard mein majaduron ne 'vande mataram' kahane par pratibandh ke khilaph hadatal ki thi? Isliye sahi nateeja barn shipayard (Burn Shipyard) nikalta hai. majagon dok, gardan rich, kochin shipayard mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se barn shipayard (Burn Shipyard) sahi hai. Exam point: barn shipayard (Burn Shipyard) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who led the labor strike in Tuticorin (Tamil Nadu) in 1908?
qh: 1908 में तूतीकोरिन (तमिलनाडु) में मजदूर हड़ताल का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
o: सुब्रमण्यम शिव और चिदंबरम पिल्लै (Subramania Siva & Chidambaram Pillai)
e: in netaon ne british svamitv vali koral suti mil mein majaduron ki mangon ke lie andolan kiya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1908 mein tutikorin (tamilanadu) mein majadur hadatal ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par subramanyam shiv aur chidanbaram pillai (Subramania Siva & Chidambaram Pillai) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. kamaraj, gandhi ji, rajagopalachari ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan subramanyam shiv aur chidanbaram pillai (Subramania Siva & Chidambaram Pillai) hi milti hai. Exam point: subramanyam shiv aur chidanbaram pillai (Subramania Siva... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which leaders supported the strike in the railway & engineering dept in Rawalpindi?
qh: पंजाब के रावलपिंडी में रेलवे और इंजीनियरिंग विभाग की हड़ताल का समर्थन किन नेताओं ने किया था?
o: लाला लाजपत राय और अजीत सिंह (Lala Lajpat Rai & Ajit Singh)
e: lala lajapat ray aur ajit sinh ne panjab mein majaduron ko sangathit kiya, jisake lie unhein nirvasit bhi kiya gaya. Is sawaal mein lala lajapat ray aur ajit sinh (Lala Lajpat Rai & Ajit Singh) ki baat hai. Isliye antim jawab lala lajapat ray aur ajit sinh (Lala... ke roop mein milta hai. neharu aur patel, bhagat sinh, sachchidanand sinha is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar lala lajapat ray aur ajit sinh (Lala... hi hai. Exam point: lala lajapat ray aur ajit sinh (Lala... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC) established?
qh: अखिल भारतीय ट्रेड यूनियन कांग्रेस (AITUC / एटक) की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: etak ki sthapana 31 aktubar 1920 ko hui thi, jo bharat mein majadur sangathanon ke lie ek mil ka patthar tha. Is prashn ka vishay 1920 hai. Isliye antim jawab 1920 ke roop mein milta hai. Galti 1947, 1905, 1885 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1920 baithta hai. Exam point: 1920 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the first President of AITUC?
qh: एटक (AITUC) के प्रथम अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: lala lajapat ray ko etak ke pahale adhiveshan ka adhyaksh chuna gaya tha. Yah prashn lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) se juda hai. Isliye antim jawab lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) ke roop mein milta hai. si.ar. das, javaharalal neharu, en.em. joshi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) baithta hai. Exam point: lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the founding Secretary of AITUC?
qh: एटक के संस्थापक सचिव (Secretary) कौन थे?
e: divan chaman lal ne etak ke gathan mein sachiv ke rup mein mahatvapurn bhumika nibhai thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki etak ke sansthapak sachiv (Secretary) kaun the? Yahi wajah hai ki divan chaman lal (Dewan Chaman Lall) sahi hai. joseph baiptista, vi.vi. giri, bi.pi. vadiya is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad divan chaman lal (Dewan Chaman Lall) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: divan chaman lal (Dewan Chaman Lall) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who said 'Militarism and Imperialism are the twin children of Capitalism'?
qh: किसने कहा था कि 'सैन्यवाद और साम्राज्यवाद, पूंजीवाद के जुड़वां बच्चे हैं'?
e: lala lajapat ray ne punjivad ko shoshan ki jad batate hue use samrajyavad se joda tha. Is prashn ka vishay lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hai. Isi aadhar par lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp mahatma gandhi, subhash chandr bos, karl marks bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hi milti hai. Exam point: lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: When was a shift from 'economic' to 'political' nature seen in worker demands?
qh: मजदूर वर्ग की मांगों में 'आर्थिक' से 'राजनीतिक' स्वरूप की ओर बदलाव कब देखा गया?
o: स्वदेशी आंदोलन और प्रथम विश्वयुद्ध के बाद (Post-Swadeshi & WWI)
e: majaduron ne dhire-dhire samajh liya ki unaki arthik mukti rajanitik ajadi (svaraj) se judai hai. Is prashn ka dayra swadeshi tak phaila hua hai. swadeshi ka matlab desi maal apnana tatha videshi maal ka bahishkar tha. Isi baat se svadeshi andolan aur pratham vishvayuddh ke bad (Post-Swadeshi & WWI) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti 19vin sadi ki shuruat mein, 1857 mein, kabhi nahin chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab svadeshi andolan aur pratham vishvayuddh ke bad... hai. Exam point: svadeshi andolan aur pratham vishvayuddh ke bad (Post-Swadeshi & WWI) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What did Lala Lajpat Rai describe as the 'Antidote' for workers?
qh: लाला लाजपत राय ने मजदूरों के लिए 'प्रतिविष' (Antidote) किसे बताया था?
e: unhonne kaha ki sangathit punjivad ke jaharile prabhav ka ekamatr tod 'sangathit majadur' hain. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki lala lajapat ray ne majaduron ke lie 'prativish' (Antidote) kise bataya tha? Isi aadhar par sangathit majadur (Organized Labor) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - british kanun, keval shiksha, hathiyar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad sangathit majadur (Organized Labor) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: sangathit majadur (Organized Labor) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why was the early moderate nationalists' stance towards labor movements weak?
qh: प्रारंभिक उदारवादी राष्ट्रवादियों का मजदूर आंदोलनों के प्रति रुख लचर क्यों था?
o: उन्हें भारतीय पूंजीपतियों के नाराज होने का भय था (Fear of upsetting Indian capitalists)
e: udaravadi nahin chahate the ki bharatiy malikon ke khilaph andolan se rashtriy ekata mein phut p e. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki praranbhik udaravadi rashtravadiyon ka majadur andolanon ke prati rukh lachar kyon tha? Isi karan se unhein bharatiy punjipatiyon ke naraj hone ka bhay tha (Fear of upsetting Indian capitalists) sahi uttar hai. koi samasya nahin thi, ve angrejon se darate the, ve alasi the is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad unhein bharatiy punjipatiyon ke naraj hone ka bhay tha (Fear of upsetting Indian capitalists) hi theek uttar hai. qe: Which nationalist newspaper wrote against worker exploitation in 'Mahratta' & 'Kesari'?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी समाचार पत्र ने श्रमिकों के शोषण के खिलाफ 'मराठा' और 'केसरी' में लेख लिखे?
o: बाल गंगाधर तिलक के पत्र (Tilak's papers)
e: tilak ne apane samachar patron ke madhyam se shramikon ke adhikaron ki joradar pairavi ki. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki kis rashtravadi samachar patr ne shramikon ke shoshan ke khilaph 'maratha' aur 'kesari' mein lekh likhe? qe: What was the impact of the Russian Revolution (1917) on Indian labor movements?
qh: रूसी क्रांति (1917) का भारतीय मजदूर आंदोलनों पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ा?
o: समाजवादी और वर्ग-चेतना के विचारों का प्रसार (Spread of socialist & class-consciousness ideas)
e: rus ki kranti ne bharatiy krantikariyon aur majaduron ko 'sarvahara' ki shakti ka ahasas karaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki rusi kranti (1917) ka bharatiy majadur andolanon par kya prabhav p a? Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se samajavadi aur varg-chetana ke vicharon ka prasar (Spread of socialist & class-consciousness ideas) sahi hai. Exam point: samajavadi aur varg-chetana ke vicharon ka prasar (Spread of socialist & class-consciousness ideas) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the attempt to form an 'All India Union' fail during the Swadeshi movement?
qh: स्वदेशी आंदोलन के समय 'अखिल भारतीय यूनियन' बनाने का प्रयास विफल क्यों हुआ?
o: राष्ट्रवादियों का मत भारतीय बनाम विदेशी मालिकों पर बटा था (Division over Indian vs Foreign owners)

Baaki vikalp - gandhi ji ne mana kiya, log anapadh the, paise nahin the - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad rashtravadiyon ka mat bharatiy banam videshi malikon... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: rashtravadiyon ka mat bharatiy banam videshi malikon par bata tha (Division over Indian vs Foreign owners) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Why did Gandhi suggest wearing 'minimal clothes' to promote Khadi among workers?
qh: गांधी जी ने मजदूरों को खादी अपनाने के लिए 'कम वस्त्र' धारण करने का सुझाव किस कारण दिया था?
o: खादी का महंगा होना (High cost of Khadi)

Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gandhi ji ne majaduron ko khadi apanane ke lie 'kam vastr' dharan karane ka sujhav kis karan diya tha? qe: Which of these is associated with the GIP Railway strike of 1899?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा 'ग्रेट इंडियन पेनिनसुला रेलवे' (GIP) की 1899 की हड़ताल से जुड़ा है?

Prashn ka saar yah hai ki inamein se kaun sa 'gret indiyan peninasula relave' (GIP) ki 1899 ki hadatal se juda hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par pratham sangathit relave hadatal (First organized railway strike) hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp keval vyapariyon ki mang, ahinsa divas, vayu sena vidroh bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan pratham sangathit relave hadatal (First organized railway... hi milti hai. Exam point: pratham sangathit relave hadatal (First organized railway strike) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What did Lala Lajpat Rai mean by workers' 'Class Consciousness'?
qh: मजदूरों की 'वर्ग चेतना' (Class Consciousness) से लाला लाजपत राय का क्या तात्पर्य था?
o: अपने अधिकारों और शोषण के प्रति जागरूकता (Awareness of rights and exploitation)

Is prashn ka theek jawab apane adhikaron aur shoshan ke prati jagarukata (Awareness of rights and exploitation) hai. Exam point: apane adhikaron aur shoshan ke prati jagarukata (Awareness of rights and exploitation) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

Is prashn ka theek jawab gret indiyan peninasula relave (GIP Railway) hai. Exam point: gret indiyan peninasula relave (GIP Railway) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Why were the laws made by European planters exploitative for workers?
qh: यूरोपीय बागान मालिकों (Planters) द्वारा मजदूरों के लिए बनाए गए कानून शोषणकारी क्यों थे?
o: उनमें दंड देने और नौकरी न छोड़ने देने के अधिकार थे (Right to punish & restrict quitting)
e: in kanunon ke tahat majaduron ko jel bhejane aur unhein bandhua banakar rakhane ka adhikar malikon ke pas tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki yuropiy bagan malikon (Planters) dvara majaduron ke lie banae gae kanun shoshanakari kyon the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par unamein dand dene aur naukari n chho ne dene ke adhikar the (Right to punish & restrict quitting) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. ve chhuttiyan dete the, ve adhik vetan dete the, ve shiksha dete the is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar unamein dand dene aur naukari n chho ne dene ke adhikar the (Right to punish & restrict quitting) hi hai. Exam point: unamein dand dene aur naukari n chho... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which nationalist newspaper prominently raised workers' issues?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी समाचार पत्र ने मजदूर वर्ग की समस्याओं को प्रमुखता से उठाना शुरू किया था?
e: bal gangadhar tilak ne apane patron ke madhyam se majaduron ke adhikaron aur unaki durdasha par jamakar likha. Prashn yah batata hai ki kis rashtravadi samachar patr ne majadur varg ki samasyaon ko pramukhata se uthana shuru kiya tha? Isliye antim jawab kesari aur maratha (Kesari & Mahratta) ke roop mein milta hai. d stetsamain, taims oph indiya, landan taims is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad kesari aur maratha (Kesari & Mahratta) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kesari aur maratha (Kesari & Mahratta) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was 'Industrialization' for 19th-century nationalists?
qh: 19वीं सदी के राष्ट्रवादियों के लिए 'औद्योगिकीकरण' (Industrialization) क्या था?
o: देश की गरीबी की एकमात्र औषधि (Sole remedy for poverty)
e: rashtravadi manate the ki udyogon ke vikas se hi bharat ki garibi aur berojagari dur ho sakati hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 19vin sadi ke rashtravadiyon ke lie 'audyogikikaran' (Industrialization) kya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki desh ki garibi ki ekamatr aushadhi (Sole remedy for poverty) sahi hai. ek burai, angrejon ka upahar, keval amiron ka khel ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad desh ki garibi ki ekamatr aushadhi (Sole remedy for poverty) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: desh ki garibi ki ekamatr aushadhi (Sole... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the level of worker participation during the Non-Cooperation movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन (Non-Cooperation) के दौरान मजदूरों की भागीदारी कैसी थी?
o: अत्यंत सक्रिय और व्यापक (Very active and widespread)
e: 1920-22 ke dauran relave, stimar aur mil majaduron ne deshavyapi hadatalon mein bhag liya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation) ke dauran majaduron ki bhagidari kaisi thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par atyant sakriy aur vyapak (Very active and widespread) hi sahi baithta hai. ve angrejon ke sath the, shuny, keval bangal tak simit mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar atyant sakriy aur vyapak (Very active and widespread) baithta hai. Exam point: atyant sakriy aur vyapak (Very active and... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: How did post-WWI inflation affect Indian workers?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के बाद भारत में मुद्रास्फीति (Inflation) का मजदूरों पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ा?
o: उन पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ा
महंगाई बढ़ने से उनका जीवन कठिन हो गया (Life became difficult due to high prices)
e: yuddh ke bad jaruri vastuon ki kimatein b gain, jisase majadur varg mein bhari asantosh paida hua. Is prashn ka vishay mahangai b ne se unaka jivan kathin ho gaya (Life became difficult due to high prices) hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par mahangai b ne se unaka jivan kathin... sahi nikalta hai. un par koi prabhav nahin p a, ve amir ho gae, unaki bachat b i anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar mahangai b ne se unaka jivan kathin ho gaya (Life became difficult due to high prices) baithta hai. Exam point: mahangai b ne se unaka jivan kathin ho gaya (Life became difficult due to high prices) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which important union was founded by B.P. Wadia in Madras in 1918?
qh: बी.पी. वाडिया ने 1918 में मद्रास में किस महत्वपूर्ण संघ की स्थापना की थी?
e: madras lebar yuniyan bharat ka pahala vyavasthit 'tred yuniyan' mana jata hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bi.pi. vadiya ne 1918 mein madras mein kis mahatvapurn sangh ki sthapana ki thi? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isliye sahi nateeja madras lebar yuniyan (Madras Labour Union) nikalta hai. kisan sabha, gadar parti, ary samaj ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan madras lebar yuniyan (Madras Labour Union) hi milti hai. Exam point: madras lebar yuniyan (Madras Labour Union) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the nationalists' stance towards the Bombay Factory Commission (1885)?
qh: मजदूरों की स्थिति की जांच के लिए गठित 'बंबई फैक्ट्री आयोग' (1885) के प्रति राष्ट्रवादियों का रुख क्या था?
e: shuruati daur mein rashtravadiyon ne shram kanunon ka samarthan nahin kiya kyonki unhein laga ki isase bharatiy udyogon ko nukasan hoga. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki majaduron ki sthiti ki janch ke lie gathit 'banbai phaiktri ayog' (1885) ke prati rashtravadiyon ka rukh kya tha? Isliye antim jawab udasin aur maun (Indifferent and silent) ke roop mein milta hai. hadatal par gae, vidroh kar diya, purn samarthan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab udasin aur maun (Indifferent and silent) hai. Exam point: udasin aur maun (Indifferent and silent) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which of these reflects the 'embryonic stage' of nationalism?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा शब्द राष्ट्रवाद की 'भ्रूण अवस्था' (Embryonic stage) को दर्शाता है?
e: punarjagaran ke samay rashtravad abhi vikasit hona shuru hi hua tha, isalie ise shaishavavastha kaha gaya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki inamein se kaun sa shabd rashtravad ki 'bhrun avastha' (Embryonic stage) ko darshata hai? Isi baat se 19vin sadi ka punarjagaran (19th century Renaissance) sahi sabit hota hai. bharat chho o andolan, sanvidhan nirman, 1947 ki ajadi anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 19vin sadi ka punarjagaran (19th century Renaissance) hi hai. Exam point: 19vin sadi ka punarjagaran (19th century Renaissance) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which mill worker movement did Gandhi successfully lead in 1918?
qh: गांधी जी ने किस मिल मजदूर आंदोलन का सफल नेतृत्व 1918 में किया था?
e: gandhi ji ne ahamadabad mein majaduron ke lie 35% bonas ki mang ko lekar bhukh hadatal ki thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gandhi ji ne kis mil majadur andolan ka saphal netritv 1918 mein kiya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki ahamadabad mil hadatal (Ahmedabad Mill Strike) sahi hai. kheda, chanparan, baradoli alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad ahamadabad mil hadatal (Ahmedabad Mill Strike) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ahamadabad mil hadatal (Ahmedabad Mill Strike) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who is mainly credited with linking worker discontent to the national movement?
qh: मजदूर वर्ग के असंतोष को राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन से जोड़ने का श्रेय मुख्य रूप से किसे जाता है?
o: गरमपंथी नेताओं (तिलक आदि) को (Extremist leaders like Tilak)
e: tilak jaise netaon ne majaduron ki samasyaon ko samrajyavad ke khilaph ek hathiyar ke rup mein istemal kiya. Is prashn ka kendra garamapanthi netaon (tilak adi) ko (Extremist leaders like Tilak) hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par garamapanthi netaon (tilak adi) ko (Extremist leaders... sahi nikalta hai. keval jamindaron ko, keval vyapariyon ko, british sarakar ko is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se garamapanthi netaon (tilak adi) ko (Extremist leaders like Tilak) sahi hai. Exam point: garamapanthi netaon (tilak adi) ko (Extremist leaders like Tilak) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the main reason for 'spontaneous' labor revolts in the 1880s?
qh: 1880 के दशक में 'स्वतः स्फूर्त' (Spontaneous) मजदूर विद्रोहों का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
e: bina kisi badae sangathan ke majadur apani kharab arthik sthiti ke karan achanak vidroh kar dete the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1880 ke dashak mein 'svatah sphurt' (Spontaneous) majadur vidrohon ka mukhy karan kya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki arthik shoshan (Economic exploitation) sahi hai. chhuttiyan n milana, rajaniti, dharmik karan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab arthik shoshan (Economic exploitation) hai. Exam point: arthik shoshan (Economic exploitation) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: How should the 'financial aid' given by capitalists to Congress be viewed?
qh: पूंजीपतियों द्वारा कांग्रेस को दी जाने वाली 'आर्थिक सहायता' को किस दृष्टिकोण से देखा जाना चाहिए?
o: आंदोलन के संचालन की मजबूरी और आवश्यकता (Necessity for running the movement)
e: badae andolanon aur sabhaon ke ayojan ke lie rashtravadi netaon ko sansadhanon ki avashyakata thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki punjipatiyon dvara kangres ko di jane vali 'arthik sahayata' ko kis drishtikon se dekha jana chahie? Isliye antim jawab andolan ke sanchalan ki majaburi aur avashyakata... ke roop mein milta hai. bhrashtachar, upahar, angrejon ki chal alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan andolan ke sanchalan ki majaburi aur avashyakata (Necessity for running the movement) hi milti hai. Exam point: andolan ke sanchalan ki majaburi aur avashyakata... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Sasipada Banerji was inspired by which social reform movement?
qh: शशि पद बनर्जी किस समाज सुधार आंदोलन से प्रेरित थे?
e: unhonne brahm samaj ke manaviy adarshon ke tahat majadur kalyan ke lie kary kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki shashi pad banarji kis samaj sudhar andolan se prerit the? Isliye antim jawab brahm samaj (Brahmo Samaj) ke roop mein milta hai. thiyosophikal sosaiti, prarthana samaj, ary samaj alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab brahm samaj (Brahmo Samaj) hai. Exam point: brahm samaj (Brahmo Samaj) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the meaning of 'Begari' during British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन काल में 'बेगारी' (Begari) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: बिना मजदूरी के काम कराना (Forced labor without pay)
e: majaduron aur kisanon se bina kisi bhugatan ke jabaran kam karana begari kahalata tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki british shasan kal mein 'begari' (Begari) ka kya arth tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bina majaduri ke kam karana (Forced labor... sahi nikalta hai. Galti sarakari naukari, bhari vetan, vyapar karana chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav bina majaduri ke kam karana (Forced labor without pay) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: bina majaduri ke kam karana (Forced labor without pay) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What became the character of relations between workers and nationalists post-1900?
qh: मजदूर वर्ग और राष्ट्रवादियों के बीच संबंधों का चरित्र 1900 के बाद कैसा हो गया?
e: svadeshi andolan aur usake bad majaduron aur rashtravadiyon ke hit ek jagah milane lage. Is sawaal mein gahara aur sahayogatmak (Deep and collaborative) ki baat hai. Yahi wajah hai ki gahara aur sahayogatmak (Deep and collaborative) sahi hai. maun, shatrutapurn, purn vichchhed is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar gahara aur sahayogatmak (Deep and collaborative) hi hai. Exam point: gahara aur sahayogatmak (Deep and collaborative) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which of these organizations was NOT made for worker class rights?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा संगठन 'वर्कर क्लास' के अधिकारों के लिए नहीं बनाया गया था?
e: hindu mahasabha ek rajanitik-dharmik sangathan tha, shramik sangh nahin. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki inamein se kaun sa sangathan 'varkar klas' ke adhikaron ke lie nahin banaya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par hindu mahasabha hi sahi baithta hai. banbai mil haind esosieshan, bharat shramajivi klab, madras lebar yuniyan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar hindu mahasabha hai. Exam point: hindu mahasabha - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The metaphor 'Infant' has been used for what in the national movement?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन में 'शिशु' (Infant) उपमा किसके लिए प्रयुक्त की गई है?
o: शुरुआती साम्राज्यवाद विरोधी आंदोलन (Early anti-imperialist movement)
e: shuruati daur mein rashtravadi andolan bahut najuk tha, jise bahari chot se bachana jaruri tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki rashtriy andolan mein 'shishu' (Infant) upama kisake lie prayukt ki gai hai? Yahi wajah hai ki shuruati samrajyavad virodhi andolan (Early anti-imperialist movement) sahi hai. Galti punjipati, british sena, kisan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan shuruati samrajyavad virodhi andolan (Early anti-imperialist movement) hi milti hai. Exam point: shuruati samrajyavad virodhi andolan (Early anti-imperialist movement) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the Bardoli Satyagraha take place?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह किस वर्ष हुआ था?
e: baradoli satyagrah mukhy rup se 1928 mein gujarat ke surat jile mein hua tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki baradoli satyagrah kis varsh hua tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. In tathyon ke chalte 1928 hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - 1922, 1930, 1918 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1928 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1928 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who led the Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
o: सरदार वल्लभ भाई पटेल (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel)
e: vallabh bhai patel ne is andolan ka kushal aur sangathit netritv kiya tha. Is prashn ka vishay satyagraha hai. satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi karan se saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) sahi uttar hai. mahatma gandhi, kalyan ji mehata, javaharalal neharu ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the percentage increase in land revenue for Bardoli farmers?
qh: बारदोली में किसानों पर लगान (Land Revenue) में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि की गई थी?
e: banbai sarakar ke rajasv adhikariyon ne baradoli mein lagan mein 30 pratishat ki bhari vriddhi ki sipharish ki thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki baradoli mein kisanon par lagan (Land Revenue) mein kitane pratishat ki vriddhi ki gai thi? Yahi wajah hai ki 30% sahi hai. 50%, 10%, 22% is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 30% hi milti hai. Exam point: 30% - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who gave the title of 'Sardar' to Vallabhbhai Patel?
qh: वल्लभ भाई पटेल को 'सरदार' की उपाधि किसने दी थी?
o: बारदोली की महिलाओं ने (Women of Bardoli)
e: andolan ki saphalata aur unake netritv se khush hokar baradoli ki mahilaon ne unhein 'saradar' kaha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki vallabh bhai patel ko 'saradar' ki upadhi kisane di thi? Isi baat se baradoli ki mahilaon ne (Women of Bardoli) sahi sabit hota hai. javaharalal neharu, mahatma gandhi, british sarakar is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar baradoli ki mahilaon ne (Women of Bardoli) hi hai. Exam point: baradoli ki mahilaon ne (Women of Bardoli) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: For whom was the term 'Kali Paraj' used in the Bardoli region?
qh: बारदोली क्षेत्र में 'काली पराज' शब्द किसके लिए प्रयुक्त होता था?
o: पिछड़े वर्ग और जनजाति (Backward classes and Tribals)
e: pichhadae aur shoshit janajatiy samuhon ko 'kali paraj' (kale log) kaha jata tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki baradoli kshetr mein 'kali paraj' shabd kisake lie prayukt hota tha? Yahi wajah hai ki pichhadae varg aur janajati (Backward classes and Tribals) sahi hai. Galti uchch varg ke jamindar, videshi vyapari, sarakari karmachari chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav pichhadae varg aur janajati (Backward classes and Tribals) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: pichhadae varg aur janajati (Backward classes and Tribals) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What name did Gandhi suggest to replace 'Kali Paraj'?
qh: गांधी जी ने 'काली पराज' का नाम बदलकर क्या रखने का सुझाव दिया था?
e: gandhi ji ne 1927 ke sammelan mein unhein sammanit nam 'rani paraj' (van ke raja) diya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki gandhi ji ne 'kali paraj' ka nam badalakar kya rakhane ka sujhav diya tha? Isi karan se rani paraj sahi uttar hai. harijan, svadeshi, ujali paraj is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar rani paraj hai. Exam point: rani paraj - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Into how many camps (chhavnis) did Patel divide Bardoli during the Satyagraha?
qh: सत्याग्रह के दौरान लगान अदायगी रोकने के लिए पटेल ने बारदोली को कितनी छावनियों में बांटा था?
e: patel ne pure taluka ko 13 chhavaniyon mein bantakar pratyek ka ek anubhavi neta niyukt kiya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki satyagrah ke dauran lagan adayagi rokane ke lie patel ne baradoli ko kitani chhavaniyon mein banta tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi aadhar par 13 chuna jaata hai. 10, 20, 5 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav 13 hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 13 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which journal was regularly published during the Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह के दौरान कौन सी पत्रिका (Journal) नियमित रूप से प्रकाशित की जाती थी?
e: janata ko jagaruk karane aur nirdesh dene ke lie 'satyagrah patrika' ka prakashan kiya jata tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki baradoli satyagrah ke dauran kaun si patrika (Journal) niyamit rup se prakashit ki jati thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par satyagrah patrika (Satyagraha Patrika) sahi nikalta hai. yang indiya, komanavil, kesari is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan satyagrah patrika (Satyagraha Patrika) hi milti hai. Exam point: satyagrah patrika (Satyagraha Patrika) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: With what was the 'Hali System' in Bardoli related?
qh: बारदोली क्षेत्र में प्रचलित 'हाली प्रथा' (Hali System) का संबंध किससे था?
e: hali pratha ek prakar ki shoshanakari bandhua majaduri thi, jisake khilaph karyakartaon ne avaj uthai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki baradoli kshetr mein prachalit 'hali pratha' (Hali System) ka sanbandh kisase tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bandhua majaduri (Bonded Labor) hi sahi baithta hai. dharmik shiksha, svatantr vyapar, sainy bharti alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar bandhua majaduri (Bonded Labor) hi hai. Exam point: bandhua majaduri (Bonded Labor) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which committee did the government eventually form to investigate Bardoli's issues?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह की जाँच के लिए सरकार ने अंततः किस समिति का गठन किया था?
e: sarakar ne nyayik adhikari brumaphild aur rajasv adhikari maiksavel ki ek janch samiti banai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki baradoli satyagrah ki janch ke lie sarakar ne antatah kis samiti ka gathan kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par brumaphild-maiksavel samiti (Broomfield-Maxwell Committee) hi sahi baithta hai. saiman kamishan, hantar kameti, rolet ayog mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar brumaphild-maiksavel samiti (Broomfield-Maxwell Committee) hai. Exam point: brumaphild-maiksavel samiti (Broomfield-Maxwell Committee) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: After the inquiry report, to what was the tax rate reduced from 30%?
qh: जाँच समिति की रिपोर्ट के बाद लगान की दर को 30% से घटाकर कितना कर दिया गया था?
e: samiti ne paya ki vriddhi anuchit thi aur ise ghatakar matr 6.03% kar diya gaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki janch samiti ki riport ke bad lagan ki dar ko 30% se ghatakar kitana kar diya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 6.03% hi sahi baithta hai. 10%, 15%, 0% in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 6.03% hi milti hai. Exam point: 6.03% - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main task of the 'Intelligence Wing' in Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह में 'खुफिया विभाग' (Intelligence Wing) का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: चोरी-छुपे लगान देने वालों पर नजर रखना (Monitoring those paying tax secretly)
e: yah vibhag sunishchit karata tha ki koi bhi kisan samajik shapath todakar lagan n bhare. Is prashn ka vishay satyagraha hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par chori-chhupe lagan dene valon par najar rakhana... sahi nikalta hai. angrejon ko marana, aspatal chalana, videshi kapadae bechana anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad chori-chhupe lagan dene valon par najar rakhana... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: chori-chhupe lagan dene valon par najar rakhana (Monitoring those paying tax secretly) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which event mentions 'Congress Special' or 'Home Rule Special' trains to reach sessions?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने बारदोली जाने के लिए 'कांग्रेस स्पेशल' ट्रेन का उल्लेख किया है?
e: asahayog aur lakhanau adhiveshan ke samay karyakartaon ne 'kangres speshal' trenon ka upayog kiya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki kis rashtravadi neta ne baradoli jane ke lie 'kangres speshal' tren ka ullekh kiya hai? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi karan se asahayog / lakhanau adhiveshan (Non-Cooperation/Lucknow Session context) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp chanparan, gadar, baradoli bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab asahayog / lakhanau adhiveshan (Non-Cooperation/Lucknow Session context) hai. Exam point: asahayog / lakhanau adhiveshan (Non-Cooperation/Lucknow Session context) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who was the Viceroy of India during the Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह के समय भारत का वायसराय कौन था?
e: 1928 ke dauran lord iravin bharat ke vayasaray the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki baradoli satyagrah ke samay bharat ka vayasaray kaun tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi aadhar par lord iravin (Lord Irwin) chuna jaata hai. lord riding, lord vevel, lord karjan anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar lord iravin (Lord Irwin) hai. Exam point: lord iravin (Lord Irwin) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which British newspaper called the Bardoli report a 'slap on the government's face'?
qh: किस ब्रिटिश समाचार पत्र ने बारदोली जाँच रिपोर्ट को 'सरकार के मुँह पर तमाचा' कहा था?
e: nyu stetsamain ne is riport ko british sarakar ki naitik har ke rup mein varnit kiya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki kis british samachar patr ne baradoli janch riport ko 'sarakar ke munh par tamacha' kaha tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par nyu stetsamain (New Statesman) sahi nikalta hai. landan taims, morning post, taims oph indiya ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan nyu stetsamain (New Statesman) hi milti hai. Exam point: nyu stetsamain (New Statesman) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which local leaders (Mehta brothers) contributed to organizing Bardoli farmers?
qh: बारदोली के किसानों को संगठित करने में किन स्थानीय नेताओं (मेहता बंधु) का योगदान था?
o: कल्याण जी और कुंवर जी मेहता (Kalyanji and Kunwarji Mehta)
e: kalyan ji mehata aur kunvar ji mehata ne baradoli mein lanbe samay tak rachanatmak kary kie the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki baradoli ke kisanon ko sangathit karane mein kin sthaniy netaon (mehata bandhu) ka yogadan tha? Isi karan se kalyan ji aur kunvar ji mehata (Kalyanji... sahi uttar hai. siddhu aur kanu, bhagat aur rajaguru, shaukat aur mohammad ali is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad kalyan ji aur kunvar ji mehata (Kalyanji and Kunwarji Mehta) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kalyan ji aur kunvar ji mehata (Kalyanji and Kunwarji Mehta) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What warning did Patel give in his letter to the Governor of Bombay?
qh: पटेल ने बंबई के गवर्नर को पत्र लिखकर क्या चेतावनी दी थी?
o: कर वृद्धि वापस न लेने पर असहयोग की (Non-cooperation if tax hike not revoked)
e: unhonne spasht kaha tha ki yadi kar vriddhi vapas nahin li gai to vyapak asahayog hoga. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki patel ne banbai ke gavarnar ko patr likhakar kya chetavani di thi? Isliye antim jawab kar vriddhi vapas n lene par asahayog... ke roop mein milta hai. bharat chhodane ki, kangres bhang karane ki, yuddh ki is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad kar vriddhi vapas n lene par asahayog ki (Non-cooperation if tax hike not revoked) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kar vriddhi vapas n lene par asahayog ki (Non-cooperation if tax hike not revoked) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the prominent woman who organized women in Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह में महिलाओं को संगठित करने वाली प्रमुख महिला कौन थी?
e: mithuben petit aur sharada mehata jaisi mahilaon ne baradoli mein jan-jagarukata phailai. Yahaan satyagraha se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi baat se mithuben petit sahi sabit hota hai. kasturaba gandhi, eni beseint, sarojini nayadu is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad mithuben petit hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: mithuben petit - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the primary reason for the success of Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह की सफलता का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: अटूट एकता और अहिंसक अनुशासन (Unshakable unity and non-violent discipline)
e: kisanon ki ekata aur vallabh bhai patel ka dridh netritv isaki saphalata ka mul mantr tha. Is sawaal mein satyagraha ki baat hai. satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi tathya par atut ekata aur ahinsak anushasan (Unshakable unity... tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - hathiyaron ka prayog, paise ki adhikata, angrejon ki daya - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar atut ekata aur ahinsak anushasan (Unshakable unity... hi hai. Exam point: atut ekata aur ahinsak anushasan (Unshakable unity and non-violent discipline) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What did Gandhi say about the Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: गांधी जी ने बारदोली सत्याग्रह के बारे में क्या कहा था?
o: यह केवल अमीरों का आंदोलन है
यह हमें स्वराज के करीब पहुँचा रहा है (It is bringing us closer to Swaraj)
e: gandhi ji ne kaha ki baradoli sangharsh svaraj ki manjil tak pahunchane mein sahayak siddh hoga. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gandhi ji ne baradoli satyagrah ke bare mein kya kaha tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par yah hamein svaraj ke karib pahuncha raha... sahi nikalta hai. yah keval amiron ka andolan hai, yah svaraj ki prapti hai, yah ek asaphal prayas hai in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan yah hamein svaraj ke karib pahuncha raha hai (It is bringing us closer to Swaraj) hi milti hai. Exam point: yah hamein svaraj ke karib pahuncha raha hai (It is bringing us closer to Swaraj) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: On what basis did the farmers take their pledge during Satyagraha?
qh: सत्याग्रह के दौरान किसानों ने अपनी प्रतिज्ञा (Pledge) किस आधार पर ली थी?
o: धार्मिक ग्रंथों और आपसी एकता के आधार पर (Religious texts and unity)
e: kisanon ne gita, kuran aur kabir ke dohon ki kasamein khakar ekata ka parichay diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki satyagrah ke dauran kisanon ne apani pratijna (Pledge) kis adhar par li thi? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Yahi wajah hai ki dharmik granthon aur apasi ekata ke adhar par (Religious texts and unity) sahi hai. keval dar ke adhar par, british kanun ke adhar par, keval dhan ke adhar par anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar dharmik granthon aur apasi ekata ke adhar par (Religious texts and unity) hai. Exam point: dharmik granthon aur apasi ekata ke adhar... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How did farmers react to the threat of government 'impounding' their cattle?
qh: बारदोली के किसानों ने सरकारी मवेशियों को 'हका लेने' की धमकी पर क्या प्रतिक्रिया दी?
o: अपने घरों और खेतों में मवेशियों के साथ कैद हो गए
e: kisanon ne khud ko aur apane maveshiyon ko gharon ke andar band kar liya taki kurki n ho sake. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki baradoli ke kisanon ne sarakari maveshiyon ko 'haka lene' ki dhamaki par kya pratikriya di? Isi baat se apane gharon aur kheton mein maveshiyon ke sath kaid ho gae sahi sabit hota hai. bhag gae, angrejon ko maveshi de die, maveshi bech die alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar apane gharon aur kheton mein maveshiyon ke sath kaid ho gae hi hai. Exam point: apane gharon aur kheton mein maveshiyon ke... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who played a key role in the 1923 'Nagpur Flag Satyagraha'?
qh: 1923 में हुए 'नागपुर झंडा सत्याग्रह' में किसने महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी?
e: vallabh bhai patel ne nagapur mein jhanda satyagrah ka saphal netritv kiya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1923 mein hue 'nagapur jhanda satyagrah' mein kisane mahatvapurn bhumika nibhai thi? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi aadhar par vallabh bhai patel (Vallabhbhai Patel) chuna jaata hai. bhagat sinh, javaharalal neharu, subhash chandr bos is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan vallabh bhai patel (Vallabhbhai Patel) hi milti hai. Exam point: vallabh bhai patel (Vallabhbhai Patel) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Indian Council members resigned in support of Bardoli Satyagraha?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह के समर्थन में किन भारतीय परिषद सदस्यों ने इस्तीफा दिया था?
o: के.एम. मुंशी और लालजी नारायणजी (K.M. Munshi and Lalji Naranji)
e: banbai vidhan parishad ke sadasy ke.em. munshi aur lalaji narayanaji ne virodh mein istipha de diya tha. Yahaan satyagraha se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi baat se ke.em. munshi aur lalaji narayanaji (K.M. Munshi and Lalji Naranji) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - rajeindr prasad, bi.ar. anbedakar, motilal neharu - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad ke.em. munshi aur lalaji narayanaji (K.M. Munshi and Lalji Naranji) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ke.em. munshi aur lalaji narayanaji (K.M. Munshi... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Bardoli Satyagraha laid the foundation for which upcoming major movement?
qh: बारदोली सत्याग्रह ने आने वाले किस बड़े आंदोलन के लिए नींव तैयार की?
e: baradoli ki saphalata ne 1930 ke savinay avajna andolan ke lie pure desh mein utsah bhar diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki baradoli satyagrah ne ane vale kis badae andolan ke lie ninv taiyar ki? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye antim jawab savinay avajna andolan (Civil Disobedience Movement) ke roop mein milta hai. bharat chhodao andolan, svadeshi andolan, asahayog andolan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab savinay avajna andolan (Civil Disobedience Movement) hai. Exam point: savinay avajna andolan (Civil Disobedience Movement) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Moplah Rebellion primarily occurred in which region of India?
qh: मोपला विद्रोह (Moplah Rebellion) मुख्य रूप से भारत के किस क्षेत्र में हुआ था?
e: mopala vidroh 1921 mein keral ke malabar tat par hua tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mopala vidroh (Moplah Rebellion) mukhy rup se bharat ke kis kshetr mein hua tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par malabar, keral (Malabar, Kerala) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. uttar pradesh, panjab, bangal in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan malabar, keral (Malabar, Kerala) hi milti hai. Exam point: malabar, keral (Malabar, Kerala) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who were the Moplahs?
qh: मोपला कौन थे?
o: मालाबार के मुस्लिम किसान और बटाईदार (Muslim peasants of Malabar)
e: mopala mukhy rup se muslim kashtakar aur khetihar majadur the jo hindu jamindaron (jenamiyon) ke adhin kam karate the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki mopala kaun the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par malabar ke muslim kisan aur bataidar (Muslim peasants of Malabar) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti keral ke adivasi, malabar ke hindu jamindar, british sainik chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar malabar ke muslim kisan aur bataidar (Muslim... hi hai. Exam point: malabar ke muslim kisan aur bataidar (Muslim peasants of Malabar) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which year did the Moplah Rebellion begin?
qh: मोपला विद्रोह की शुरुआत किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: mopala vidroh agast 1921 mein asahayog aur khilaphat andolan ke dauran bhadaka tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mopala vidroh ki shuruat kis varsh hui thi? qe: Where was the Malabar District Congress conference held in April 1920?
