e: 20vin sadi ke kisan andolan rashtriy andolan (jaise asahayog) ke sath sanyugmit hokar chale. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 20vin shatabdi ke kisan andolanon ki mukhy visheshata kya thi? Isliye antim jawab ve rashtriy svadhinata sangharsh se prerit the... ke roop mein milta hai. ve puri tarah se alag-thalag the, ve keval angrejon ke paksh mein the, ve keval dharmik uddeshyon ke lie the alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar ve rashtriy svadhinata sangharsh se prerit the (Inspired by National Struggle) hi hai. Exam point: ve rashtriy svadhinata sangharsh se prerit the (Inspired by National Struggle) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the 'Kisan Sabha' formed in Uttar Pradesh (Awadh)?
qh: उत्तर प्रदेश (अवध) में 'किसान सभा' का गठन किस वर्ष किया गया था?
e: pharavari 1918 mein gauri shankar mishr, indr narayan dvivedi aur madan mohan malaviy ke prayason se isaki sthapana hui. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki uttar pradesh (avadh) mein 'kisan sabha' ka gathan kis varsh kiya gaya tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi karan se 1918 sahi uttar hai. 1922, 1915, 1920 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1918 hai. Exam point: 1918 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: 'Baba Ramchandra', the leader of Awadh peasant movement, was originally from?
qh: अवध किसान आंदोलन के प्रमुख नेता 'बाबा रामचंद्र' मूलतः कहाँ के निवासी थे?
e: baba ramachandr maharashtr ke rahane vale the, jo phiji se lautane ke bad avadh mein bas gae the. Is prashn ka kendra maharashtr (Maharashtra) hai. In tathyon ke chalte maharashtr (Maharashtra) hi sahi hai. Vikalp phiji, bihar, uttar pradesh bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad maharashtr (Maharashtra) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: maharashtr (Maharashtra) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Baba Ramchandra used verses from which text to organize farmers?
qh: बाबा रामचंद्र किसानों को संगठित करने के लिए किस ग्रंथ के दोहों का प्रयोग करते थे?
e: ve graminon ke bich ramacharitamanas ki katha sunate the aur unhein ekata ke lie prerit karate the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki baba ramachandr kisanon ko sangathit karane ke lie kis granth ke dohon ka prayog karate the? Yahi wajah hai ki ramacharitamanas (Ramcharitmanas) sahi hai. mahabharat, bhagavad gita, satyarth prakash anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar ramacharitamanas (Ramcharitmanas) baithta hai. Exam point: ramacharitamanas (Ramcharitmanas) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When did the 'Dhobi-Nai Band' social boycott start in Pratapgarh?
qh: प्रतापगढ़ जिले में 'धोबी-नाई बंद' सामाजिक बहिष्कार आंदोलन कब शुरू हुआ था?
e: 1919 mein pratapagadh ke buletadaron (nai-dhobi) ne jamindaron ki seva karane se mana kar diya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki pratapagadh jile mein 'dhobi-nai band' samajik bahishkar andolan kab shuru hua tha? Isi baat se 1919 sahi sabit hota hai. 1921, 1925, 1918 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 1919 hi hai. Exam point: 1919 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Deputy Commissioner of Pratapgarh assured farmers to hear their grievances?
qh: प्रतापगढ़ के किस डिप्टी कमिश्नर ने किसानों की शिकायतों को सुनने का आश्वासन दिया था?
e: mistar mehata ne kisanon ko ashvasan diya tha ki ve unaki shikayaton ka hal nikaleinge. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki pratapagadh ke kis dipti kamishnar ne kisanon ki shikayaton ko sunane ka ashvasan diya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par mistar mehata (Mr. Mehta) sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - mistar telar, mistar rid, mistar dayar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar mistar mehata (Mr. Mehta) baithta hai. Exam point: mistar mehata (Mr. Mehta) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Baba Ramchandra was arrested on Aug 28, 1920, along with how many other farmers?
qh: बाबा रामचंद्र को 28 अगस्त 1920 को कितने अन्य किसानों के साथ गिरफ्तार किया गया था?
e: unhein aur 32 any kisanon ko chori ke jhuthe arop mein giraphtar kiya gaya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki baba ramachandr ko 28 agast 1920 ko kitane any kisanon ke sath giraphtar kiya gaya tha? Isi tathya par 32 tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - 500, 10, 100 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 32 hi hai. Exam point: 32 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where was 'Awadh Kisan Sabha' formed on Oct 17, 1920?
qh: 'अवध किसान सभा' का गठन 17 अक्टूबर 1920 को कहाँ किया गया था?
e: matabhedon ke bad pratapagadh mein ek samanantar sangathan 'avadh kisan sabha' ka gathan hua. Is prashn ka vishay sabha hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par pratapagadh (Pratapgarh) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - lakhanau, ayodhya, ilahabad - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad pratapagadh (Pratapgarh) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: pratapagadh (Pratapgarh) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What did Baba Ramchandra do in Ayodhya to show the helplessness of farmers?
qh: अयोध्या की जनसभा में बाबा रामचंद्र ने किसानों की बेबसी दिखाने के लिए क्या किया?
o: अपने हाथ रस्सी से बाँध लिए (Tied his hands with rope)
e: unhonne pratikatmak rup se apane hath bandh kar kisanon ki gulami aur dasha ko pradarshit kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki ayodhya ki janasabha mein baba ramachandr ne kisanon ki bebasi dikhane ke lie kya kiya? Isi aadhar par apane hath rassi se bandh lie (Tied his hands with rope) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - maun vrat rakha, bhukh hadatal ki, jel chale gae - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar apane hath rassi se bandh lie (Tied his hands with rope) hi hai. Exam point: apane hath rassi se bandh lie (Tied... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Madan Mohan Malviya wanted to keep the peasant movement separate from which movement?
qh: मदन मोहन मालवीय किसान आंदोलन को किस आंदोलन से अलग रखना चाहते थे?
e: ve asahayog ke 'asanvaidhanik' tarikon (jaise kaunsil bahishkar) ke paksh mein nahin the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki madan mohan malaviy kisan andolan ko kis andolan se alag rakhana chahate the? Isi karan se asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) sahi uttar hai. svadeshi, gadar, khilaphat alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) hi hai. Exam point: asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which districts was the 'Eka Movement' primarily active?
qh: 'एका आंदोलन' (Eka Movement) मुख्य रूप से किन जिलों में सक्रिय था?
o: हरदोई, बहराइच और सीतापुर (Hardoi, Bahraich & Sitapur)
e: yah andolan 1921 ke ant mein avadh ke uttari jilon mein bhadaka tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 'eka andolan' (Eka Movement) mukhy rup se kin jilon mein sakriy tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par haradoi, baharaich aur sitapur (Hardoi, Bahraich &... sahi nikalta hai. varanasi aur gajipur, merath aur agara, patana aur gaya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab haradoi, baharaich aur sitapur (Hardoi, Bahraich &... hai. Exam point: haradoi, baharaich aur sitapur (Hardoi, Bahraich &... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The Eka movement was primarily led by a leader from which community?
qh: एका आंदोलन का नेतृत्व मुख्य रूप से किस समुदाय के नेता ने किया था?
e: madari pasi eka andolan ke sabase pramukh aur jujharu neta the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki eka andolan ka netritv mukhy rup se kis samuday ke neta ne kiya tha? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi aadhar par pasi / pichhadai jati (Pasi / Lower Caste) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - muslim jamindar, brahman, rajaput - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se pasi / pichhadai jati (Pasi / Lower Caste) sahi hai. Exam point: pasi / pichhadai jati (Pasi / Lower Caste) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was used as a religious symbol in Eka movement meetings?
qh: एका आंदोलन की बैठकों में धार्मिक प्रतीक के रूप में किसका उपयोग किया जाता था?
o: गड्ढे में भरा पानी जिसे गंगा माना जाता था (Water in a pit as Ganga)
e: kisan gaddhe ke pani ko ganga manakar ekata ki shapath lete the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki eka andolan ki baithakon mein dharmik pratik ke rup mein kisaka upayog kiya jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par gaddhe mein bhara pani jise ganga mana... sahi nikalta hai. talavar, keval jhanda, havan kund mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se gaddhe mein bhara pani jise ganga mana jata tha (Water in a pit as Ganga) sahi hai. Exam point: gaddhe mein bhara pani jise ganga mana... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the primary protest of farmers during the Eka movement?
qh: एका आंदोलन के दौरान किसानों का मुख्य विरोध किस बात को लेकर था?
o: निर्धारित लगान से 50% अधिक वसूली (Collection of 50% more than fixed rent)
e: jamindar nirdharit dar se bahut adhik lagan vasul rahe the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki eka andolan ke dauran kisanon ka mukhy virodh kis bat ko lekar tha? In tathyon ke chalte nirdharit lagan se 50% adhik vasuli (Collection of 50% more than fixed rent) hi sahi hai. nil ki kheti, angreji shiksha, namak kar anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan nirdharit lagan se 50% adhik vasuli (Collection of 50% more than fixed rent) hi milti hai. Exam point: nirdharit lagan se 50% adhik vasuli (Collection of 50% more than fixed rent) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was a key difference between the Eka movement and Awadh Kisan Sabha?
qh: एका आंदोलन और अवध किसान सभा में एक प्रमुख अंतर क्या था?
o: एका में छोटे जमींदार भी शामिल थे (Small landlords included in Eka)
अवध सभा अंग्रेजों के साथ थी
e: eka andolan mein chhote jamindar aur talukedar bhi kisanon ke sath angrejon ka virodh kar rahe the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki eka andolan aur avadh kisan sabha mein ek pramukh antar kya tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isliye sahi nateeja eka mein chhote jamindar bhi shamil the (Small landlords included in Eka) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - eka keval shahar mein tha, avadh sabha angrejon ke sath thi, koi antar nahin tha - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab eka mein chhote jamindar bhi shamil the... hai. Exam point: eka mein chhote jamindar bhi shamil the (Small landlords included in Eka) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Through which act did the British govt ban Kisan Sabhas?
qh: किस अधिनियम के माध्यम से ब्रिटिश सरकार ने किसान सभाओं पर प्रतिबंध लगाया?
e: 1921 mein sarakar ne kisan gatividhiyon ko dabane ke lie is adhiniyam ko lagu kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki kis adhiniyam ke madhyam se british sarakar ne kisan sabhaon par pratibandh lagaya? In tathyon ke chalte deshadrohi baithak adhiniyam (Seditious Meetings Act) hi sahi hai. arms ekt, varnakular pres ekt, rolet ekt is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab deshadrohi baithak adhiniyam (Seditious Meetings Act) hai. Exam point: deshadrohi baithak adhiniyam (Seditious Meetings Act) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which year did Jawaharlal Nehru start touring the villages of Awadh?
qh: जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने किस वर्ष अवध के गाँवों का दौरा शुरू किया था?
e: jun 1920 mein neharu ne baba ramachandr ke agrah par avadh ke kisanon ki sthiti dekhi thi. Is prashn ka dayra 1920 tak phaila hua hai. Isi aadhar par 1920 chuna jaata hai. 1925, 1930, 1915 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1920 hai. Exam point: 1920 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein. Prashn chhota lage par iske peeche poora ek ghatna-kram tatha saal ka gyaan chhupa hota hai, isliye poora sandarbh dhyan mein rakhein.

qe: Which peasant movement was completely suppressed by the British by March 1922?
qh: किस किसान आंदोलन को ब्रिटिश सरकार ने मार्च 1922 तक पूरी तरह दबा दिया था?
e: daman chakr aur rajanitik alagav ke karan eka andolan 1922 tak samapt ho gaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kis kisan andolan ko british sarakar ne march 1922 tak puri tarah daba diya tha? Isi aadhar par eka andolan (Eka Movement) chuna jaata hai. nil vidroh, kheda satyagrah, chanparan satyagrah alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan eka andolan (Eka Movement) hi milti hai. Exam point: eka andolan (Eka Movement) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where did a massive gathering of 1 lakh farmers take place in 1920?
qh: किस स्थान पर 1920 में 1 लाख किसानों की विशाल जनसभा हुई थी?
e: disanbar 1920 mein ayodhya mein kisanon ka aitihasik mahasammelan hua tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kis sthan par 1920 mein 1 lakh kisanon ki vishal janasabha hui thi? Yahi wajah hai ki ayodhya sahi hai. Galti merath, varanasi, lakhanau chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ayodhya hi milti hai. Exam point: ayodhya - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did the British exile Nawab Wajid Ali Shah of Awadh?
qh: अवध के नवाब 'वाजिद अली शाह' को अंग्रेजों ने कहाँ निर्वासित किया था?
e: 1856 mein avadh ke adhigrahan ke bad navab ko kalakatta bhej diya gaya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki avadh ke navab 'vajid ali shah' ko angrejon ne kahan nirvasit kiya tha? Isi karan se kalakatta (Calcutta) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp landan, andaman, rangun bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kalakatta (Calcutta) hi milti hai. Exam point: kalakatta (Calcutta) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What did 'Begari' mean in peasant movements?
qh: किसान आंदोलनों में 'बेगारी' (Begari) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: मुफ्त में काम करना (Unpaid forced labor)
e: kisanon ko bina kisi parishramik ke jamindaron ke yahan kam karana p ta tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki kisan andolanon mein 'begari' (Begari) ka kya arth tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par mupht mein kam karana (Unpaid forced labor) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - naya bij bona, jamin bechana, sarakar ka sath dena - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad mupht mein kam karana (Unpaid forced labor) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: mupht mein kam karana (Unpaid forced labor) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date did the Non-Cooperation Movement begin?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन की शुरुआत किस तिथि को हुई थी?
e: 1 agast 1920 ko asahayog andolan shuru hua, isi din tilak ka nidhan hua tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki asahayog andolan ki shuruat kis tithi ko hui thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1 agast 1920 (1st Aug 1920) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 26 janavari 1921, 15 agast 1920, 13 aprail 1919 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1 agast 1920 (1st Aug 1920) hai. Exam point: 1 agast 1920 (1st Aug 1920) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: With what was the term 'Nikkasi' related during the Eka movement?
qh: एका आंदोलन के दौरान 'निकासी' (Nikkasi) शब्द का संबंध किससे था?
e: kisanon ne shapath li thi ki ve lagan dene par rasid (nikasi) prapt kareinge. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki eka andolan ke dauran 'nikasi' (Nikkasi) shabd ka sanbandh kisase tha? Isliye antim jawab lagan ki rasid (Rent receipt) ke roop mein milta hai. ganv se bahar jana, bijon ka chayan, sarakari naukari anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se lagan ki rasid (Rent receipt) sahi hai. Exam point: lagan ki rasid (Rent receipt) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What stand did Awadh farmers take against 'evicted' (Bedakhli) land?
qh: अवध के किसानों ने 'बेदखली' (Eviction) जमीन के प्रति क्या रुख अपनाया?
o: उसे नहीं जोतने की शपथ ली (Swore not to till it)
e: kisanon ne shapath li ki ve kisi bhi bedakhal ki gai jamin par kheti nahin kareinge. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki avadh ke kisanon ne 'bedakhali' (Eviction) jamin ke prati kya rukh apanaya? Yahi wajah hai ki use nahin jotane ki shapath li (Swore not to till it) sahi hai. Vikalp use sarakar ko bech diya, us par ghar bana liya, use turant jotana shuru kiya bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan use nahin jotane ki shapath li (Swore not to till it) hi milti hai. Exam point: use nahin jotane ki shapath li (Swore not to till it) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Through which act did Awadh Taluqdars regain rights in 1877?
qh: 1877 में किस अधिनियम के माध्यम से अवध के तालुकेदारों को फिर से अधिकार मिले?
e: 1857 ke vidroh ke bad angrejon ne talukedaron ko khush karane ke lie unhein jamin ke malikana hak die. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1877 mein kis adhiniyam ke madhyam se avadh ke talukedaron ko phir se adhikar mile? Yahi wajah hai ki avadh samajhauta adhiniyam (Awadh Settlement Act) sahi hai. avadh lagan adhiniyam, raulet ekt, pits indiya ekt in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar avadh samajhauta adhiniyam (Awadh Settlement Act) hi hai. Exam point: avadh samajhauta adhiniyam (Awadh Settlement Act) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who were called 'Bulletdars' during the movement?
qh: किसान आंदोलन के दौरान 'बुलेटदार' (Bulletdars) किसे कहा गया?
o: धोबी, नाई और सेवादार जातियों को (Service castes)
e: samaj ki sevadar jatiyon (jaise nai, dhobi) ko avadh mein buletadar kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kisan andolan ke dauran 'buletadar' (Bulletdars) kise kaha gaya? Isliye antim jawab dhobi, nai aur sevadar jatiyon ko (Service... ke roop mein milta hai. jamindaron ke lathaiton ko, sainikon ko, keval patavariyon ko anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad dhobi, nai aur sevadar jatiyon ko (Service castes) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: dhobi, nai aur sevadar jatiyon ko (Service... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who called the farmers to Roor village to record their grievances?
qh: प्रतापगढ़ के 'रूर' (Roor) गाँव में शिकायतों को दर्ज करने के लिए किसानों को किसने बुलाया था?
e: dipti kamishnar mehata ne rur ganv mein kisanon ko apani shikayatein likhavane ke lie amantrit kiya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki pratapagadh ke 'rur' (Roor) ganv mein shikayaton ko darj karane ke lie kisanon ko kisane bulaya tha? Isi aadhar par dipti kamishnar mehata (DC Mehta) chuna jaata hai. madan mohan malaviy, baba ramachandr, javaharalal neharu anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar dipti kamishnar mehata (DC Mehta) baithta hai. Exam point: dipti kamishnar mehata (DC Mehta) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Madari Pasi belonged to which category of the movement?
qh: एका आंदोलन के प्रमुख नेता 'मदारी पासी' का संबंध किस वर्ग से था?
e: madari pasi ek pichhadai jati ke neta the, jinhonne eka andolan ko ek ugr rup diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki eka andolan ke pramukh neta 'madari pasi' ka sanbandh kis varg se tha? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi tathya par dalit / pichhadai jati (Dalit / Backward... tika hua hai. kulin varg, british sena, burjua varg is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se dalit / pichhadai jati (Dalit / Backward Caste) sahi hai. Exam point: dalit / pichhadai jati (Dalit / Backward Caste) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did the 'Indigo Revolt' take place in the 19th century?
qh: 19वीं सदी के किसान आंदोलनों में 'नील विद्रोह' (Indigo Revolt) कहाँ हुआ था?
e: nil vidroh 1859-60 mein mukhy rup se bangal ke nadiya jile mein hua tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 19vin sadi ke kisan andolanon mein 'nil vidroh' (Indigo Revolt) kahan hua tha? Isi karan se bangal (Bengal) sahi uttar hai. Galti bihar, maharashtr, panjab chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab bangal (Bengal) hai. Exam point: bangal (Bengal) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What law was the eventual outcome of the Awadh peasant movement?
qh: अवध किसान आंदोलन की अंतिम परिणति (Conclusion) किस कानून के रूप में हुई?
o: अवध मालगुजारी संशोधन अधिनियम (Awadh Rent Amendment Act)
e: andolan ke dabav mein 1921 mein sarakar ne avadh reint sanshodhan adhiniyam parit kiya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki avadh kisan andolan ki antim parinati (Conclusion) kis kanun ke rup mein hui? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par avadh malagujari sanshodhan adhiniyam (Awadh Rent Amendment Act) hi sahi baithta hai. raulet ekt, jamindari unmulan, van kanun ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab avadh malagujari sanshodhan adhiniyam (Awadh Rent Amendment Act) hai. Exam point: avadh malagujari sanshodhan adhiniyam (Awadh Rent Amendment... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which session was the decision taken to speed up the Non-Cooperation Movement and start Civil Disobedience?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन की गति बढ़ाने और सविनय अवज्ञा शुरू करने का निर्णय किस अधिवेशन में लिया गया था?
e: disanbar 1921 ke ahamadabad adhiveshan mein yah mahasus kiya gaya ki andolan ki gati tej karani hogi kyonki sarakar par asar nahin p raha tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki asahayog andolan ki gati badhane aur savinay avajna shuru karane ka nirnay kis adhiveshan mein liya gaya tha? civil disobedience mein kanoon todkar sarkari kaam rokne ki appeal thi. Isi karan se ahamadabad adhiveshan 1921 (Ahmedabad Session 1921) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp belaganv adhiveshan, kalakatta adhiveshan, nagapur adhiveshan bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar ahamadabad adhiveshan 1921 (Ahmedabad Session 1921) hi hai. Exam point: ahamadabad adhiveshan 1921 (Ahmedabad Session 1921) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: From which place did Gandhi announce the start of the Civil Disobedience movement?
qh: गांधी जी ने सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन (Civil Disobedience) की शुरुआत कहाँ से करने की घोषणा की थी?
e: gandhi ji ne vayasaray ko agah kiya tha ki yadi mangein nahin mani gain to ve baradoli se deshavyapi savinay avajna shuru kareinge. Is sawaal mein civil ki baat hai. civil disobedience mein kanoon todkar sarkari kaam rokne ki appeal thi. Isi aadhar par baradoli (Bardoli) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - chauri-chaura, sabaramati, chanparan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab baradoli (Bardoli) hai. Exam point: baradoli (Bardoli) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: On which date did the famous Chauri Chaura incident occur?
qh: चौरी-चौरा की प्रसिद्ध घटना किस तिथि को हुई थी?
e: 5 pharavari 1922 ko gorakhapur ke chauri-chaura mein bhid aur pulis ke bich hinsak jhadap hui thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki chauri-chaura ki prasiddh ghatana kis tithi ko hui thi? Yahi wajah hai ki 5 pharavari 1922 (5th Feb 1922) sahi hai. 1 agast 1920, 13 aprail 1919, 12 pharavari 1922 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar 5 pharavari 1922 (5th Feb 1922) hi hai. Exam point: 5 pharavari 1922 (5th Feb 1922) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How many policemen were killed in the Chauri Chaura incident?
qh: चौरी-चौरा कांड में कुल कितने पुलिसकर्मी मारे गए थे?
e: ugr bhid ne thane mein ag laga di thi, jisamein 22 pulisakarmi jalakar ya pitakar mare gae the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki chauri-chaura kand mein kul kitane pulisakarmi mare gae the? Isliye antim jawab 22 ke roop mein milta hai. Galti 15, 50, 10 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 22 hai. Exam point: 22 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where was Gandhi at the time of the Chauri Chaura incident?
qh: चौरी-चौरा घटना के समय गांधी जी कहाँ थे?
e: jab chauri-chaura ki ghatana hui, gandhi ji baradoli mein savinay avajna andolan ki taiyari kar rahe the. Is prashn ka kendra baradoli (Bardoli) hai. Isliye antim jawab baradoli (Bardoli) ke roop mein milta hai. yaravada, ahamadabad, gorakhapur ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan baradoli (Bardoli) hi milti hai. Exam point: baradoli (Bardoli) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On which day was the Non-Cooperation Movement officially withdrawn?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन को आधिकारिक रूप से किस दिन वापस लिया गया?
e: 12 pharavari 1922 ko baradoli mein hui kangres karyasamiti ki baithak mein andolan vapas lene ka nirnay liya gaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki asahayog andolan ko adhikarik rup se kis din vapas liya gaya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 12 pharavari 1922 (12th Feb 1922) sahi nikalta hai. 10 march 1922, 1 agast 1920, 5 pharavari 1922 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 12 pharavari 1922 (12th Feb 1922) hi hai. Exam point: 12 pharavari 1922 (12th Feb 1922) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What charge did Rajni Palme Dutt level against Gandhi after the withdrawal?
qh: आंदोलन वापस लेने के निर्णय के बाद रजनी पाम दत्त ने गांधी जी पर क्या आरोप लगाया?
o: वे अमीर वर्ग और जमींदारों के हितों की रक्षा कर रहे थे (Protecting interests of elites/landlords)
e: vamapanthi vicharakon ne arop lagaya ki gandhi ji ne jan-shakti ke uday se darakar aur jamindaron ko bachane ke lie andolan vapas liya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki andolan vapas lene ke nirnay ke bad rajani pam datt ne gandhi ji par kya arop lagaya? Isliye sahi nateeja ve amir varg aur jamindaron ke hiton ki raksha kar rahe the (Protecting interests of elites/landlords) nikalta hai. Galti ve bahut dare hue the, unhein rajaniti nahin ati thi, ve bimar the chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar ve amir varg aur jamindaron ke hiton ki raksha kar rahe the (Protecting interests of elites/landlords) hai. Exam point: ve amir varg aur jamindaron ke hiton... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What main reason did Gandhi give for withdrawing the movement?
qh: गांधी जी ने असहयोग आंदोलन वापस लेने का मुख्य कारण क्या बताया?
e: gandhi ji ka manana tha ki andolan hinsak ho raha hai aur bina purn anushasan ke yah daman ka shikar ho jaega. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gandhi ji ne asahayog andolan vapas lene ka mukhy karan kya bataya? In tathyon ke chalte andolan mein badhati hinsa (Increasing violence) hi sahi hai. angrejon ki takat, netaon ki giraphtari, paise ki kami mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar andolan mein badhati hinsa (Increasing violence) hai. Exam point: andolan mein badhati hinsa (Increasing violence) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who called the sudden suspension of the movement a 'National Calamity'?

e: subhash chandr bos aur kai any yuva neta andolan ko vapas lene ke gandhi ji ke phaisale se behad nirash the. Is prashn ka kendra subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) hai. Yahi wajah hai ki subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) sahi hai. javaharalal neharu, chittaranjan das, motilal neharu is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) hai. Exam point: subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

e: gandhi ji ne lord riding ko chetavani di thi ki ve daman rokein aur svaraj par dhyan dein. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gandhi ji ne savinay avajna ki dhamaki dene se pahale kis vayasaray ko patr likha tha? civil disobedience mein kanoon todkar sarkari kaam rokne ki appeal thi. In tathyon ke chalte lord riding (Lord Reading) hi sahi hai. lord kaining, lord iravin, lord karjan is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar lord riding (Lord Reading) hi hai. Exam point: lord riding (Lord Reading) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which party was formed by leaders who split from Gandhi after the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के बाद गांधी जी के पृथक होकर किस पार्टी का गठन हुआ?

Yahi sahi uttar svaraj parti (Swaraj Party) hai. Exam point: svaraj parti (Swaraj Party) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad janasabhaon mein bhid ka kam hona (Fewer... hi theek uttar hai. qe: What did Gandhi try to protect the public from by withdrawing the movement?
qh: गांधी जी ने आंदोलन वापस लेकर जनता को किससे बचाने का प्रयास किया?

qe: To how much did the import of foreign clothes drop from 102 crores during the movement?

Galti shuny, 90 karod, 20 karod chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 57 karod (57 Crores) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 57 karod (57 Crores) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: The procession in Chauri Chaura was mainly led by workers of which group?

qe: What is considered the greatest achievement of the Non-Cooperation Movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन की सबसे बड़ी उपलब्धि क्या मानी जाती है?

qe: What did Gandhi adopt as a symbol of boycotting foreign clothes?

Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki gandhi ji ne videshi kapadaon ke bahishkar ke pratik ke rup mein kya apanaya? Isi tathya par khadi aur langot (Khadi and Loincloth) tika hua hai. topi, tilak, saphed kurta is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar khadi aur langot (Khadi and Loincloth) baithta hai. Exam point: khadi aur langot (Khadi and Loincloth) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: On the death anniversary of which leader did Gandhi start the movement?
qh: गांधी जी ने किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता के निधन के दिन असहयोग आंदोलन शुरू किया था?
e: 1 agast 1920 ko tilak ji ki mrityu ke sath hi andolan ka shankhanad hua tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gandhi ji ne kis rashtravadi neta ke nidhan ke din asahayog andolan shuru kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) hi sahi baithta hai. dadabhai nauroji, gopal krishn gokhale, lala lajapat ray is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) hi milti hai. Exam point: bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Picketing liquor shops was a part of which aspect of the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान 'ताड़ी' (Liquor) की दुकानों पर धरना देना किसका हिस्सा था?
o: रचनात्मक कार्य और राजस्व विरोध (Constructive work & revenue protest)
e: sharababandi se sarakar ke rajasv ko arthik nukasan pahunchana aur naitik sudhar karana uddeshy tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki asahayog andolan ke dauran 'tadai' (Liquor) ki dukanon par dharana dena kisaka hissa tha? Isi aadhar par rachanatmak kary aur rajasv virodh (Constructive work & revenue protest) chuna jaata hai. sainik vidroh, keval manoranjan, dharmik yatra ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se rachanatmak kary aur rajasv virodh (Constructive work & revenue protest) sahi hai. Exam point: rachanatmak kary aur rajasv virodh (Constructive work & revenue protest) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which committee was formed to investigate the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
qh: ब्रिटिश सरकार ने जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड की जांच के लिए कौन सी कमेटी बनाई थी?
e: hantar kameti ne janaral dayar ke krity ko keval ek 'bhul' batakar use klin chit de di thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki british sarakar ne jaliyanvala bag hatyakand ki janch ke lie kaun si kameti banai thi? Isi tathya par hantar kameti (Hunter Committee) tika hua hai. rolet kameti, saiman kamishan, batalar kameti is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav hantar kameti (Hunter Committee) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: hantar kameti (Hunter Committee) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What happened in Bombay during the visit of the Prince of Wales?
qh: प्रिंस ऑफ वेल्स (Prince of Wales) की भारत यात्रा के समय बंबई में क्या हुआ?
o: देशव्यापी हड़ताल और दंगे (Country-wide strike and riots)
गांधी जी ने उनसे मुलाकात की
e: prins oph vels ka svagat suni galiyon aur hadatal se hua, jisase british sarakar tilamila uthi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki prins oph vels (Prince of Wales) ki bharat yatra ke samay banbai mein kya hua? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par deshavyapi hadatal aur dange (Country-wide strike and... sahi nikalta hai. sena ne vidroh kiya, unaka bhavy svagat, gandhi ji ne unase mulakat ki anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar deshavyapi hadatal aur dange (Country-wide strike and riots) baithta hai. Exam point: deshavyapi hadatal aur dange (Country-wide strike and riots) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How much time did Gandhi promise to get Swaraj during the movement?
qh: गांधी जी ने असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान 'स्वराज' कितने समय में दिलाने का वादा किया था?
e: gandhi ji ne kaha tha ki yadi purn anushasan aur ahinsa ka palan hua to 1 sal mein svaraj milega. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gandhi ji ne asahayog andolan ke dauran 'svaraj' kitane samay mein dilane ka vada kiya tha? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isi karan se 1 varsh mein (In 1 year) sahi uttar hai. 10 sal, 5 sal, turant in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar 1 varsh mein (In 1 year) hi hai. Exam point: 1 varsh mein (In 1 year) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the primary basis of Hindu-Muslim unity during the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन में हिंदू-मुस्लिम एकता का आधार मुख्य रूप से क्या था?
e: gandhi ji ne khilaphat andolan ka samarthan kar donon samudayon ko angrejon ke viruddh ekajut kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki asahayog andolan mein hindu-muslim ekata ka adhar mukhy rup se kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par khilaphat ka mudda (The Khilafat issue) sahi nikalta hai. Vikalp keval vyapar, angreji shiksha, sati pratha bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan khilaphat ka mudda (The Khilafat issue) hi milti hai. Exam point: khilaphat ka mudda (The Khilafat issue) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were 'Congress Special' or 'Home Rule Special' during the movement?
qh: आंदोलन के दौरान 'कांग्रेस स्पेशल' या 'होमरूल स्पेशल' क्या थी?
o: लखनऊ अधिवेशन के लिए बुक की गई ट्रेनें (Special trains for Lucknow session)
e: karyakartaon ne lakhanau adhiveshan mein shamil hone ke lie puri trenein buk ki thin. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki andolan ke dauran 'kangres speshal' ya 'homarul speshal' kya thi? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi karan se lakhanau adhiveshan ke lie buk ki gai trenein (Special trains for Lucknow session) sahi uttar hai. sainik tukadaiyan, vishesh samachar patr, vishesh viman alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar lakhanau adhiveshan ke lie buk ki gai trenein (Special trains for Lucknow session) hi hai. Exam point: lakhanau adhiveshan ke lie buk ki gai trenein (Special trains for Lucknow session) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the purpose of keeping the membership fee at 4 annas?
qh: कांग्रेस की सदस्यता शुल्क 4 आना (25 पैसे) रखने का उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: गरीबों और किसानों को कांग्रेस से जोड़ना (Including poor and peasants)
e: gandhi ji chahate the ki kangres keval amiron ki nahin balki am janata ki sanstha bane. Prashn yah batata hai ki kangres ki sadasyata shulk 4 ana (25 paise) rakhane ka uddeshy kya tha? Isi aadhar par garibon aur kisanon ko kangres se jodana (Including poor and peasants) chuna jaata hai. videshi chanda rokana, keval vakilon ke lie, paise kamana in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan garibon aur kisanon ko kangres se jodana... hi milti hai. Exam point: garibon aur kisanon ko kangres se jodana... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who among the Ali brothers said it is 'Haram' for Muslims to remain in the British army?
qh: अली बंधुओं में से किसने कहा था कि 'मुसलमानों का ब्रिटिश सेना में रहना हराम है'?
e: mohammad ali ne karachi adhiveshan mein sainikon se sena chhodane ka ahvan kiya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki ali bandhuon mein se kisane kaha tha ki 'musalamanon ka british sena mein rahana haram hai'? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par mohammad ali sahi nikalta hai. shaukat ali, abul kalam ajad, hasarat mohani ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab mohammad ali hai. Exam point: mohammad ali - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which leader was jailed for 6 years after the withdrawal of the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन की वापसी के बाद किस नेता को 6 साल की जेल हुई?
e: andolan sthagit hone ke bad march 1922 mein gandhi ji ko giraphtar kar 6 sal ki saja sunai gai. Is sawaal mein mahatma gandhi ki baat hai. Isi aadhar par mahatma gandhi chuna jaata hai. javaharalal neharu, motilal neharu, saradar patel is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar mahatma gandhi baithta hai. Exam point: mahatma gandhi - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which present-day district is 'Chauri Chaura' located?
qh: उत्तर प्रदेश का 'चौरी-चौरा' स्थल वर्तमान के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: chauri-chaura uttar pradesh ke gorakhapur jile ka ek mahatvapurn aitihasik sthal hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki uttar pradesh ka 'chauri-chaura' sthal vartaman ke kis jile mein sthit hai? Isi karan se gorakhapur (Gorakhpur) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp lakhanau, varanasi, ilahabad bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad gorakhapur (Gorakhpur) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: gorakhapur (Gorakhpur) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which institution was formed as an alternative to English education during the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान शिक्षा के विकल्प के रूप में कौन सी संस्था बनी थी?
o: काशी विद्यापीठ / जामिया मिलिया (Kashi Vidyapeeth / Jamia Millia)
e: shiksha ke bahishkar ke dauran kai svadeshi aur rashtriy shikshan sansthan sthapit kie gae. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki asahayog andolan ke dauran shiksha ke vikalp ke rup mein kaun si sanstha bani thi? Isliye sahi nateeja kashi vidyapith / jamiya miliya (Kashi Vidyapeeth / Jamia Millia) nikalta hai. kolakata vishvavidyalay, bi.ech.yu., oksaphord is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kashi vidyapith / jamiya miliya (Kashi Vidyapeeth / Jamia Millia) hai. Exam point: kashi vidyapith / jamiya miliya (Kashi Vidyapeeth / Jamia Millia) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date was the Non-Cooperation Movement formally launched?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन (Non-Cooperation Movement) की औपचारिक शुरुआत किस तिथि को हुई थी?
e: asahayog andolan 1 agast 1920 ko shuru hua tha. isi din durbhagyavash bal gangadhar tilak ka nidhan bhi hua tha. Yahaan 1 agast 1920 (1st Aug 1920) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi aadhar par 1 agast 1920 (1st Aug 1920) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - 26 janavari 1921, 13 aprail 1919, 15 agast 1920 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1 agast 1920 (1st Aug 1920) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1 agast 1920 (1st Aug 1920) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Against which event did Gandhi return his 'Kaiser-i-Hind' title?
qh: गांधी जी ने किस घटना के विरोध में अपनी 'केसर-ए-हिंद' (Kaiser-i-Hind) की उपाधि लौटा दी थी?
o: जलियांवाला बाग और रॉलेट एक्ट (Jallianwala & Rowlatt)
e: jaliyanvala bag hatyakand aur rolet ekt se dukhi hokar gandhi ji ne asahayog andolan ke dauran apani upadhi lauta di thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhi ji ne kis ghatana ke virodh mein apani 'kesar-e-hind' (Kaiser-i-Hind) ki upadhi lauta di thi? Isi karan se jaliyanvala bag aur rolet ekt (Jallianwala &... sahi uttar hai. ilbart bil, chauri-chaura kand, bangal vibhajan is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jaliyanvala bag aur rolet ekt (Jallianwala & Rowlatt) hi milti hai. Exam point: jaliyanvala bag aur rolet ekt (Jallianwala & Rowlatt) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which special session of Congress (1920) was the Non-Cooperation resolution placed?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन का प्रस्ताव कांग्रेस के किस विशेष अधिवेशन (1920) में रखा गया था?
e: sitanbar 1920 mein lala lajapat ray ki adhyakshata mein kalakatta ke vishesh adhiveshan mein yah prastav rakha gaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki asahayog andolan ka prastav kangres ke kis vishesh adhiveshan (1920) mein rakha gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kalakatta adhiveshan (Calcutta Session) sahi nikalta hai. nagapur adhiveshan, belaganv adhiveshan, lakhanau adhiveshan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar kalakatta adhiveshan (Calcutta Session) hi hai. Exam point: kalakatta adhiveshan (Calcutta Session) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which annual session (Dec 1920) was the Non-Cooperation Movement ratified?
qh: कांग्रेस के किस वार्षिक अधिवेशन (दिसंबर 1920) में असहयोग आंदोलन की पुष्टि की गई?
e: nagapur adhiveshan mein siar das ne asahayog prastav pesh kiya aur kangres ne ise adhikarik taur par apanaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kangres ke kis varshik adhiveshan (disanbar 1920) mein asahayog andolan ki pushti ki gai? Isi tathya par nagapur adhiveshan (Nagpur Session) tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - kalakatta adhiveshan, surat adhiveshan, ahamadabad adhiveshan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab nagapur adhiveshan (Nagpur Session) hai. Exam point: nagapur adhiveshan (Nagpur Session) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What major structural change was made in Congress during the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान कांग्रेस के संगठनात्मक ढांचे में क्या बड़ा बदलाव किया गया?
o: 15 सदस्यीय कार्यकारिणी समिति का गठन (Formation of Working Committee)
e: andolan ke sanchalan ke lie gandhi ji ke sujhav par 15 sadasyon vali ek 'kangres varking kameti' (CWC) banai gai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki asahayog andolan ke dauran kangres ke sangathanatmak dhanche mein kya bada badalav kiya gaya? samiti gram ke aam logon ki sabha thi. Isi karan se 15 sadasyiy karyakarini samiti ka gathan (Formation of Working Committee) sahi uttar hai. videshi sadasyon ko shamil karana, adhyaksh pad ko samapt karana, keval angreji bhasha ka prayog anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab 15 sadasyiy karyakarini samiti ka gathan (Formation of Working Committee) hai. Exam point: 15 sadasyiy karyakarini samiti ka gathan (Formation of Working Committee) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the target amount for the 'Tilak Swaraj Fund' during the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान स्थापित 'तिलक स्वराज फंड' का लक्ष्य कितनी राशि एकत्रित करना था?
e: 1921 ke vijayavada adhiveshan mein tilak svaraj phand ke lie 1 karod rupaye jutane ka lakshy rakha gaya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki asahayog andolan ke dauran sthapit 'tilak svaraj phand' ka lakshy kitani rashi ekatrit karana tha? swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isi aadhar par 1 karod rupaye (1 Crore Rupees) chuna jaata hai. 50 lakh, 10 lakh, 5 karod anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 1 karod rupaye (1 Crore Rupees) hi hai. Exam point: 1 karod rupaye (1 Crore Rupees) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The movement was most successful in boycotting which area?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन का सर्वाधिक प्रभाव किस क्षेत्र के बहिष्कार में देखा गया?
e: videshi kapadaon ka bahishkar sabase adhik saphal raha, jisase videshi kapadaon ka ayat 102 karod se ghatakar 57 karod rah gaya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki asahayog andolan ka sarvadhik prabhav kis kshetr ke bahishkar mein dekha gaya? Isliye antim jawab videshi kapadae (Foreign Clothes) ke roop mein milta hai. Galti skul-kolej, sarakari naukariyan, adalatein chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan videshi kapadae (Foreign Clothes) hi milti hai. Exam point: videshi kapadae (Foreign Clothes) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: When did the 'Prince of Wales' visit India during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान 'प्रिंस ऑफ वेल्स' (Prince of Wales) भारत कब आए थे?
e: navanbar 1921 mein prins oph vels ka bharat mein deshavyapi hadatal aur sannate ke sath svagat kiya gaya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki asahayog andolan ke dauran 'prins oph vels' (Prince of Wales) bharat kab ae the? Isi karan se navanbar 1921 (November 1921) sahi uttar hai. Galti janavari 1922, agast 1920, mai 1919 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar navanbar 1921 (November 1921) hi hai. Exam point: navanbar 1921 (November 1921) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: When did Gandhi start wearing only a loincloth during the movement?
qh: आंदोलन के दौरान गांधी जी ने अपनी वेशभूषा बदलकर केवल 'लंगोट' (Loincloth) पहनना कब से शुरू किया?
o: 1921 विजयवाड़ा अधिवेशन के बाद (Post Vijayawada Session)
e: khadi ki mahatta aur garibon ke sath ekatmakata darshane ke lie unhonne 1921 mein apana pahanava badal liya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki andolan ke dauran gandhi ji ne apani veshabhusha badalakar keval 'langot' (Loincloth) pahanana kab se shuru kiya? Isi baat se 1921 vijayavada adhiveshan ke bad (Post Vijayawada Session) sahi sabit hota hai. asahayog ke ant mein, chanparan satyagrah, dandi march ke dauran in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1921 vijayavada adhiveshan ke bad (Post Vijayawada Session) hai. Exam point: 1921 vijayavada adhiveshan ke bad (Post Vijayawada Session) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who was the first major leader arrested during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन में गिरफ्तार होने वाले पहले प्रमुख नेता कौन थे?
e: sarakar ne daman shuru karate hue sabase pahale bangal ke neta chittaranjan das ko giraphtar kiya tha. Is prashn ka vishay si.ar. das (C.R. Das) hai. Isi aadhar par si.ar. das (C.R. Das) chuna jaata hai. vallabh bhai patel, mahatma gandhi, javaharalal neharu alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan si.ar. das (C.R. Das) hi milti hai. Exam point: si.ar. das (C.R. Das) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who became the Principal of National College, Calcutta during the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान शिक्षा के बहिष्कार के समय कलकत्ता के 'नेशनल कॉलेज' के प्रिंसिपल कौन बने?
e: subhash chandr bos ne sarakari naukari chhodakar neshanal kolej, kalakatta ke prinsipal ka pad sanbhala. Is prashn ka kendra subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) hai. Isliye sahi nateeja subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) nikalta hai. ravindranath taigor, sarapalli radhakrishnan, motilal neharu anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) hai. Exam point: subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which class gave up their legal practice to boycott government courts?
qh: आंदोलन के दौरान किस वर्ग ने सरकारी अदालतों का बहिष्कार कर अपनी वकालत छोड़ दी थी?
e: si.ar. das, motilal neharu aur saradar patel jaise badae vakilon ne apani praiktis chhod di thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki andolan ke dauran kis varg ne sarakari adalaton ka bahishkar kar apani vakalat chho di thi? In tathyon ke chalte pramukh vakilon ne (Leading Lawyers) hi sahi hai. doktaron ne, keval chhatron ne, kisanon ne ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad pramukh vakilon ne (Leading Lawyers) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: pramukh vakilon ne (Leading Lawyers) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which of these was a 'Constructive Program' of the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन का 'रचनात्मक कार्यक्रम' (Constructive Program) इनमें से कौन सा था?
o: छुआछूत का अंत और हिंदू-मुस्लिम एकता (Abolition of Untouchability & Unity)
e: gandhi ji ne khadi, ekata aur samajik sudharon par vishesh bal diya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki asahayog andolan ka 'rachanatmak karyakram' (Constructive Program) inamein se kaun sa tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par chhuachhut ka ant aur hindu-muslim ekata (Abolition of Untouchability & Unity) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti videshi kapadae jalana, taiks n dena, hadatal karana chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab chhuachhut ka ant aur hindu-muslim ekata (Abolition... hai. Exam point: chhuachhut ka ant aur hindu-muslim ekata (Abolition of Untouchability & Unity) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: When did Gandhi give a notice to the Viceroy before starting the movement?
qh: गांधी जी ने असहयोग आंदोलन शुरू करने से पहले वायसराय को नोटिस कब दिया था?
e: 22 jun 1920 ko gandhi ji ne vayasaray ko patr likhakar asahayog ke apane adhikar ki ghoshana ki thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gandhi ji ne asahayog andolan shuru karane se pahale vayasaray ko notis kab diya tha? Isi aadhar par 22 jun 1920 (22nd June 1920) chuna jaata hai. 13 aprail 1919, 26 janavari 1921, 1 agast 1920 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 22 jun 1920 (22nd June 1920) hai. Exam point: 22 jun 1920 (22nd June 1920) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: On what core idea was the 'Non-Cooperation' based?
qh: 'असहयोग' (Non-Cooperation) का मुख्य विचार किस बात पर आधारित था?
o: ब्रिटिश शासन भारतीयों के सहयोग से चल रहा है (British rule relies on Indian cooperation)
e: gandhi ji ka manana tha ki yadi bharatiy sahayog karana band kar dein, to british shasan ek sal mein gir jaega. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 'asahayog' (Non-Cooperation) ka mukhy vichar kis bat par adharit tha? Isliye antim jawab british shasan bharatiyon ke sahayog se chal... ke roop mein milta hai. Galti shastr uthana, vyapar band karana, keval hinsa chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad british shasan bharatiyon ke sahayog se chal raha hai (British rule relies on Indian cooperation) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: british shasan bharatiyon ke sahayog se chal raha hai (British rule relies on Indian cooperation) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Picketing at 'Tadi' (liquor) shops was primarily a protest against?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान 'ताड़ी' (Liquor) की दुकानों पर पिकेटिंग मुख्य रूप से किसका विरोध था?
o: ब्रिटिश राजस्व और नैतिकता का ह्रास (British revenue & moral decay)
e: sharababandi asahayog ka hissa ban gai kyonki yah angrejon ke lie rajasv ka bada srot thi. Is sawaal mein british rajasv aur naitikata ka hras (British revenue & moral decay) ki baat hai. Isi karan se british rajasv aur naitikata ka hras (British... sahi uttar hai. Vikalp kimatein badhana, keval sharab ka, bhojan ki kami bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad british rajasv aur naitikata ka hras (British... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: british rajasv aur naitikata ka hras (British revenue & moral decay) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: For which movement did Gandhi say 'Swaraj in one year' is possible?
qh: गांधी जी ने किस आंदोलन के संदर्भ में कहा था कि 'स्वराज एक वर्ष में' मिल सकता है?
e: gandhi ji ne vada kiya tha ki yadi andolan puri tarah ahinsak aur anushasit raha, to svaraj ek sal mein milega. Is prashn ka kendra swaraj hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. svadeshi andolan, bharat chhodao, savinay avajna in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) hi milti hai. Exam point: asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: To what amount was the Congress membership fee reduced?
qh: कांग्रेस की सदस्यता शुल्क (Membership Fee) घटाकर कितनी कर दी गई थी?
e: taki garib kisan aur majadur bhi kangres se ju sakein, sadasyata shulk matr 4 ana rakha gaya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki kangres ki sadasyata shulk (Membership Fee) ghatakar kitani kar di gai thi? In tathyon ke chalte 4 ana / 25 paise (4 Annas / 25 Paise) hi sahi hai. Vikalp 1 rupaya, mupht, 10 rupaye salana bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 4 ana / 25 paise (4 Annas... hai. Exam point: 4 ana / 25 paise (4 Annas... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which law was challenged in Andhra Pradesh during the movement?
qh: आंध्र प्रदेश में असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान कौन सा कानून तोड़ने का प्रयास किया गया?
e: andhr ke guntur jile aur palanadu mein adivasiyon ne charai shulk aur van kanunon ki avajna ki. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki andhr pradesh mein asahayog andolan ke dauran kaun sa kanun to ne ka prayas kiya gaya? Isi karan se van kanun (Forest Laws) sahi uttar hai. shiksha kanun, namak kanun, pres kanun is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar van kanun (Forest Laws) hi hai. Exam point: van kanun (Forest Laws) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Against whom were the protests held during the 'Akali Movement' in Punjab?
qh: पंजाब में 'अकाली आंदोलन' के दौरान किनके विरुद्ध प्रदर्शन हुए थे?
e: sikhon ne gurudvaron ko bhrasht aur sarakari pitthu mahanton ke changul se chhudane ke lie andolan kiya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki panjab mein 'akali andolan' ke dauran kinake viruddh pradarshan hue the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par bhrasht mahanton ke (Corrupt Mahants) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. keval pulis ke, muslim lig ke, angrej sainikon ke mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bhrasht mahanton ke (Corrupt Mahants) hi milti hai. Exam point: bhrasht mahanton ke (Corrupt Mahants) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which British officer ordered the firing at Jallianwala Bagh?
qh: किस ब्रिटिश अधिकारी ने जलियांवाला बाग में अंधाधुंध गोलियां चलाने का आदेश दिया था?
e: janaral dayar ne nihatthi bhid par goli chalane ka adesh diya, jise hantar kameti ne mamuli bhul mana. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kis british adhikari ne jaliyanvala bag mein andhadhundh goliyan chalane ka adesh diya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par janaral dayar (General Dyer) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp maikal o dayar, lord kaining, lord ripan bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar janaral dayar (General Dyer) hi hai. Exam point: janaral dayar (General Dyer) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which governance system did the 1919 reforms introduce in provinces?
qh: मोंटेग्यू-चेम्सफोर्ड सुधार (1919) ने प्रांतों में कौन सी शासन प्रणाली लागू की थी?
e: 1919 ke ekt ke madhyam se pranton mein 'dvaidh shasan' lagu kiya gaya, jisase rashtravadi asantusht the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki montegyu-chemsaphord sudhar (1919) ne pranton mein kaun si shasan pranali lagu ki thi? dyarchy mein soobon ki satta do hisson - hastantarit tatha aarakshit - mein banti thi. Isliye sahi nateeja dvaidh shasan (Dyarchy) nikalta hai. tanashahi, svashasan, purn svatantrata mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar dvaidh shasan (Dyarchy) hai. Exam point: dvaidh shasan (Dyarchy) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who called the burning of foreign clothes 'a cruel waste'?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान विदेशी कपड़ों को जलाना 'एक निष्ठुर बर्बादी' किसने कहा था?
e: taigor pratikatmak rup se kapadae jalane ke paksh mein nahin the aur ise barbadi manate the. Yah prashn ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) se juda hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) sahi nikalta hai. mahatma gandhi, motilal neharu, lord karjan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) sahi hai. Exam point: ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: On what basis were the provincial Congress committees formed?
qh: कांग्रेस की प्रांतीय समितियों का गठन किस आधार पर किया गया था?
e: gandhi ji ne sthaniy star par ju av ke lie bhashai adhar par kangres samitiyon ka gathan karavaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kangres ki prantiy samitiyon ka gathan kis adhar par kiya gaya tha? Isi baat se bhashai adhar (Linguistic Basis) sahi sabit hota hai. sainy adhar, dharmik adhar, janasankhya in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad bhashai adhar (Linguistic Basis) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bhashai adhar (Linguistic Basis) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which institutions were established as alternatives during the education boycott?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन में 'शिक्षा' के विकल्प के रूप में कौन सी संस्थाएं स्थापित हुईं?
e: kashi vidyapith, bihar vidyapith aur jamiya miliya islamiya jaisi sansthaen isi dauran banin. Is sawaal mein rashtriy vidyapith (National Universities like Kashi/Gujarat) ki baat hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par rashtriy vidyapith (National Universities like Kashi/Gujarat) hi sahi baithta hai. keval angreji skul, konveint skul, videshi mishanari skul in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar rashtriy vidyapith (National Universities like Kashi/Gujarat) hi hai. Exam point: rashtriy vidyapith (National Universities like Kashi/Gujarat) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main issue of the Khilafat Movement?
qh: खिलाफत आंदोलन (Khilafat Movement) का मुख्य मुद्दा क्या था?
o: तुर्की के खलीफा का पद और अधिकार (Position of Caliph in Turkey)
e: bharatiy musalaman turki ke khalipha ke apaman aur turki ke vibhajan ke viruddh the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki khilaphat andolan (Khilafat Movement) ka mukhy mudda kya tha? khilafat andolan turki ke khalifa ke samarthan mein chalaya gaya tha. Yahi wajah hai ki turki ke khalipha ka pad aur adhikar (Position of Caliph in Turkey) sahi hai. keval karon mein kami, sati pratha, svadeshi is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar turki ke khalipha ka pad aur adhikar (Position of Caliph in Turkey) baithta hai. Exam point: turki ke khalipha ka pad aur adhikar (Position of Caliph in Turkey) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Approximately how many people were jailed during the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान कुल कितने लोगों के जेल जाने का अनुमान है?
e: daman ke dauran sarakar ne desh bhar ke lagabhag 30,000 se adhik svayansevakon ko jel bheja. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki asahayog andolan ke dauran kul kitane logon ke jel jane ka anuman hai? Isliye antim jawab 30,000 se adhik (More than 30,000) ke roop mein milta hai. shuny, 5,000, 1 lakh alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 30,000 se adhik (More than 30,000) hi hai. Exam point: 30,000 se adhik (More than 30,000) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which city did famous lawyer Motilal Nehru give up his legal practice?
qh: प्रसिद्ध वकील मोतीलाल नेहरू ने किस शहर में अपनी वकालत छोड़ी थी?
e: ilahabad ke motilal neharu ne asahayog ke samarthan mein apani alishan vakalat ka tyag kar diya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki prasiddh vakil motilal neharu ne kis shahar mein apani vakalat chhodai thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par ilahabad (Prayagraj) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. madras, kalakatta, banbai anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab ilahabad (Prayagraj) hai. Exam point: ilahabad (Prayagraj) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did Gandhi withdraw the movement? (Immediate cause)
qh: गांधी जी ने असहयोग आंदोलन को क्यों वापस लिया था? (तात्कालिक कारण)
o: चौरी-चौरा की हिंसक घटना (Chauri Chaura Violence)
e: pharavari 1922 mein chauri-chaura mein hui hinsa se dukhi hokar gandhi ji ne andolan sthagit kar diya. Yahaan chauri-chaura ki hinsak ghatana (Chauri Chaura Violence) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi baat se chauri-chaura ki hinsak ghatana (Chauri Chaura Violence) sahi sabit hota hai. angrej jit gae the, tilak ki mrityu, phand khatm ho gaya tha is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar chauri-chaura ki hinsak ghatana (Chauri Chaura Violence) hai. Exam point: chauri-chaura ki hinsak ghatana (Chauri Chaura Violence) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What is considered a major achievement of the movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन की एक बड़ी उपलब्धि क्या मानी जाती है?
o: राष्ट्रवाद का जन-आंदोलन बनना (Nationalism became a mass movement)
e: is andolan ne pahali bar desh ke kisan, majadur aur mahilaon ko ajadi ki ladai se joda. Is prashn ka dayra jati tak phaila hua hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par rashtravad ka jan-andolan banana (Nationalism became a mass movement) hi sahi baithta hai. angrejon ka hriday parivartan, bharat ki purn ajadi, keval sena ka gathan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar rashtravad ka jan-andolan banana (Nationalism became a mass movement) hi hai. Exam point: rashtravad ka jan-andolan banana (Nationalism became a mass movement) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi permanently return to India from South Africa?
qh: महात्मा गांधी किस वर्ष दक्षिण अफ्रीका से स्थायी रूप से भारत लौटे थे?
e: gandhi ji 9 janavari 1915 ko bharat laute the, jise ab 'pravasi bharatiy divas' ke rup mein manaya jata hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mahatma gandhi kis varsh dakshin aphrika se sthayi rup se bharat laute the? In tathyon ke chalte 1915 hi sahi hai. 1916, 1914, 1917 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1915 hai. Exam point: 1915 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Whom did Gandhi consider his political guru after returning to India?
qh: गांधी जी ने भारत आने के बाद अपना राजनीतिक गुरु (Political Guru) किसे माना?
e: gokhale ke sujhav par hi gandhi ji ne sakriy rajaniti mein utarane se pahale ek varsh tak bharat bhraman kiya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gandhi ji ne bharat ane ke bad apana rajanitik guru (Political Guru) kise mana? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. dadabhai nauroji, ravindranath taigor, bal gangadhar tilak anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) hi hai. Exam point: gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which was Gandhi's first successful Satyagraha in India?
qh: गांधी जी का भारत में पहला सफल सत्याग्रह कौन सा था?
e: 1917 mein bihar ke chanparan mein nil kisanon ke samarthan mein kiya gaya satyagrah bharat mein unaka pahala saphal andolan tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gandhi ji ka bharat mein pahala saphal satyagrah kaun sa tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye antim jawab chanparan satyagrah (Champaran Satyagraha) ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp ahamadabad mil hadatal, kheda satyagrah, rolet satyagrah bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav chanparan satyagrah (Champaran Satyagraha) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: chanparan satyagrah (Champaran Satyagraha) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Against which 'system' was the Champaran Satyagraha launched?
qh: चंपारण सत्याग्रह किस 'पद्धति' के विरोध में चलाया गया था?
e: tinakathiya paddhati ke tahat kisanon ko apani jamin ke 3/20 bhag par anivary rup se nil ki kheti karani padati thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki chanparan satyagrah kis 'paddhati' ke virodh mein chalaya gaya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi tathya par tinakathiya paddhati (Tinkathia System) tika hua hai. raiyatavadai, ijaredari, mahalavadai in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar tinakathiya paddhati (Tinkathia System) hi hai. Exam point: tinakathiya paddhati (Tinkathia System) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who invited Gandhi to visit Champaran?
qh: गांधी जी को चंपारण आने का निमंत्रण किसने दिया था?
e: bihar ke kisan neta rajakumar shukl ne 1916 ke lakhanau adhiveshan mein gandhi ji se milakar unhein chanparan ane ka agrah kiya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gandhi ji ko chanparan ane ka nimantran kisane diya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par rajakumar shukl (Rajkumar Shukla) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. rajeindr prasad, je.bi. kripalani, brajakishor prasad anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab rajakumar shukl (Rajkumar Shukla) hai. Exam point: rajakumar shukl (Rajkumar Shukla) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the main issue of the Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918)?
qh: अहमदाबाद मिल हड़ताल (1918) का मुख्य मुद्दा क्या था?
e: mil malik pleg bonas samapt karana chahate the, jabaki majadur mahangai ke karan ise jari rakhane ki mang kar rahe the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ahamadabad mil hadatal (1918) ka mukhy mudda kya tha? Isi tathya par pleg bonas (Plague Bonus) tika hua hai. svaraj, kam ke ghante, namak kar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad pleg bonas (Plague Bonus) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: pleg bonas (Plague Bonus) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which movement did Gandhi use a 'Hunger Strike' for the first time?
qh: गांधी जी ने पहली बार 'भूख हड़ताल' (Hunger Strike) का प्रयोग किस आंदोलन में किया था?
e: majaduron ka manobal badhane ke lie gandhi ji ne ahamadabad mein pahali bar bhukh hadatal ki thi. Yahaan ahamadabad mil hadatal (Ahmedabad Mill Strike) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isliye sahi nateeja ahamadabad mil hadatal (Ahmedabad Mill Strike) nikalta hai. kheda, chanparan, asahayog andolan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ahamadabad mil hadatal (Ahmedabad Mill Strike) hi milti hai. Exam point: ahamadabad mil hadatal (Ahmedabad Mill Strike) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who was Gandhi's main associate in the Kheda Satyagraha (1918)?
qh: खेड़ा सत्याग्रह (1918) में गांधी जी का मुख्य सहयोगी कौन था?
o: सरदार वल्लभ भाई पटेल (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel)
e: saradar patel ne kheda ke kisanon ko lagan n dene ke lie sangathit karane mein mahatvapurn bhumika nibhai thi. Yah prashn satyagraha se juda hai. satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye antim jawab saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) ke roop mein milta hai. Galti mahadev desai, javaharalal neharu, subhash chandr bos chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) hi hai. Exam point: saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the primary reason for the Kheda Satyagraha?
qh: खेड़ा सत्याग्रह का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: फसल खराब होने के बावजूद लगान वसूली (Revenue collection despite crop failure)
e: akal ke karan phasal kharab hone par bhi sarakar lagan maph karane ko taiyar nahin thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki kheda satyagrah ka mukhy karan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par phasal kharab hone ke bavajud lagan vasuli... sahi nikalta hai. nil ki kheti, majaduri mein kami, dharmik daman is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se phasal kharab hone ke bavajud lagan vasuli (Revenue collection despite crop failure) sahi hai. Exam point: phasal kharab hone ke bavajud lagan vasuli... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What name did Indians give to the Rowlatt Act (1919)?
qh: रॉलेट एक्ट (1919) को भारतीयों ने क्या नाम दिया था?
e: bina vakil, bina dalil aur bina apil ke giraphtari ke karan ise 'kala kanun' kaha gaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki rolet ekt (1919) ko bharatiyon ne kya nam diya tha? Isi tathya par kala kanun (Black Act) tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - saty kanun, shvet kanun, ajadi ka kanun - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kala kanun (Black Act) hai. Exam point: kala kanun (Black Act) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: When did Gandhi call for a 'Satyagraha Day' to protest against the Rowlatt Act?
qh: गांधी जी ने रॉलेट एक्ट के विरोध में 'सत्याग्रह दिवस' कब मनाने का आह्वान किया था?
e: gandhi ji ne 6 aprail 1919 ko deshavyapi hadatal aur upavas ka ahvan kiya tha. Is prashn ka kendra satyagraha hai. satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi karan se 6 aprail 1919 (6th April 1919) sahi uttar hai. 1 agast 1920, 13 aprail 1919, 30 march 1919 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab 6 aprail 1919 (6th April 1919) hai. Exam point: 6 aprail 1919 (6th April 1919) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On which date did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre occur?
qh: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड किस तिथि को हुआ था?
e: baisakhi ke din amritasar ke jaliyanvala bag mein shantipurn bhid par andhadhundh goliyan chalai gai thin. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki jaliyanvala bag hatyakand kis tithi ko hua tha? Isi baat se 13 aprail 1919 (13th April 1919) sahi sabit hota hai. 6 aprail 1919, 15 agast 1919, 10 aprail 1919 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 13 aprail 1919 (13th April 1919) hi milti hai. Exam point: 13 aprail 1919 (13th April 1919) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which British officer ordered the firing at Jallianwala Bagh?
qh: जलियांवाला बाग में गोली चलाने का आदेश किस अंग्रेज अधिकारी ने दिया था?
e: janaral dayar ne bina kisi chetavani ke nihatthi bhid par goli chalane ka adesh diya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki jaliyanvala bag mein goli chalane ka adesh kis angrej adhikari ne diya tha? In tathyon ke chalte janaral dayar (General Dyer) hi sahi hai. lord chemsaphord, lord karjan, sidani rolet anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar janaral dayar (General Dyer) hai. Exam point: janaral dayar (General Dyer) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who returned the 'Knighthood' title in protest against the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
qh: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड के विरोध में किसने 'नाइटहुड' (Knighthood) की उपाधि लौटा दी थी?
e: taigor ne british daman ke virodh mein apani pratishthit upadhi tyag di thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki jaliyanvala bag hatyakand ke virodh mein kisane 'naitahud' (Knighthood) ki upadhi lauta di thi? In tathyon ke chalte ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) hi sahi hai. motilal neharu, mahatma gandhi, chittaranjan das is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: From which place was Gandhi arrested and sent back to Bombay during the Rowlatt Satyagraha?
qh: रॉलेट सत्याग्रह के दौरान गांधी जी को किस स्थान से गिरफ्तार कर वापस बंबई भेज दिया गया था?
e: panjab pravesh se pahale unhein palaval steshan par giraphtar kar liya gaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki rolet satyagrah ke dauran gandhi ji ko kis sthan se giraphtar kar vapas banbai bhej diya gaya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi karan se palaval / hariyana (Palwal / Haryana) sahi uttar hai. Galti chanparan, dilli, amritasar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad palaval / hariyana (Palwal / Haryana) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: palaval / hariyana (Palwal / Haryana) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which two popular leaders were arrested in Amritsar for protesting the Rowlatt Act?
qh: अमृतसर में रॉलेट एक्ट के विरोध में किन दो लोकप्रिय नेताओं को गिरफ्तार किया गया था?
o: डॉ. सैफुद्दीन किचलू और डॉ. सत्यपाल (Dr. Kitchlew & Dr. Satyapal)
e: inaki giraphtari ke virodh mein hi 13 aprail ko jaliyanvala bag mein sabha ayojit ki gai thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki amritasar mein rolet ekt ke virodh mein kin do lokapriy netaon ko giraphtar kiya gaya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja do. saiphuddin kichalu aur do. satyapal (Dr. Kitchlew & Dr. Satyapal) nikalta hai. tilak aur lajapat ray, gandhi aur neharu, bos aur patel alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan do. saiphuddin kichalu aur do. satyapal (Dr. Kitchlew & Dr. Satyapal) hi milti hai. Exam point: do. saiphuddin kichalu aur do. satyapal (Dr.... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

e: bos us samay sakriy rajaniti mein nahin the, jabaki any tinon gandhi ji ke mukhy sahayogi the. Is prashn ka vishay subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) hai. In tathyon ke chalte subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) hi sahi hai. rajeindr prasad, je.bi. kripalani, mahadev desai mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) hi milti hai. Exam point: subhash chandr bos (Subhas Chandra Bose) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What percentage of bonus did mill owners announce during the Ahmedabad strike?
qh: अहमदाबाद मिल हड़ताल के दौरान मिल मालिकों ने कितने प्रतिशत बोनस देने की घोषणा की थी?
e: malik 20% bonas dena chahate the, jabaki gandhi ji ne 35% ki mang manavai. Isi baat se 20% sahi sabit hota hai. 50%, 10%, 35% is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar 20% hi hai. Exam point: 20% - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which commission was formed by the govt to investigate the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
qh: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड की जांच के लिए सरकार ने कौन सा आयोग गठित किया था?
e: british sarakar ne hatyakand ki aupacharik janch ke lie hantar kameti ka gathan kiya tha. Galti saiman kamishan, batalar ayog, rolet ayog chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab hantar ayog (Hunter Commission) hai. Exam point: hantar ayog (Hunter Commission) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What percentage of illegal collection did Champaran planters agree to refund?
qh: चंपारण के प्लांटर्स ने किसानों से की गई अवैध वसूली का कितना प्रतिशत वापस करने पर सहमति जताई?
e: gandhi ji 25% riphand par man gae kyonki yah plantars ki naitik har aur pratishtha ka saval tha. Exam point: 25% - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: After which event did Gandhi withdraw the Rowlatt Satyagraha?
qh: गांधी जी ने किस घटना के बाद रॉलेट सत्याग्रह को वापस ले लिया था?
o: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड और व्यापक हिंसा (Wide-scale violence)
e: deshavyapi hinsa aur jaliyanvala bag trasadi ko dekhate hue gandhi ji ne 18 aprail 1919 ko andolan vapas liya. Is prashn ka vishay satyagraha hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par jaliyanvala bag hatyakand aur vyapak hinsa (Wide-scale violence) hi sahi baithta hai. chauri-chaura kand, tilak ki mrityu, chanparan ki saphalata is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se jaliyanvala bag hatyakand aur vyapak hinsa (Wide-scale violence) sahi hai. Exam point: jaliyanvala bag hatyakand aur vyapak hinsa (Wide-scale violence) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which global war was ongoing when Gandhi arrived in India?
qh: गांधी जी के भारत आगमन के समय कौन सा वैश्विक युद्ध चल रहा था?
e: gandhi ji 1915 mein laute, us samay pratham vishv yuddh (1914-1918) chal raha tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gandhi ji ke bharat agaman ke samay kaun sa vaishvik yuddh chal raha tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par pratham vishv yuddh (World War I) hi sahi baithta hai. rus-japan yuddh, koriyai yuddh, dvitiy vishv yuddh anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se pratham vishv yuddh (World War I) sahi hai. Exam point: pratham vishv yuddh (World War I) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who invited Gandhi to lead the Ahmedabad Mill strike?
qh: अहमदाबाद मिल हड़ताल में गांधी जी को किसने आमंत्रित किया था?
e: anusuya ben, jo mil malik anbalal sarabhai ki bahan thin, ne gandhi ji se madad mangi thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki ahamadabad mil hadatal mein gandhi ji ko kisane amantrit kiya tha?
