Exam point: anusuya ben (Anasuya Sarabhai) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where did Gandhi form the Satyagraha Sabha?
qh: सत्याग्रह सभा (Satyagraha Sabha) का गठन गांधी जी ने कहाँ किया था?
e: rolet ekt ke khilaph andolan chalane ke lie unhonne banbai mein satyagrah sabha banai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki satyagrah sabha (Satyagraha Sabha) ka gathan gandhi ji ne kahan kiya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye sahi nateeja banbai (Bombay) nikalta hai. dilli, lakhanau, ahamadabad alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar banbai (Bombay) baithta hai. Exam point: banbai (Bombay) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: According to Gandhi, what is the core basis of 'Satyagraha'?
qh: गांधी जी के अनुसार 'सत्याग्रह' का मूल आधार क्या है?
e: satyagrah ka arth hai saty ke lie kiya gaya agrah jo purnatah ahinsak ho. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav saty aur ahinsa (Truth and Non-violence) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: saty aur ahinsa (Truth and Non-violence) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which of these is called Gandhi's 'Real Peasant Satyagraha'?

Prashn yah batata hai ki inamein se kis andolan ko gandhi ji ka 'vastavik kisan satyagrah' (Real Peasant Satyagraha) kaha jata hai? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi karan se kheda satyagrah (Kheda Satyagraha) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - chanparan, ahamadabad, baradoli - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kheda satyagrah (Kheda Satyagraha) hi milti hai. Exam point: kheda satyagrah (Kheda Satyagraha) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who was the Lieutenant Governor of Punjab during the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
qh: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड के समय पंजाब का लेफ्टिनेंट गवर्नर कौन था?
e: janaral dayar sainy kamandar tha, jabaki maikal o'dayar panjab ka lephtineint gavarnar tha. Is prashn ka kendra maikal o dayar (Michael O'Dwyer) hai. Isliye sahi nateeja maikal o dayar (Michael O'Dwyer) nikalta hai. Vikalp janaral dayar, lord harding, lord karjan bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se maikal o dayar (Michael O'Dwyer) sahi hai. Exam point: maikal o dayar (Michael O'Dwyer) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On the banks of which river did Gandhi establish his ashram in India?
qh: गांधी जी ने भारत में अपना 'आश्रम' किस नदी के किनारे स्थापित किया था?
e: gandhi ji ne ahamadabad mein sabaramati nadi ke kinare apana ashram banaya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki gandhi ji ne bharat mein apana 'ashram' kis nadi ke kinare sthapit kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sabaramati (Sabarmati) sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - narmada, ganga, yamuna - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab sabaramati (Sabarmati) hai. Exam point: sabaramati (Sabarmati) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which event did Gandhi describe as a 'Himalayan Blunder'?
qh: किस घटना को गांधी जी ने 'हिमालय जैसी भूल' (Himalayan Blunder) कहा था?
o: रॉलेट सत्याग्रह में जनता का हिंसक होना (Violence in Rowlatt Satyagraha)
e: bina puri taiyari aur anushasan ke janata ko satyagrah mein utarane ko unhonne apani badai bhul mana. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kis ghatana ko gandhi ji ne 'himalay jaisi bhul' (Himalayan Blunder) kaha tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye antim jawab rolet satyagrah mein janata ka hinsak hona... ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp chauri-chaura, svadeshi bahishkar, vibhajan bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab rolet satyagrah mein janata ka hinsak hona... hai. Exam point: rolet satyagrah mein janata ka hinsak hona (Violence in Rowlatt Satyagraha) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who gave the title of 'Mahatma' to Gandhi after the success of Champaran?
qh: चंपारण सत्याग्रह की सफलता के बाद गांधी जी को 'महात्मा' की उपाधि किसने दी थी?
e: gandhi ji ki nisvarth seva aur chanparan ki jit se prabhavit hokar taigor ne unhein 'mahatma' kaha. Is prashn ka vishay ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) hai. Yahi wajah hai ki ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) sahi hai. vallabh bhai patel, javaharalal neharu, subhash chandr bos alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) hi hai. Exam point: ravindranath taigor (Rabindranath Tagore) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi go to South Africa as a barrister for a legal case?
qh: महात्मा गांधी किस वर्ष बैरिस्टर के रूप में कानूनी केस लड़ने के लिए दक्षिण अफ्रीका गए थे?
e: gandhi ji 1893 mein dada abdulla ka kes l ne ke lie dakshin aphrika gae the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki mahatma gandhi kis varsh bairistar ke rup mein kanuni kes l ne ke lie dakshin aphrika gae the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1893 sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - 1885, 1906, 1915 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se 1893 sahi hai. Exam point: 1893 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Where did Gandhi first encounter racial discrimination in South Africa?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका में गांधी जी का 'रंगभेद' (Racial Discrimination) से पहली बार सामना कहाँ हुआ था?
e: tren yatra ke dauran unhein pitaramairitsabarg steshan par pratham shreni ke dibbe se bahar pheink diya gaya tha. Is sawaal mein pitaramairitsabarg (Pietermaritzburg) ki baat hai. Yahi wajah hai ki pitaramairitsabarg (Pietermaritzburg) sahi hai. Galti pritoriya (Pretoria), johansabarg (Johannesburg), daraban (Durban) chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan pitaramairitsabarg (Pietermaritzburg) hi milti hai. Exam point: pitaramairitsabarg (Pietermaritzburg) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which organization did Gandhi form in South Africa for the rights of Indians?
qh: गांधी जी ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका में भारतीयों के अधिकारों के लिए किस संस्था का गठन किया था?
e: 1894 mein gandhi ji ne natal bharatiy kangres ki sthapana ki thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki gandhi ji ne dakshin aphrika mein bharatiyon ke adhikaron ke lie kis sanstha ka gathan kiya tha? Isliye antim jawab natal bharatiy kangres (Natal Indian Congress) ke roop mein milta hai. bharatiy rashtriy kangres, homarul lig, gadar parti anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar natal bharatiy kangres (Natal Indian Congress) hi hai. Exam point: natal bharatiy kangres (Natal Indian Congress) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the name of the newspaper published by Gandhi in South Africa?
qh: गांधी जी द्वारा दक्षिण अफ्रीका से प्रकाशित समाचार पत्र का नाम क्या था?
e: gandhi ji ne 'indiyan opiniyan' ke madhyam se bharatiyon ki samasyaon aur satyagrah ke vicharon ka prachar kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki gandhi ji dvara dakshin aphrika se prakashit samachar patr ka nam kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par indiyan opiniyan (Indian Opinion) sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - harijan, kesari, yang indiya - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab indiyan opiniyan (Indian Opinion) hai. Exam point: indiyan opiniyan (Indian Opinion) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When was Gandhi's 'Moderate Phase' in South Africa considered to be?
qh: गांधी जी के दक्षिण अफ्रीका प्रवास के दौरान उनका 'नरमपंथी चरण' (Moderate Phase) कब से कब तक माना जाता है?
e: shuruati 12 varshon (1894-1906) mein gandhi ji ne prarthana patron aur jnapanon ke madhyam se sudhar ki mang ki thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gandhi ji ke dakshin aphrika pravas ke dauran unaka 'naramapanthi charan' (Moderate Phase) kab se kab tak mana jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1894-1906 hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - 1906-1914, 1915-1920, 1893-1894 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 1894-1906 hai. Exam point: 1894-1906 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year did Gandhi start his first 'Satyagraha'?
qh: गांधी जी ने अपना पहला 'सत्याग्रह' (Satyagraha) किस वर्ष शुरू किया था?
e: gandhi ji ne 1906 mein panjikaran praman patr (Registration Certificates) ke khilaph pahala satyagrah shuru kiya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gandhi ji ne apana pahala 'satyagrah' (Satyagraha) kis varsh shuru kiya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi karan se 1906 sahi uttar hai. 1893, 1917, 1915 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se 1906 sahi hai. Exam point: 1906 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which 'farm' did Gandhi establish in South Africa for his associates?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका में गांधी जी ने अपने सहयोगियों के रहने के लिए किस 'फार्म' की स्थापना की थी?
e: gandhi ji ne apane mitr kolenabak ki sahayata se tolastoy pharm ki sthapana ki thi. Is prashn ka dayra tolastoy pharm (Tolstoy Farm) tak phaila hua hai. Isi aadhar par tolastoy pharm (Tolstoy Farm) chuna jaata hai. vardha ashram, sabaramati ashram, shanti niketan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav tolastoy pharm (Tolstoy Farm) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: tolastoy pharm (Tolstoy Farm) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What name did Indians give to jails during the Satyagraha?
qh: सत्याग्रह के दौरान जेल जाने वाले भारतीयों ने जेल को क्या नाम दिया था?
o: किंग एडवर्ड का होटल (King Edward’s Hotel)
e: jel jane ke dar ko khatm karane ke lie pradarshanakariyon ne jel ko 'king edavard ka hotal' kahana shuru kiya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki satyagrah ke dauran jel jane vale bharatiyon ne jel ko kya nam diya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi karan se king edavard ka hotal (King Edward's Hotel) sahi uttar hai. sasural, karagar, svarg in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar king edavard ka hotal (King Edward's Hotel) hai. Exam point: king edavard ka hotal (King Edward's Hotel) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: How many pounds of annual tax was imposed on Indians by the SA government?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका की सरकार ने भारतीयों पर कितने पाउंड का वार्षिक कर (Tax) लगाया था?
e: yah kar un bharatiyon par lagaya gaya tha jinaki majaduri ki avadhi samapt ho chuki thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki dakshin aphrika ki sarakar ne bharatiyon par kitane paund ka varshik kar (Tax) lagaya tha? Isi baat se 3 paund (3 Pounds) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - 1 paund, 10 paund, 5 paund - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav 3 paund (3 Pounds) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 3 paund (3 Pounds) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who donated 25,000 rupees from India for Gandhi's movement in South Africa?
qh: गांधी जी के दक्षिण अफ्रीका के आंदोलन के लिए भारत से 25,000 रुपये का दान किसने दिया था?
e: ratan tata ne is andolan ki arthik sahayata ke lie badai rashi bheji thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gandhi ji ke dakshin aphrika ke andolan ke lie bharat se 25,000 rupaye ka dan kisane diya tha? Isi karan se ratan tata sahi uttar hai. nijam, jamanalal bajaj, ji.di. bidala ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad ratan tata hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ratan tata - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which event led Indian women in SA to join the movement?
qh: किस घटना के कारण दक्षिण अफ्रीका की भारतीय महिलाएं भी आंदोलन में कूद पड़ी थीं?
o: गैर-ईसाई विवाहों को अवैध घोषित करना (Invalidating non-Christian marriages)
e: suprim kort ke ek phaisale ne gair-isai paddhati se hue vivahon ko avaidh karar diya tha, jisase mahilaen andolit ho uthin. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kis ghatana ke karan dakshin aphrika ki bharatiy mahilaen bhi andolan mein kud p i thin? Isi aadhar par gair-isai vivahon ko avaidh ghoshit karana (Invalidating non-Christian marriages) chuna jaata hai. namak kar, shiksha par rok, bhojan ki kami is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar gair-isai vivahon ko avaidh ghoshit karana (Invalidating... hi hai. Exam point: gair-isai vivahon ko avaidh ghoshit karana (Invalidating non-Christian marriages) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Kasturba Gandhi led satyagrahis between which two places?
qh: गांधी जी की पत्नी कस्तूरबा गांधी ने किस स्थान के बीच सत्याग्रहियों का नेतृत्व किया?
e: kasturaba gandhi ne 16 satyagrahiyon ke sath natal se transaval ki or kuch kiya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gandhi ji ki patni kasturaba gandhi ne kis sthan ke bich satyagrahiyon ka netritv kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par natal se transaval (Natal to Transvaal) sahi nikalta hai. daraban se pritoriya, kep taun se natal, bharat se aphrika is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad natal se transaval (Natal to Transvaal) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: natal se transaval (Natal to Transvaal) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which year did G.K. Gokhale visit South Africa on Gandhi's invitation?
qh: गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले किस वर्ष गांधी जी के निमंत्रण पर दक्षिण अफ्रीका गए थे?
e: 1912 mein gokhale dakshin aphrika gae aur sarakar se bharatiyon ki samasyaon par charcha ki. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gopal krishn gokhale kis varsh gandhi ji ke nimantran par dakshin aphrika gae the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1912 sahi nikalta hai. 1915, 1894, 1906 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1912 hai. Exam point: 1912 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which language did Gandhi try to teach Indians in South Africa?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका में गांधी जी ने भारतीयों को कौन सी भाषा सिखाने का प्रयास किया था?
e: gandhi ji ka manana tha ki sanvad aur adhikaron ki mang ke lie angreji ka jnan jaruri hai. Is prashn ka dayra angreji (English) tak phaila hua hai. Isliye antim jawab angreji (English) ke roop mein milta hai. gujarati, marathi, hindi mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav angreji (English) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: angreji (English) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Under pressure from Gandhi's movement, which Viceroy criticized the SA government?
qh: गांधी जी के आंदोलन के दबाव में किस वायसराय ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका की सरकार की आलोचना की थी?
e: lord harding ne khule taur par dakshin aphrika mein bharatiyon ke sath ho rahe vyavahar ki ninda ki thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki gandhi ji ke andolan ke dabav mein kis vayasaray ne dakshin aphrika ki sarakar ki alochana ki thi? In tathyon ke chalte lord harding (Lord Hardinge) hi sahi hai. lord karjan, lord iravin, lord kaining ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad lord harding (Lord Hardinge) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: lord harding (Lord Hardinge) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What did Gandhi and his supporters do publicly in protest against the registration certificates?
qh: पंजीकरण प्रमाण पत्र के विरोध में गांधी जी और उनके समर्थकों ने सार्वजनिक रूप से क्या किया था?
o: प्रमाण पत्रों की होली जलाई (Burned the certificates)
e: sarakar dvara vishvasaghat kie jane par unhonne sarvajanik rup se panjikaran praman patron ko jala diya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki panjikaran praman patr ke virodh mein gandhi ji aur unake samarthakon ne sarvajanik rup se kya kiya tha? Isi baat se praman patron ki holi jalai (Burned the certificates) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp upavas, jahaj dubo diya, hadatal bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad praman patron ki holi jalai (Burned the... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: praman patron ki holi jalai (Burned the certificates) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many times was Gandhi arrested during the struggle in South Africa?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका के संघर्ष के दौरान गांधी जी को कितनी बार गिरफ्तार किया गया था?
e: transaval march ke dauran aur any andolanon mein gandhi ji ko tin bar giraphtar kiya gaya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki dakshin aphrika ke sangharsh ke dauran gandhi ji ko kitani bar giraphtar kiya gaya tha? Isi tathya par tin bar (Three times) tika hua hai. Galti keval ek bar, panch bar, ve kabhi giraphtar nahin hue chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar tin bar (Three times) baithta hai. Exam point: tin bar (Three times) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How much total time did Gandhi spend in South Africa?
qh: गांधी जी ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका में रहने के लिए कुल कितना समय दिया था?
e: gandhi ji ek mah ke lie gae the lekin sangharsh ke karan unhein 20 varsh (1893-1914) tak vahan rahana p a. Is prashn ka dayra 20 sal (20 Years) tak phaila hua hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 20 sal (20 Years) hi sahi baithta hai. 5 sal, 10 sal, 1 sal anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar 20 sal (20 Years) hai. Exam point: 20 sal (20 Years) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date did Gandhi permanently return to India from South Africa?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका से गांधी जी स्थायी रूप से भारत किस तिथि को लौटे थे?
e: 9 janavari ko unake bharat lautane ke upalakshy mein 'pravasi bharatiy divas' manaya jata hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki dakshin aphrika se gandhi ji sthayi rup se bharat kis tithi ko laute the? Isi karan se 9 janavari 1915 (9th Jan 1915) sahi uttar hai. 13 aprail 1919, 15 agast 1947, 26 janavari 1930 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 9 janavari 1915 (9th Jan 1915) hai. Exam point: 9 janavari 1915 (9th Jan 1915) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which 'weapon' did Gandhi invent for the struggle in South Africa?
qh: गांधी जी ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका में संघर्ष के लिए किस 'हथियार' का आविष्कार किया?
e: saty aur ahinsa par adharit 'satyagrah' ka saphal prayog gandhi ji ne pahali bar aphrika mein hi kiya. Is prashn ka dayra satyagraha tak phaila hua hai. satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isi baat se satyagrah (Satyagraha) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti bam, hadatal, talavar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se satyagrah (Satyagraha) sahi hai. Exam point: satyagrah (Satyagraha) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who was not included in the three categories of Indians in South Africa?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका में भारतीयों की तीन श्रेणियों में कौन शामिल नहीं था?
e: majadur, vyapari aur ve log jo anubandh ke bad vahin bas gae, ye tin mukhy shreniyan thin. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki dakshin aphrika mein bharatiyon ki tin shreniyon mein kaun shamil nahin tha? Isliye sahi nateeja british sainik (British Soldiers) nikalta hai. Galti sthayi rup se base bharatiy, majadur, vyapari chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav british sainik (British Soldiers) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: british sainik (British Soldiers) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Gandhi wrote a letter to 'Natal Advertiser' comparing which religion to justice and civilization?
qh: गांधी जी ने 'नटाल एडवरटाइजर' को पत्र लिखकर किस धर्म की तुलना न्याय और सभ्यता से की थी?
e: unhonne angrejon se puchha tha ki kya unaka bhedabhav unake isai dharm ki shikshaon ke anukul hai? Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhi ji ne 'natal edavarataijar' ko patr likhakar kis dharm ki tulana nyay aur sabhyata se ki thi? Isi karan se isai dharm (Christianity) sahi uttar hai. bauddh dharm, hindu dharm, islam is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav isai dharm (Christianity) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: isai dharm (Christianity) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which person from an Indian community attacked Gandhi in SA, thinking he sided with the govt?
qh: गांधी जी पर दक्षिण अफ्रीका में किस भारतीय समुदाय के व्यक्ति ने जानलेवा हमला किया था?
e: sarakar ke sath hue samajhaute ko galat samajhakar ek pathan ne gandhi ji par hamala kiya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki gandhi ji par dakshin aphrika mein kis bharatiy samuday ke vyakti ne janaleva hamala kiya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki ek bharatiy pathan (Indian Pathan) sahi hai. ek parasi, ek tamil majadur, ek hindu mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ek bharatiy pathan (Indian Pathan) hi milti hai. Exam point: ek bharatiy pathan (Indian Pathan) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which communities supported Gandhi in his South Africa struggle?
qh: गांधी जी के दक्षिण अफ्रीका संघर्ष में किन समुदायों ने उनका साथ दिया था?
o: हिंदू, मुस्लिम, सिख और ईसाई (All communities)
e: gandhi ji ne aphrika mein sabhi dharmon aur vargon ke bharatiyon ko ekajut karane mein saphalata pai thi. Is prashn ka dayra hindu, muslim, sikh aur isai (All communities) tak phaila hua hai. Isi baat se hindu, muslim, sikh aur isai (All communities) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti keval gujarati, keval vakil, keval gore log chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hindu, muslim, sikh aur isai (All communities) hi milti hai. Exam point: hindu, muslim, sikh aur isai (All communities) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the Indians taken to South Africa for 'labor' called?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका में 'मजदूरी' के लिए ले जाए जाने वाले भारतीयों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: inhein ek nishchit samay (anubandh) ke lie kam par le jaya jata tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki dakshin aphrika mein 'majaduri' ke lie le jae jane vale bharatiyon ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi tathya par giramitiya / anubandhit majadur (Indentured Laborers) tika hua hai. svadeshi, pravasi, gulam ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan giramitiya / anubandhit majadur (Indentured Laborers) hi milti hai. Exam point: giramitiya / anubandhit majadur (Indentured Laborers) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Against which 'system' did Gandhi fight in South Africa?
qh: गांधी जी ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका में किस 'पद्धति' के खिलाफ लड़ाई लड़ी थी?
e: dakshin aphrika mein kale-gore ke bhedabhav aur bharatiyon ke apaman ke khilaph unhonne lanbi l ai l i. Yahaan rangabhed / naslavad (Apartheid / Racism) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isliye sahi nateeja rangabhed / naslavad (Apartheid / Racism) nikalta hai. parda pratha, jamindari, sati pratha anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se rangabhed / naslavad (Apartheid / Racism) sahi hai. Exam point: rangabhed / naslavad (Apartheid / Racism) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Most laborers in the New Castle mines were from which Indian region?
qh: न्यू कैसल (New Castle) की खदानों में काम करने वाले अधिकतर मजदूर किस भारतीय क्षेत्र से थे?
o: तमिलनाडु / दक्षिण भारत (Tamil Nadu / South India)
e: nyu kaisal ke khadan majadur mukhyatah tamil bhashi aur dakshin bharatiy the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki nyu kaisal (New Castle) ki khadanon mein kam karane vale adhikatar majadur kis bharatiy kshetr se the? Yahi wajah hai ki tamilanadu / dakshin bharat (Tamil Nadu / South India) sahi hai. bangal, bihar, panjab in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav tamilanadu / dakshin bharat (Tamil Nadu / South India) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: tamilanadu / dakshin bharat (Tamil Nadu /... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What main lesson did Gandhi learn from the struggle in South Africa?
qh: गांधी जी ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका के संघर्ष से कौन सी मुख्य सीख (Lesson) ली थी?
o: जनशक्ति की ताकत और नेतृत्व की कला (Power of masses and leadership)
e: vahan unhonne sikha ki kaise vibhinn vargon ko ek uddeshy ke lie ekajut kiya ja sakata hai. Is prashn ka dayra janashakti ki takat aur netritv ki kala (Power of masses and leadership) tak phaila hua hai. Isi baat se janashakti ki takat aur netritv ki kala (Power of masses and leadership) sahi sabit hota hai. hathiyar uthana, keval amiron ka sath lena, angrejon se darana ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan janashakti ki takat aur netritv ki kala... hi milti hai. Exam point: janashakti ki takat aur netritv ki kala... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When was the final success achieved in the South Africa Satyagraha?
qh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका में सत्याग्रह की अंतिम सफलता कब मिली?
e: 1914 mein sarakar ne bharatiyon ki adhikansh mangein man lin aur pramukh damanakari kanunon ko radd kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki dakshin aphrika mein satyagrah ki antim saphalata kab mili? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. In tathyon ke chalte 1914 hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - 1906, 1893, 1915 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1914 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1914 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which 'slogan' did Gandhi use to unite Indians in South Africa?
qh: गांधी जी ने दक्षिण अफ्रीका में भारतीयों को एकजुट करने के लिए किस 'नारे' (Slogan) का उपयोग किया था?
e: vande mataram vahan ke bharatiyon ke bich ekata ka ek pramukh sutr ban gaya tha. Is prashn ka vishay vande mataram hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par vande mataram hi sahi baithta hai. inkalab jindabad, sat shri akal, jay hind in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan vande mataram hi milti hai. Exam point: vande mataram - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who presided over the historic 'Lucknow Pact' of 1916?
qh: वर्ष 1916 के ऐतिहासिक 'लखनऊ समझौते' की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
e: anbika charan majumadar ne 1916 ke lakhanau adhiveshan ki adhyakshata ki thi, jahan naram dal aur garam dal phir se ek hue. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki varsh 1916 ke aitihasik 'lakhanau samajhaute' ki adhyakshata kisane ki thi? Isi karan se anbika charan majumadar (A.C. Majumdar) sahi uttar hai. javaharalal neharu, dadabhai nauroji, eni beseint mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav anbika charan majumadar (A.C. Majumdar) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: anbika charan majumadar (A.C. Majumdar) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the main outcome of the Lucknow Pact (1916)?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते (1916) का मुख्य परिणाम क्या था?
o: मुस्लिम लीग और कांग्रेस के बीच राजनीतिक समझौता (Agreement between Congress & Muslim League)
e: is samajhaute ke tahat kangres aur muslim lig ne milakar sanvaidhanik sudharon ki mang rakhi aur prithak nirvachak mandal ko svikar kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki lakhanau samajhaute (1916) ka mukhy parinam kya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par muslim lig aur kangres ke bich rajanitik samajhauta (Agreement between Congress & Muslim League) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. savinay avajna ki shuruat, kangres ka vibhajan, bharat chhodao andolan ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad muslim lig aur kangres ke bich rajanitik samajhauta (Agreement between Congress & Muslim League) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: muslim lig aur kangres ke bich rajanitik samajhauta (Agreement between Congress & Muslim League) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Where did Tilak establish his Home Rule League?
qh: तिलक ने अपनी होमरूल लीग की स्थापना कहाँ की थी?
e: tilak ne aprail 1916 mein belaganv (pune) mein apani homarul lig ka gathan kiya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki tilak ne apani homarul lig ki sthapana kahan ki thi? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isliye sahi nateeja belaganv / pune (Belgaum / Pune) nikalta hai. madras, banbai, kalakatta is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab belaganv / pune (Belgaum / Pune) hai. Exam point: belaganv / pune (Belgaum / Pune) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: From which place did Annie Besant start her Home Rule League?
qh: एनी बेसेंट ने अपनी होमरूल लीग की शुरुआत किस स्थान से की थी?
e: eni beseint ne sitanbar 1916 mein madras (adyar) se apani homarul lig ki shuruat ki thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki eni beseint ne apani homarul lig ki shuruat kis sthan se ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par madras / adyar hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp lakhanau, banbai, dilli bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan madras / adyar hi milti hai. Exam point: madras / adyar - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which two journals edited by Annie Besant propagated Home Rule?
qh: एनी बेसेंट द्वारा संपादित उन दो पत्रों के नाम क्या थे जिन्होंने होमरूल का प्रचार किया?
o: न्यू इंडिया और कॉमनवील (New India & Commonweal)
e: eni beseint ne 'nyu indiya' aur 'komanavil' ke madhyam se svashasan ka sandesh phailaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki eni beseint dvara sanpadit un do patron ke nam kya the jinhonne homarul ka prachar kiya? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Yahi wajah hai ki nyu indiya aur komanavil (New India & Commonweal) sahi hai. yang indiya aur navajivan, kesari aur maratha, bangali aur hitavadi is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar nyu indiya aur komanavil (New India & Commonweal) baithta hai. Exam point: nyu indiya aur komanavil (New India & Commonweal) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the working area of Tilak's Home Rule League?
qh: तिलक की होमरूल लीग का कार्यक्षेत्र कौन सा था?
o: कर्नाटक, महाराष्ट्र (बंबई छोड़कर), बरार और मध्य प्रांत (Karnataka, Maharashtra excluding Bombay, Berar & CP)
e: tilak ka karyakshetr simit tha, jabaki eni beseint ka karyakshetr shesh bharat tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki tilak ki homarul lig ka karyakshetr kaun sa tha? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi karan se karnatak, maharashtr (banbai chhodakar), barar aur madhy... sahi uttar hai. keval madras, keval bangal, pura bharat alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan karnatak, maharashtr (banbai chhodakar), barar aur madhy... hi milti hai. Exam point: karnatak, maharashtr (banbai chhodakar), barar aur madhy... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the Montagu Declaration (August Declaration) made?
qh: मोंटेग्यू घोषणा (August Declaration) किस वर्ष की गई थी?
e: 20 agast 1917 ko bharat sachiv edavin montegyu ne british sansad mein uttaradayi sarakar ke gathan ki ghoshana ki. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki montegyu ghoshana (August Declaration) kis varsh ki gai thi? Isi karan se 1917 sahi uttar hai. 1916, 1909, 1919 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1917 baithta hai. Exam point: 1917 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who called Tilak the 'Father of Indian Unrest'?
qh: तिलक को 'भारतीय अशांति का जनक' (Father of Indian Unrest) किसने कहा था?
e: british patrakar vaileintain shirol ne tilak ko yah upadhi di thi, jis par tilak ne manahani ka dava kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki tilak ko 'bharatiy ashanti ka janak' (Father of Indian Unrest) kisane kaha tha? Isi baat se vaileintain shirol (Valentine Chirol) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp lord karjan, lord chemsaphord, montegyu bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar vaileintain shirol (Valentine Chirol) hi hai. Exam point: vaileintain shirol (Valentine Chirol) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who renounced his 'Knighthood' in protest against Annie Besant's arrest in June 1917?
qh: जून 1917 में एनी बेसेंट की गिरफ्तारी के विरोध में किसने 'नाइटहुड' की उपाधि त्याग दी थी?
e: eni beseint ki giraphtari ke bad sar es. subramanyam ayyar ne virodh svarup apani upadhi lauta di thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki jun 1917 mein eni beseint ki giraphtari ke virodh mein kisane 'naitahud' ki upadhi tyag di thi? Yahi wajah hai ki es. subramanyam ayyar (S. Subramania Iyer) sahi hai. mahatma gandhi, gopal krishn gokhale, ravindranath taigor anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se es. subramanyam ayyar (S. Subramania Iyer) sahi hai. Exam point: es. subramanyam ayyar (S. Subramania Iyer) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What restriction did the Madras government impose on students to suppress the movement?
qh: मद्रास सरकार ने होमरूल आंदोलन को दबाने के लिए छात्रों पर क्या प्रतिबंध लगाया था?
o: राजनीतिक सभाओं में भाग लेने पर रोक (Ban on attending political meetings)
e: madras sarakar ne chhatron ko homarul lig ya kangres ki baithakon mein jane se mana kar diya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki madras sarakar ne homarul andolan ko dabane ke lie chhatron par kya pratibandh lagaya tha? Isliye antim jawab rajanitik sabhaon mein bhag lene par rok... ke roop mein milta hai. yunivarsiti band kar di, pariksha radd kar di, phis b a di anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar rajanitik sabhaon mein bhag lene par rok (Ban on attending political meetings) hai. Exam point: rajanitik sabhaon mein bhag lene par rok (Ban on attending political meetings) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which leader inspired the masses by saying 'the fire has started' regarding Home Rule?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने होमरूल आंदोलन को 'आग लग चुकी है' कहकर जनता को प्रेरित किया?
e: tilak ne sarakari notison ke bad janata ko sangathit hone ka ahvan kiya tha. Is prashn ka vishay home hai. home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi aadhar par bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) chuna jaata hai. motilal neharu, saradar patel, mahatma gandhi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) sahi hai. Exam point: bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Approximately how many members did Tilak's league have by the end of 1916?
qh: 1916 के अंत तक तिलक की लीग के पास लगभग कितने सदस्य थे?
e: tilak ki lig sankhya mein chhoti thi par eni beseint ki lig se adhik sangathit thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1916 ke ant tak tilak ki lig ke pas lagabhag kitane sadasy the? Isi karan se 14,000 (Approx 14,000) sahi uttar hai. 1,00,000, 5,000, 7,000 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 14,000 (Approx 14,000) hai. Exam point: 14,000 (Approx 14,000) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which two leaders played a key role in bridging the gap between Congress and Muslim League?
qh: कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के बीच तालमेल बिठाने में किन दो नेताओं की भूमिका महत्वपूर्ण थी?
o: तिलक और मोहम्मद अली जिन्ना (Tilak & M.A. Jinnah)
e: tilak aur jinna ke prayason se hi lakhanau samajhauta sanbhav ho saka tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kangres aur muslim lig ke bich talamel bithane mein kin do netaon ki bhumika mahatvapurn thi? Isliye sahi nateeja tilak aur mohammad ali jinna (Tilak & M.A. Jinnah) nikalta hai. patel aur bos, gandhi aur neharu, karjan aur minto mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se tilak aur mohammad ali jinna (Tilak & M.A. Jinnah) sahi hai. Exam point: tilak aur mohammad ali jinna (Tilak & M.A. Jinnah) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: When was Annie Besant elected as the first woman President of the INC?
qh: एनी बेसेंट को भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की पहली महिला अध्यक्षा कब चुना गया?
e: jel se riha hone ke bad 1917 ke kalakatta adhiveshan mein eni beseint ko adhyaksh chuna gaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki eni beseint ko bharatiy rashtriy kangres ki pahali mahila adhyaksha kab chuna gaya? Isliye sahi nateeja 1917 kalakatta (1917 Calcutta) nikalta hai. Galti 1915 banbai, 1916 lakhanau, 1925 kanapur chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1917 kalakatta (1917 Calcutta) baithta hai. Exam point: 1917 kalakatta (1917 Calcutta) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the primary goal of the Home Rule League movement?
qh: होमरूल लीग आंदोलन का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या था?
o: ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य के भीतर स्वशासन (Self-government within British Empire)
e: homarul ka uddeshy sanvaidhanik tarikon se british samrajy ke tahat 'dominiyan' darja pana tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki homarul lig andolan ka mukhy lakshy kya tha? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. qe: When did Tilak propose forming a 'Working Committee' which was then rejected?

qe: To which mythological event did Montagu compare the impact of Annie Besant's arrest?
qh: मोंटेग्यू ने एनी बेसेंट की गिरफ्तारी के प्रभाव की तुलना किस पौराणिक घटना से की थी?

Exam point: sanvaidhanik sudhar aur svashasan (Constitutional reforms & Self-rule) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is the literal meaning of the word 'Home Rule'?

qe: At which place did Tilak establish his Home Rule League?

Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar karnatak, maharashtr (banbai chho kar) aur madhy... hi hai. qh: तिलक और एनी बेसेंट ने अलग-अलग होमरूल लीग क्यों चलाई?
o: दोनों के समर्थकों के बीच वैचारिक तालमेल की कमी थी (Lack of coordination among supporters)
e: donon ke bich koi vyaktigat vivad nahin tha, par unake samarthakon mein matabhed ke karan unhonne alag lig banai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki tilak aur eni beseint ne alag-alag homarul lig kyon chalai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par donon ke samarthakon ke bich vaicharik talamel ki kami thi (Lack of coordination among supporters) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. donon ki mang alag thi, unake bich jhag a tha, angrejon ke dabav ke karan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar donon ke samarthakon ke bich vaicharik talamel... hi hai. Exam point: donon ke samarthakon ke bich vaicharik talamel ki kami thi (Lack of coordination among supporters) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who was the Secretary of Annie Besant's Home Rule League?
qh: एनी बेसेंट की होमरूल लीग के सचिव (Secretary) कौन थे?
e: jorj arundel eni beseint ki lig ke pramukh sachiv aur sahayogi the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki eni beseint ki homarul lig ke sachiv (Secretary) kaun the? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi karan se jorj arundel (George Arundale) sahi uttar hai. si.pi. ramasvami ayyar, bi.pi. vadiya, javaharalal neharu mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jorj arundel (George Arundale) hi milti hai. Exam point: jorj arundel (George Arundale) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who led the Home Rule League in Allahabad?
qh: इलाहाबाद में होमरूल लीग का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: javaharalal neharu eni beseint vali homarul lig ki ilahabad shakha ke sadasy aur neta the. Is prashn ka vishay home hai. home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi aadhar par javaharalal neharu (Jawaharlal Nehru) chuna jaata hai. lala lajapat ray, mahatma gandhi, bal gangadhar tilak in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan javaharalal neharu (Jawaharlal Nehru) hi milti hai. Exam point: javaharalal neharu (Jawaharlal Nehru) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Tilak supported education in which language for the demand of Swaraj?
qh: तिलक ने 'स्वराज' की मांग के लिए किस भाषा में शिक्षा देने का समर्थन किया?
e: tilak ka manana tha ki shiksha kshetriy bhashaon mein honi chahie taki am janata rashtravad ko samajh sake. Is sawaal mein swaraj ki baat hai. swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isi karan se kshetriy bhasha / matribhasha (Regional Language) sahi uttar hai. keval hindi, angreji, sanskrit mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar kshetriy bhasha / matribhasha (Regional Language) hai. Exam point: kshetriy bhasha / matribhasha (Regional Language) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who led the legal team to defend Tilak in 1916?
qh: 1916 में तिलक के बचाव के लिए वकीलों की टीम का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: jab tilak par rajadroh ka kes chala, tab jinna ke netritv mein vakilon ne unaka bachav kiya. Is sawaal mein mohammad ali jinna (M.A. Jinnah) ki baat hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par mohammad ali jinna (M.A. Jinnah) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. vallabh bhai patel, si.ar. das, motilal neharu is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan mohammad ali jinna (M.A. Jinnah) hi milti hai. Exam point: mohammad ali jinna (M.A. Jinnah) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Annie Besant was also the president of which famous institution?
qh: एनी बेसेंट किस प्रसिद्ध संस्था की अध्यक्षा भी रहीं?
e: eni beseint 1907 mein thiyosophikal sosaiti ki vaishvik adhyaksha bani thin. Yah prashn sabha se juda hai. sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi tathya par thiyosophikal sosaiti (Theosophical Society) tika hua hai. sikh sabha, gadar parti, ary samaj is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab thiyosophikal sosaiti (Theosophical Society) hai. Exam point: thiyosophikal sosaiti (Theosophical Society) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Members of which of Gokhale's organizations supported the Home Rule movement?
qh: गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले की किस संस्था के सदस्यों ने होमरूल आंदोलन में सहयोग दिया?
o: सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडिया सोसाइटी (Servants of India Society)
e: yadyapi yah sanstha sidhe shamil nahin thi, par isake kai sadasyon ne homarul ka prachar kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gopal krishn gokhale ki kis sanstha ke sadasyon ne homarul andolan mein sahayog diya? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isliye sahi nateeja sarveints oph indiya sosaiti (Servants of India Society) nikalta hai. muslim lig, kangres speshal, prajamandal is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar sarveints oph indiya sosaiti (Servants of India Society) hai. Exam point: sarveints oph indiya sosaiti (Servants of India Society) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main significance of the 1916 Lucknow session?
qh: 1916 के लखनऊ अधिवेशन का मुख्य महत्व क्या था?
o: नरम दल और गरम दल का पुनर्मिलन (Reunion of Moderates & Extremists)
e: eni beseint aur tilak ke prayason se 1916 mein kangres ke donon dhadae phir se ek ho gae. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1916 ke lakhanau adhiveshan ka mukhy mahatv kya tha? In tathyon ke chalte naram dal aur garam dal ka punarmilan (Reunion of Moderates & Extremists) hi sahi hai. Galti kangres ka vibhajan, jajiya kar ki vapasi, bharat chho o ka nara chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar naram dal aur garam dal ka punarmilan (Reunion of Moderates & Extremists) hi hai. Exam point: naram dal aur garam dal ka punarmilan (Reunion of Moderates & Extremists) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which train was used by Home Rule supporters to go to the Lucknow session?
qh: होमरूल समर्थकों ने लखनऊ अधिवेशन में जाने के लिए किस ट्रेन का उपयोग किया?
o: कांग्रेस स्पेशल / होमरूल स्पेशल (Congress/Home Rule Special)
e: samarthakon ne puri tren buk ki thi jise 'kangres speshal' ya 'homarul speshal' kaha gaya. Yah prashn home se juda hai. home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi karan se kangres speshal / homarul speshal (Congress/Home Rule Special) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp vande bharat, rajadhani eksapres, ajad eksapres bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab kangres speshal / homarul speshal (Congress/Home Rule Special) hai. Exam point: kangres speshal / homarul speshal (Congress/Home Rule Special) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: According to Annie Besant, how many members were minimum required to open a branch of the League?
qh: एनी बेसेंट के अनुसार, होमरूल लीग की एक शाखा खोलने के लिए न्यूनतम कितने सदस्यों की आवश्यकता थी?
e: eni beseint ki lig mein koi bhi tin log milakar kahin bhi shakha khol sakate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki eni beseint ke anusar, homarul lig ki ek shakha kholane ke lie nyunatam kitane sadasyon ki avashyakata thi? Isi aadhar par 3 chuna jaata hai. 5, 10, 100 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 3 hi milti hai. Exam point: 3 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the total membership of Tilak's Home Rule League by 1917?
qh: तिलक की होमरूल लीग में 1917 तक कुल कितने सदस्य थे?
e: 1917 tak tilak ki lig ke pas lagabhag 14,000 sadasy the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki tilak ki homarul lig mein 1917 tak kul kitane sadasy the? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isliye antim jawab 14000 ke roop mein milta hai. 7000, 5000, 1 lakh is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 14000 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 14000 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which nationalist leader encouraged the movement by saying 'the fire has started'?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने होमरूल आंदोलन को 'आग लग चुकी है' कहकर प्रोत्साहित किया?
e: tilak ne sarakari daman ke bad apane samarthakon ko sangathit karane ke lie yah ahvan kiya tha. Yahaan bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi aadhar par bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) chuna jaata hai. motilal neharu, saradar patel, mahatma gandhi is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) hai. Exam point: bal gangadhar tilak (B.G. Tilak) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Annie Besant spread which ideology through 'New India'?
qh: एनी बेसेंट ने 'न्यू इंडिया' पत्रिका के माध्यम से किस विचारधारा का प्रसार किया?
e: unhonne bharatiyon ko apane rajanitik adhikaron aur svashasan ke prati jagaruk kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki eni beseint ne 'nyu indiya' patrika ke madhyam se kis vicharadhara ka prasar kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par svashasan aur rashtravad (Self-rule & Nationalism) hi sahi baithta hai. samajavad, samyavad, sati pratha ka samarthan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan svashasan aur rashtravad (Self-rule & Nationalism) hi milti hai. Exam point: svashasan aur rashtravad (Self-rule & Nationalism) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How much amount was gifted to Tilak by his supporters on his 60th birthday?
qh: तिलक के 60वें जन्मदिन पर उनके समर्थकों ने उन्हें कितनी राशि भेंट की थी?
e: tilak ko unake 60vein janmadin par 1 lakh rupaye ki thaili bheint ki gai thi jise unhonne lig ko samarpit kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki tilak ke 60vein janmadin par unake samarthakon ne unhein kitani rashi bheint ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1 lakh rupaye (1 Lakh Rupees) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti 10 lakh, 50 hajar, 10 hajar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 1 lakh rupaye (1 Lakh Rupees) hi hai. Exam point: 1 lakh rupaye (1 Lakh Rupees) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which language was education demanded in the 'Deccan' region during Home Rule?
qh: होमरूल लीग के दौरान 'दक्कन' क्षेत्र में किस भाषा में शिक्षा की माँग उठी थी?
e: dakkan kshetr mein bhashai adhar par kannad bhasha mein shiksha aur rajyon ke bantavare ki mang ki gai thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki homarul lig ke dauran 'dakkan' kshetr mein kis bhasha mein shiksha ki mang uthi thi? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isliye sahi nateeja kannad (Kannada) nikalta hai. Vikalp telugu, malayalam, tamil bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar kannad (Kannada) hi hai. Exam point: kannad (Kannada) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year did Annie Besant come to India for the first time?
qh: एनी बेसेंट भारत में पहली बार किस वर्ष आई थीं?
e: eni beseint 1893 mein thiyosophikal sosaiti ke kam se bharat ai thin. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki eni beseint bharat mein pahali bar kis varsh ai thin? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1893 sahi nikalta hai. Vikalp 1914, 1917, 1885 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1893 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1893 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: On the start day of which historical movement did Tilak pass away?
qh: तिलक की मृत्यु किस ऐतिहासिक आंदोलन के शुरू होने वाले दिन हुई थी?
e: 1 agast 1920 ko asahayog andolan ke pahale din tilak ki mrityu ho gai thi. Is prashn ka vishay asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) hai. Isi aadhar par asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) chuna jaata hai. bharat chho o, svadeshi, homarul in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How was the 'secular' character of the Home Rule movement proved?
qh: होमरूल आंदोलन का 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' चरित्र किस बात से सिद्ध होता है?
o: हिंदू, मुस्लिम और ईसाई नेताओं की सक्रिय भागीदारी से (Participation of various religions)
e: isamein tilak (hindu), barakatullah (muslim) aur eni beseint (isai mul) jaise vibhinn dharmon ke log shamil the. Is prashn ka kendra home hai. home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isliye sahi nateeja hindu, muslim aur isai netaon ki sakriy bhagidari se (Participation of various religions) nikalta hai. Galti keval mandiron mein puja se, angreji bhasha ke upayog se, sena ke gathan se chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hindu, muslim aur isai netaon ki sakriy... hi milti hai. Exam point: hindu, muslim aur isai netaon ki sakriy bhagidari se (Participation of various religions) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which faction of the Congress was led by Pherozeshah Mehta, a strong opponent of Tilak?
qh: कांग्रेस के किस गुट के नेता फिरोज शाह मेहता तिलक के प्रबल विरोधी थे?
e: phiroj shah mehata naram dal ke neta the aur ve tilak ki kangres mein vapasi ke khilaph the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kangres ke kis gut ke neta phiroj shah mehata tilak ke prabal virodhi the? Isi karan se naram dal (Moderates) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp garam dal, koi nahin, krantikari bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar naram dal (Moderates) baithta hai. Exam point: naram dal (Moderates) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Where did the echo of the Home Rule League movement reach abroad?
qh: होमरूल लीग आंदोलन की गूंज विदेशों में कहाँ तक पहुँची थी?
o: अमेरिका और कनाडाई प्रवासियों तक (US and Canadian Immigrants)
e: gadar andolan aur homarul ki khabarein amerika aur kanada mein base bharatiyon tak pahunchi thin. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki homarul lig andolan ki gunj videshon mein kahan tak pahunchi thi? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isi karan se amerika aur kanadai pravasiyon tak (US and Canadian Immigrants) sahi uttar hai. Galti keval aphrika, keval chin, japan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar amerika aur kanadai pravasiyon tak (US and Canadian Immigrants) hai. Exam point: amerika aur kanadai pravasiyon tak (US and Canadian Immigrants) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: During Home Rule, Tilak gave the 'Educated vs Uneducated' argument regarding what?
qh: होमरूल लीग के दौरान 'शिक्षित बनाम अशिक्षित' का तर्क तिलक ने किसके संदर्भ में दिया था?
o: ब्राह्मण बनाम गैर-ब्राह्मण प्रतिनिधित्व (Brahmin vs Non-Brahmin representation)
e: tilak ne samajhaya ki asali antar jati ka nahin balki shiksha ka hai, taki samajik darar ko bhara ja sake. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki homarul lig ke dauran 'shikshit banam ashikshit' ka tark tilak ne kisake sandarbh mein diya tha? home rule ka matlab angrezi raj ke andar hi apni sarkar ke haq ki maang thi. Isliye sahi nateeja brahman banam gair-brahman pratinidhitv (Brahmin vs Non-Brahmin representation) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - keval kheti, sena, jamindari - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar brahman banam gair-brahman pratinidhitv (Brahmin vs Non-Brahmin representation) baithta hai. Exam point: brahman banam gair-brahman pratinidhitv (Brahmin vs Non-Brahmin representation) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which journal did Gandhi give best wishes for the success of the Home Rule movement?
qh: गांधी जी ने किस पत्रिका में होमरूल आंदोलन की सफलता के लिए शुभकामनाएं दी थीं?
e: gandhi ji ne 'yang indiya' mein tilak ke nirdosh sabit hone par khushi jatai aur andolan ka samarthan kiya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gandhi ji ne kis patrika mein homarul andolan ki saphalata ke lie shubhakamanaen di thin? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par yang indiya (Young India) hi sahi baithta hai. navajivan, harijan, kesari mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad yang indiya (Young India) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: yang indiya (Young India) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the main ideological base of the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन का मुख्य वैचारिक आधार (Ideological Base) क्या था?
o: क्रांतिकारी राष्ट्रवाद और धर्मनिरपेक्षता (Revolutionary Nationalism & Secularism)
e: gadar andolan ne dharm se upar uthakar rashtrabhakti ko hi apana dharm mana aur sabhi dharmon ke logon ko ekajut kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki gadar andolan ka mukhy vaicharik adhar (Ideological Base) kya tha? Isi karan se krantikari rashtravad aur dharmanirapekshata (Revolutionary Nationalism & Secularism) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - samantavad, dharmik rashtravad (Religious Nationalism), udaravadi rajaniti - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan krantikari rashtravad aur dharmanirapekshata (Revolutionary Nationalism &... hi milti hai. Exam point: krantikari rashtravad aur dharmanirapekshata (Revolutionary Nationalism &... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which strict law was made by the Canadian government to stop Indian entry?
qh: कनाडा सरकार ने भारतीयों के प्रवेश को रोकने के लिए कौन सा सख्त कानून बनाया था?
o: सीधी यात्रा का कानून (Continuous Journey Provision)
e: is kanun ke tahat keval unhin bharatiyon ko pravesh milata tha jo sidhe bharat se kanada ae hon. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki kanada sarakar ne bharatiyon ke pravesh ko rokane ke lie kaun sa sakht kanun banaya tha? Isliye antim jawab sidhi yatra ka kanun (Continuous Journey Provision) ke roop mein milta hai. namak kanun, varnakular ekt, gadar pratibandh mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar sidhi yatra ka kanun (Continuous Journey Provision) hi hai. Exam point: sidhi yatra ka kanun (Continuous Journey Provision) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was Komagata Maru?
qh: कामागाटा मारू (Komagata Maru) क्या था?
o: एक जापानी समुद्री जहाज (A Japanese Ship)
e: yah ek japani jahaj tha jise guradip sinh ne kirae par liya tha taki kanadai apravasan kanunon ko chunauti di ja sake. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kamagata maru (Komagata Maru) kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja ek japani samudri jahaj (A Japanese Ship) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - ek panjabi patrika, ek krantikari dal, ek kanadai bandaragah - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ek japani samudri jahaj (A Japanese Ship) hi milti hai. Exam point: ek japani samudri jahaj (A Japanese Ship) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: At which Canadian port was the Komagata Maru ship stopped?
qh: कामागाटा मारू जहाज को कनाडा के किस बंदरगाह पर रोका गया था?
e: jahaj ko vainkuvar ke pas rok diya gaya aur yatriyon ko utarane ki anumati nahin di gai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki kamagata maru jahaj ko kanada ke kis bandaragah par roka gaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par vainkuvar (Vancouver) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - montriyal, toranto, otava - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan vainkuvar (Vancouver) hi milti hai. Exam point: vainkuvar (Vancouver) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who were the leaders of the 'Shore Committee' formed for Indians in Canada?
qh: कनाडा में फंसे भारतीयों के अधिकारों के लिए बनी 'शोर कमेटी' (Shore Committee) के नेता कौन थे?
o: हुसैन रहीम, सोहन लाल पाठक और बलवंत सिंह (H. Rahim, S.L. Pathak & B. Singh)
e: shor kameti ka gathan yatriyon ki kanuni aur manaviy sahayata ke lie kiya gaya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki kanada mein phanse bharatiyon ke adhikaron ke lie bani 'shor kameti' (Shore Committee) ke neta kaun the? Isliye sahi nateeja husain rahim, sohan lal pathak aur balavant sinh (H. Rahim, S.L. Pathak & B. Singh) nikalta hai. javaharalal neharu, bhagat sinh, lala haradayal is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab husain rahim, sohan lal pathak aur balavant... hai. Exam point: husain rahim, sohan lal pathak aur balavant... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On returning to India, at which Calcutta port did the Komagata Maru ship stop?
qh: कामागाटा मारू जहाज वापस भारत आने पर कलकत्ता के किस बंदरगाह पर रुका था?
e: bajabaj bandaragah par yatriyon aur pulis ke bich khuni jhadap hui jisamein 18 yatri shahid ho gae. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kamagata maru jahaj vapas bharat ane par kalakatta ke kis bandaragah par ruka tha? Isi aadhar par bajabaj (Budge Budge) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp haldiya, kandala, dayamand harbar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad bajabaj (Budge Budge) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bajabaj (Budge Budge) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which statement is correct about Lala Hardayal?
qh: लाला हरदयाल के बारे में कौन सा कथन सही है?
o: वे एक महान प्रचारक और विचारक थे (A great propagandist and thinker)
e: ve krantikari vicharon ko phailane mein kushal the lekin rananitik netritv mein kuchh kamiyan thin. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki lala haradayal ke bare mein kaun sa kathan sahi hai? Isliye sahi nateeja ve ek mahan pracharak aur vicharak the (A great propagandist and thinker) nikalta hai. ve shantivadi neta the, ve keval ek sainik the, ve british samarthak the mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar ve ek mahan pracharak aur vicharak the (A great propagandist and thinker) hi hai. Exam point: ve ek mahan pracharak aur vicharak the (A great propagandist and thinker) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which date was chosen for the armed revolt in India during the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन के दौरान भारत में सशस्त्र विद्रोह के लिए किस तिथि (Date) को चुना गया था?
e: gadar krantikariyon ne 21 pharavari 1915 ko vidroh ki yojana banai thi, jo bad mein 19 pharavari kar di gai. Prashn yah batata hai ki gadar andolan ke dauran bharat mein sashastr vidroh ke lie kis tithi (Date) ko chuna gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 21 pharavari 1915 (21st Feb 1915) hi sahi baithta hai. 15 agast 1947, 26 janavari 1930, 10 mai 1857 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 21 pharavari 1915 (21st Feb 1915) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 21 pharavari 1915 (21st Feb 1915) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who gave the secret information of the Ghadar revolt to the British?
qh: गदर विद्रोह की गुप्त सूचना अंग्रेजों को किसने दी थी?
e: kripal sinh namak mukhabir ne angrejon ko vidroh ki puri janakari de di thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gadar vidroh ki gupt suchana angrejon ko kisane di thi? Isi karan se kripal sinh (Kirpal Singh) sahi uttar hai. bhagat sinh, siddhu manjhi, mangal pande in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar kripal sinh (Kirpal Singh) hi hai. Exam point: kripal sinh (Kirpal Singh) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Whom did the Ghadarites choose as their leader in India?
qh: गदर क्रांतिकारियों ने अपना नेता (Leader) किसे चुना था जो उस समय बंगाल में थे?
e: ras bihari bos ne gadar andolan ko bharat mein sangathit netritv pradan karane ka bida uthaya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gadar krantikariyon ne apana neta (Leader) kise chuna tha jo us samay bangal mein the? Isi tathya par ras bihari bos (Rash Behari Bose) tika hua hai. lala lajapat ray, subhash chandr bos, aravind ghosh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se ras bihari bos (Rash Behari Bose) sahi hai. Exam point: ras bihari bos (Rash Behari Bose) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: How did the Ghadar Party view World War I?
qh: गदर पार्टी ने प्रथम विश्वयुद्ध को किस रूप में देखा?
o: ब्रिटेन की मदद के रूप में
आजादी पाने के अवसर के रूप में (Opportunity for Independence)
e: unhein laga ki briten yuddh mein vyast hai, isalie bharat par hamala kar use ajad karaya ja sakata hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gadar parti ne pratham vishvayuddh ko kis rup mein dekha? Isi tathya par ajadi pane ke avasar ke rup mein... tika hua hai. ek sankat ke rup mein, briten ki madad ke rup mein, dharmik yuddh ke rup mein is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ajadi pane ke avasar ke rup mein (Opportunity for Independence) hi milti hai. Exam point: ajadi pane ke avasar ke rup mein (Opportunity for Independence) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which Punjab organization opposed Ghadar and supported the British?
qh: पंजाब के किस संगठन ने गदर आंदोलन का विरोध किया और अंग्रेजों का साथ दिया?
e: khalasa divan ne gadar krantikariyon ki alochana ki aur unhein 'gumarah' bataya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki panjab ke kis sangathan ne gadar andolan ka virodh kiya aur angrejon ka sath diya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par khalasa divan (Khalsa Diwan) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. ary samaj, akali dal, shiromani kameti is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab khalasa divan (Khalsa Diwan) hai. Exam point: khalasa divan (Khalsa Diwan) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a major reason for the failure of the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन की विफलता का एक प्रमुख कारण क्या था?
o: रणनीतिक नेतृत्व और संगठन का अभाव (Lack of strategic leadership and organization)
e: andolanakariyon mein josh bahut tha lekin ve suniyojit rananiti aur sangathan banane mein viphal rahe. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gadar andolan ki viphalata ka ek pramukh karan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par rananitik netritv aur sangathan ka abhav (Lack of strategic leadership and organization) hi sahi baithta hai. hathiyaron ki adhikata, briten ki har, janata ka bhari samarthan is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav rananitik netritv aur sangathan ka abhav (Lack of strategic leadership and organization) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: rananitik netritv aur sangathan ka abhav (Lack of strategic leadership and organization) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: At which place did Raja Mahendra Pratap form the 'Interim Government of India'?
qh: राजा महेंद्र प्रताप ने किस स्थान पर 'भारत की अंतरिम सरकार' का गठन किया था?
e: 1915 mein kabul mein barakatullah aur raja maheindr pratap ne antarim sarakar banai thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki raja maheindr pratap ne kis sthan par 'bharat ki antarim sarakar' ka gathan kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja kabul nikalta hai. singapur, barlin, tokyo mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kabul hi milti hai. Exam point: kabul - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which slogan was popularized by the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन ने किस नारे (Slogan) को प्रमुखता दी थी?
e: dharmanirapekshata banae rakhane ke lie unhonne 'vande mataram' ko ekata ka sutr banaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gadar andolan ne kis nare (Slogan) ko pramukhata di thi? Isi karan se vande mataram sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - jay javan jay kisan, sat shri akal, satyamev jayate - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar vande mataram baithta hai. Exam point: vande mataram - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the population of India stated in Ghadar's 'Kacha Chitha'?
qh: गदर अखबार के 'कच्चे चिट्ठे' में भारत की आबादी कितनी बताई गई थी?
e: akhabar ne dava kiya ki 31 karod bharatiy mutthi bhar angrejon ko ukhad pheink sakate hain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gadar akhabar ke 'kachche chitthe' mein bharat ki abadi kitani batai gai thi? Isi karan se 31 karod (31 Crores) sahi uttar hai. 100 karod, 10 karod, 50 karod is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 31 karod (31 Crores) hi hai. Exam point: 31 karod (31 Crores) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which revolutionary was hanged at 19 for spreading 'Ghadar'?
qh: किस क्रांतिकारी को 'गदर' का प्रचार करने के लिए 19 वर्ष की आयु में फांसी दी गई?
e: karatar sinh sarabha gadar andolan ke sabase yuva aur utsahi shahid the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kis krantikari ko 'gadar' ka prachar karane ke lie 19 varsh ki ayu mein phansi di gai? Isi karan se karatar sinh sarabha (Kartar Singh Sarabha) sahi uttar hai. rajaguru, bhagat sinh, udham sinh is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad karatar sinh sarabha (Kartar Singh Sarabha) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: karatar sinh sarabha (Kartar Singh Sarabha) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: The Ghadar movement's international outlook was inspired by which country?
qh: गदर आंदोलन का अंतरराष्ट्रीय दृष्टिकोण (International Outlook) किस देश से प्रेरित था?
o: अमेरिका और यूरोपीय क्रांतियां (US and European Revolutions)
e: ve ayarish, rusi aur ameriki krantiyon se gaharai se prabhavit the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki gadar andolan ka antararashtriy drishtikon (International Outlook) kis desh se prerit tha? Isi karan se amerika aur yuropiy krantiyan (US and European... sahi uttar hai. keval chin, shrilanka, keval nepal is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav amerika aur yuropiy krantiyan (US and European Revolutions) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: amerika aur yuropiy krantiyan (US and European... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which ordinance did the British govt issue to inspect returning immigrants?
qh: ब्रिटिश सरकार ने विदेशी आप्रवासियों की जांच के लिए कौन सा आदेश (Ordinance) जारी किया था?
o: इनग्रेस इनटू इंडिया ऑर्डिनेंस (Ingress into India Ordinance)
e: is adesh ke tahat bandaragahon par laut rahe bharatiyon ki kadai talashi aur giraphtari ki jati thi. Yah prashn inagres inatu indiya ordineins (Ingress into India Ordinance) se juda hai. Isliye sahi nateeja inagres inatu indiya ordineins (Ingress into India Ordinance) nikalta hai. ilbart bil, varnakular ekt, arms ekt mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan inagres inatu indiya ordineins (Ingress into India... hi milti hai. Exam point: inagres inatu indiya ordineins (Ingress into India Ordinance) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Where was the 'Swadesh Sevak' organization formed during the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन के दौरान 'स्वदेश सेवक' (Swadesh Sevak) संगठन कहाँ बनाया गया था?
e: ji.di. kumar ne vainkuvar mein svadesh sevak grih aur patrika ki shuruat ki thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gadar andolan ke dauran 'svadesh sevak' (Swadesh Sevak) sangathan kahan banaya gaya tha? Isi aadhar par vainkuvar (Vancouver) chuna jaata hai. landan, barlin, peris ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab vainkuvar (Vancouver) hai. Exam point: vainkuvar (Vancouver) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which city did Lala Hardayal found the 'Hind Association'?
qh: लाला हरदयाल ने 'हिंद एसोसिएशन' की स्थापना किस शहर में की थी?
e: portalaind mein hind esosieshan ki sthapana hui, jo bad mein gadar parti ka adhar bani. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki lala haradayal ne 'hind esosieshan' ki sthapana kis shahar mein ki thi? In tathyon ke chalte portalaind (Portland) hi sahi hai. Vikalp nyuyork, shikago, sain phransisko bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab portalaind (Portland) hai. Exam point: portalaind (Portland) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What did Ghadarites do regarding the loyalty of Punjab states in the 1857 revolt?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह में पंजाब की रियासतों की वफादारी की गदर ने क्या की?
e: gadar ne sikhon ko yad dilaya ki 1857 mein angrejon ka sath dena unake lie sharmanak tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1857 ke vidroh mein panjab ki riyasaton ki vaphadari ki gadar ne kya ki? Isliye antim jawab kadai ninda ki (Strongly Criticized) ke roop mein milta hai. samarthan kiya, tariph ki, kuchh nahin kaha is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kadai ninda ki (Strongly Criticized) hi milti hai. Exam point: kadai ninda ki (Strongly Criticized) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the famous statement of Sohan Singh Bhakna?
qh: सोहन सिंह भकना (Sohan Singh Bhakna) का प्रसिद्ध कथन क्या था?
o: हमारा धर्म देशभक्ति है (Our religion is patriotism)
e: unhonne kaha tha ki 'ham sikh ya panjabi nahin the, hamara dharm deshabhakti tha'. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki sohan sinh bhakana (Sohan Singh Bhakna) ka prasiddh kathan kya tha? Isi tathya par hamara dharm deshabhakti hai (Our religion is... tika hua hai. ajadi asanbhav hai, angrej hamare mitr hain, ham hindu hain in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hamara dharm deshabhakti hai (Our religion is... hi milti hai. Exam point: hamara dharm deshabhakti hai (Our religion is patriotism) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which 'Ashram' was established in the US during the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन के दौरान अमेरिका में कौन सा 'आश्रम' स्थापित किया गया था?
e: sain phransisko mein gadar parti ke mukhyalay ko 'yugantar ashram' nam diya gaya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gadar andolan ke dauran amerika mein kaun sa 'ashram' sthapit kiya gaya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki yugantar ashram sahi hai. shanti niketan, sevagram, sabaramati ashram is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav yugantar ashram hi thehrta hai. Exam point: yugantar ashram - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: With which ideology did many revolutionaries align after the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन के बाद कई क्रांतिकारी भारत में किस विचारधारा से जुड़े?
o: किसान और वामपंथी आंदोलन (Peasant and Leftist movements)
e: gadar se bache hue kai log age chalakar kisan sabha aur kamyunist andolanon ke neta bane. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki gadar andolan ke bad kai krantikari bharat mein kis vicharadhara se ju e? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kisan aur vamapanthi andolan (Peasant and Leftist... sahi nikalta hai. keval dharmik prachar, samantavad, british rajabhakti mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kisan aur vamapanthi andolan (Peasant and Leftist... hi milti hai. Exam point: kisan aur vamapanthi andolan (Peasant and Leftist movements) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What can be considered the greatest success of the Ghadar movement?
qh: गदर आंदोलन की सबसे बड़ी सफलता क्या मानी जा सकती है?
o: क्रांतिकारी राष्ट्रवाद और एकता का बीज बोना (Seeding Revolutionary Nationalism & Unity)
e: isane bharatiy pravasiyon aur sainikon ke man mein british samrajy ki ajeyata ke mithak ko toda. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki gadar andolan ki sabase badai saphalata kya mani ja sakati hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par krantikari rashtravad aur ekata ka bij bona (Seeding Revolutionary Nationalism & Unity) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai.
