e: sarakar ne andolan ko kuchalane ke lie karib ek darjan b e netaon ko giraphtar kar nirvasit kiya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1905 se 1908 ke bich kitane pramukh rashtravadi netaon ko bangal se nirvasit kiya gaya tha? In tathyon ke chalte takariban ek darjan (About a dozen) hi sahi hai. chhah, do, shuny mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan takariban ek darjan (About a dozen) hi milti hai. Exam point: takariban ek darjan (About a dozen) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the main objective of the Indian Councils Act of 1861?
qh: 1861 के भारत परिषद अधिनियम का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: भारतीयों को विधाई कार्यों में प्रतीकात्मक भागीदारी देना (Symbolic participation to Indians)
पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता देना (To give full independence)
सेना का भारतीयकरण करना (To Indianize the army)
सती प्रथा को पुनः लागू करना (To re-implement Sati)
e: 1861 ke ekt ka uddeshy 1857 ke vidroh ke bad bharatiyon ko shasan mein shamil kar unhein shant karana tha. Is prashn ka kendra bharatiyon ko vidhai karyon mein pratikatmak bhagidari dena (Symbolic participation to Indians) hai. Isi karan se bharatiyon ko vidhai karyon mein pratikatmak bhagidari dena (Symbolic participation to Indians) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp purn svatantrata dena (To give full independence), sena ka bharatiyakaran karana (To Indianize the army), sati pratha ko punah lagu karana (To re-implement Sati) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar bharatiyon ko vidhai karyon mein pratikatmak bhagidari... hi hai. Exam point: bharatiyon ko vidhai karyon mein pratikatmak bhagidari dena (Symbolic participation to Indians) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which new right did 'non-official members' get under the Act of 1892?
qh: 1892 के अधिनियम के तहत 'गैर-सरकारी सदस्यों' को कौन सा नया अधिकार प्राप्त हुआ?
o: कानून को वीटो करने का अधिकार (Veto laws)
बजट पर बहस करने का अधिकार (Discussion on budget)
पूरक प्रश्न पूछने का अधिकार (Supplementary questions)
e: 1892 ke ekt mein pahali bar bharatiy sadasyon ko bajat par bahas karane ki anumati mili, halanki ve matadan nahin kar sakate the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1892 ke adhiniyam ke tahat 'gair-sarakari sadasyon' ko kaun sa naya adhikar prapt hua? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bajat par bahas karane ka adhikar (Discussion on budget) hi sahi baithta hai. kanun ko vito karane ka adhikar (Veto laws), matadan ka adhikar (Right to vote), purak prashn puchhane ka adhikar (Supplementary questions) alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar bajat par bahas karane ka adhikar (Discussion... hi hai. Exam point: bajat par bahas karane ka adhikar (Discussion on budget) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In what context was the slogan 'No representation, no tax' given?
qh: 'प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं तो कर नहीं' का नारा किस संदर्भ में दिया गया था?
o: विधाई सुधारों की मांग (Demand for legislative reforms)
e: rashtravadiyon ne tark diya ki yadi vidhan parishadon mein hamara vastavik pratinidhitv nahin hai, to ham taiks nahin deinge. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 'pratinidhitv nahin to kar nahin' ka nara kis sandarbh mein diya gaya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. In tathyon ke chalte vidhai sudharon ki mang (Demand for legislative reforms) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - 1857 ka vidroh (Revolt of 1857), namak satyagrah (Salt Satyagraha), asahayog andolan (Non-cooperation movement) - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se vidhai sudharon ki mang (Demand for legislative reforms) sahi hai. Exam point: vidhai sudharon ki mang (Demand for legislative reforms) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How did Lord Dufferin want to use the Legislative Council?
qh: लॉर्ड डफरिन ने विधान परिषद को किस रूप में इस्तेमाल करना चाहा था?
o: व्यापारिक केंद्र के रूप में (As a trading center)
न्यायालय के रूप में (As a Court)
सुरक्षा वॉल्व (Safety Valve) के रूप में
संसद के रूप में (As a Parliament)
e: dapharin chahata tha ki bharatiy apani bhadas parishad mein nikal dein taki bahar koi bada vidroh n ho. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki lord dapharin ne vidhan parishad ko kis rup mein istemal karana chaha tha? Yahi wajah hai ki suraksha volv (Safety Valve) ke rup mein sahi hai. Vikalp vyaparik keindr ke rup mein (As a trading center), nyayalay ke rup mein (As a Court), sansad ke rup mein (As a Parliament) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar suraksha volv (Safety Valve) ke rup mein hi hai. Exam point: suraksha volv (Safety Valve) ke rup mein - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Regarding whom did the nationalist leaders adopt the 'Lightning Conductor' theory?
qh: 'तड़ित चालक' (Lightning Conductor) का सिद्धांत राष्ट्रवादी नेताओं ने किसके संदर्भ में अपनाया था?
e: bharatiyon ne hyum ko ek 'kavach' ki tarah istemal kiya taki british sarakar kangres ko turant pratibandhit n kar sake. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 'tadait chalak' (Lightning Conductor) ka siddhant rashtravadi netaon ne kisake sandarbh mein apanaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) sahi nikalta hai. lord karjan (Lord Curzon), lord ripan (Lord Ripon), rani viktoriya (Queen Victoria) is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Pherozeshah Mehta was a founding member of which political organization?
qh: फिरोज शाह मेहता किस राजनीतिक संगठन के संस्थापक सदस्य थे?
e: phiroj shah mehata bombe presideinsi esosieshan ke sansthapak aur kangres ke pramukh neta the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki phiroj shah mehata kis rajanitik sangathan ke sansthapak sadasy the? Isliye sahi nateeja bombe presideinsi esosieshan (Bombay Presidency Association) nikalta hai. Vikalp ary samaj (Arya Samaj), gadar parti (Ghadar Party), muslim lig (Muslim League) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad bombe presideinsi esosieshan (Bombay Presidency Association) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bombe presideinsi esosieshan (Bombay Presidency Association) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the average annual time of Legislative Council meetings between 1893-1909?
qh: 1893-1909 के बीच विधान परिषद की बैठकों का औसत वार्षिक समय क्या था?
e: parishad ki baithakein sal bhar mein ausatan keval 13 din hoti thin, jo ganbhir charcha ke lie bahut kam thin. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1893-1909 ke bich vidhan parishad ki baithakon ka ausat varshik samay kya tha? Isi aadhar par 13 din (13 days) chuna jaata hai. Galti 200 din, 50 din, 100 din chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar 13 din (13 days) hi hai. Exam point: 13 din (13 days) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which year did Gopal Krishna Gokhale give his first famous budget speech?
qh: गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले ने अपना पहला प्रसिद्ध बजट भाषण किस वर्ष दिया था?
e: gokhale ne 1902 mein bajat par die apane bhashan se pure sadan ko apani vidvatta se prabhavit kiya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki gopal krishn gokhale ne apana pahala prasiddh bajat bhashan kis varsh diya tha? In tathyon ke chalte 1902 hi sahi hai. 1915, 1892, 1885 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1902 baithta hai. Exam point: 1902 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who entered the Legislative Council as the successor to Pherozeshah Mehta?
qh: फिरोज शाह मेहता के उत्तराधिकारी के रूप में विधान परिषद में किसने प्रवेश किया?
e: 1901 mein mehata ke ritayar hone ke bad unaki jagah gopal krishn gokhale parishad ke sadasy bane. Yah prashn gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) se juda hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. lala lajapat ray, bal gangadhar tilak, dadabhai nauroji mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) hi hai. Exam point: gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Where did Lord Curzon attribute the concept of 'Truth' in 1905?
qh: लॉर्ड कर्जन ने 1905 में 'सत्य' की अवधारणा को कहाँ की देन बताया था?
e: karjan ne kalakatta vishvavidyalay mein kaha tha ki saty ka samman karana pashchim ne duniya ko sikhaya hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki lord karjan ne 1905 mein 'saty' ki avadharana ko kahan ki den bataya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja pashchim (West) nikalta hai. Galti purv (East), bharat (India), chin (China) chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar pashchim (West) hi hai. Exam point: pashchim (West) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Amrita Bazar Patrika exposed the lie of which Viceroy through his own book?
qh: अमृत बाजार पत्रिका ने किस वायसराय के झूठ को उनकी अपनी पुस्तक के माध्यम से उजागर किया?
e: patrika ne karjan ki pustak 'purv ki samasyaen' ka havala dekar unake jhuth ko sarvajanik kiya. Yahaan lord karjan (Lord Curzon) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi karan se lord karjan (Lord Curzon) sahi uttar hai. lord minto, lord elagin, lord dapharin alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan lord karjan (Lord Curzon) hi milti hai. Exam point: lord karjan (Lord Curzon) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Surendranath Banerjee was jailed in 1883 for an article in which journal?
qh: सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी को 1883 में किस पत्रिका में लेख लिखने के कारण जेल हुई थी?
e: unhonne 'bangali' mein jaj noris ki alochana ki thi, jisake lie unhein manahani mein jel hui. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki sureindranath banarji ko 1883 mein kis patrika mein lekh likhane ke karan jel hui thi? Isi baat se bangali (Bengalee) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp maratha, kesari, yang indiya bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar bangali (Bengalee) hai. Exam point: bangali (Bengalee) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The title 'Lokmanya' was given to Bal Gangadhar Tilak by whom?
qh: 'लोकमान्य' की उपाधि बाल गंगाधर तिलक को किसके द्वारा दी गई थी?
e: tilak ko unaki nidarata aur rashtravadi sangharsh ke lie janata ne 'lokamany' (janata dvara svikrit) ki upadhi di. Is sawaal mein janata (The Public) ki baat hai. Isliye sahi nateeja janata (The Public) nikalta hai. raja ram mohan ray, british sarakar, mahatma gandhi mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar janata (The Public) hai. Exam point: janata (The Public) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which language did Tilak start the 'Kesari' newspaper?
qh: तिलक ने 'केसरी' समाचार पत्र किस भाषा में शुरू किया था?
e: kesari marathi bhasha mein tha, jabaki unaka dusara patr 'maratha' angreji mein tha. Yahaan marathi se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par marathi hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp angreji (English), gujarati, hindi bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav marathi hi thehrta hai. Exam point: marathi - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who assassinated Rand, the chairman of the Plague Committee in Pune in 1897?
qh: 1897 में पुणे में प्लेग समिति के अध्यक्ष रैंड की हत्या किसने की थी?
e: pleg ke dauran angrejon ke atyacharon se tang akar chapekar bandhuon ne raind aur ayarst ki hatya ki thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 1897 mein pune mein pleg samiti ke adhyaksh raind ki hatya kisane ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par chapekar bandhu (Chapekar Brothers) sahi nikalta hai. Galti udham sinh, bhagat sinh, savarakar bandhu chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab chapekar bandhu (Chapekar Brothers) hai. Exam point: chapekar bandhu (Chapekar Brothers) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which jail did Tilak write the book 'Gita Rahasya'?
qh: 'गीता रहस्य' नामक पुस्तक की रचना तिलक ने किस जेल में की थी?
e: tilak ko 1908 mein rajadroh ke lie barma ki mandale jel bheja gaya tha, jahan unhonne yah pustak likhi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 'gita rahasy' namak pustak ki rachana tilak ne kis jel mein ki thi? Isi baat se mandale jel (Mandalay Jail) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti yaravada jel, tihad jel, selular jel chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar mandale jel (Mandalay Jail) hi hai. Exam point: mandale jel (Mandalay Jail) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In 1922, Gandhi was tried for sedition due to articles in which newspaper?
qh: 1922 में गांधी जी पर राजद्रोह का मुकदमा किस समाचार पत्र में लेखों के कारण चला?
e: gandhi ji ko 'yang indiya' mein unake tin lekhon ke lie rajadroh (124A) ke tahat saja hui thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1922 mein gandhi ji par rajadroh ka mukadama kis samachar patr mein lekhon ke karan chala? Isliye sahi nateeja yang indiya (Young India) nikalta hai. navajivan, harijan, svaraj mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav yang indiya (Young India) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: yang indiya (Young India) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In what sense did the British use the word 'Native' for Indians?
qh: 'नेटिव' (Native) शब्द का प्रयोग अंग्रेज भारतीयों के लिए किस भाव में करते थे?
e: angrej aksar 'desi' ya 'netiv' shabd ka prayog bharatiyon ko asabhy dikhane ke lie gali ki tarah karate the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 'netiv' (Native) shabd ka prayog angrej bharatiyon ke lie kis bhav mein karate the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par apamanajanak/gavar (Derogatory) sahi nikalta hai. sammanapurvak, vaijnanik, mitravat in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan apamanajanak/gavar (Derogatory) hi milti hai. Exam point: apamanajanak/gavar (Derogatory) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Whose deep influence was on Gokhale's economic ideas?
qh: गोखले के आर्थिक विचारों पर किसका गहरा प्रभाव था?
e: gokhale ne nyayamurti ranade aur ji.vi. joshi se arthik ankadaon ki barik samajh sikhi thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki gokhale ke arthik vicharon par kisaka gahara prabhav tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par mahadev govind ranade (M.G. Ranade) hi sahi baithta hai. karl marks, lord karjan, edam smith in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav mahadev govind ranade (M.G. Ranade) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: mahadev govind ranade (M.G. Ranade) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How much surplus budget did Edward Law present in 1902?
qh: 1902 के बजट में एडवर्ड लॉ ने कितनी राशि की बचत का बजट पेश किया था?
e: british sarakar ne 7 karod ki bachat dikhai thi, jabaki gokhale ne ise janata par bhari bojh bataya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1902 ke bajat mein edavard lo ne kitani rashi ki bachat ka bajat pesh kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 7 karod (7 Crores) hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp 10 karod, 5 karod, 1 karod bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 7 karod (7 Crores) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 7 karod (7 Crores) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which nationalist leader said that 'the budget has not considered India's poverty'?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने कहा कि 'बजट में भारत की गरीबी का ख्याल नहीं रखा गया है'?
e: gokhale ne bajat bhashan mein ginaya ki kaise kisanon ki daridrata ki upeksha ki gai hai. Is prashn ka kendra gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) hai. Isi karan se gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) sahi uttar hai. sureindranath banarji, dadabhai nauroji, phiroj shah mehata is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) hi hai. Exam point: gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Whom did Lord Minto appoint in 1910 to counter Gokhale's arguments?
qh: 1910 में लॉर्ड मिंटो ने गोखले के तर्कों का जवाब देने के लिए किसे नियुक्त किया था?
e: minto ko dar tha ki gokhale ke deta ka javab koi samany adhikari nahin de paega. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1910 mein lord minto ne gokhale ke tarkon ka javab dene ke lie kise niyukt kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par ar.dablyu. kalail (R.W. Carlyle) sahi nikalta hai. Galti jems vestalaind, lord ripan, noris chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar ar.dablyu. kalail (R.W. Carlyle) hi hai. Exam point: ar.dablyu. kalail (R.W. Carlyle) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: To whom did Madan Mohan Malviya give the term 'Bagula Bhagat'?
qh: 'बगुला भगत' की संज्ञा मदन मोहन मालवीय ने किसे दी थी?
o: अंग्रेजों के चापलूस भारतीय सदस्यों को (Pro-British Indian members)
e: unhonne un bharatiyon ki alochana ki jo parishad mein keval dikhava karate the aur angrejon ki han mein han milate the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 'bagula bhagat' ki sanjna madan mohan malaviy ne kise di thi? Isi tathya par angrejon ke chapalus bharatiy sadasyon ko (Pro-British... tika hua hai. Vikalp chhatron ko, svatantrata senaniyon ko, kisanon ko bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan angrejon ke chapalus bharatiy sadasyon ko (Pro-British... hi milti hai. Exam point: angrejon ke chapalus bharatiy sadasyon ko (Pro-British... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who opposed the amendment to the Police Act of 1860?
qh: 1860 के पुलिस अधिनियम में संशोधन का विरोध किसने किया था?
e: mehata ne tark diya ki yah sanshodhan bina kisi dalil ke nagarikon ko giraphtar karane ki krur shakti deta hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1860 ke pulis adhiniyam mein sanshodhan ka virodh kisane kiya tha? Isi tathya par phiroj shah mehata (Pherozeshah Mehta) tika hua hai. mahatma gandhi, lord dapharin, javaharalal neharu in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab phiroj shah mehata (Pherozeshah Mehta) hai. Exam point: phiroj shah mehata (Pherozeshah Mehta) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Nationalist Indians demanding self-government cited the model of which country?
qh: स्वशासन (Self-government) की मांग करने वाले प्रबुद्ध भारतीयों ने किस देश के मॉडल का हवाला दिया था?
e: bharatiyon ne ostreliya aur kanada ki tarah aupaniveshik svatantrata (domeniyan stetas) ki mang ki thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki svashasan (Self-government) ki mang karane vale prabuddh bharatiyon ne kis desh ke modal ka havala diya tha? Isi baat se ostreliya aur kanada (Australia and Canada) sahi sabit hota hai. rus (Russia), japan, chin (China) in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab ostreliya aur kanada (Australia and Canada) hai. Exam point: ostreliya aur kanada (Australia and Canada) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What number of 'informants' was mentioned in the secret report of 1885?
qh: 1885 की गोपनीय रिपोर्ट में कितनी संख्या में 'मुखबिरों' का उल्लेख किया गया था?
e: hyum ki riport ke anusar, 30,000 mukhabiron ne vidroh ki ashanka jatai thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1885 ki gopaniy riport mein kitani sankhya mein 'mukhabiron' ka ullekh kiya gaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 30,000 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti 5000, 1,00,000, 1000 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 30,000 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 30,000 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who was the Governor General who declared Sati illegal?
qh: सती प्रथा को गैर-कानूनी घोषित करने वाला गवर्नर जनरल कौन था?
e: 1829 mein raja ram mohan ray ke sahayog se beintik ne sati pratha ko pratibandhit kiya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki sati pratha ko gair-kanuni ghoshit karane vala gavarnar janaral kaun tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par lord viliyam beintik (Lord William Bentinck) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. lord karjan, lord kaining, lord dalahauji alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se lord viliyam beintik (Lord William Bentinck) sahi hai. Exam point: lord viliyam beintik (Lord William Bentinck) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What kind of authority did Secretary of State Charles Wood suggest to Viceroy Elgin for India?
qh: भारत सचिव चार्ल्स वुड ने वायसराय एलगिन को भारत में किस प्रकार की सत्ता का सुझाव दिया था?
o: गृह देश से नियंत्रित सत्ता (Authority controlled from Britain)
e: charls vud ka manana tha ki bharat mein satta ko briten (grih desh) se majabuti se niyantrit kiya jana chahie. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bharat sachiv charls vud ne vayasaray elagin ko bharat mein kis prakar ki satta ka sujhav diya tha? Isi karan se grih desh se niyantrit satta (Authority controlled from Britain) sahi uttar hai. purn lokatantr (Full democracy), rajaon ka shasan (Rule of Kings), sainy shasan (Military rule) in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar grih desh se niyantrit satta (Authority controlled from Britain) hi hai. Exam point: grih desh se niyantrit satta (Authority controlled... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On which date was the Indian Constitution fully implemented?
qh: भारतीय संविधान को पूर्ण रूप से किस तिथि को लागू किया गया था?
e: 26 janavari 1950 ko sanvidhan lagu hua aur bharat ek ganatantr bana. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bharatiy sanvidhan ko purn rup se kis tithi ko lagu kiya gaya tha? Isliye antim jawab 26 janavari 1950 ke roop mein milta hai. 26 navanbar 1949, 15 agast 1947, 30 janavari 1948 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 26 janavari 1950 hi milti hai. Exam point: 26 janavari 1950 - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What is the primary function of the Legislature?
qh: विधायिका (Legislature) का मुख्य कार्य क्या होता है?
o: विधि या कानून का निर्माण करना (Law making)
e: vidhayika vah sansthan hai jahan vidhi (kanun) ke nirman ke lie kary kiya jata hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki vidhayika (Legislature) ka mukhy kary kya hota hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par vidhi ya kanun ka nirman karana (Law making) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. yuddh l na, vyapar karana, keval kar vasulana anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan vidhi ya kanun ka nirman karana (Law making) hi milti hai. Exam point: vidhi ya kanun ka nirman karana (Law... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: After which major historical event was the Council of India Act of 1861 introduced?
qh: 1861 का भारत परिषद अधिनियम (Council of India Act) किस बड़ी ऐतिहासिक घटना के बाद लाया गया था?
e: 1857 ke vidroh ke bad angrejon ne mahasus kiya ki bharatiyon ko vidhai karyon mein shamil karana jaruri hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1861 ka bharat parishad adhiniyam (Council of India Act) kis badai aitihasik ghatana ke bad laya gaya tha? Isi baat se 1857 ki kranti (Revolt of 1857) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp asahayog andolan, plasi ka yuddh, baksar ka yuddh bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1857 ki kranti (Revolt of 1857) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1857 ki kranti (Revolt of 1857) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under the 1861 Act, the number of members in the Viceroy's council was increased to?
qh: 1861 के अधिनियम के तहत वायसराय की परिषद में सदस्यों की संख्या कितनी कर दी गई थी?
e: 1861 ke adhiniyam ne vayasaray ko parishad mein 6 se 12 atirikt sadasyon ko namit karane ka adhikar diya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1861 ke adhiniyam ke tahat vayasaray ki parishad mein sadasyon ki sankhya kitani kar di gai thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 6 se 12 (6 to 12) hi sahi baithta hai. 20 se 30, keval 15, 2 se 5 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 6 se 12 (6 to 12) hi milti hai. Exam point: 6 se 12 (6 to 12) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the condition for 'Non-official members' in the 1861 Act?
qh: 1861 के अधिनियम में 'गैर-सरकारी सदस्यों' (Non-official members) के लिए क्या शर्त थी?
o: कम से कम आधे सदस्य गैर-सरकारी हों (At least half should be non-official)
e: niyam tha ki atirikt sadasyon mein se kam se kam adhe sadasy 'gair-sarakari' hone chahie. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1861 ke adhiniyam mein 'gair-sarakari sadasyon' (Non-official members) ke lie kya shart thi? Isi baat se kam se kam adhe sadasy gair-sarakari hon (At least half should be non-official) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp unaki sankhya shuny honi chahie, ve sabhi kisan hone chahie, ve sabhi angrej hone chahie bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab kam se kam adhe sadasy gair-sarakari hon... hai. Exam point: kam se kam adhe sadasy gair-sarakari hon (At least half should be non-official) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under the Acts of 1861 and 1892, Indian members primarily lacked which right?
qh: 1861 और 1892 के अधिनियमों के तहत भारतीय सदस्यों को सदन में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा अधिकार नहीं था?
o: प्रभावी चर्चा और प्रश्न पूछने का अधिकार (Right to effective discussion/questioning)
e: bharatiy sadasyon ko muk darshak banakar baithana p ta tha, unhein bajat ya mahatvapurn nitigat muddon par bolane ka adhikar nahin tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1861 aur 1892 ke adhiniyamon ke tahat bharatiy sadasyon ko sadan mein mukhy rup se kaun sa adhikar nahin tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par prabhavi charcha aur prashn puchhane ka adhikar (Right to effective discussion/questioning) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. nam darj karane ka adhikar, baithane ka adhikar, vastr pahanane ka adhikar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se prabhavi charcha aur prashn puchhane ka adhikar (Right to effective discussion/questioning) sahi hai. Exam point: prabhavi charcha aur prashn puchhane ka adhikar... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: By which act was the post of 'Secretary of State for India' created?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन काल में 'भारत सचिव' (Secretary of State) का पद किस अधिनियम द्वारा बनाया गया था?
e: 1858 ke gavarnameint oph indiya ekt ke madhyam se bharat sachiv aur bharat parishad ka gathan hua. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki british shasan kal mein 'bharat sachiv' (Secretary of State) ka pad kis adhiniyam dvara banaya gaya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki 1858 ka adhiniyam (Act of 1858) sahi hai. 1935 ka adhiniyam, 1861 ka adhiniyam, 1892 ka adhiniyam alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1858 ka adhiniyam (Act of 1858) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1858 ka adhiniyam (Act of 1858) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Most Indians nominated to legislative councils between 1862-1892 belonged to which class?
qh: 1862 से 1892 के बीच विधान परिषदों में नामित होने वाले अधिकांश भारतीय किस वर्ग से थे?
o: कुलीन और सामंत वर्ग (Elite and Feudal class)
e: namankit sadasy aksar bharatiy rajavadae, badae jamindar ya amir vyapari hote the jo angrejon ke prati vaphadar the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1862 se 1892 ke bich vidhan parishadon mein namit hone vale adhikansh bharatiy kis varg se the? Isliye antim jawab kulin aur samant varg (Elite and Feudal... ke roop mein milta hai. shikshak, krantikari chhatr, garib majadur mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar kulin aur samant varg (Elite and Feudal class) hai. Exam point: kulin aur samant varg (Elite and Feudal class) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the example of King Digvijay Singh of Balrampur illustrate?
qh: बलरामपुर के राजा दिग्विजय सिंह का उदाहरण किस बात को स्पष्ट करता है?
o: सदन में भारतीयों की दिखावटी भूमिका (Symbolic role of Indians)
e: ve angreji nahin janate the aur keval vayasaray ke ishare par hath uthakar matadan karate the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki balaramapur ke raja digvijay sinh ka udaharan kis bat ko spasht karata hai? Isi aadhar par sadan mein bharatiyon ki dikhavati bhumika (Symbolic role of Indians) chuna jaata hai. bharatiyon ki vidvatta, maharani ka virodh, angreji ka jnan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se sadan mein bharatiyon ki dikhavati bhumika (Symbolic role of Indians) sahi hai. Exam point: sadan mein bharatiyon ki dikhavati bhumika (Symbolic role of Indians) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What is the first 20 years phase of the INC (formed in 1885) called?
qh: 1885 में गठित भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के प्रारंभिक 20 वर्षों के चरण को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: 1885 se 1905 tak kangres ka rukh prarthana aur yachikaon tak simit tha, jise udaravadi yug kaha jata hai. Is sawaal mein udaravadi charan (Moderate Phase) ki baat hai. Isi tathya par udaravadi charan (Moderate Phase) tika hua hai. Vikalp ugravadi charan, gandhivadi charan, samajavadi charan bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar udaravadi charan (Moderate Phase) baithta hai. Exam point: udaravadi charan (Moderate Phase) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main cause of the Ilbert Bill controversy?
qh: इल्बर्ट बिल (Ilbert Bill) विवाद का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: भारतीय जजों को यूरोपीय अपराधियों के मुकदमे सुनने का अधिकार देना (Right to trial of Europeans by Indian judges)
e: is bil ke dvara bharatiy jajon ko yuropiyon ke mukadame sunane ki anumati di gai thi, jisaka angrejon ne bhari virodh kiya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ilbart bil (Ilbert Bill) vivad ka mukhy karan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bharatiy jajon ko yuropiy aparadhiyon ke mukadame... sahi nikalta hai. vyapar par kar, pres par pratibandh, jamin ki nilami ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar bharatiy jajon ko yuropiy aparadhiyon ke mukadame sunane ka adhikar dena (Right to trial of Europeans by Indian judges) baithta hai. Exam point: bharatiy jajon ko yuropiy aparadhiyon ke mukadame sunane ka adhikar dena (Right to trial of Europeans by Indian judges) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What did Madan Mohan Malviya call pro-British Indians in the 1890 Congress session?
qh: मदन मोहन मालवीय ने 1890 के कांग्रेस अधिवेशन में अंग्रेजों के पक्षकार भारतीयों को क्या कहा था?
e: unhonne un bharatiyon ki alochana ki jo parishad mein rahakar keval dikhava karate the aur rashtravad ke pakshadhar nahin the. Is prashn ka kendra bagula bhagat (Hypocrites / Symbol of pretension) hai. Isliye antim jawab bagula bhagat (Hypocrites / Symbol of pretension) ke roop mein milta hai. deshabhakt, vidvan, svatantrata senani anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad bagula bhagat (Hypocrites / Symbol of pretension) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bagula bhagat (Hypocrites / Symbol of pretension) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Section 124A of the IPC, added in 1870, was related to?
qh: 1870 में जोड़ी गई IPC की धारा 124A किससे संबंधित थी?
e: dhara 124A ke tahat british sarakar ke prati virodh bhadakane par ajivan karavas tak ki saja ka pravadhan tha. Is prashn ka kendra rajadroh (Sedition) hai. Isi tathya par rajadroh (Sedition) tika hua hai. Galti vivah, chori, sati pratha chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se rajadroh (Sedition) sahi hai. Exam point: rajadroh (Sedition) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which year was the Vernacular Press Act passed?
qh: वर्नाकुलर प्रेस एक्ट (Vernacular Press Act) किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
e: lord litan ne 1878 mein bharatiy bhashaon ke samachar patron par niyantran ke lie yah kanun banaya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki varnakular pres ekt (Vernacular Press Act) kis varsh parit kiya gaya tha? Isi karan se 1878 sahi uttar hai. Galti 1870, 1857, 1881 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1878 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1878 - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which language did Amrita Bazar Patrika switch overnight to escape the act?
qh: अमृत बाजार पत्रिका ने वर्नाकुलर प्रेस एक्ट से बचने के लिए रातों-रात अपनी भाषा किसमें बदल ली थी?
e: yah patrika raton-rat bangali se angreji mein badal gai kyonki kanun keval kshetriy bhashaon par lagu tha. Is sawaal mein angreji (English) ki baat hai. Isi karan se angreji (English) sahi uttar hai. hindi, udaiya, marathi anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar angreji (English) baithta hai. Exam point: angreji (English) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the name of the Marathi newspaper edited by Tilak?
qh: तिलक (Bal Gangadhar Tilak) द्वारा संपादित मराठी समाचार पत्र का नाम क्या था?
e: tilak ne marathi mein 'kesari' aur angreji mein 'maratha' samachar patr nikala tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki tilak (Bal Gangadhar Tilak) dvara sanpadit marathi samachar patr ka nam kya tha? In tathyon ke chalte kesari hi sahi hai. yang indiya, maratha, hindu is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar kesari hai. Exam point: kesari - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did Lord Curzon deliver a controversial speech on Truth in 1905?
qh: लॉर्ड कर्जन ने 1905 में किस विश्वविद्यालय के दीक्षांत समारोह में झूठ और सत्य पर विवादित भाषण दिया था?
e: karjan ne kalakatta vishvavidyalay mein kaha tha ki saty ki avadharana pashchim ki den hai, jisaka bharatiyon ne kada virodh kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki lord karjan ne 1905 mein kis vishvavidyalay ke dikshant samaroh mein jhuth aur saty par vivadit bhashan diya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki kalakatta vishvavidyalay (Calcutta University) sahi hai. madras vishvavidyalay, banbai vishvavidyalay, dilli vishvavidyalay is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kalakatta vishvavidyalay (Calcutta University) hi milti hai. Exam point: kalakatta vishvavidyalay (Calcutta University) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did Surendranath Banerjee have to go to jail in 1883?
qh: सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी को 1883 में किस विवाद के कारण जेल जाना पड़ा?

qh: कौन सा समाचार पत्र वर्नाकुलर प्रेस एक्ट से बचने के लिए रातों-रात बंगाली से अंग्रेजी भाषा में बदल गया था?

Is prashn ka dayra amrit bajar patrika (Amrita Bazar Patrika) tak phaila hua hai. Yahi wajah hai ki amrit bajar patrika (Amrita Bazar Patrika) sahi hai. bangali, kesari, d hindu in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad amrit bajar patrika (Amrita Bazar Patrika) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: amrit bajar patrika (Amrita Bazar Patrika) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who started the newspapers 'The Hindu' and 'Swadesamitram'?
qh: समाचार पत्र 'द हिंदू' (The Hindu) और 'स्वदेशमित्रम' की शुरुआत किसने की थी?
e: ji. subramanyam ayyar ne dakshin bharat mein in prabhavashali samachar patron ka sanpadan kiya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki samachar patr 'd hindu' (The Hindu) aur 'svadeshamitram' ki shuruat kisane ki thi? Yahi wajah hai ki ji. subramanyam ayyar (G. Subramania Iyer) sahi hai. sureindranath banarji, bal gangadhar tilak, dadabhai nauroji anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ji. subramanyam ayyar (G. Subramania Iyer) hi milti hai. Exam point: ji. subramanyam ayyar (G. Subramania Iyer) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was B.G. Tilak sentenced to 6 years of imprisonment for sedition for the first time?
qh: बाल गंगाधर तिलक को राजद्रोह के आरोप में किस वर्ष पहली बार लंबी जेल (6 वर्ष) की सजा हुई थी?
e: tilak ko 1908 mein unake lekhon ke lie saja sunai gai aur unhein mandale jel bheja gaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bal gangadhar tilak ko rajadroh ke arop mein kis varsh pahali bar lanbi jel (6 varsh) ki saja hui thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1908 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp 1885, 1922, 1897 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se 1908 sahi hai. Exam point: 1908 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was Gandhi arrested under Sedition (Section 124A) for his writings?
qh: गांधी जी को उनके लेखों के कारण राजद्रोह (धारा 124A) के तहत किस वर्ष गिरफ्तार किया गया था?
e: asahayog andolan ke bad 1922 mein gandhi ji ko unake lekhon ke lie giraphtar kiya gaya tha. Yahaan 1922 se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1922 hi sahi baithta hai. Galti 1942, 1915, 1919 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1922 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1922 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the first Indian to go to jail during his journalistic career?
qh: पत्रकारिता के दौरान जेल जाने वाले प्रथम भारतीय कौन थे?
e: sureindranath banarji patrakarita ke dauran jel jane vale pahale bharatiy mane jate hain. Yah prashn sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) se juda hai. Isi baat se sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp mahatma gandhi, javaharalal neharu, bal gangadhar tilak bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) hi hai. Exam point: sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who was the editor of the newspaper 'Bengalee'?
qh: समाचार पत्र 'बंगाली' (Bengalee) का संपादन किसके द्वारा किया जाता था?
e: sureindranath banarji ne 'bangali' samachar patr ke madhyam se janamat taiyar kiya. Is prashn ka kendra sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) hai. In tathyon ke chalte sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) hi sahi hai. motilal ghosh, es.en. sen, raja ram mohan ray is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) hai. Exam point: sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Through which newspaper did Dadabhai Naoroji raise Indian issues?
qh: दादाभाई नौरोजी ने किस समाचार पत्र के माध्यम से भारतीयों की समस्याओं को उठाया?
e: nauroji ne 'voyas oph indiya' aur 'hindustani' jaise prakashanon se sahayog kiya. Yah prashn hindustani (Hindustani / Voice of India) se juda hai. Isi aadhar par hindustani (Hindustani / Voice of India) chuna jaata hai. tribyun, indiyan mirar, kesari anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hindustani (Hindustani / Voice of India) hi milti hai. Exam point: hindustani (Hindustani / Voice of India) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where were newspapers often read aloud at the end of the 19th century?
qh: 19वीं सदी के अंत में समाचार पत्रों का वाचन (Reading) अक्सर कहाँ किया जाता था?
e: ganvon aur kasbon mein pustakalay ya vachanalay charcha aur jagarukata ke mukhy keindr the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 19vin sadi ke ant mein samachar patron ka vachan (Reading) aksar kahan kiya jata tha? Isi tathya par pustakalayon aur vachanalayon (Libraries/Reading rooms) tika hua hai. jangalon mein, keval mahalon mein, keval angreji daphtaron mein in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar pustakalayon aur vachanalayon (Libraries/Reading rooms) hai. Exam point: pustakalayon aur vachanalayon (Libraries/Reading rooms) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the maximum punishment under the 'Sedition' law (124A) during British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन काल में 'राजद्रोह' कानून (धारा 124A) के तहत अधिकतम सजा क्या थी?
e: dhara 124A ke tahat 3 sal ki kaid se lekar ajivan karavas tak ki saja ka pravadhan tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki british shasan kal mein 'rajadroh' kanun (dhara 124A) ke tahat adhikatam saja kya thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par ajivan karavas (Life Imprisonment) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - keval jurmana, 1 mahina kaid, 3 varsh kaid - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar ajivan karavas (Life Imprisonment) hi hai. Exam point: ajivan karavas (Life Imprisonment) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: With which term did Viceroy Lord Dufferin refer to Indian journalists?
qh: वायसराय लॉर्ड डफरिन ने भारतीय पत्रकारों को किस शब्द से संबोधित किया था?
e: dapharin ne patrakaron ke hamalon se pareshan hokar unhein 'tej-tarrar babu' kaha tha. Is prashn ka dayra tej-tarrar babu (Smart Babus) tak phaila hua hai. Isi karan se tej-tarrar babu (Smart Babus) sahi uttar hai. dushman, svatantrata senani, krantikari mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad tej-tarrar babu (Smart Babus) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: tej-tarrar babu (Smart Babus) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which of these newspapers was published from Punjab?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा समाचार पत्र पंजाब से प्रकाशित होता था?
e: d tribyun panjab ka ek pramukh rashtravadi samachar patr tha. Is sawaal mein d tribyun (The Tribune) ki baat hai. Isi karan se d tribyun (The Tribune) sahi uttar hai. sudharak, indu prakash, amrit bajar patrika anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab d tribyun (The Tribune) hai. Exam point: d tribyun (The Tribune) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which council did Lord Lytton pass the Vernacular Press Act secretly?
qh: लॉर्ड लिटन ने वर्नाकुलर प्रेस एक्ट को चोरी-छिपे किस परिषद में पास कराया था?
e: ise bina bharatiyon ki ray lie anan-phanan mein lejisaletiv kaunsil mein pas kiya gaya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki lord litan ne varnakular pres ekt ko chori-chhipe kis parishad mein pas karaya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja lejisaletiv kaunsil (Legislative Council) nikalta hai. british sansad, kangres karyasamiti, nagar nigam alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab lejisaletiv kaunsil (Legislative Council) hai. Exam point: lejisaletiv kaunsil (Legislative Council) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What clever method did Indian journalists use to avoid repressive laws?
qh: भारतीय पत्रकारों ने दमनकारी कानूनों से बचने के लिए क्या चतुराई अपनाई थी?
o: लंदन टाइम्स या विदेशी मीडिया का हवाला देना (Referring to foreign media)
e: ve aksar british akhabaron mein chhape lekhon ko ri-kopi karate the taki sarakar un par karravai n kar sake. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bharatiy patrakaron ne damanakari kanunon se bachane ke lie kya chaturai apanai thi? Isliye antim jawab landan taims ya videshi midiya ka havala... ke roop mein milta hai. angrejon se maphi mangi, akhabar band kar die, keval kavitaen chhapi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar landan taims ya videshi midiya ka havala... hi hai. Exam point: landan taims ya videshi midiya ka havala... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which leader spoke of social reform through the newspaper 'Sudharak'?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने समाचार पत्र 'सुधारक' (Sudharak) के माध्यम से समाज सुधार की बात की?
e: gopal krishn gokhale ne 'sudharak' ke madhyam se samaj aur rajaniti mein sudhar ki vakalat ki. Yah prashn gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) se juda hai. Isi tathya par gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) tika hua hai. sureindranath banarji, motilal neharu, bal gangadhar tilak alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) hai. Exam point: gopal krishn gokhale (G.K. Gokhale) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In the 19th century, publishing a newspaper was considered what instead of a business?
qh: 19वीं सदी में अखबार छापना व्यवसाय (Business) के बजाय क्या माना जाता था?
o: राजनीतिक और नैतिक कर्तव्य (Political and Moral duty)
e: us samay patrakarita labh ke lie nahin, balki desh seva aur jagarukata ke lie ki jati thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 19vin sadi mein akhabar chhapana vyavasay (Business) ke bajay kya mana jata tha? Isi karan se rajanitik aur naitik kartavy (Political and Moral duty) sahi uttar hai. khel, samay ki barbadi, sarakari naukari is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad rajanitik aur naitik kartavy (Political and Moral... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: rajanitik aur naitik kartavy (Political and Moral... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Indian newspapers primarily played the role of what during British rule?
qh: भारतीय समाचार पत्रों ने ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान मुख्य रूप से किसकी भूमिका निभाई?
e: chunki us samay koi nirvachit vipaksh nahin tha, pres ne hi sarakar ki kamiyon ko ujagar kiya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki bharatiy samachar patron ne british shasan ke dauran mukhy rup se kisaki bhumika nibhai? Isliye sahi nateeja vipaksh (Opposition) ki nikalta hai. sarakari pravakta ki, manoranjan ki, keval vijnapan ki in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab vipaksh (Opposition) ki hai. Exam point: vipaksh (Opposition) ki - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What type of newspapers were targeted under the Vernacular Press Act?
qh: वर्नाकुलर प्रेस एक्ट के तहत किस प्रकार के समाचार पत्रों को लक्षित किया गया था?
e: yah adhiniyam keval bharatiy bhashaon (jaise bangali, marathi) mein chhapane vale akhabaron ko dabane ke lie tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki varnakular pres ekt ke tahat kis prakar ke samachar patron ko lakshit kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kshetriy/sthaniy bhasha ke (Regional languages) sahi nikalta hai. videshi akhabar, angreji bhasha ke, dharmik patrikaen anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar kshetriy/sthaniy bhasha ke (Regional languages) baithta hai. Exam point: kshetriy/sthaniy bhasha ke (Regional languages) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the editor of 'Indian Mirror'?
qh: अखबार 'इंडियन मिरर' (Indian Mirror) के संपादक कौन थे?
e: en.en. sen indiyan mirar ke madhyam se rashtravadi vicharon ka prachar karate the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki akhabar 'indiyan mirar' (Indian Mirror) ke sanpadak kaun the? Isi aadhar par en.en. sen (N.N. Sen) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp tilak, shishir ghosh, ji.es. ayyar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se en.en. sen (N.N. Sen) sahi hai. Exam point: en.en. sen (N.N. Sen) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Approximately how much did it cost to start Amrita Bazar Patrika at that time?
qh: उस समय अमृत बाजार पत्रिका को शुरू करने में लगभग कितना खर्च आता था?
e: amrit bajar patrika jaise kai patr bahut hi mamuli lagat (jaise 2 rupaye) se shuru kie gae the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki us samay amrit bajar patrika ko shuru karane mein lagabhag kitana kharch ata tha? Isi tathya par rupaye 2 (Rs. 2) tika hua hai. rupaye 32, rupaye 100, rupaye 1000 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan rupaye 2 (Rs. 2) hi milti hai. Exam point: rupaye 2 (Rs. 2) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What did Lord Dufferin write in May 1886 about the Indian perception of the British?
qh: लॉर्ड डफरिन ने मई 1886 में अंग्रेजों के प्रति भारतीय धारणा के बारे में क्या लिखा?
o: अंग्रेजों को भारत का दुश्मन माना जा रहा है (British seen as enemies)
भारतीय अंग्रेजों से प्यार करते हैं
e: dapharin ne svikar kiya ki akhabaron ke karan bharatiyon mein yah dharana ban rahi hai ki angrej puri manav jati ke dushman hain. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki lord dapharin ne mai 1886 mein angrejon ke prati bharatiy dharana ke bare mein kya likha? Isi baat se angrejon ko bharat ka dushman mana ja raha hai (British seen as enemies) sahi sabit hota hai. bharatiy rajaniti nahin janate, koi samasya nahin hai, bharatiy angrejon se pyar karate hain ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab angrejon ko bharat ka dushman mana ja... hai. Exam point: angrejon ko bharat ka dushman mana ja raha hai (British seen as enemies) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What change was made in the IPC in 1870 to control the press?
qh: प्रेस पर नियंत्रण के लिए 1870 में भारतीय दंड संहिता में कौन सा परिवर्तन किया गया?
e: sarakar ne rajadroh ko paribhashit karane ke lie 1870 mein IPC mein dhara 124A jodai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki pres par niyantran ke lie 1870 mein bharatiy dand sanhita mein kaun sa parivartan kiya gaya? In tathyon ke chalte dhara 124A jodana (Adding Section 124A) hi sahi hai. sati pratha rok, arms ekt, chunavi sudhar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad dhara 124A jodana (Adding Section 124A) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: dhara 124A jodana (Adding Section 124A) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: For what did Gandhi describe press freedom as 'planting a sapling'?
qh: गांधी जी ने प्रेस और अभिव्यक्ति की आजादी को किसके लिए 'बिरवा रोपना' (Planting a sapling) कहा था?
e: pres ko rashtriy chetana jagane aur rashtravad ke paudhe ko sinchane ka ekamatr jariya mana gaya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gandhi ji ne pres aur abhivyakti ki ajadi ko kisake lie 'birava ropana' (Planting a sapling) kaha tha? Isi aadhar par rashtriy chetana (National Consciousness) chuna jaata hai. keval shiksha, angreji bhasha, kheti ke lie alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar rashtriy chetana (National Consciousness) baithta hai. Exam point: rashtriy chetana (National Consciousness) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On which date was the Indian National Congress founded?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की स्थापना किस तिथि को हुई थी?
e: bharatiy rashtriy kangres ka pahala adhiveshan 28 disanbar 1885 ko banbai mein hua tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bharatiy rashtriy kangres ki sthapana kis tithi ko hui thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 28 disanbar 1885 sahi nikalta hai. 10 mai 1885, 26 janavari 1885, 15 agast 1885 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 28 disanbar 1885 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 28 disanbar 1885 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who presided over the first session of the Congress?
qh: कांग्रेस के प्रथम अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
e: vyomesh chandr banarji kangres ke pahale adhyaksh chune gae the. Is sawaal mein vyomesh chandr banarji (W.C. Bonnerjee) ki baat hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par vyomesh chandr banarji (W.C. Bonnerjee) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. e.o. hyum, dadabhai nauroji, badaruddin taiyabaji mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar vyomesh chandr banarji (W.C. Bonnerjee) hi hai. Exam point: vyomesh chandr banarji (W.C. Bonnerjee) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the Viceroy of India at the time of Congress's formation?
qh: कांग्रेस की स्थापना के समय भारत का वायसराय कौन था?
e: 1885 mein jab kangres ki sthapana hui, tab lord dapharin bharat ke vayasaray the. Is prashn ka dayra lord dapharin (Lord Dufferin) tak phaila hua hai. Isi karan se lord dapharin (Lord Dufferin) sahi uttar hai. lord ripan, lord kaining, lord karjan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. e: yadyapi kai bharatiyon ka sahayog tha, mukhy sutradhar e.o. hyum the. Is prashn ka dayra e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) tak phaila hua hai. Isi karan se e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) sahi uttar hai. sureindranath banarji, javaharalal neharu, ravindranath taigor anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) hi hai. Exam point: e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the concept of 'Nation' at the time of Congress's foundation?
qh: कांग्रेस की स्थापना के समय 'राष्ट्र' की अवधारणा क्या थी?
o: भारत पहले से एक राष्ट्र था
राष्ट्र निर्माण की प्रक्रिया शुरू हो रही थी (Nation in the making)
e: itihasakar kangres ke shuruati varshon ko 'rashtr nirman ki prakriya' ka hissa manate hain. Is sawaal mein rashtr nirman ki prakriya shuru ho rahi thi (Nation in the making) ki baat hai. Isi karan se rashtr nirman ki prakriya shuru ho rahi... sahi uttar hai. koi rashtr nahin tha, bharat pahale se ek rashtr tha, sirph dharmik rashtr tha is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan rashtr nirman ki prakriya shuru ho rahi... hi milti hai. Exam point: rashtr nirman ki prakriya shuru ho rahi thi (Nation in the making) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which year was the Indian National Congress founded?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: bharatiy rashtriy kangres ki sthapana 28 disanbar 1885 ko hui thi. Is sawaal mein 1885 ki baat hai. In tathyon ke chalte 1885 hi sahi hai. 1905, 1916, 1857 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1885 baithta hai. Exam point: 1885 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai. Is baat ko nakshon tatha samay-rekha ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai tatha galti kam hoti hai.

qe: Who is considered the founder of the Indian National Congress?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के संस्थापक (Founder) किसे माना जाता है?
e: elan okteviyan hyum (A.O. Hume), jo ek ritayard british adhikari the, ne kangres ki sthapana ki thi. Is prashn ka vishay e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) hai. Isi baat se e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) sahi sabit hota hai. sureindranath banarji, dadabhai nauroji, lord dapharin in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) hai. Exam point: e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: How many delegates attended the first session of Congress in 1885?
qh: कांग्रेस के पहले अधिवेशन (1885) में कितने प्रतिनिधियों ने भाग लिया था?
e: munbai mein hue pahale adhiveshan mein desh bhar se kul 72 pratinidhiyon ne hissa liya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kangres ke pahale adhiveshan (1885) mein kitane pratinidhiyon ne bhag liya tha? Isi karan se 72 sahi uttar hai. Vikalp 50, 100, 389 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 72 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 72 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is the 'Safety Valve' theory regarding the foundation of Congress?
qh: कांग्रेस की स्थापना के संदर्भ में 'सुरक्षा वॉल्व' (Safety Valve) सिद्धांत क्या है?
o: जनता के असंतोष को शांतिपूर्वक निकालने का माध्यम
e: is siddhant ke anusar, angrejon ne bharatiy janata ke b te gusse ko rokane ke lie kangres ko ek sephti volv ki tarah istemal kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kangres ki sthapana ke sandarbh mein 'suraksha volv' (Safety Valve) siddhant kya hai? Isi karan se janata ke asantosh ko shantipurvak nikalane ka... sahi uttar hai. angrejon ke viruddh hinsak vidroh, sena ka ek sangathan, vaijnanik khoj is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar janata ke asantosh ko shantipurvak nikalane ka madhyam hi hai. Exam point: janata ke asantosh ko shantipurvak nikalane ka madhyam - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which leader wrote in 'Young India' (1916) that Congress was the brainchild of Lord Dufferin?
qh: किस राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने अपनी पत्रिका 'यंग इंडिया' (1916) में लिखा कि कांग्रेस लॉर्ड डफरिन के दिमाग की उपज थी?
e: lala lajapat ray ne 'yang indiya' mein kangres ki sthapana ke pichhe sephti volv ka mithak pracharit kiya tha. Is prashn ka kendra lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hai. Isi karan se lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) sahi uttar hai. Galti vipin chandr pal, bal gangadhar tilak, mahatma gandhi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hi milti hai. Exam point: lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: William Wedderburn wrote the biography of which person?
qh: विलियम वेडरबर्न ने किस व्यक्ति की जीवनी (Biography) लिखी थी?
e: 1913 mein viliyam vedarabarn ne e.o. hyum ki jivani prakashit ki, jisamein 'gopaniy riport' ka jikr tha. Is prashn ka dayra e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) tak phaila hua hai. Isi karan se e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) sahi uttar hai. neharu, lord dapharin, mahatma gandhi ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) hi hai. Exam point: e.o. hyum (A.O. Hume) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: According to the myth, how many volumes did the secret report have that Hume received in Shimla?
qh: मिथक के अनुसार, ए.ओ. ह्यूम को शिमला में जो गोपनीय रिपोर्ट मिली थी, वह कितने खंडों (Volumes) में थी?
e: kaha jata hai ki hyum ko sat khandon vali ek gupt riport mili thi, jo deshavyapi hinsak vidroh ki chetavani deti thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki mithak ke anusar, e.o. hyum ko shimala mein jo gopaniy riport mili thi, vah kitane khandon (Volumes) mein thi? Yahi wajah hai ki 7 sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - 5, 10, 3 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav 7 hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 7 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Hume was the Secretary of which government department during Congress's establishment?
qh: कांग्रेस की स्थापना के समय ए.ओ. ह्यूम किस सरकारी विभाग के सचिव (Secretary) थे?
e: e.o. hyum rajasv, krishi aur vanijy vibhag ke sachiv the, n ki grih vibhag ke. Is prashn ka dayra rajasv, krishi aur vanijy vibhag tak phaila hua hai. In tathyon ke chalte rajasv, krishi aur vanijy vibhag hi sahi hai. grih vibhag (Home), videshi vibhag, raksha vibhag (Defense) anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar rajasv, krishi aur vanijy vibhag hi hai. Exam point: rajasv, krishi aur vanijy vibhag - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which book did Rajni Palme Dutt discuss the 'dual character' of Congress?
qh: रजनी पाम दत्त ने अपनी किस प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक में कांग्रेस के 'दोहरे चरित्र' की चर्चा की है?
e: rajani pam datt ne 'indiya tude' mein likha ki kangres ne samrajyavad aur rashtravad donon ke lie kary kiya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rajani pam datt ne apani kis prasiddh pustak mein kangres ke 'dohare charitr' ki charcha ki hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par indiya tude (India Today) sahi nikalta hai. hind svaraj, yang indiya, diskavari oph indiya anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan indiya tude (India Today) hi milti hai. Exam point: indiya tude (India Today) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which historian refuted the 'Safety Valve' theory as a myth?
qh: किस इतिहासकार ने 'सेफ्टी वॉल्व' थ्योरी का खंडन करते हुए इसे एक 'मिथक' बताया है?
e: bipin chandr ne apani pustak mein tark diya ki sephti volv ki kahani tathyatmak rup se sahi nahin hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki kis itihasakar ne 'sephti volv' thyori ka khandan karate hue ise ek 'mithak' bataya hai? In tathyon ke chalte bipin chandr (Bipan Chandra) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - lala lajapat ray, tarachandr, ar.si. majumadar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar bipin chandr (Bipan Chandra) hi hai. Exam point: bipin chandr (Bipan Chandra) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What did M.S. Golwalkar attack regarding Congress in 1939?
qh: एम.एस. गोलवलकर ने 1939 में कांग्रेस की स्थापना के संदर्भ में किस पर प्रहार किया था?
e: golavalakar ne kangres ki dharmanirapekshata ki alochana karate hue ise 'sephti volv' se jo a tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki em.es. golavalakar ne 1939 mein kangres ki sthapana ke sandarbh mein kis par prahar kiya tha? Isi baat se kangres ki dharmanirapekshata (Secularism) sahi sabit hota hai. e.o. hyum ki shiksha, kangres ki arthik niti, kangres ke jhande is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar kangres ki dharmanirapekshata (Secularism) hi hai. Exam point: kangres ki dharmanirapekshata (Secularism) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: How many informants did supporters of the theory claim Hume used?
qh: सुरक्षा वॉल्व सिद्धांत के समर्थकों का दावा है कि ह्यूम ने भारत में विद्रोह का पता लगाने के लिए कितने 'मुखबिरों' (Informants) का उपयोग किया?
e: riport mein dava kiya gaya tha ki 30,000 mukhabiron ki suchana ke adhar par hinsak visphot ka dar tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki suraksha volv siddhant ke samarthakon ka dava hai ki hyum ne bharat mein vidroh ka pata lagane ke lie kitane 'mukhabiron' (Informants) ka upayog kiya? In tathyon ke chalte 30,000 hi sahi hai. 5,000, 1,00,000, 1,000 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav 30,000 hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 30,000 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the working method of Congress between 1885-1905 called?
qh: 1885 से 1905 के बीच कांग्रेस के कार्य करने के तरीके को क्या कहा जाता है?

Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1885 se 1905 ke bich kangres ke kary karane ke tarike ko kya kaha jata hai? Isliye antim jawab udaravadi/naramapanthi yug (Moderate Era) ke roop mein milta hai. krantikari yug, samajavadi yug, gandhivadi yug alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad udaravadi/naramapanthi yug (Moderate Era) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: udaravadi/naramapanthi yug (Moderate Era) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the strongest argument against the Safety Valve theory?

ह्यूम गृह विभाग में नहीं थे (Hume was not in the Home Dept)

Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki suraksha volv siddhant ke viruddh sabase b a tark kya hai? Yahi wajah hai ki hyum grih vibhag mein nahin the (Hume was not in the Home Dept) sahi hai. kangres kabhi saphal nahin hui, lord dapharin hyum ke dushman the, hyum bharatiy the in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hyum grih vibhag mein nahin the (Hume... hi milti hai. Exam point: hyum grih vibhag mein nahin the (Hume was not in the Home Dept) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which theory did C.F. Andrews and Girija Mukherjee accept in 1938?
qh: सी.एफ. एंड्रयूज और गिरिजा मुखर्जी ने 1938 में कांग्रेस के उदय को किस सिद्धांत के तहत स्वीकार किया?
e: unhonne svikar kiya ki kangres ne hinsak raktapat rokane ke lie sephti volv ka kam kiya. Yah prashn sephti volv (Safety Valve) se juda hai. Isliye sahi nateeja sephti volv (Safety Valve) nikalta hai. samantavad, t it chalak, samajavad mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar sephti volv (Safety Valve) hai. Exam point: sephti volv (Safety Valve) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who first popularized the term 'Safety Valve' for Congress?
qh: सुरक्षा वॉल्व शब्द का प्रयोग सबसे पहले किसने किया था?
e: lala lajapat ray ne is shabd ke jarie kangres ki sthapana par saval uthae the. Is prashn ka kendra lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hai. In tathyon ke chalte lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hi sahi hai. robart klaiv, javaharalal neharu, e.o. hyum anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: A.O. Hume was a resident of which country?
qh: ए.ओ. ह्यूम किस देश के निवासी थे?
e: e.o. hyum mul rup se skotalaind ke nivasi the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki e.o. hyum kis desh ke nivasi the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par skotalaind (Scotland) sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - ayaralaind, phrans, inglaind - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav skotalaind (Scotland) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: skotalaind (Scotland) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What does the term 'Bourgeois' mean?
qh: 'बुर्जुआ' (Bourgeois) वर्ग का अर्थ क्या होता है?
e: burjua varg samaj ka vah madhyam sanpann tabaka hai jisake prashasan aur sarakar se sanpark hote the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 'burjua' (Bourgeois) varg ka arth kya hota hai? Isliye antim jawab madhyam sanpann varg (Middle-class elites) ke roop mein milta hai. raja-maharaja, videshi sainik, garib majadur anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav madhyam sanpann varg (Middle-class elites) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: madhyam sanpann varg (Middle-class elites) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was Hume's secret report reportedly received?
qh: ह्यूम की गोपनीय रिपोर्ट मिलने की घटना किस वर्ष की बताई जाती है?

Isliye sahi uttar 1878 hi hai. Exam point: 1878 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein. Prashn chhota lage par iske peeche poora ek ghatna-kram tatha saal ka gyaan chhupa hota hai, isliye poora sandarbh dhyan mein rakhein.

qe: Which theory was supported by historians like Tarachand and R.C. Majumdar?
qh: ताराचंद्र और आर.सी. मजूमदार जैसे इतिहासकारों ने किस सिद्धांत का समर्थन किया था?
e: in prabuddh itihasakaron ne bhi shuruat mein suraksha volv ki avadharana ko svikar kiya tha. Is prashn ka vishay suraksha volv (Safety Valve) hai. Isi baat se suraksha volv (Safety Valve) sahi sabit hota hai. hindu rashtravad, marksavad, gandhivad alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan suraksha volv (Safety Valve) hi milti hai. Exam point: suraksha volv (Safety Valve) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: The 'Truth' of Congress's establishment lies in which fact?
qh: कांग्रेस की स्थापना का 'सच' (Truth) किस बात में निहित है?
o: यह भारतीयों की राजनीतिक चेतना का परिणाम थी
यह केवल मुसलमानों की संस्था थी
e: kangres ka gathan bharatiy netaon ki b ti rashtravadi chetana aur akhil bharatiy sangathan ki jarurat ka parinam tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki kangres ki sthapana ka 'sach' (Truth) kis bat mein nihit hai? Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad yah bharatiyon ki rajanitik chetana ka parinam thi hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: yah bharatiyon ki rajanitik chetana ka parinam thi - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who called Hume a 'Lover of Freedom'?
qh: ह्यूम को 'आजादी का प्रेमी' (Lover of Freedom) किसने कहा था?
e: lala lajapat ray ne hyum ko ajadi ka premi bataya tha lekin sath hi unhein british rajabhakt bhi kaha. Is prashn ka vishay lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hi sahi baithta hai. lord dapharin, subhash chandr bos, bhagat sinh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) hai. Exam point: lala lajapat ray (Lala Lajpat Rai) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the role of an 'Informant' during British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान 'मुखबिर' का क्या कार्य होता था?
e: mukhabir samaj ke bich hone vali gatividhiyon ki gupt janakari sarakar ko dete the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki british shasan ke dauran 'mukhabir' ka kya kary hota tha? Isi aadhar par gupt suchanaen sarakar tak pahunchana (Spying) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - taiks vasulana, shiksha dena, sena ka netritv - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se gupt suchanaen sarakar tak pahunchana (Spying) sahi hai. Exam point: gupt suchanaen sarakar tak pahunchana (Spying) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why was the 'Secret Report' not made public in 1885?
qh: 1885 में कांग्रेस की स्थापना के समय 'गोपनीय रिपोर्ट' की चर्चा सार्वजनिक क्यों नहीं की गई थी?
o: क्योंकि ह्यूम ने उसे जला दिया था
क्योंकि वह सरकारी रिकॉर्ड में नहीं मिली (Not found in archives)
e: bad ke shodhakartaon ko sarakari abhilekhagar (Archives) mein aisi kisi riport ka koi sakshy nahin mila. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1885 mein kangres ki sthapana ke samay 'gopaniy riport' ki charcha sarvajanik kyon nahin ki gai thi? Isliye antim jawab kyonki vah sarakari rikord mein nahin mili... ke roop mein milta hai. kyonki hyum ne use jala diya tha, kyonki dapharin dar gae the, kyonki vah kho gai thi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar kyonki vah sarakari rikord mein nahin mili... hi hai. Exam point: kyonki vah sarakari rikord mein nahin mili (Not found in archives) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did Lord Dufferin use Hume?
qh: लॉर्ड डफरिन ने ह्यूम का उपयोग क्यों किया था?
o: ह्यूम के भारतीयों के साथ अच्छे संपर्क थे
e: dapharin ka manana tha ki hyum bharatiyon ke vicharon ko behatar samajh sakate hain aur unhein sarakar ke paksh mein mo sakate hain. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki lord dapharin ne hyum ka upayog kyon kiya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki hyum ke bharatiyon ke sath achchhe sanpark the sahi hai. Vikalp hyum ko hindi ati thi, hyum dapharin ke bhai the, hyum ek achchhe sainik the bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hyum ke bharatiyon ke sath achchhe sanpark the hi milti hai. Exam point: hyum ke bharatiyon ke sath achchhe sanpark the - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which class was likely to lead the revolution during the foundation of Congress?
qh: कांग्रेस की स्थापना के समय कौन सा वर्ग क्रांति का नेतृत्व करने की संभावना रखता था?
e: 1857 ke viparit, ab shikshit varg asantosh ko ek disha dekar rashtriy vidroh mein badal sakata tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kangres ki sthapana ke samay kaun sa varg kranti ka netritv karane ki sanbhavana rakhata tha? Isi tathya par shikshit madhyam varg (Educated Middle Class) tika hua hai. keval kisan, keval sipahi, keval jamindar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar shikshit madhyam varg (Educated Middle Class) baithta hai. Exam point: shikshit madhyam varg (Educated Middle Class) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why was Congress called an 'All-India level' institution?
qh: कांग्रेस को 'अखिल भारतीय स्तर' (All-India level) की संस्था क्यों कहा गया?
o: क्योंकि इसमें पूरे भारत की समस्याओं को उठाया गया
क्योंकि यह केवल बंबई में थी
क्योंकि यह अंग्रेजों की पार्टी थी
e: kangres kshetriy sansthaon se alag pure bharat ke rashtravyapi muddon par vichar karane ke lie bani thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki kangres ko 'akhil bharatiy star' (All-India level) ki sanstha kyon kaha gaya? Isliye sahi nateeja kyonki isamein pure bharat ki samasyaon ko uthaya gaya nikalta hai. kyonki yah keval banbai mein thi, kyonki yah angrejon ki parti thi, kyonki isamein keval raja the in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav kyonki isamein pure bharat ki samasyaon ko uthaya gaya hi thehrta hai. Exam point: kyonki isamein pure bharat ki samasyaon ko uthaya gaya - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Pabna Revolt is primarily related to which region of India?
qh: पावना विद्रोह (Pabna Revolt) मुख्य रूप से भारत के किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: pavana vidroh 1873-76 ke dauran purvi bangal (ab bangladesh) ke yusuphashahi paragana mein hua tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki pavana vidroh (Pabna Revolt) mukhy rup se bharat ke kis kshetr se sanbandhit hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par purvi bangal (adhunik bangladesh) sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - dakshini madras, pashchimi panjab, uttar pradesh - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan purvi bangal (adhunik bangladesh) hi milti hai. Exam point: purvi bangal (adhunik bangladesh) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: From which pargana did the Pabna peasant movement begin?
qh: पावना किसान आंदोलन की शुरुआत किस परगना से हुई थी?
e: pavana jile ke yusuphashahi paragana ke kisanon ne sabase pahale jamindaron ke atyachar ke khilaph avaj uthai thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki pavana kisan andolan ki shuruat kis paragana se hui thi? Isi karan se yusuphashahi paragana (Yusufshahi Pargana) sahi uttar hai. nadiya paragana, rajamahal, bhagalapur mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab yusuphashahi paragana (Yusufshahi Pargana) hai. Exam point: yusuphashahi paragana (Yusufshahi Pargana) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which organization was formed by Pabna farmers to strongly present their demands?
qh: पावना के किसानों ने अपनी मांगों को मजबूती से रखने के लिए किस संगठन का गठन किया था?
e: 1873 mein pavana mein 'kisan sangh' ka gathan kiya gaya tha taki sangathit hokar kanuni l ai l i ja sake. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki pavana ke kisanon ne apani mangon ko majabuti se rakhane ke lie kis sangathan ka gathan kiya tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi tathya par kisan sangh (Agrarian League) tika hua hai. ajad hind phauj, ahom sabha, prajamandal in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad kisan sangh (Agrarian League) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kisan sangh (Agrarian League) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which famous slogan was given by farmers during the Pabna Revolt?
qh: पावना विद्रोह के दौरान किसानों ने कौन सा प्रसिद्ध नारा दिया था?
o: हम महारानी और सिर्फ महारानी के रैयत होना चाहते हैं
e: pavana ke kisanon ne kaha ki ve bichauliyon (jamindaron) ko hatakar sidhe british kraun ke adhin rahana chahate hain. Prashn yah batata hai ki pavana vidroh ke dauran kisanon ne kaun sa prasiddh nara diya tha? raiyat kheti karne wala kisaan hota tha. Isi karan se ham maharani aur sirph maharani ke raiyat... sahi uttar hai. inkalab jindabad, jay javan jay kisan, angrejon bharat chho o alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad ham maharani aur sirph maharani ke raiyat hona chahate hain hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ham maharani aur sirph maharani ke raiyat hona chahate hain - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who were the prominent leaders of the Pabna Revolt?
qh: पावना विद्रोह का नेतृत्व करने वाले प्रमुख नेताओं में कौन शामिल थे?
o: ईशान चंद्र राय और शंभू पाल (Ishan Chandra Roy and Shambhu Pal)
e: ishan chandr ray, shanbhu pal aur khudi malla pavana kisan sangh ke mukhy neta the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki pavana vidroh ka netritv karane vale pramukh netaon mein kaun shamil the? Isi tathya par ishan chandr ray aur shanbhu pal (Ishan... tika hua hai. birasa munda, siddhu aur kanu, mahatma gandhi in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad ishan chandr ray aur shanbhu pal (Ishan Chandra Roy and Shambhu Pal) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ishan chandr ray aur shanbhu pal (Ishan Chandra Roy and Shambhu Pal) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did the Deccan Riots primarily break out in 1875?
qh: दक्कन विद्रोह (Deccan Riots) 1875 में मुख्य रूप से कहाँ भड़का था?
o: पुणे के सुपा गाँव (Supa village of Pune)
e: dakkan vidroh ki shuruat pune jile ke supa ganv ke sahukaron ke khilaph hui thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki dakkan vidroh (Deccan Riots) 1875 mein mukhy rup se kahan bh ka tha? Isliye sahi nateeja pune ke supa ganv (Supa village of Pune) nikalta hai. amaravati, nagapur, surat alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad pune ke supa ganv (Supa village of Pune) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: pune ke supa ganv (Supa village of Pune) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What did Deccan farmers primarily try to destroy during attacks on moneylenders?
qh: दक्कन के किसानों ने साहूकारों पर हमला कर मुख्य रूप से किसे नष्ट करने का प्रयास किया?
o: ऋण पत्र और बही-खाते (Debt bonds and Account books)
e: kisanon ne sahukaron ke gharon par hamala kar un rin patron aur kagajaton ko jala diya jo unaki gulami ka karan the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki dakkan ke kisanon ne sahukaron par hamala kar mukhy rup se kise nasht karane ka prayas kiya? Isliye sahi nateeja rin patr aur bahi-khate (Debt bonds and Account books) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - sainik chhavani, rel ki patariyan, anaj ke godam - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar rin patr aur bahi-khate (Debt bonds and Account books) hi hai. Exam point: rin patr aur bahi-khate (Debt bonds and Account books) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What caused the increased demand for cotton in India during the 1860s?
qh: 1860 के दशक में भारत में 'कपास' की मांग बढ़ने का क्या कारण था?
e: ameriki grihayuddh ke karan briten ko kapas ki apurti ruk gai thi, jisase bharatiy kapas ki mang b gai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1860 ke dashak mein bharat mein 'kapas' ki mang b ne ka kya karan tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par ameriki grihayuddh (American Civil War) sahi nikalta hai. Galti japani mang, bharat mein nai takanik ana, chin se yuddh chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav ameriki grihayuddh (American Civil War) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: ameriki grihayuddh (American Civil War) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which act was passed by the British government to provide relief to farmers after the Deccan Riots?
qh: दक्कन विद्रोह के बाद ब्रिटिश सरकार ने किसानों को राहत देने के लिए कौन सा अधिनियम पारित किया?
o: दक्कन कृषक राहत अधिनियम 1879 (Deccan Agriculturalists' Relief Act)
e: 1879 mein dakkan krishak rahat adhiniyam parit kar sahukaron ke shoshan par kuchh simaen lagai gain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki dakkan vidroh ke bad british sarakar ne kisanon ko rahat dene ke lie kaun sa adhiniyam parit kiya?
