Yahi wajah hai ki dakkan krishak rahat adhiniyam 1879 (Deccan Agriculturalists' Relief Act) sahi hai. raulet ekt, bangal kashtakari adhiniyam, ilahabad sandhi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab dakkan krishak rahat adhiniyam 1879 (Deccan Agriculturalists'... hai. Exam point: dakkan krishak rahat adhiniyam 1879 (Deccan Agriculturalists'... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What kind of social boycott was practiced against moneylenders in the Deccan?
qh: दक्कन क्षेत्र में साहूकारों के खिलाफ किस प्रकार का सामाजिक बहिष्कार (Social Boycott) किया गया?
o: नाई, धोबी और मोची ने सेवा देने से मना कर दिया
e: ganv ki sevadar jatiyon (balutedaron) ne sahukaron ke lie kam karana band kar diya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki dakkan kshetr mein sahukaron ke khilaph kis prakar ka samajik bahishkar (Social Boycott) kiya gaya? Isliye antim jawab nai, dhobi aur mochi ne seva dene... ke roop mein milta hai. unhein ganv se bhaga diya, unhein jel bhej diya, unaki phasal jala di is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar nai, dhobi aur mochi ne seva dene... hi hai. Exam point: nai, dhobi aur mochi ne seva dene se mana kar diya - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which law was made to improve the condition of tenants in Bengal after the Indigo Revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह (1859-60) के बाद बंगाल में काश्तकारों की स्थिति सुधारने के लिए कौन सा कानून बना?
e: kisanon ke lanbe sangharsh ke bad 1885 mein bangal kashtakari adhiniyam parit kiya gaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki nil vidroh (1859-60) ke bad bangal mein kashtakaron ki sthiti sudharane ke lie kaun sa kanun bana? Yahi wajah hai ki bangal kashtakari adhiniyam 1885 (Bengal Tenancy Act) sahi hai. mahalavadai vyavastha, raiyatavadai kanun, pits indiya ekt anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bangal kashtakari adhiniyam 1885 (Bengal Tenancy Act) hi milti hai. Exam point: bangal kashtakari adhiniyam 1885 (Bengal Tenancy Act) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were the moneylenders from Gujarat and Marwar called during the Deccan riots?
qh: दक्कन के विद्रोह के समय गुजरात और मारवाड़ से आए साहूकारों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: dakkan ke sthaniy kisan bahari sahukaron ke changul mein phans gae the, jo marava aur gujarat se ae the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki dakkan ke vidroh ke samay gujarat aur marava se ae sahukaron ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi karan se bahari/marava i-gujarati sahukar sahi uttar hai. damin, poligar, payak ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar bahari/marava i-gujarati sahukar hai. Exam point: bahari/marava i-gujarati sahukar - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Through which organization did Justice M.G. Ranade raise the farmers' voice?
qh: न्यायमूर्ति महादेव गोविंद रानाडे (M.G. Ranade) ने किस संगठन के माध्यम से किसानों की आवाज उठाई?
e: ranade ne puna sarvajanik sabha ke jarie kisanon ke shoshan ke khilaph sarakar ka dhyan khincha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki nyayamurti mahadev govind ranade (M.G. Ranade) ne kis sangathan ke madhyam se kisanon ki avaj uthai? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isliye sahi nateeja puna sarvajanik sabha (Poona Sarvajanik Sabha) nikalta hai. ajad dasta, bharatiy rashtriy kangres, kisan sangh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan puna sarvajanik sabha (Poona Sarvajanik Sabha) hi milti hai. Exam point: puna sarvajanik sabha (Poona Sarvajanik Sabha) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a key characteristic of the Pabna and Deccan revolts?
qh: पावना और दक्कन के विद्रोहों की एक मुख्य विशेषता क्या थी?
o: वे अंग्रेजों को भगाने के लिए थे
वे कानून के दायरे में और संयमित थे (Regulated and Legal)
e: in andolanon mein kisanon ne aksar kanuni sahara liya aur b e paimane par hatyaen ya hinsa nahin ki. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki pavana aur dakkan ke vidrohon ki ek mukhy visheshata kya thi? Isi karan se ve kanun ke dayare mein aur sanyamit the (Regulated and Legal) sahi uttar hai. ve puri tarah hinsak the, ve angrejon ko bhagane ke lie the, unaka koi neta nahin tha in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad ve kanun ke dayare mein aur sanyamit the (Regulated and Legal) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ve kanun ke dayare mein aur sanyamit the (Regulated and Legal) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the middleman between the tenant and the landlord called?
qh: काश्तकार (Tenant) और जमींदार के बीच के बिचौलिये को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: karinde aksar jamindaron ke ejeint ke rup mein kisanon se rishvat aur adhik lagan vasulate the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki kashtakar (Tenant) aur jamindar ke bich ke bichauliye ko kya kaha jata tha? raiyat kheti karne wala kisaan hota tha. In tathyon ke chalte karinda (Agent) hi sahi hai. Galti raiyat, mukaddam, sahukar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad karinda (Agent) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: karinda (Agent) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which was the famous peasant revolt in the Malabar region?
qh: मालाबार क्षेत्र में होने वाला प्रसिद्ध किसान विद्रोह कौन सा था?
e: keral ke malabar tat par muslim bataidaron (mopala) ne hindu jamindaron ke khilaph vidroh kiya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki malabar kshetr mein hone vala prasiddh kisan vidroh kaun sa tha? Isliye antim jawab mopala vidroh (Moplah Revolt) ke roop mein milta hai. kuka andolan, pavana vidroh, birasa munda vidroh is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab mopala vidroh (Moplah Revolt) hai. Exam point: mopala vidroh (Moplah Revolt) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How was the 'Kuka Movement' of Punjab suppressed?
qh: पंजाब का 'कूका आंदोलन' (Kuka Movement) किस प्रकार दबाया गया?
e: kuka vidrohiyon ke daman ke lie 45 se adhik saradaron ko top ke munh par bandhakar u a diya gaya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki panjab ka 'kuka andolan' (Kuka Movement) kis prakar dabaya gaya? Isi aadhar par barbaratapurvak top se u akar (By cannons) chuna jaata hai. kanun banakar, batachit dvara, shantipurn samajhaute se alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab barbaratapurvak top se u akar (By cannons) hai. Exam point: barbaratapurvak top se u akar (By cannons) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which intellectual demanded protection of peasant interests through the 'Indian Association'?
qh: किस बुद्धिजीवी ने 'इंडियन एसोसिएशन' के माध्यम से किसानों के हितों की रक्षा की मांग की?
e: sureindranath banarji aur dvarakanath ganguli ne indiyan esosieshan ke jarie kashtakari kanun ka samarthan kiya. Is prashn ka kendra sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) hai. Isi tathya par sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) tika hua hai. Vikalp bal gangadhar tilak, mahatma gandhi, lala lajapat ray bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: sureindranath banarji (Surendranath Banerjee) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the name of the commission formed to investigate the Deccan Riots of 1875?
qh: 1875 के दक्कन दंगों की जांच के लिए गठित आयोग का क्या नाम था?
e: dakkan danga ayog ne 1878 mein apani riport british sansad mein pesh ki thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1875 ke dakkan dangon ki janch ke lie gathit ayog ka kya nam tha? Isi aadhar par dakkan danga ayog (Deccan Riots Commission) chuna jaata hai. hantar ayog, saiman kamishan, nil ayog is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar dakkan danga ayog (Deccan Riots Commission) hi hai. Exam point: dakkan danga ayog (Deccan Riots Commission) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Whom did the Deccan Riots Commission hold primarily responsible for the revolt?
qh: दक्कन दंगा आयोग ने विद्रोह का मुख्य दोषी किसे माना?
e: ayog ne sarakar ki bhu-rajasv niti ko bachane ke lie sara dosh sahukaron ke lalach par m diya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki dakkan danga ayog ne vidroh ka mukhy doshi kise mana? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sahukaron ko (Moneylenders) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - british sarakar ko, jamindaron ko, kisanon ko - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sahukaron ko (Moneylenders) hi milti hai. Exam point: sahukaron ko (Moneylenders) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which leaders exemplify Hindu-Muslim unity during the Pabna Revolt?
qh: पावना विद्रोह के दौरान हिंदू-मुस्लिम एकता का उदाहरण किन नेताओं से मिलता है?
o: शंभू पाल और खुदी मल्ला (Shambhu Pal and Khudi Mulla)
e: shanbhu pal (hindu) aur khudi malla (muslim) ne milakar pavana ke kisanon ka netritv kiya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki pavana vidroh ke dauran hindu-muslim ekata ka udaharan kin netaon se milata hai? Isi aadhar par shanbhu pal aur khudi malla (Shambhu Pal and Khudi Mulla) chuna jaata hai. anbedakar aur neharu, ranade aur tilak, siddhu aur kanu alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar shanbhu pal aur khudi malla (Shambhu Pal and Khudi Mulla) baithta hai. Exam point: shanbhu pal aur khudi malla (Shambhu Pal and Khudi Mulla) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: To what percentage were the revenue rates increased in the Ryotwari system?
qh: रैयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था (Ryotwari System) में लगान की दरें कितनी प्रतिशत तक बढ़ा दी गई थीं?
e: 1867 mein british sarakar ne raiyatavadai ilakon mein lagan ki dar ko lagabhag 50% tak b a diya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki raiyatavadai vyavastha (Ryotwari System) mein lagan ki darein kitani pratishat tak b a di gai thin? ryotwari bandobast mein lagaan seedhe kisaan se wasool kiya jaata tha. Isliye antim jawab 50% tak ke roop mein milta hai. 80%, 10%, 25% is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 50% tak hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 50% tak - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The revolt against a moneylender named Kaluram in 1874 occurred in which taluka of Maharashtra?
qh: 1874 में कालूराम नामक सूदखोर के खिलाफ विद्रोह महाराष्ट्र के किस तालुका में हुआ था?
e: sirur taluka ke karaha ganv mein kaluram dvara kisan ke ghar ki kurki ke adesh ke bad vidroh bh ka. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 1874 mein kaluram namak sudakhor ke khilaph vidroh maharashtr ke kis taluka mein hua tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sirur taluka hi sahi baithta hai. satara, pune, ahamadabad mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sirur taluka hi milti hai. Exam point: sirur taluka - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a major limitation of 19th-century peasant movements?
qh: 19वीं शताब्दी के किसान आंदोलनों की एक प्रमुख कमी (Limitation) क्या थी?
o: उन्हें औपनिवेशिक शासन के असली चरित्र की समझ नहीं थी
e: kisanon ko yah samajh nahin thi ki jamindaron aur sahukaron ke pichhe asali takat british shasan hai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 19vin shatabdi ke kisan andolanon ki ek pramukh kami (Limitation) kya thi? Isi tathya par unhein aupaniveshik shasan ke asali charitr ki... tika hua hai. ve l na nahin janate the, ve anap the, unake pas bhojan nahin tha ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar unhein aupaniveshik shasan ke asali charitr ki samajh nahin thi hai. Exam point: unhein aupaniveshik shasan ke asali charitr ki... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What kind of revolt was led by 'Vasudev Balwant Phadke' in Maharashtra?
qh: महाराष्ट्र में 'वासुदेव बलवंत फड़के' का विद्रोह किस प्रकार का था?
e: ph ke ne ramoshi janajati ke sath milakar angrejon ke khilaph sashastr sangharsh ka prayas kiya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki maharashtr mein 'vasudev balavant ph ke' ka vidroh kis prakar ka tha? Isliye sahi nateeja sashastr krantikari vidroh (Armed Revolutionary) nikalta hai. puri tarah kanuni, shantipurn dharana, dharmik sudhar mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sashastr krantikari vidroh (Armed Revolutionary) hi milti hai. Exam point: sashastr krantikari vidroh (Armed Revolutionary) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Depression in which crop's prices worsened the farmers' condition in the Deccan?
qh: दक्कन के विद्रोह में किस फसल की मंदी (Depression) ने किसानों की हालत बिगाड़ दी?
e: ameriki grihayuddh samapt hone ke bad kapas ke niryat mein bhari giravat ai, jisase kisan karj mein dub gae. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki dakkan ke vidroh mein kis phasal ki mandi (Depression) ne kisanon ki halat biga di? Isi karan se kapas (Cotton) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp nil, chay, makka bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar kapas (Cotton) hi hai. Exam point: kapas (Cotton) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Governor showed sympathy towards farmers during the Pabna Revolt?
qh: पावना विद्रोह के समय बंगाल के किस गवर्नर ने किसानों के प्रति सहानुभूति दिखाई थी?
e: lephtineint gavarnar kaimpabel ne pavana ke kisanon ki kanuni mangon ka samarthan kiya tha. Is sawaal mein kaimpabel (Campbell) ki baat hai. Isi karan se kaimpabel (Campbell) sahi uttar hai. lord dalahauji, robart klaiv, lord kaining in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab kaimpabel (Campbell) hai. Exam point: kaimpabel (Campbell) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which class played a major role in giving legal advice to farmers?
qh: किसानों को कानूनी सलाह और सहायता देने में किस वर्ग ने बड़ी भूमिका निभाई?
e: bankim chandr chatarji, ar.si. datt aur any buddhijiviyon ne lekhon aur sabhaon ke jarie kisanon ki madad ki. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kisanon ko kanuni salah aur sahayata dene mein kis varg ne b i bhumika nibhai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par shikshit buddhijivi varg (Educated Intelligentsia) sahi nikalta hai. navabon ne, videshi vyapariyon ne, sainikon ne ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar shikshit buddhijivi varg (Educated Intelligentsia) hai. Exam point: shikshit buddhijivi varg (Educated Intelligentsia) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was a major reason for the success of the Pabna Revolt?
qh: पावना विद्रोह के सफल होने का एक मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: किसानों की गजब की एकजुटता और संगठन
e: kisanon ne sangathit hokar lagan band kiya aur lanbe samay tak kanuni l ai l i. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki pavana vidroh ke saphal hone ka ek mukhy karan kya tha? Isi karan se kisanon ki gajab ki ekajutata aur sangathan sahi uttar hai. hathiyaron ka prayog, angrejon ka sath dena, bhari hinsa anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab kisanon ki gajab ki ekajutata aur sangathan hai. Exam point: kisanon ki gajab ki ekajutata aur sangathan - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Peasant movements of the 19th century inspired which class in the 20th century?
qh: 19वीं शताब्दी के किसान आंदोलनों ने 20वीं शताब्दी के किस वर्ग को प्रेरित किया?
e: in andolanon ne agami rashtravadi sangharsh aur b e kisan andolanon ke lie adhar taiyar kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki 19vin shatabdi ke kisan andolanon ne 20vin shatabdi ke kis varg ko prerit kiya? Isi karan se rashtravadi netaon aur buddhijiviyon ko sahi uttar hai. british sena ko, keval rajaon ko, sahukaron ko in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan rashtravadi netaon aur buddhijiviyon ko hi milti hai. Exam point: rashtravadi netaon aur buddhijiviyon ko - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which was the first major peasant revolt in Bengal after the 1857 revolution?
qh: 1857 की क्रांति के बाद बंगाल में होने वाला पहला प्रमुख किसान विद्रोह कौन सा था?
e: 1859-60 mein bangal mein hua nil vidroh 1857 ki kranti ke bad ka pahala bada sangathit kisan andolan tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1857 ki kranti ke bad bangal mein hone vala pahala pramukh kisan vidroh kaun sa tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par nil vidroh (Indigo Revolt) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti santhal vidroh, munda vidroh, pavana vidroh chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar nil vidroh (Indigo Revolt) hi hai. Exam point: nil vidroh (Indigo Revolt) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which district of Bengal did the Indigo Revolt begin?
qh: नील विद्रोह की शुरुआत बंगाल के किस जिले से हुई थी?
e: is vidroh ki shuruat 1859 mein bangal ke nadiya jile ke govindapur ganv se hui thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki nil vidroh ki shuruat bangal ke kis jile se hui thi? Isi karan se nadiya (Nadia) sahi uttar hai. patana, chanparan, murshidabad in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan nadiya (Nadia) hi milti hai. Exam point: nadiya (Nadia) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who primarily led the Indigo Revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह का नेतृत्व मुख्य रूप से किन दो व्यक्तियों ने किया था?
o: दिंबर विश्वास और विष्णु विश्वास (Digambar and Vishnu Biswas)
e: dinbar vishvas aur vishnu vishvas, jo nil bagan ke purv karmachari the, ne is andolan ka saphal netritv kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki nil vidroh ka netritv mukhy rup se kin do vyaktiyon ne kiya tha? Isliye antim jawab dinbar vishvas aur vishnu vishvas (Digambar and... ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - birasa munda, siddhu aur kanu, mahatma gandhi - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan dinbar vishvas aur vishnu vishvas (Digambar and Vishnu Biswas) hi milti hai. Exam point: dinbar vishvas aur vishnu vishvas (Digambar and Vishnu Biswas) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the main reason for the increased demand for Indian Indigo in Europe?
qh: यूरोप में भारतीय नील की मांग बढ़ने का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: भारतीय नील का रंग फीका था
यूरोप में नील नहीं उगता था
औद्योगिक क्रांति और कपड़ा उद्योग का विस्तार (Industrial Revolution)
e: audyogik kranti ke karan yurop mein kapada utpadan b a, jisase kapadaon ko rangane ke lie bharatiy nil ki mang b gai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki yurop mein bharatiy nil ki mang b ne ka mukhy karan kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja audyogik kranti aur kapada udyog ka vistar (Industrial Revolution) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - bharatiy nil ka rang phika tha, bharatiy nil sasta tha, yurop mein nil nahin ugata tha - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad audyogik kranti aur kapada udyog ka vistar (Industrial Revolution) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: audyogik kranti aur kapada udyog ka vistar (Industrial Revolution) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which European crop competed with Indian Indigo?
qh: भारतीय नील का मुकाबला यूरोप में उगने वाली किस फसल से था?
e: yurop mein kapadaon ko rangane ke lie 'vod' ka istemal hota tha, lekin bharatiy nil ki tulana mein isaka rang halka aur phika tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharatiy nil ka mukabala yurop mein ugane vali kis phasal se tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par vod (Woad) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. makka, ganna, kapas alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan vod (Woad) hi milti hai. Exam point: vod (Woad) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the advance payment given to farmers by indigo planters called?
qh: नील बागान मालिक किसानों को खेती के लिए जो अग्रिम राशि (Advance) देते थे, उसे क्या कहा जाता था?
e: kisanon ko nil ki kheti ke lie majabur karane ke lie bagan malik 'dadani' ya agrim rakam dete the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki nil bagan malik kisanon ko kheti ke lie jo agrim rashi (Advance) dete the, use kya kaha jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par dadani hi sahi baithta hai. jajiya, raiyat, amala ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar dadani hi hai. Exam point: dadani - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which famous play depicted the oppression of indigo farmers?
qh: किस प्रसिद्ध नाटक में नील की खेती करने वाले किसानों के उत्पीड़न का चित्रण किया गया है?
e: dinabandhu mitr dvara likhit 'nil darpan' mein kisanon par hone vale atyacharon ka marmik varnan hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki kis prasiddh natak mein nil ki kheti karane vale kisanon ke utpidan ka chitran kiya gaya hai? Isi tathya par nil darpan tika hua hai. Vikalp godan, shakuntala, anandamath bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar nil darpan hi hai. Exam point: nil darpan - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the author of the play Nil Darpan?
qh: नील दर्पण नाटक के लेखक कौन थे?
e: dinabandhu mitr ne 1860 mein is natak ki rachana ki thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki nil darpan natak ke lekhak kaun the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par dinabandhu mitr (Dinabandhu Mitra) hi sahi baithta hai. bankim chandr chatarji, ravindranath taigor, harishchandr mukharji mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar dinabandhu mitr (Dinabandhu Mitra) hi hai. Exam point: dinabandhu mitr (Dinabandhu Mitra) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which newspaper and its editor strongly supported the Indigo Revolt?
qh: किस समाचार पत्र और उसके संपादक ने नील विद्रोह का पुरजोर समर्थन किया था?
e: 'hindu paitriyat' ke sanpadak harishchandr mukharji ne apane lekhon ke madhyam se kisanon ki avaj uthai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kis samachar patr aur usake sanpadak ne nil vidroh ka purajor samarthan kiya tha? In tathyon ke chalte hindu paitriyat - harishchandr mukharji (Hindu Patriot) hi sahi hai. sanvad kaumudi - raja ramamohan ray, kesari - tilak, yang indiya - gandhi ji is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar hindu paitriyat - harishchandr mukharji (Hindu Patriot) baithta hai. Exam point: hindu paitriyat - harishchandr mukharji (Hindu Patriot) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the Indigo Commission formed?
qh: नील आयोग (Indigo Commission) का गठन किस वर्ष किया गया था?
e: vidroh ki vyapakata ko dekhate hue british sarakar ne 1860 mein dablyu. es. sitan kar ki adhyakshata mein nil ayog banaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki nil ayog (Indigo Commission) ka gathan kis varsh kiya gaya tha? Isi baat se 1860 sahi sabit hota hai. 1859, 1857, 1917 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1860 hai. Exam point: 1860 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Whom did the Indigo Commission find guilty in its report?
qh: नील आयोग ने अपनी रिपोर्ट में किसे दोषी ठहराया था?
e: ayog ne mana ki bagan malikon ne kisanon ke sath jabaradasti aur shoshan kiya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki nil ayog ne apani riport mein kise doshi thaharaya tha? Isi karan se bagan malikon ko (Indigo Planters) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - kisanon ko, isai mishanariyon ko, mugal badashah ko - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar bagan malikon ko (Indigo Planters) hi hai. Exam point: bagan malikon ko (Indigo Planters) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which crop did Bengal farmers prefer to grow instead of indigo?
qh: बंगाल के किसानों ने नील की खेती के बजाय किस फसल को उगाना पसंद किया?
e: nil ki kheti se jamin ki upajau shakti kam ho jati thi, isalie kisan dhan ugana chahate the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki bangal ke kisanon ne nil ki kheti ke bajay kis phasal ko ugana pasand kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par dhan/chaval (Paddy/Rice) sahi nikalta hai. kapas, kophi, chay in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav dhan/chaval (Paddy/Rice) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: dhan/chaval (Paddy/Rice) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a major reason for the success of the Indigo Revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह की सफलता का एक प्रमुख कारण क्या था?
o: हिंदू-मुस्लिम और शिक्षित-अशिक्षित की एकता (Unity of all classes)
e: is andolan mein kisanon, buddhijiviyon, mishanariyon aur hindu-muslimon ne ekajut hokar kam kiya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki nil vidroh ki saphalata ka ek pramukh karan kya tha? In tathyon ke chalte hindu-muslim aur shikshit-ashikshit ki ekata (Unity of all classes) hi sahi hai. hathiyaron ki adhikata, sainik sahayata, angrejon ki kamajori is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav hindu-muslim aur shikshit-ashikshit ki ekata (Unity of all classes) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: hindu-muslim aur shikshit-ashikshit ki ekata (Unity of all classes) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: How did peasants counter the 'Lathiyals' (musclemen) of the planters?
qh: नील विद्रोह के दौरान बागान मालिकों द्वारा पाले गए लठैतों (Lathiyals) का मुकाबला किसानों ने कैसे किया?
o: संगठित होकर और लाठी-भाले से लड़कर (Organized physical resistance)
e: kisanon ne lathaiton ke hamalon ka sangathit hokar mukabala kiya aur unhein ganvon se bhaga diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki nil vidroh ke dauran bagan malikon dvara pale gae lathaiton (Lathiyals) ka mukabala kisanon ne kaise kiya? Isi baat se sangathit hokar aur lathi-bhale se l kar (Organized physical resistance) sahi sabit hota hai. bhagakar, angrejon se shikayat kar, atmasamarpan kar is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar sangathit hokar aur lathi-bhale se l kar (Organized physical resistance) hi hai. Exam point: sangathit hokar aur lathi-bhale se l kar... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: How could farmers terminate their contract for indigo cultivation?
qh: नील की खेती के लिए अनुबंध (Contract) को समाप्त करने का किसानों के पास क्या तरीका था?
o: अग्रिम राशि वापस लौटाकर (Repaying the advance)
e: kisan apani li gai agrim rashi lautakar karar khatm karana chahate the, lekin malik use svikar nahin karate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki nil ki kheti ke lie anubandh (Contract) ko samapt karane ka kisanon ke pas kya tarika tha? Yahi wajah hai ki agrim rashi vapas lautakar (Repaying the advance) sahi hai. Galti ganv chho kar, kanun badalakar, jamindar ko marakar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar agrim rashi vapas lautakar (Repaying the advance) hi hai. Exam point: agrim rashi vapas lautakar (Repaying the advance) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the role of the Bengali intelligentsia during the Indigo Revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह के समय बंगाल के बुद्धिजीवी वर्ग की क्या भूमिका थी?
o: किसानों का समर्थन और प्रचार किया (Supported and publicized the cause)
e: p e-likhe varg ne samachar patron, lekhon aur natakon ke jarie kisanon ke shoshan ko ujagar kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki nil vidroh ke samay bangal ke buddhijivi varg ki kya bhumika thi? Isliye sahi nateeja kisanon ka samarthan aur prachar kiya (Supported and publicized the cause) nikalta hai. nyutral rahe, vidroh ka virodh kiya, angrejon ka sath diya mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se kisanon ka samarthan aur prachar kiya (Supported and publicized the cause) sahi hai. Exam point: kisanon ka samarthan aur prachar kiya (Supported and publicized the cause) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Whom did the Christian missionaries support during the Indigo Revolt?
qh: ईसाई मिशनरियों ने नील विद्रोह के दौरान किसका समर्थन किया था?
e: mishanariyon ne bagan malikon ke atyacharon ko dekh kisanon ke paksh mein gavahi di aur ayog ke gathan mein madad ki. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki isai mishanariyon ne nil vidroh ke dauran kisaka samarthan kiya tha? Isi aadhar par kisanon ka (Peasants) chuna jaata hai. british sena ka, jamindaron ka, bagan malikon ka anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kisanon ka (Peasants) hai. Exam point: kisanon ka (Peasants) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did indigo planters use to terrorize the farmers?
qh: नील बागान मालिकों ने किसानों को आतंकित करने के लिए किसका सहारा लिया?
o: लठैतों और गुंडों का (Lathiyals and goons)
e: bagan malikon ne jabaran kheti karane ke lie lathaiton ki sena pal rakhi thi jo marapit aur agajani karati thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki nil bagan malikon ne kisanon ko atankit karane ke lie kisaka sahara liya? Isliye sahi nateeja lathaiton aur gundon ka (Lathiyals and goons) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - keval vyaparik chhut ka, keval shiksha ka, keval kanun ka - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad lathaiton aur gundon ka (Lathiyals and goons) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: lathaiton aur gundon ka (Lathiyals and goons) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the period of the Indigo Revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह की अवधि क्या थी?
e: nil vidroh mukhy rup se 1859-60 ke dauran bangal mein sakriy raha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki nil vidroh ki avadhi kya thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1859-60 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - 1865-66, 1917-18, 1857-58 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1859-60 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1859-60 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What notification did the British govt issue after the revolt in 1860?
qh: 1860 में नील विद्रोह के बाद ब्रिटिश सरकार ने क्या अधिसूचना (Notification) जारी की?
o: रैयतों को नील उगाने के लिए मजबूर नहीं किया जा सकता (No forced indigo farming)
बंगाल को स्वतंत्र कर दिया गया
e: sarakar ne ghoshana ki ki rayaton ko unaki ichchha ke viruddh nil ki kheti ke lie majabur nahin kiya ja sakata. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1860 mein nil vidroh ke bad british sarakar ne kya adhisuchana (Notification) jari ki? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par raiyaton ko nil ugane ke lie majabur nahin kiya ja sakata (No forced indigo farming) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. nil ki kheti anivary hai, bangal ko svatantr kar diya gaya, kisanon ko phansi di jaegi anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab raiyaton ko nil ugane ke lie majabur nahin kiya ja sakata (No forced indigo farming) hai. Exam point: raiyaton ko nil ugane ke lie majabur nahin kiya ja sakata (No forced indigo farming) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which class of people inspired farmers to fight a legal battle in the Indigo Revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह में किस वर्ग के लोगों ने किसानों को कानूनी लड़ाई लड़ने के लिए प्रेरित किया?
o: शिक्षित बुद्धिजीवी और पूर्व कर्मचारियों ने (Intellectuals and former employees)
e: diganbar vishvas jaise shikshit logon ne kisanon ko sangathit hokar kanuni rasta apanane ke lie prerit kiya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki nil vidroh mein kis varg ke logon ne kisanon ko kanuni l ai l ne ke lie prerit kiya? Isi karan se shikshit buddhijivi aur purv karmachariyon ne (Intellectuals and former employees) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp navabon ne, videshi vyapariyon ne, sainikon ne bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab shikshit buddhijivi aur purv karmachariyon ne (Intellectuals... hai. Exam point: shikshit buddhijivi aur purv karmachariyon ne (Intellectuals and former employees) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Contracts for indigo cultivation were often for how many years?
qh: नील की खेती के लिए किसानों के साथ होने वाला 'करार' (Bond) अक्सर कितने वर्षों के लिए होता था?
e: bagan malik aksar kisanon se 3 sal ya usase adhik ke lie jabaran karar karava lete the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki nil ki kheti ke lie kisanon ke sath hone vala 'karar' (Bond) aksar kitane varshon ke lie hota tha? Isliye antim jawab 3 varsh (3 Years) ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - 10 varsh, jivanabhar, 1 varsh - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 3 varsh (3 Years) hai. Exam point: 3 varsh (3 Years) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What else did farmers refuse to give to the planters during the revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह के दौरान किसानों ने बागान मालिकों को और क्या देने से मना कर दिया था?
e: kisanon ne keval nil ugana hi band nahin kiya, balki bagan malikon ko lagan dena bhi band kar diya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki nil vidroh ke dauran kisanon ne bagan malikon ko aur kya dene se mana kar diya tha? In tathyon ke chalte lagan/kiraya (Revenue/Rent) hi sahi hai. Vikalp bhojan, vot, abhivadan bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se lagan/kiraya (Revenue/Rent) sahi hai. Exam point: lagan/kiraya (Revenue/Rent) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: How did the news of the Indigo Revolt spread across Bengal?
qh: नील विद्रोह की खबर पूरे बंगाल में किस तरह फैली?
o: अखबारों के लेखों और 'जंगल की आग' की तरह (Newspapers and word of mouth)
e: nadiya se shuru hui chingari akhabaron ke lekhon aur sandeshon ke madhyam se bahut teji se phaili. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki nil vidroh ki khabar pure bangal mein kis tarah phaili? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par akhabaron ke lekhon aur 'jangal ki ag'... sahi nikalta hai. intaranet se, rediyo se, keval sarakari adeshon se is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar akhabaron ke lekhon aur 'jangal ki ag' ki tarah (Newspapers and word of mouth) baithta hai. Exam point: akhabaron ke lekhon aur 'jangal ki ag' ki tarah (Newspapers and word of mouth) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the large tank or vessel used for making dye from indigo plants called?
qh: नील के पौधों से रंग बनाने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले बड़े हौज या पात्र को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: nil ke paudhon ko pani mein bhigokar aur ubalakar 'haud' mein ranga jata tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki nil ke paudhon se rang banane ke lie upayog kie jane vale b e hauj ya patr ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi baat se haud (Vat) sahi sabit hota hai. kuan, tijori, mataka alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan haud (Vat) hi milti hai. Exam point: haud (Vat) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: How much reward did the British government announce for capturing indigo rebel leaders?
qh: नील विद्रोह के नेताओं को पकड़ने के लिए ब्रिटिश सरकार ने कितने रुपये के इनाम की घोषणा की थी?
e: santhal vidroh ki tarah hi vidroh ko dabane ke lie netaon par 10,000 rupaye ka inam rakha gaya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki nil vidroh ke netaon ko pak ne ke lie british sarakar ne kitane rupaye ke inam ki ghoshana ki thi? Isliye antim jawab 10,000 rupaye (10,000 Rupees) ke roop mein milta hai. 100 rupaye, 1 lakh rupaye, 1,000 rupaye anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 10,000 rupaye (10,000 Rupees) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 10,000 rupaye (10,000 Rupees) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who was the chairman of the Indigo Commission (1860)?
qh: नील आयोग (1860) के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: dablyu. es. sitan kar ne nil ayog ki adhyakshata ki thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki nil ayog (1860) ke adhyaksh kaun the? Isi tathya par dablyu. es. sitan kar (W.S. Seton-Karr) tika hua hai. lord kaining, ti.ar. homs, robart klaiv anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav dablyu. es. sitan kar (W.S. Seton-Karr) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: dablyu. es. sitan kar (W.S. Seton-Karr) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What is seen as the main success of the Indigo Revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह की मुख्य सफलता किस रूप में देखी जाती है?
o: जबरन नील की खेती का अंत (End of forced indigo farming)
e: is vidroh ne sabit kiya ki kisan sangathit hokar shaktishali aupaniveshik hiton ko hara sakate hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki nil vidroh ki mukhy saphalata kis rup mein dekhi jati hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par jabaran nil ki kheti ka ant (End of forced indigo farming) hi sahi baithta hai. kisanon ko hathiyar milana, navabon ki satta vapasi, angrejon ka bharat chhodana anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar jabaran nil ki kheti ka ant (End of forced indigo farming) hi hai. Exam point: jabaran nil ki kheti ka ant (End of forced indigo farming) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: The first organized revolt against British rule in 1757 began under whose leadership?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन के खिलाफ पहला संगठित विद्रोह 1757 में किसके नेतृत्व में शुरू हुआ था?
e: 1757 mein bangal ke navab sirajuddaula ne angrejon ki kilebandi aur vyaparik durupayog ke khilaph hathiyar uthae the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki british shasan ke khilaph pahala sangathit vidroh 1757 mein kisake netritv mein shuru hua tha? In tathyon ke chalte sirajuddaula (Siraj-ud-Daulah) hi sahi hai. mir japhar, tipu sultan, bahadur shah japhar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab sirajuddaula (Siraj-ud-Daulah) hai. Exam point: sirajuddaula (Siraj-ud-Daulah) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Into which three categories can the pre-1857 popular resistance be primarily divided?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के पूर्व होने वाले जन-प्रतिरोध को मुख्य रूप से किन तीन श्रेणियों में बाँटा जा सकता है?
o: नागरिक, आदिवासी और किसान विद्रोह (Civil, Tribal, and Peasant)
e: vipaksh ko nagarik vidroh, adivasi vidroh aur kisan vidroh ke rup mein vargikrit kiya gaya hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ke purv hone vale jan-pratirodh ko mukhy rup se kin tin shreniyon mein banta ja sakata hai? Isliye sahi nateeja nagarik, adivasi aur kisan vidroh (Civil, Tribal, and Peasant) nikalta hai. Vikalp sainik, shahari aur gramin, keval hindu aur muslim vidroh, dharmik, rajanitik aur arthik bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se nagarik, adivasi aur kisan vidroh (Civil, Tribal, and Peasant) sahi hai. Exam point: nagarik, adivasi aur kisan vidroh (Civil, Tribal,... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Civil rebellions were primarily led by whom?
qh: नागरिक विद्रोहों का नेतृत्व मुख्य रूप से किन लोगों ने किया था?
o: राजा, नवाब, सामंत और भूस्वामी (Kings, Nawabs, and Landlords)
e: nagarik vidrohon ka netritv aksar un rajaon aur navabon ne kiya jinaki satta angrejon ne chhin li thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki nagarik vidrohon ka netritv mukhy rup se kin logon ne kiya tha? Isi karan se raja, navab, samant aur bhusvami (Kings, Nawabs,... sahi uttar hai. keval am kisan, british senapati, videshi vyapari in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar raja, navab, samant aur bhusvami (Kings, Nawabs,... hi hai. Exam point: raja, navab, samant aur bhusvami (Kings, Nawabs,... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: By what name were landlords or landowners known in South India?
qh: दक्षिण भारत में जमींदारों या भूस्वामियों को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: dakshin bharat ke shaktishali sthaniy bhusvamiyon ko british kal mein poligar kaha jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki dakshin bharat mein jamindaron ya bhusvamiyon ko kis nam se jana jata tha? Isi aadhar par poligar (Poligars) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp talukedar, payak, jat bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav poligar (Poligars) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: poligar (Poligars) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Within just 30 years of British arrival, by how much did revenue collection increase in Bengal?
qh: अंग्रेजों के आने के मात्र 30 वर्षों के भीतर बंगाल में लगान (Tax) की वसूली कितनी बढ़ गई थी?
e: angrejon ne navabon ki tulana mein 30 sal ke bhitar hi lagan vasuli ko doguna kar diya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki angrejon ke ane ke matr 30 varshon ke bhitar bangal mein lagan (Tax) ki vasuli kitani b gai thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par do guna (Double) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. koi badalav nahin, adhi rah gai, char guna anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab do guna (Double) hai. Exam point: do guna (Double) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main cause of the Sanyasi Rebellion (1763-1800)?
qh: सन्यासी विद्रोह (1763-1800) का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: धार्मिक यात्राओं पर कर (Tax on Pilgrimage)
e: angrejon dvara sanyasiyon ki tirth yatraon par kar lagane ke karan yah vidroh bh ka tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki sanyasi vidroh (1763-1800) ka mukhy karan kya tha? Isi baat se dharmik yatraon par kar (Tax on Pilgrimage) sahi sabit hota hai. jamin ka bantavara, sena mein bharti, sati pratha ka ant ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar dharmik yatraon par kar (Tax on Pilgrimage) baithta hai. Exam point: dharmik yatraon par kar (Tax on Pilgrimage) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee's famous novel 'Anandamath' is based on which revolt?
qh: बंकिम चंद्र चटर्जी का प्रसिद्ध उपन्यास 'आनंदमठ' किस विद्रोह पर आधारित है?
e: anandamath upanyas sanyasi vidroh ki ghatanaon aur 'vande mataram' ke nare se prerit hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bankim chandr chatarji ka prasiddh upanyas 'anandamath' kis vidroh par adharit hai? Yahi wajah hai ki sanyasi vidroh (Sanyasi Rebellion) sahi hai. kol vidroh, munda vidroh, santhal vidroh mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav sanyasi vidroh (Sanyasi Rebellion) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: sanyasi vidroh (Sanyasi Rebellion) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Diwan Velu Thampi's revolt is related to which region of India?
qh: दीवान वेलु थंपी का विद्रोह भारत के किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: velu thanpi ne travanakor (keral) mein angrejon ke khilaph bahaduri se l ai l i thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki divan velu thanpi ka vidroh bharat ke kis kshetr se sanbandhit hai? Isi baat se travanakor (Travancore) sahi sabit hota hai. panjab, asam, bangal is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad travanakor (Travancore) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: travanakor (Travancore) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: By what name did the tribals refer to outsiders (landlords, moneylenders, British)?
qh: आदिवासी लोग बाहरी लोगों (जमींदार, साहूकार, अंग्रेज) को किस नाम से पुकारते थे?
e: adivasi log shoshan karane vale bahari logon ko 'diku' kahate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki adivasi log bahari logon (jamindar, sahukar, angrej) ko kis nam se pukarate the? Isi baat se diku (Dikus) sahi sabit hota hai. sahab, payak, masiha anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan diku (Dikus) hi milti hai. Exam point: diku (Dikus) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did Birsa Munda declare himself as?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा ने स्वयं को क्या घोषित किया था?
e: 1895 mein birasa munda ne khud ko bhagavan ka dut ghoshit kiya aur munda vidroh ka netritv kiya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki birasa munda ne svayan ko kya ghoshit kiya tha? Isi tathya par bhagavan ka dut (Messenger of God) tika hua hai. navab, raja, jamindar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se bhagavan ka dut (Messenger of God) sahi hai. Exam point: bhagavan ka dut (Messenger of God) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: During which time period did the Munda Rebellion (Ulgulan) take place?
qh: मुंडा विद्रोह (उलगुलान) किस समय अवधि के दौरान हुआ था?
e: birasa munda ke netritv mein ulagulan ya mahan halachal 1899-1900 mein hui thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki munda vidroh (ulagulan) kis samay avadhi ke dauran hua tha? Isliye sahi nateeja 1899-1900 nikalta hai. Galti 1855-56, 1763-1800, 1920-22 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1899-1900 hai. Exam point: 1899-1900 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the shifting cultivation practiced by tribals called?
qh: आदिवासियों द्वारा की जाने वाली स्थानांतरित खेती (Shifting Cultivation) को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: adivasi jangalon ko saph karake thodae samay ke lie kheti karate the, jise jhum kheti kaha jata hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki adivasiyon dvara ki jane vali sthanantarit kheti (Shifting Cultivation) ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi karan se jhum kheti (Jhum Cultivation) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp sthai kheti, sidhainuma kheti, mishrit kheti bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jhum kheti (Jhum Cultivation) hi milti hai. Exam point: jhum kheti (Jhum Cultivation) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: During which revolt is the struggle between the 'Plough and Hoe' described?
qh: किस विद्रोह के दौरान 'हल और कुदाल' (Plough and Hoe) के बीच संघर्ष का वर्णन मिलता है?
o: संथाल और पहाड़िया संघर्ष (Santhal and Paharia)
e: santhal 'hal' (sthai kheti) aur pahadaiya 'kudal' (jhum kheti) ka pratik the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kis vidroh ke dauran 'hal aur kudal' (Plough and Hoe) ke bich sangharsh ka varnan milata hai? Yahi wajah hai ki santhal aur pahadaiya sangharsh (Santhal and Paharia) sahi hai. rampa vidroh, bhil vidroh, sanyasi vidroh anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan santhal aur pahadaiya sangharsh (Santhal and Paharia) hi milti hai. Exam point: santhal aur pahadaiya sangharsh (Santhal and Paharia) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why did the revolts before 1857 fail against the East India Company?
qh: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के विरुद्ध 1857 से पूर्व होने वाले विद्रोह असफल क्यों रहे?
o: स्थानीयता और तालमेल का अभाव (Local nature and lack of coordination)
अंग्रेजों के पास हथियार नहीं थे
e: ye vidroh sthaniy the, alag-alag samay par hue aur inamein rashtriy ekata ka abhav tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ist indiya kanpani ke viruddh 1857 se purv hone vale vidroh asaphal kyon rahe? Isliye sahi nateeja sthaniyata aur talamel ka abhav (Local nature and lack of coordination) nikalta hai. Vikalp sainikon ki kami, angrejon ke pas hathiyar nahin the, koi neta nahin tha bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sthaniyata aur talamel ka abhav (Local nature... hi milti hai. Exam point: sthaniyata aur talamel ka abhav (Local nature and lack of coordination) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which region did the Kol Revolt (1831-32) primarily occur?
qh: कोल विद्रोह (1831-32) मुख्य रूप से किस क्षेत्र में हुआ था?
e: kol vidroh mukhy rup se chhota nagapur (jharakhand) ke kshetr mein adivasiyon dvara kiya gaya tha. Is sawaal mein chhota nagapur (Chhota Nagpur) ki baat hai. Isi baat se chhota nagapur (Chhota Nagpur) sahi sabit hota hai. malabar, travanakor, kachchh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab chhota nagapur (Chhota Nagpur) hai. Exam point: chhota nagapur (Chhota Nagpur) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which British official said 'the police is the main cause of public oppression'?
qh: किस ब्रिटिश अधिकारी ने कहा था कि 'पुलिस जनता के उत्पीड़न का मुख्य कारण है'?
e: viliyam edavard ne svikar kiya tha ki pulis ka bhrasht aur damanakari vyavahar vidroh ka ek bada karan tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kis british adhikari ne kaha tha ki 'pulis janata ke utpidan ka mukhy karan hai'? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par viliyam edavard (William Edwards) hi sahi baithta hai. robart klaiv, lord dalahauji, voren hestings is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar viliyam edavard (William Edwards) baithta hai. Exam point: viliyam edavard (William Edwards) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Paharias were primarily dependent on what for their livelihood?
qh: पहाड़िया लोग अपनी आजीविका के लिए मुख्य रूप से किस पर निर्भर थे?
o: जंगल के उत्पाद और झूम खेती (Forest products and Jhum)
e: pahadaiya log mahua, resham ke kidae aur kudal se ki jane vali kheti par nirbhar the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki pahadaiya log apani ajivika ke lie mukhy rup se kis par nirbhar the? Isi karan se jangal ke utpad aur jhum kheti (Forest... sahi uttar hai. videshi niryat, shahari vyapar, mashini udyog is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar jangal ke utpad aur jhum kheti (Forest products and Jhum) hai. Exam point: jangal ke utpad aur jhum kheti (Forest products and Jhum) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many Santhals are estimated to have been killed in the 1855 revolt?
qh: 1855 के संथाल विद्रोह में कितने संथालों के मारे जाने का अनुमान है?
e: santhal vidroh ke krur daman ke dauran lagabhag 15,000 santhalon ke shahid hone ka anuman hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1855 ke santhal vidroh mein kitane santhalon ke mare jane ka anuman hai? Isliye sahi nateeja 15,000 nikalta hai. 500, 1,00,000, 5,000 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 15,000 hi hai. Exam point: 15,000 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What reason did Sidhu give for the revolt during the Santhal rebellion?
qh: संथाल विद्रोह के दौरान सिद्धू ने विद्रोह का क्या कारण बताया था?
o: ठाकुर जी (भगवान) का आदेश (Order of God/Thakur Ji)
e: siddhu ne dava kiya tha ki thakur ji ne unhein videshiyon (sahabon) ke khilaph l ne ka adesh diya hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki santhal vidroh ke dauran siddhu ne vidroh ka kya karan bataya tha? Isi baat se thakur ji (bhagavan) ka adesh (Order of God/Thakur Ji) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti unhein raja banana tha, unhein inglaind jana tha, ve taiks b ana chahate the chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab thakur ji (bhagavan) ka adesh (Order of God/Thakur Ji) hai. Exam point: thakur ji (bhagavan) ka adesh (Order of... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Poligar rebellions primarily occurred in which part of India?
qh: पॉलिगर (Poligar) विद्रोह मुख्य रूप से भारत के किस भाग में हुए थे?
e: poligar vidroh mukhy rup se tamilanadu aur malabar jaise dakshin bharatiy kshetron mein hue. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki poligar (Poligar) vidroh mukhy rup se bharat ke kis bhag mein hue the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par dakshin bharat (South India) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - pashchim bharat, uttar bharat, purvi bharat - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad dakshin bharat (South India) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: dakshin bharat (South India) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Bhil rebellion is related to which state/region of India?
qh: भील विद्रोह भारत के किस राज्य/क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: bhil vidroh mukhy rup se maharashtr ke khanadesh aur rajasthan ke ilakon mein hua tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bhil vidroh bharat ke kis rajy/kshetr se sanbandhit hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par khanadesh aur rajasthan (Khandesh and Rajasthan) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. keval keral, keval bihar, asam alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar khanadesh aur rajasthan (Khandesh and Rajasthan) hi hai. Exam point: khanadesh aur rajasthan (Khandesh and Rajasthan) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which region did the Rampa rebellion occur?
qh: रम्पा (Rampa) विद्रोह किस क्षेत्र में हुआ था?
e: rampa vidroh andhr pradesh ke tatiy pahadai ilakon mein adivasiyon dvara kiya gaya tha. Yah prashn andhr tatiy pahadaiyan (Andhra Coastal Hills) se juda hai. Isliye antim jawab andhr tatiy pahadaiyan (Andhra Coastal Hills) ke roop mein milta hai. saurashtr, bareli, jabalapur is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar andhr tatiy pahadaiyan (Andhra Coastal Hills) baithta hai. Exam point: andhr tatiy pahadaiyan (Andhra Coastal Hills) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the British attempt by calling tribals 'uncivilized'?
qh: अंग्रेजों ने आदिवासियों को 'असभ्य' कहकर क्या करने का प्रयास किया?
o: जबरन सुधार और ईसाई धर्म का प्रचार (Forced reform and Missionary work)
उन्हें देश का राजा बनाने का
e: angrejon ne sudhar ke nam par adivasiyon ki paranparaon mein hastakshep kiya aur isai mishanariyon ko b ava diya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki angrejon ne adivasiyon ko 'asabhy' kahakar kya karane ka prayas kiya? Isi karan se jabaran sudhar aur isai dharm ka prachar... sahi uttar hai. Vikalp unase vyapar karane ka, unhein desh ka raja banane ka, unhein jangal lautane ka bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab jabaran sudhar aur isai dharm ka prachar (Forced reform and Missionary work) hai. Exam point: jabaran sudhar aur isai dharm ka prachar (Forced reform and Missionary work) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why was British rule considered to have a 'foreign character'?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन को 'विदेशी चरित्र' का क्यों माना जाता था?
o: वे भारतीयों के अपमान और आर्थिक दोहन पर आधारित थे (Exclusion and exploitation)
वे भारत में ही पैदा हुए थे
e: pichhali sattaon ke viparit, angrejon ka uddeshy keval bharat ka arthik shoshan karana tha aur ve bharatiyon ko prashasan se dur rakhate the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki british shasan ko 'videshi charitr' ka kyon mana jata tha? Isliye antim jawab ve bharatiyon ke apaman aur arthik dohan... ke roop mein milta hai. ve bharat mein hi paida hue the, kyonki ve hindi bolate the, ve mugalon ke rishtedar the mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar ve bharatiyon ke apaman aur arthik dohan... hi hai. Exam point: ve bharatiyon ke apaman aur arthik dohan par adharit the (Exclusion and exploitation) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year was the prominent Santhal leader 'Sidhu' captured?
qh: संथाल विद्रोह के प्रमुख नेता 'सिद्धू' को किस वर्ष पकड़ा गया था?
e: siddhu ko 1855 mein angrejon dvara pakad liya gaya tha, jabaki vidroh 1856 tak chala. Prashn yah batata hai ki santhal vidroh ke pramukh neta 'siddhu' ko kis varsh pakada gaya tha? Isi karan se 1855 sahi uttar hai. 1858, 1857, 1856 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1855 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1855 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: On the basis of which plan was the Indian Constituent Assembly formed?
qh: भारतीय संविधान सभा का गठन किस योजना के आधार पर किया गया था?
e: 1946 ke kaibinet mishan ke prastavon ke adhar par hi bharatiy sanvidhan sabha ka gathan hua tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bharatiy sanvidhan sabha ka gathan kis yojana ke adhar par kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kaibinet mishan (Cabinet Mission) sahi nikalta hai. krips mishan, mauntabetan yojana, agast prastav in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab kaibinet mishan (Cabinet Mission) hai. Exam point: kaibinet mishan (Cabinet Mission) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: When was the first meeting of the Constituent Assembly held?
qh: संविधान सभा की पहली बैठक कब हुई थी?
e: sanvidhan sabha ki pahali baithak 9 disanbar 1946 ko hui thi, jisaka muslim lig ne bahishkar kiya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki sanvidhan sabha ki pahali baithak kab hui thi? constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi tathya par 9 disanbar 1946 (9th Dec 1946) tika hua hai. 11 disanbar 1946, 13 disanbar 1946, 26 janavari 1950 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 9 disanbar 1946 (9th Dec 1946) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 9 disanbar 1946 (9th Dec 1946) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who was elected as the temporary Chairman of the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा के अस्थायी अध्यक्ष (Temporary Chairman) के रूप में किसे चुना गया था?
e: 9 disanbar 1946 ko do. sachchidanand sinha ko sabha ka asthayi adhyaksh chuna gaya tha. Yah prashn constituent se juda hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par do. sachchidanand sinha (S.N. Sinha) hi sahi baithta hai. javaharalal neharu, bi.en. rav, do. rajeindr prasad alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar do. sachchidanand sinha (S.N. Sinha) hai. Exam point: do. sachchidanand sinha (S.N. Sinha) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who was the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा के स्थायी अध्यक्ष (Permanent President) कौन थे?
e: 11 disanbar 1946 ko do. rajeindr prasad ko sanvidhan sabha ka sthayi adhyaksh chuna gaya tha. Yahaan constituent se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi karan se do. rajeindr prasad (Rajendra Prasad) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp saradar patel, do. bi.ar. anbedakar, mahatma gandhi bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad do. rajeindr prasad (Rajendra Prasad) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: do. rajeindr prasad (Rajendra Prasad) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constitution?
qh: संविधान की 'प्रारूप समिति' (Drafting Committee) के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: do. bi.ar. anbedakar prarup samiti ke adhyaksh the, jinhonne sanvidhan ka masauda taiyar kiya. Is sawaal mein samiti ki baat hai. samiti gram ke aam logon ki sabha thi. Isi tathya par do. bi.ar. anbedakar (B.R. Ambedkar) tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - saradar patel, javaharalal neharu, do. rajeindr prasad - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab do. bi.ar. anbedakar (B.R. Ambedkar) hai. Exam point: do. bi.ar. anbedakar (B.R. Ambedkar) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who was the 'Constitutional Advisor' to the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा के 'संवैधानिक सलाहकार' (Constitutional Advisor) कौन थे?
e: bi.en. rav ne vibhinn deshon ke sanvidhanon ka adhyayan kar sabha ko salah di thi. Is prashn ka kendra constituent hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bi.en. rav (B.N. Rau) hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp ke.em. munshi, javaharalal neharu, es.en. mukharji bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bi.en. rav (B.N. Rau) hi milti hai. Exam point: bi.en. rav (B.N. Rau) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the Chairman of the Cabinet Mission (1946)?
qh: कैबिनेट मिशन (1946) के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: kaibinet mishan mein tin sadasy the, jisake adhyaksh paithik loreins the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kaibinet mishan (1946) ke adhyaksh kaun the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par paithik loreins (Pethick-Lawrence) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - stephord krips, e.vi. alekjeindar, lord mauntabetan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav paithik loreins (Pethick-Lawrence) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: paithik loreins (Pethick-Lawrence) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How many members remained in the Indian Constituent Assembly after partition?
qh: विभाजन के बाद भारतीय संविधान सभा में कितने सदस्य रह गए थे?
e: vibhajan ke bad muslim lig ke sadasyon ke hatane se sankhya 389 se ghatakar 299 rah gai thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki vibhajan ke bad bharatiy sanvidhan sabha mein kitane sadasy rah gae the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 299 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 300, 389, 211 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 299 hi milti hai. Exam point: 299 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who called Separate Electorates a 'Poison' in the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में 'पृथक निर्वाचिका' (Separate Electorate) को 'विष' या 'जहर' किसने कहा था?
e: saradar patel ne prithak nirvachika ka kada virodh karate hue ise desh ke lie jahar bataya tha. Yah prashn constituent se juda hai. constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi karan se saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Patel) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - bi. pokar bahadur, govind vallabh pant, anbedakar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Patel) hai. Exam point: saradar vallabh bhai patel (Sardar Patel) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who said that the 'Real Minorities' are the poor and downtrodden, not religious groups?
qh: किसने कहा था कि 'असली अल्पसंख्यक' (Real Minorities) धार्मिक नहीं, बल्कि गरीब और दबे-कुचले लोग हैं?
e: en.ji. ranga ne tark diya tha ki asali alpasankhyak is desh ke garib kisan aur majadur hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kisane kaha tha ki 'asali alpasankhyak' (Real Minorities) dharmik nahin, balki garib aur dabe-kuchale log hain? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par en.ji. ranga (N.G. Ranga) sahi nikalta hai. mahatma gandhi, bi.ar. anbedakar, jayapal sinh is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan en.ji. ranga (N.G. Ranga) hi milti hai. Exam point: en.ji. ranga (N.G. Ranga) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who prominently raised the voice for Tribal interests in the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में आदिवासियों (Tribals) के हितों के लिए किसने प्रमुखता से आवाज उठाई थी?
e: jayapal sinh ek adivasi neta the jinhonne adivasiyon ke lie arakshan aur suraksha ki mang ki. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki sanvidhan sabha mein adivasiyon (Tribals) ke hiton ke lie kisane pramukhata se avaj uthai thi? constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi karan se jayapal sinh (Jaipal Singh) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp saradar patel, je. nagappa, bi.ar. anbedakar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar jayapal sinh (Jaipal Singh) hi hai. Exam point: jayapal sinh (Jaipal Singh) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Power distribution between Centre and States was done through how many lists?
qh: केंद्र और राज्यों के बीच शक्तियों का बंटवारा कितनी सूचियों (Lists) के माध्यम से किया गया?
e: sanvidhan mein tin suchiyan - sangh suchi, rajy suchi aur samavarti suchi banai gai hain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki keindr aur rajyon ke bich shaktiyon ka bantavara kitani suchiyon (Lists) ke madhyam se kiya gaya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par tin (Three Lists) sahi nikalta hai. do, panch, char alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan tin (Three Lists) hi milti hai. Exam point: tin (Three Lists) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under which article was Untouchability abolished in the Indian Constitution?
qh: भारतीय संविधान में 'अस्पृश्यता का अंत' (Abolition of Untouchability) किस अनुच्छेद के तहत किया गया?
e: sanvidhan ke anuchchhed 17 ke tahat chhuachhut ko ek dandaniy aparadh ghoshit kiya gaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bharatiy sanvidhan mein 'asprishyata ka ant' (Abolition of Untouchability) kis anuchchhed ke tahat kiya gaya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par anuchchhed 17 (Article 17) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti anuchchhed 15, anuchchhed 370, anuchchhed 14 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan anuchchhed 17 (Article 17) hi milti hai. Exam point: anuchchhed 17 (Article 17) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who supported 'Hindustani' as the national language in the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में 'हिंदुस्तानी' भाषा को राष्ट्रभाषा बनाने का समर्थन किसने किया था?
e: gandhi ji ka manana tha ki hindustani (hindi + urdu) bhasha hindu-muslim ekata ka pratik hai. Yah prashn constituent se juda hai. constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi tathya par mahatma gandhi tika hua hai. shrimati durgabai, neharu, ar.vi. dhulekar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav mahatma gandhi hi thehrta hai. Exam point: mahatma gandhi - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who took the most aggressive stand in favor of Hindi in the assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में हिंदी के पक्ष में सबसे आक्रामक रुख किसने अपनाया था?
e: ar.vi. dhulekar ne kaha tha ki jo log hindi nahin janate unhein sabha mein rahane ka adhikar nahin. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki sanvidhan sabha mein hindi ke paksh mein sabase akramak rukh kisane apanaya tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Yahi wajah hai ki ar.vi. dhulekar (R.V. Dhulekar) sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - govind vallabh pant, saradar patel, javaharalal neharu - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar ar.vi. dhulekar (R.V. Dhulekar) hi hai. Exam point: ar.vi. dhulekar (R.V. Dhulekar) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: On what basis was the Junagadh state annexed at the time of independence?
qh: स्वतंत्रता के समय जूनागढ़ रियासत का विलय किस आधार पर किया गया था?
e: junagadh ka vilay janamat sangrah (janata ki ichchha) ke adhar par bharat mein kiya gaya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki svatantrata ke samay junagadh riyasat ka vilay kis adhar par kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par janamat sangrah (Referendum) hi sahi baithta hai. vilay patr, sainik karyavahi, upahar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se janamat sangrah (Referendum) sahi hai. Exam point: janamat sangrah (Referendum) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which operation did Sardar Patel launch against the Hyderabad state?
qh: हैदराबाद रियासत के खिलाफ सरदार पटेल ने कौन सा ऑपरेशन चलाया था?
e: haidarabad ke nijam ke viruddh sainik karyavahi ko 'opareshan polo' nam diya gaya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki haidarabad riyasat ke khilaph saradar patel ne kaun sa opareshan chalaya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki opareshan polo (Operation Polo) sahi hai. opareshan vijay, opareshan shakti, opareshan blu star anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad opareshan polo (Operation Polo) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: opareshan polo (Operation Polo) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the 'Chief Draughtsman' of the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा के मुख्य 'योजनाकार' (Chief Draughtsman) कौन थे?
e: es.en. mukharji jatil kanuni pravadhanon ko spasht aur saral bhasha mein likhane ke mahir the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki sanvidhan sabha ke mukhy 'yojanakar' (Chief Draughtsman) kaun the? constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi tathya par es.en. mukharji (S.N. Mukherjee) tika hua hai. rajeindr prasad, bi.en. rav, ke.em. munshi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad es.en. mukharji (S.N. Mukherjee) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: es.en. mukharji (S.N. Mukherjee) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When was the Indian Constitution finalized and signed?
qh: भारतीय संविधान कब बनकर तैयार हुआ और उस पर हस्ताक्षर किए गए?
e: 26 navanbar 1949 ko bharatiy sanvidhan ko angikrit (Finalized) kiya gaya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki bharatiy sanvidhan kab banakar taiyar hua aur us par hastakshar kie gae? Yahi wajah hai ki 26 navanbar 1949 (26th Nov 1949) sahi hai. Galti 24 janavari 1950, 26 janavari 1950, 15 agast 1947 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 26 navanbar 1949 (26th Nov 1949) hai. Exam point: 26 navanbar 1949 (26th Nov 1949) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: When did the Indian Constitution fully come into effect?
qh: भारतीय संविधान पूर्ण रूप से कब लागू हुआ?
e: bharatiy sanvidhan 26 janavari 1950 ko pure desh mein lagu hua, jise ham ganatantr divas ke rup mein manate hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharatiy sanvidhan purn rup se kab lagu hua? Isi tathya par 26 janavari 1950 (26th Jan 1950) tika hua hai. 30 janavari 1948, 15 agast 1947, 26 navanbar 1949 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 26 janavari 1950 (26th Jan 1950) hai. Exam point: 26 janavari 1950 (26th Jan 1950) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the total time taken to draft the Indian Constitution?
qh: संविधान सभा के निर्माण में कुल कितना समय लगा?
e: sanvidhan ko taiyar karane mein kul 2 varsh, 11 mah aur 18 din ka samay laga tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki sanvidhan sabha ke nirman mein kul kitana samay laga? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 2 sal 11 mahine 18 din (2yr 11mo 18d) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp 2 sal, 1 sal 10 mahine, 3 sal bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 2 sal 11 mahine 18 din (2yr 11mo 18d) hai. Exam point: 2 sal 11 mahine 18 din (2yr... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: When did the Muslim League observe 'Direct Action Day'?
qh: मुस्लिम लीग ने 'प्रत्यक्ष कार्यवाही दिवस' (Direct Action Day) कब मनाया था?
e: kaibinet mishan ki viphalata ke bad 16 agast 1946 ko muslim lig ne yah divas manaya, jisase dange bhadak gae. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki muslim lig ne 'pratyaksh karyavahi divas' (Direct Action Day) kab manaya tha? Isi tathya par 16 agast 1946 (16th Aug 1946) tika hua hai. 14 agast 1947, 26 janavari 1947, 15 agast 1946 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 16 agast 1946 (16th Aug 1946) hi milti hai. Exam point: 16 agast 1946 (16th Aug 1946) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the strongest advocate for 'States' Rights' in the assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में 'राज्यों के अधिकारों' के लिए सबसे प्रबल आवाज किसने उठाई थी?
e: ke. santhanam ne tark diya tha ki rajyon ko adhik shaktiyan aur sansadhan milane chahie. Yahaan sabha se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi aadhar par ke. santhanam (K. Santhanam) chuna jaata hai. Galti rajeindr prasad, bi.ar. anbedakar, javaharalal neharu chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar ke. santhanam (K. Santhanam) hi hai. Exam point: ke. santhanam (K. Santhanam) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the Cripps Mission visit India?
qh: क्रिप्स मिशन किस वर्ष भारत आया था?
e: sar stephord krips ke netritv mein yah mishan 1942 mein bharatiyon ka sahayog mangane aya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki krips mishan kis varsh bharat aya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1942 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1946, 1940, 1935 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 1942 hi hai. Exam point: 1942 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How were the elections for the Constituent Assembly (1946) conducted?
qh: संविधान सभा के चुनाव (1946) किस प्रकार हुए थे?
o: अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रांतीय सभाओं द्वारा (Indirectly)
e: sanvidhan sabha ke sadasy prantiy vidhanasabhaon ke sadasyon dvara apratyaksh rup se chune gae the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki sanvidhan sabha ke chunav (1946) kis prakar hue the? constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. Isi tathya par apratyaksh rup se prantiy sabhaon dvara (Indirectly) tika hua hai. Vikalp sidhe janata dvara, british sansad dvara niyukt, keval rajaon dvara bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan apratyaksh rup se prantiy sabhaon dvara (Indirectly) hi milti hai. Exam point: apratyaksh rup se prantiy sabhaon dvara (Indirectly) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: How many princely states were represented in the original assembly plan?
qh: संविधान सभा में कुल कितनी रियासतें (Desi Riyasat) शामिल होने वाली थीं?
e: mul yojana (389 sadasy) ke tahat riyasaton ko 93 sitein avantit ki gai thin. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki sanvidhan sabha mein kul kitani riyasatein (Desi Riyasat) shamil hone vali thin? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi karan se 93 sahi uttar hai. Vikalp 11, 296, 565 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 93 hi milti hai. Exam point: 93 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which party was in power in Britain at the time of India's independence?
qh: आजादी के समय ब्रिटेन में किस पार्टी की सरकार सत्ता में थी?
e: 1945 mein briten mein lebar parti ki sarakar bani aur klemeint etali pradhanamantri bane. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ajadi ke samay briten mein kis parti ki sarakar satta mein thi? Isi tathya par lebar parti (Labour Party) tika hua hai. kamyunist parti, libaral parti, kanjarvetiv parti is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan lebar parti (Labour Party) hi milti hai. Exam point: lebar parti (Labour Party) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Nehru referred to the revolutions of which two countries during the drafting process?
qh: नेहरू ने संविधान निर्माण के समय किन दो देशों की क्रांतियों का हवाला दिया था?
e: neharu ne kaha tha ki ham amerika aur phrans ki krantiyon se sikh rahe hain lekin unaka sanvidhan kopi nahin kareinge. Prashn yah batata hai ki neharu ne sanvidhan nirman ke samay kin do deshon ki krantiyon ka havala diya tha? Isi baat se amerika aur phrans (USA and France) sahi sabit hota hai. japan aur jarmani, rus aur chin, inglaind aur rus anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab amerika aur phrans (USA and France) hai. Exam point: amerika aur phrans (USA and France) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who demanded 'Separate Electorates for minorities' in the assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में 'अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए पृथक निर्वाचन' की मांग किसने की थी?
e: madras ke bi. pokar bahadur ne alpasankhyakon ke adhikaron ke lie prithak nirvachika ki mang ki thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki sanvidhan sabha mein 'alpasankhyakon ke lie prithak nirvachan' ki mang kisane ki thi? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. In tathyon ke chalte bi. pokar bahadur (B. Pocker Bahadur) hi sahi hai. govind vallabh pant, saradar patel, anbedakar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab bi. pokar bahadur (B. Pocker Bahadur) hai. Exam point: bi. pokar bahadur (B. Pocker Bahadur) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did Gandhi ji first use his non-violent technique of 'Satyagraha'?
qh: गांधी जी ने 'सत्याग्रह' की अपनी अहिंसात्मक तकनीक का पहली बार प्रयोग कहाँ किया था?
e: dakshin aphrika ne hi gandhi ji ko 'mahatma' banaya aur unhonne pahali bar satyagrah ka prayog vahin kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhi ji ne 'satyagrah' ki apani ahinsatmak takanik ka pahali bar prayog kahan kiya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye antim jawab dakshin aphrika (South Africa) ke roop mein milta hai. kheda, chanparan, ahamadabad mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar dakshin aphrika (South Africa) baithta hai. Exam point: dakshin aphrika (South Africa) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the main economic objective of Colonialism?
qh: उपनिवेशवाद (Colonialism) का मुख्य आर्थिक उद्देश्य क्या होता है?
o: कच्चे माल का दोहन और तैयार माल बेचना (Economic exploitation)
e: upaniveshavad mein shaktishali rashtr kamajor rashtr ke sansadhanon ka arthik dohan karata hai aur use apane bajar ki tarah istemal karata hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki upaniveshavad (Colonialism) ka mukhy arthik uddeshy kya hota hai? Isi tathya par kachche mal ka dohan aur taiyar mal... tika hua hai. shiksha ka prasar karana, keval paryatan ko badhava dena, kamajor rashtr ki madad karana in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kachche mal ka dohan aur taiyar mal... hi milti hai. Exam point: kachche mal ka dohan aur taiyar mal... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the East India Company established?
qh: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: san 1600 mein maharani elijabeth pratham ne ist indiya kanpani ko vyapar karane ka adhikar patr diya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki ist indiya kanpani ki sthapana kis varsh hui thi? Isliye antim jawab 1600 ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp 1608, 1757, 1498 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar 1600 hai. Exam point: 1600 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the Mughal Emperor in India when the East India Company was established?
qh: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी की स्थापना के समय भारत में मुगल सम्राट कौन था?
e: san 1600 mein jab kanpani bani, tab bharat mein akabar (1556-1605) ka shasan tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki ist indiya kanpani ki sthapana ke samay bharat mein mugal samrat kaun tha? Akbar Mughal vansh ka mashhoor badshah tha jisne sasan tatha lagaan ki vyavastha sudhaari. Isi baat se akabar (Akbar) sahi sabit hota hai. shahajahan, jahangir, babar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se akabar (Akbar) sahi hai. Exam point: akabar (Akbar) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Captain Hawkins went to which Mughal Emperor's court for trade permission?
qh: कैप्टन हॉकिंस (Captain Hawkins) किस मुगल सम्राट के दरबार में व्यापारिक अनुमति लेने गया था?
e: kaiptan hokins 1608 mein hektar namak jahaj se surat pahuncha aur jahangir ke darabar mein agara gaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kaiptan hokins (Captain Hawkins) kis mugal samrat ke darabar mein vyaparik anumati lene gaya tha? Isliye antim jawab jahangir ke roop mein milta hai.
