Galti akabar, humayun, aurangajeb chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jahangir hi milti hai. Exam point: jahangir - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the Battle of Plassey fought?
qh: प्लासी का युद्ध (Battle of Plassey) किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
e: plasi ka yuddh 1757 mein robart klaiv aur bangal ke navab sirajuddaula ke bich lada gaya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki plasi ka yuddh (Battle of Plassey) kis varsh lada gaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1757 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1765, 1857, 1764 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se 1757 sahi hai. Exam point: 1757 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year did the Battle of Buxar take place?
qh: बक्सर का युद्ध (Battle of Buxar) किस वर्ष हुआ था?
e: baksar ka yuddh 1764 mein hua, jisamein angrejon ne mir kasim, sujauddaula aur shah alam dvitiy ki sanyukt sena ko haraya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki baksar ka yuddh (Battle of Buxar) kis varsh hua tha? In tathyon ke chalte 1764 hi sahi hai. 1757, 1761, 1772 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1764 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1764 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year was the Treaty of Allahabad signed?
qh: इलाहाबाद की संधि (Treaty of Allahabad) किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: baksar ke yuddh ke bad 1765 mein robart klaiv ne shah alam dvitiy aur sujauddaula ke sath yah sandhi ki thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ilahabad ki sandhi (Treaty of Allahabad) kis varsh hui thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1765 hi sahi baithta hai. 1764, 1793, 1757 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se 1765 sahi hai. Exam point: 1765 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: When and who introduced the Permanent Settlement in Bengal?
qh: बंगाल में 'स्थाई बंदोबस्त' (Permanent Settlement) कब और किसने लागू किया था?
e: lord kornavalis ne 1793 mein bangal mein sthai bandobast (istamarari) vyavastha lagu ki thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki bangal mein 'sthai bandobast' (Permanent Settlement) kab aur kisane lagu kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1793 - lord kornavalis (Lord Cornwallis) hi sahi baithta hai. 1772 - varen hestings, 1813 - lord minto, 1820 - thomas munaro alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1793 - lord kornavalis (Lord Cornwallis) baithta hai. Exam point: 1793 - lord kornavalis (Lord Cornwallis) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was responsible for revenue collection under the Permanent Settlement?
qh: स्थाई बंदोबस्त के तहत राजस्व वसूलने की जिम्मेदारी किसे दी गई थी?
e: sthai bandobast mein jamindar ko jamin ka malik mana gaya aur use kanpani ko ek nishchit rajasv dena hota tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki sthai bandobast ke tahat rajasv vasulane ki jimmedari kise di gai thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par jamindaron ko (Zamindars) sahi nikalta hai. ganv ke mukhiya ko, kisanon ko, sidhe kalektar ko is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad jamindaron ko (Zamindars) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: jamindaron ko (Zamindars) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which land revenue system was the Sunset Law related to?
qh: सूर्यास्त कानून (Sunset Law) का संबंध किस भू-राजस्व व्यवस्था से था?
e: suryast kanun ke tahat yadi jamindar nishchit tarikh ko sury dubane tak rajasv jama nahin karata, to usaki jamindari nilam ho jati thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki suryast kanun (Sunset Law) ka sanbandh kis bhu-rajasv vyavastha se tha? sthayi bandobast mein lagaan ki rashi hamesha ke liye tay kar di gayi thi. Yahi wajah hai ki sthai bandobast (Permanent Settlement) sahi hai. ijaredari, mahalavadai, raiyatavadai is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar sthai bandobast (Permanent Settlement) hi hai. Exam point: sthai bandobast (Permanent Settlement) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the group of wealthy peasants in Bengal called?
qh: बंगाल में धनी किसानों के समूह को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: ganvon mein jotadar bahut shaktishali the, jo aksar jamindaron ka virodh karate the aur ganvon mein hi rahate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bangal mein dhani kisanon ke samuh ko kya kaha jata tha? raiyat kheti karne wala kisaan hota tha. Isliye antim jawab jotadar (Jotedars) ke roop mein milta hai. payak, amal-gujar, raiyat alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad jotadar (Jotedars) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: jotadar (Jotedars) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the officer called who collected tax on behalf of the Zamindar?
qh: जमींदारों की ओर से कर वसूलने वाला अधिकारी क्या कहलाता था?
e: jamindar ka adhikari 'amala' rajasv vasulane ganv ata tha, jise aksar jotadar kam karane se rokate the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki jamindaron ki or se kar vasulane vala adhikari kya kahalata tha? zamindar beech ka wo adhikari tha jo kisaanon se lagaan vasool karta tha. Isi karan se amala (Amla) sahi uttar hai. mukaddam, patavari, divan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad amala (Amla) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: amala (Amla) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which year was the Fifth Report presented in the British Parliament?
qh: ब्रिटिश संसद में 'पाँचवीं रिपोर्ट' (Fifth Report) किस वर्ष पेश की गई थी?
e: panchavin riport 1813 mein british sansad mein pesh ki gai, jo kanpani ke prashasan aur jamindaron ki halat par adharit thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki british sansad mein 'panchavin riport' (Fifth Report) kis varsh pesh ki gai thi? Isi tathya par 1813 tika hua hai. 1793, 1832, 1857 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1813 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1813 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was the Ryotwari System primarily implemented?
qh: रैयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था (Ryotwari System) मुख्य रूप से कहाँ लागू की गई थी?
e: raiyatavadai vyavastha dakshin aur pashchim bharat (bambai aur madras presideinsi) mein lagu ki gai thi. Is prashn ka dayra ryotwari tak phaila hua hai. ryotwari bandobast mein lagaan seedhe kisaan se wasool kiya jaata tha. Isi baat se bambai aur madras (Bombay & Madras) sahi sabit hota hai. bangal aur bihar, udaisa, panjab aur avadh alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar bambai aur madras (Bombay & Madras) hai. Exam point: bambai aur madras (Bombay & Madras) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: With whom did the government make a direct agreement in the Ryotwari system?
qh: रैयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था में सरकार ने किसके साथ सीधा समझौता किया था?
e: is vyavastha mein koi bichauliya nahin tha, sarakar sidhe kisanon (raiyaton) se rajasv vasulati thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki raiyatavadai vyavastha mein sarakar ne kisake sath sidha samajhauta kiya tha? ryotwari bandobast mein lagaan seedhe kisaan se wasool kiya jaata tha. Isi karan se raiyat/kisanon ke sath (Ryots/Peasants) sahi uttar hai. jamindaron ke sath, ganv ke mukhiya ke sath, videshi vyapariyon ke sath in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se raiyat/kisanon ke sath (Ryots/Peasants) sahi hai. Exam point: raiyat/kisanon ke sath (Ryots/Peasants) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were the people living in the Rajmahal hills who practiced shifting cultivation called?
qh: राजमहल की पहाड़ियों में रहने वाले लोग जो झूम खेती करते थे, क्या कहलाते थे?
e: pahadaiya log rajamahal ki pahadaiyon mein rahate the aur kudal ka prayog kar jhum kheti karate the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki rajamahal ki pahadaiyon mein rahane vale log jo jhum kheti karate the, kya kahalate the? Isliye sahi nateeja pahadaiya (Paharias) nikalta hai. bhil, santhal, munda in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab pahadaiya (Paharias) hai. Exam point: pahadaiya (Paharias) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Whom did the British start settling for farming in the lower Rajmahal areas?
qh: अंग्रेजों ने राजमहल के निचले इलाकों में खेती के लिए किन्हें बसाना शुरू किया?
e: jab pahadaiya log sthai kheti ke lie taiyar nahin hue, to angrejon ne santhalon ko vahan basaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki angrejon ne rajamahal ke nichale ilakon mein kheti ke lie kinhein basana shuru kiya? Isi karan se santhalon ko (Santhals) sahi uttar hai. dach logon ko, purtagaliyon ko, pahadaiya logon ko ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad santhalon ko (Santhals) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: santhalon ko (Santhals) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: By what name was the land given to Santhals known?
qh: संथालों को दी गई भूमि को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: 1832 tak angrejon ne santhalon ke lie ek bada ilaka simankit kar diya, jise 'damin-i-koh' kaha gaya. Yahaan damin-i-koh se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par damin-i-koh sahi nikalta hai. raiyatavadai, istamarari, pahadaiya paragana alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar damin-i-koh baithta hai. Exam point: damin-i-koh - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the Santhal Revolt take place?
qh: संथाल विद्रोह (Santhal Revolt) किस वर्ष हुआ था?
e: santhalon ne 1855-56 mein angrejon aur mahajanon ke shoshan ke khilaph vidroh kiya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki santhal vidroh (Santhal Revolt) kis varsh hua tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1855-56 hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp 1857, 1832, 1875 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1855-56 hai. Exam point: 1855-56 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which two brothers led the Santhal Revolt?
qh: संथाल विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किन दो भाइयों ने किया था?
e: santhal vidroh ka netritv siddhu manjhi aur kanu manjhi namak do sage bhaiyon ne kiya tha. Is prashn ka kendra siddhu aur kanu (Sidhu and Kanu) hai. Isliye sahi nateeja siddhu aur kanu (Sidhu and Kanu) nikalta hai. Vikalp mir japhar aur kasim, birasa aur kanu, bhagat sinh aur rajaguru bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar siddhu aur kanu (Sidhu and Kanu) hai. Exam point: siddhu aur kanu (Sidhu and Kanu) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Conflict between Paharias and Santhals is often called the struggle of?
qh: पहाड़िया और संथालों के बीच संघर्ष को अक्सर किसका संघर्ष कहा जाता है?
e: santhal 'hal' (sthai kheti) ka aur pahadaiya 'kudal' (jhum kheti) ka pratinidhitv karate the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki pahadaiya aur santhalon ke bich sangharsh ko aksar kisaka sangharsh kaha jata hai? Isi karan se hal aur kudal (Plough and Hoe) sahi uttar hai. Galti int aur patthar, banduk aur tir, talavar aur dhal chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hal aur kudal (Plough and Hoe) hi milti hai. Exam point: hal aur kudal (Plough and Hoe) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which year did the Deccan Riots break out?
qh: दक्कन दंगा (Deccan Riots) किस वर्ष भड़का था?
e: dakkan danga 1875 mein pune ke supa ganv se shuru hua, jahan kisanon ne sahukaron ke bahi-khate jala die. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki dakkan danga (Deccan Riots) kis varsh bhadaka tha? Isliye antim jawab 1875 ke roop mein milta hai. 1917, 1855, 1857 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1875 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1875 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main cause of the Deccan Riots?
qh: दक्कन दंगों का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: अत्यधिक लगान और साहूकारों का कर्ज (High revenue and debt)
e: bhari sarakari lagan aur sahukaron ke unche byaj dar ke karan kisan vidroh par utar ae the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki dakkan dangon ka mukhy karan kya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par atyadhik lagan aur sahukaron ka karj (High revenue and debt) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti dharmik bhedabhav, shiksha ki kami, makka ki phasal chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad atyadhik lagan aur sahukaron ka karj (High... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: atyadhik lagan aur sahukaron ka karj (High revenue and debt) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was Francis Buchanan by profession?
qh: फ्रांसिस बुकानन (Francis Buchanan) पेशे से क्या था?
e: bukanan ek chikitsak tha jisane kanpani ke lie rajamahal ki pahadaiyon ka vistrit sarvekshan kiya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki phransis bukanan (Francis Buchanan) peshe se kya tha? Isi karan se chikitsak/sarvekshak (Physician/Surveyor) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp jamindar, navab, sainik bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar chikitsak/sarvekshak (Physician/Surveyor) hi hai. Exam point: chikitsak/sarvekshak (Physician/Surveyor) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: With which modern state are the Ahom Kings related?
qh: अहोम राजाओं (Ahom Kings) का संबंध किस आधुनिक राज्य से है?
e: ahom rajaon ka shasan asam kshetr mein tha, jahan 'payak' sainy seva dete the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki ahom rajaon (Ahom Kings) ka sanbandh kis adhunik rajy se hai? In tathyon ke chalte asam (Assam) hi sahi hai. Vikalp bihar, udaisa, maharashtr bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad asam (Assam) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: asam (Assam) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Under Permanent Settlement's Sunset Law, what happened if revenue wasn't paid?
qh: स्थाई बंदोबस्त में 'सूर्यास्त कानून' के अनुसार राजस्व न चुकाने पर क्या होता था?
o: जमींदारी नीलाम कर दी जाती थी (Auction of land)
e: rajasv samay par n milane par angrejon dvara jamindar ki bhumi ki sarvajanik nilami ki jati thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki sthai bandobast mein 'suryast kanun' ke anusar rajasv n chukane par kya hota tha? sthayi bandobast mein lagaan ki rashi hamesha ke liye tay kar di gayi thi. Isi karan se jamindari nilam kar di jati thi (Auction... sahi uttar hai. angrej desh chhod dete the, jamindar ko jel hoti thi, kisan ko phansi hoti thi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jamindari nilam kar di jati thi (Auction of land) hi milti hai. Exam point: jamindari nilam kar di jati thi (Auction of land) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Due to the American Civil War, demand for which crop increased in India?
qh: अमेरिकी गृहयुद्ध (American Civil War) के कारण भारत में किस फसल की मांग बढ़ गई थी?
e: amerika mein yuddh ke karan briten ne bharat se bhari matra mein kapas ka ayat shuru kar diya tha. Is prashn ka dayra kapas (Cotton) tak phaila hua hai. Isliye antim jawab kapas (Cotton) ke roop mein milta hai. gehun, chay, nil mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad kapas (Cotton) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kapas (Cotton) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What trick did Zamindars use to save their land during auctions?
qh: जमींदार नीलामी के समय अपनी जमीन बचाने के लिए क्या चाल चलते थे?
o: फर्जी बिक्री (Fictitious sale) और महिलाओं के नाम संपत्ति
e: ve apane hi ejeinton se pharji boli lagavate the ya sanpatti mahilaon (man/patni) ke nam kar dete the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki jamindar nilami ke samay apani jamin bachane ke lie kya chal chalate the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par pharji bikri (Fictitious sale) aur mahilaon ke nam sanpatti hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp ve kar chuka dete the, ve ganv chhod dete the, ve yuddh karate the bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar pharji bikri (Fictitious sale) aur mahilaon ke nam sanpatti hi hai. Exam point: pharji bikri (Fictitious sale) aur mahilaon ke... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which was the first European company to arrive in India?
qh: भारत आने वाली पहली यूरोपीय कंपनी कौन सी थी?
e: purtagali 1498 mein vaskodigama ke netritv mein sabase pahale bharat pahunche the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki bharat ane vali pahali yuropiy kanpani kaun si thi? Yahi wajah hai ki purtagali (Portuguese) sahi hai. angrej, dach, phransisi is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad purtagali (Portuguese) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: purtagali (Portuguese) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: After the Treaty of Allahabad, how many lakhs was the annual pension given to Shah Alam II?
qh: इलाहाबाद की संधि के बाद शाह आलम द्वितीय को कितने लाख रुपये की वार्षिक पेंशन दी गई?
e: shah alam dvitiy ko dilli se hatakar ilahabad ke kile mein rakha gaya aur 26 lakh rupaye peinshan tay ki gai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ilahabad ki sandhi ke bad shah alam dvitiy ko kitane lakh rupaye ki varshik peinshan di gai? Isi karan se 26 lakh sahi uttar hai. 10 lakh, 50 lakh, 2 lakh mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 26 lakh hai. Exam point: 26 lakh - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Governor-General abolished the Sati system in India?
qh: भारत में सती प्रथा का अंत किस गवर्नर जनरल ने किया था?
e: 1829 mein raja ramamohan ray ke sahayog se sati pratha ko pratibandhit kiya gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bharat mein sati pratha ka ant kis gavarnar janaral ne kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par lord viliyam beintik sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - lord ripan, lord okalaind, lord dalahauji - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav lord viliyam beintik hi thehrta hai. Exam point: lord viliyam beintik - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Between whom was the Battle of Plassey (1757) fought?
qh: प्लासी का युद्ध (1757) किसके बीच लड़ा गया था?
e: is yuddh ne bharat mein british shasan ki ninv rakhi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki plasi ka yuddh (1757) kisake bich lada gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sirajuddaula aur robart klaiv hi sahi baithta hai. tipu sultan aur kornavalis, mugal samrat aur angrej, mir kasim aur robart klaiv ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab sirajuddaula aur robart klaiv hai. Exam point: sirajuddaula aur robart klaiv - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who held the real power in Japan from the 12th century until 1867?
qh: जापान में 12वीं शताब्दी से 1867 तक वास्तविक सत्ता किसके हाथों में थी?
e: japan mein shogun sainy kamandar the jo samrat ke nam par shasan karate the aur vastavik rajanitik satta unhin ke pas thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki japan mein 12vin shatabdi se 1867 tak vastavik satta kisake hathon mein thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par shogun hi sahi baithta hai. samurai, damo, samrat (Emperor) ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar shogun baithta hai. Exam point: shogun - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the Japanese policy that meant 'Rich Country, Strong Army'?
qh: जापान की उस नीति का नाम क्या था जिसका अर्थ था 'अमीर देश, मजबूत सेना'?
e: miji sarakar ne 'phukoku kayohei' ka nara diya taki japan ko pashchimi takaton se bachane ke lie arthik aur sainy rup se majabut banaya ja sake. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki japan ki us niti ka nam kya tha jisaka arth tha 'amir desh, majabut sena'? Isliye sahi nateeja phukoku kayohei (Fukoku Kyohei) nikalta hai. shogun shasan, miji ristoreshan, samurai alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan phukoku kayohei (Fukoku Kyohei) hi milti hai. Exam point: phukoku kayohei (Fukoku Kyohei) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which last imperial dynasty ruled China from 1644 to 1912?
qh: चीन में 1644 से 1912 तक किस अंतिम शाही राजवंश ने शासन किया था?
e: kving rajavansh (manchu) chin ka antim rajavansh tha. 1911 ki kranti ke bad 1912 mein ganatantr ki sthapana hui. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki chin mein 1644 se 1912 tak kis antim shahi rajavansh ne shasan kiya tha? Isi aadhar par kving rajavansh (Qing Dynasty) chuna jaata hai. tang rajavansh, ming rajavansh, han rajavansh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab kving rajavansh (Qing Dynasty) hai. Exam point: kving rajavansh (Qing Dynasty) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who were called 'Samurai' in Japan?
qh: जापान में 'समुराई' (Samurai) किन्हें कहा जाता था?
e: samurai japan ke yoddha varg ke log the jo shogun aur damo (lords) ki seva karate the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki japan mein 'samurai' (Samurai) kinhein kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par yoddha varg (Warrior Class) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. kisan, dharmik guru, vyapari is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab yoddha varg (Warrior Class) hai. Exam point: yoddha varg (Warrior Class) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the main purpose of Matthew Perry's arrival in Japan in 1853?
qh: 1853 में अमेरिकी कमांडर 'मैथ्यू पेरी' के जापान आने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: व्यापारिक और कूटनीतिक संबंध स्थापित करना (Trade and diplomatic relations)
e: maithyu peri ne japan ko bahari duniya aur vyapar ke lie apane bandaragah kholane par majabur kiya. Yahaan vyaparik aur kutanitik sanbandh sthapit karana (Trade and diplomatic relations) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi karan se vyaparik aur kutanitik sanbandh sthapit karana (Trade... sahi uttar hai. sone ki khoj, japan par kabja karana, bauddh dharm ka prachar is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab vyaparik aur kutanitik sanbandh sthapit karana (Trade... hai. Exam point: vyaparik aur kutanitik sanbandh sthapit karana (Trade and diplomatic relations) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which of these is NOT one of the 'Three Principles' given by Dr. Sun Yat-sen?
qh: डॉ. सन यात-सेन द्वारा आधुनिक चीन के लिए दिए गए 'तीन सिद्धांतों' में से कौन सा नहीं है?
e: san yat-sen ke tin siddhant 'san min chui' the: rashtravad, lokatantr aur samajavad. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki do. san yat-sen dvara adhunik chin ke lie die gae 'tin siddhanton' mein se kaun sa nahin hai? Isi karan se sainyavad (Militarism) sahi uttar hai. lokatantr, rashtravad, samajavad anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar sainyavad (Militarism) baithta hai. Exam point: sainyavad (Militarism) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the 'May Fourth Movement' occur in China on May 4, 1919?
qh: चीन में 4 मई 1919 को 'मे फोर्थ मूवमेंट' (May Fourth Movement) क्यों हुआ था?
o: वर्साय संधि के अन्यायपूर्ण निर्णयों के विरोध में (Against Versailles Treaty)
e: pratham vishv yuddh ke bad apani teritari vapas n milane ke virodh mein chini chhatron ne bijing mein pradarshan kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki chin mein 4 mai 1919 ko 'me phorth muvameint' (May Fourth Movement) kyon hua tha? Isi karan se varsay sandhi ke anyayapurn nirnayon ke virodh... sahi uttar hai. akal ke karan, samrat ki bahali ke lie, japan ke samarthan mein mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar varsay sandhi ke anyayapurn nirnayon ke virodh mein (Against Versailles Treaty) hai. Exam point: varsay sandhi ke anyayapurn nirnayon ke virodh mein (Against Versailles Treaty) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the 'Meiji Restoration' take place in Japan?
qh: जापान में 'मीजी रिस्टोरेशन' (Meiji Restoration) किस वर्ष हुआ?
e: 1868 mein shogun shasan ko samapt kar samrat (miji) ko phir se shasan ka vastavik keindr banaya gaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki japan mein 'miji ristoreshan' (Meiji Restoration) kis varsh hua? Isi karan se 1868 sahi uttar hai. 1890, 1912, 1853 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1868 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1868 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which year was the Chinese Communist Party founded?
qh: चीनी कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (CCP) की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: rus ki kranti se prabhavit hokar 1921 mein chin mein kamyunist parti ki sthapana hui. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki chini kamyunist parti (CCP) ki sthapana kis varsh hui thi? Isi tathya par 1921 tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - 1978, 1911, 1949 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1921 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1921 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the Parliament called under the Meiji Constitution in Japan?
qh: जापान के 'मीजी संविधान' (1890) के तहत संसद को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: japan ki sansad ka nam 'dait' rakha gaya tha, jo jarman shabd se prerit tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki japan ke 'miji sanvidhan' (1890) ke tahat sansad ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi tathya par dait (Diet) tika hua hai. majalis, sinet, kangres ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar dait (Diet) hi hai. Exam point: dait (Diet) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who led the 'Long March' in China?
qh: चीन में 'लॉन्ग मार्च' (Long March) का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: mao jedang ne 6000 mil lanbe 'long march' ke jarie kamyunist parti ko bikharane se bachaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki chin mein 'long march' (Long March) ka netritv kisane kiya tha? Isliye antim jawab mao jedang (Mao Zedong) ke roop mein milta hai. deing jiyaoping, chiyang kai-shek, san yat-sen ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad mao jedang (Mao Zedong) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: mao jedang (Mao Zedong) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which program did Mao launch in 1958 for rapid industrialization?
qh: माओ जेदांग ने 1958 में चीन की अर्थव्यवस्था में तेजी लाने के लिए कौन सा कार्यक्रम शुरू किया?
e: gret lip phoravard ka uddeshy gharelu star par stil utpadan aur samuhik kheti ko badhava dena tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mao jedang ne 1958 mein chin ki arthavyavastha mein teji lane ke lie kaun sa karyakram shuru kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par gret lip phoravard (Great Leap Forward) hi sahi baithta hai. me phorth muvameint, phor modarnaijeshan, sanskritik kranti alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab gret lip phoravard (Great Leap Forward) hai. Exam point: gret lip phoravard (Great Leap Forward) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the primary cause of the Opium Wars between China and Britain?
qh: चीन और ब्रिटेन के बीच 'अफीम युद्ध' (Opium Wars) का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: अफीम का अवैध व्यापार (Smuggling of Opium)
e: briten ne chin mein aphim ka vyapar banae rakhane ke lie bal ka prayog kiya, jisaka chin ki sarakar virodh kar rahi thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki chin aur briten ke bich 'aphim yuddh' (Opium Wars) ka mukhy karan kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja aphim ka avaidh vyapar (Smuggling of Opium) nikalta hai. Galti sone ki khan, machhali pakadana, chay ki kheti chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav aphim ka avaidh vyapar (Smuggling of Opium) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: aphim ka avaidh vyapar (Smuggling of Opium) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were 'Zaibatsu' in Japan?
qh: जापान में 'जायबात्सु' (Zaibatsu) किसे कहा जाता था?
e: jayabatsu badae vyaparik sangathan the jo japani arthavyavastha ko niyantrit karane vale parivaron ke svamitv mein the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki japan mein 'jayabatsu' (Zaibatsu) kise kaha jata tha? Isi karan se badae vyaparik gharane (Large business houses) sahi uttar hai. Galti majadur sangh, sainik adhikari, videshi dut chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan badae vyaparik gharane (Large business houses) hi milti hai. Exam point: badae vyaparik gharane (Large business houses) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Where did Chiang Kai-shek flee after his defeat in 1949?
qh: चियांग काई-शेक 1949 में कम्युनिस्टों से हारने के बाद भागकर कहाँ गए?
e: chiyang kai-shek aur gaman dang (KMT) ke log taivan chale gae aur vahan 'ripablik oph chaina' ki sthapana ki. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki chiyang kai-shek 1949 mein kamyuniston se harane ke bad bhagakar kahan gae? Isi karan se taivan (Taiwan) sahi uttar hai. makau, hangakang, japan ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan taivan (Taiwan) hi milti hai. Exam point: taivan (Taiwan) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the name of Japan's bullet train introduced in 1964?
qh: जापान की प्रसिद्ध बुलेट ट्रेन का क्या नाम है, जिसे 1964 में शुरू किया गया था?
e: shinkansen japan ki unnat takanik aur adhunikata ka pratik mani jati hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki japan ki prasiddh bulet tren ka kya nam hai, jise 1964 mein shuru kiya gaya tha? In tathyon ke chalte shinkansen hi sahi hai. metro, maiglev, eksapres is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab shinkansen hai. Exam point: shinkansen - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who introduced the 'Four Modernizations' in China after 1978?
qh: चीन में 1978 के बाद 'फोर मॉडर्नाइजेशन' (Four Modernizations) की शुरुआत किसने की थी?
e: deing jiyaoping ne krishi, udyog, vijnan aur raksha ke kshetr mein adhunikikaran par jor diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki chin mein 1978 ke bad 'phor modarnaijeshan' (Four Modernizations) ki shuruat kisane ki thi? Isliye antim jawab deing jiyaoping (Deng Xiaoping) ke roop mein milta hai. mao jedang, san yat-sen, chiyang kai-shek is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab deing jiyaoping (Deng Xiaoping) hai. Exam point: deing jiyaoping (Deng Xiaoping) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which 'Article' of the Japanese constitution is known as the 'No War Clause'?
qh: जापान के संविधान के किस 'आर्टिकल' को 'नो वॉर क्लॉज' (No War Clause) कहा जाता है?
e: dvitiy vishv yuddh ke bad bane sanvidhan ke anuchchhed 9 ke tahat japan ne yuddh ko tyag diya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki japan ke sanvidhan ke kis 'artikal' ko 'no vor kloj' (No War Clause) kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par artikal 9 (Article 9) sahi nikalta hai. artikal 15, artikal 21, artikal 1 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad artikal 9 (Article 9) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: artikal 9 (Article 9) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which line divides Korea into North and South?
qh: कोरिया को दो हिस्सों (उत्तर और दक्षिण) में बांटने वाली रेखा कौन सी है?
e: dvitiy vishv yuddh ke bad 38vin samanantar rekha ke adhar par koriya ka vibhajan hua. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki koriya ko do hisson (uttar aur dakshin) mein bantane vali rekha kaun si hai? Isi karan se 38vin pairelal (38th Parallel) sahi uttar hai. redakliph lain, durand lain, 49vin pairelal ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 38vin pairelal (38th Parallel) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 38vin pairelal (38th Parallel) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What are 'Hiragana' and 'Katakana' in Japan?
qh: जापान में 'हीरागाना' और 'काताकाना' क्या हैं?
e: japani bhasha likhane ke lie chini aksharon (kanji) ke sath in do lipiyon ka prayog kiya jata hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki japan mein 'hiragana' aur 'katakana' kya hain? Yahi wajah hai ki do phonetik lipiyan (Phonetic scripts) sahi hai. do mukhy bhojan, do prasiddh shahar, do prakar ke marshal art mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan do phonetik lipiyan (Phonetic scripts) hi milti hai. Exam point: do phonetik lipiyan (Phonetic scripts) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What is the phase before the Industrial Revolution called when large-scale production occurred for the international market?
qh: औद्योगिक क्रांति से पहले के उस चरण को क्या कहा जाता है जब अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार के लिए बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन होता था?
e: audyogik kranti se pahale ke is kal ko 'adi-audyogikikaran' kaha jata hai, jisamein karakhanon ke bajay gharon mein utpadan hota tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki audyogik kranti se pahale ke us charan ko kya kaha jata hai jab antararashtriy bajar ke lie badae paimane par utpadan hota tha? Isi karan se adi-audyogikikaran (Proto-Industrialization) sahi uttar hai. adhunik audyogikikaran, markeintailijm, shahari vikas anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar adi-audyogikikaran (Proto-Industrialization) hi hai. Exam point: adi-audyogikikaran (Proto-Industrialization) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did European merchants move to the countryside in the 18th century?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी में यूरोपीय शहरों के सौदागर गांवों की तरफ क्यों जाने लगे?
o: शहरों में गिल्ड्स (Guilds) बहुत शक्तिशाली थे
e: shaharon mein tred gilds bahut shaktishali the jo utpadan aur kimaton ko niyantrit karate the, isalie nae vyapariyon ne ganvon ka rukh kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 18vin shatabdi mein yuropiy shaharon ke saudagar ganvon ki taraph kyon jane lage? Isi tathya par shaharon mein gilds (Guilds) bahut shaktishali the tika hua hai. ganvon mein jamin mupht thi, shaharon mein pradushan tha, kheti karane ke lie in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab shaharon mein gilds (Guilds) bahut shaktishali the hai. Exam point: shaharon mein gilds (Guilds) bahut shaktishali the - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the role of a 'Stapler' in cloth production?
qh: कपड़ा उत्पादन की प्रक्रिया में 'स्टेपलर' (Stapler) का क्या काम था?
o: ऊन को रेशों के हिसाब से छांटना (Sort wool according to its fibre)
e: stepalar vah vyakti hota tha jo un ko usake reshon ya gunavatta ke adhar par alag-alag chhantata tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki kapada utpadan ki prakriya mein 'stepalar' (Stapler) ka kya kam tha? Isi karan se un ko reshon ke hisab se chhantana... sahi uttar hai. kapadaon ko silana, kapadaon ki paiking, kapadae rangana is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar un ko reshon ke hisab se chhantana... hi hai. Exam point: un ko reshon ke hisab se chhantana (Sort wool according to its fibre) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did London become known as during the early phase of industrialization?
qh: औद्योगिकीकरण के शुरुआती दौर में लंदन को किस नाम से जाना जाने लगा था?
e: taiyar mal ko antararashtriy bajar mein bhejane se pahale antim rup dene ke lie landan laya jata tha, isalie ise phinishing seintar kaha gaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki audyogikikaran ke shuruati daur mein landan ko kis nam se jana jane laga tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par phinishing seintar (Finishing Centre) sahi nikalta hai. bainking rajadhani, kachcha mal bajar, utpadan keindr ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan phinishing seintar (Finishing Centre) hi milti hai. Exam point: phinishing seintar (Finishing Centre) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who created the first Cotton Mill framework?
qh: प्रथम सूती कपड़ा मिल (Cotton Mill) की रूपरेखा किसने तैयार की थी?
e: richard arkarait ne pahali suti mil sthapit ki, jisase utpadan ki puri prakriya ek hi chhat ke niche a gai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki pratham suti kapada mil (Cotton Mill) ki ruparekha kisane taiyar ki thi? Isi tathya par richard arkarait (Richard Arkwright) tika hua hai. jems vat, nyukomen, maithyu boltan ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar richard arkarait (Richard Arkwright) hi hai. Exam point: richard arkarait (Richard Arkwright) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which commodity saw a massive import rise in Britain at the end of the 18th century?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी के अंत में ब्रिटेन में किस वस्तु के आयात में भारी वृद्धि हुई?
e: 1760 mein briten 25 lakh paund kapas ayat karata tha, jo 1787 tak badhakar 220 lakh paund ho gaya. Prashn yah batata hai ki 18vin shatabdi ke ant mein briten mein kis vastu ke ayat mein bhari vriddhi hui? Yahi wajah hai ki kachcha kapas (Raw Cotton) sahi hai. chaval, chay, sona in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar kachcha kapas (Raw Cotton) hai. Exam point: kachcha kapas (Raw Cotton) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who originally produced the steam engine that James Watt improved?
qh: भाप के इंजन (Steam Engine) का आविष्कार मूल रूप से किसने किया था और जेम्स वाट ने उसमें सुधार किया?
e: bhap ke injan ko sabase pahale nyukomen ne banaya tha, jise bad mein jems vat ne aur adhik prabhavashali banaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bhap ke injan (Steam Engine) ka avishkar mul rup se kisane kiya tha aur jems vat ne usamein sudhar kiya? In tathyon ke chalte thomas nyukomen (Thomas Newcomen) hi sahi hai. maithyu boltan, jems haragrivs, richard arkarait is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad thomas nyukomen (Thomas Newcomen) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: thomas nyukomen (Thomas Newcomen) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: How many steam engines were there in all of England even at the end of the 19th century?
qh: 19वीं शताब्दी के अंत तक ब्रिटेन में भाप के इंजनों की कुल संख्या कितनी थी?
e: nai takanik mahangi aur avishvasaniy hone ke karan briten mein bhap ke injanon ka upayog bahut dhimi gati se badha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 19vin shatabdi ke ant tak briten mein bhap ke injanon ki kul sankhya kitani thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par keval 321 (Only 321) sahi nikalta hai. shuny, lagabhag 10,000, 50,000 se adhik alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan keval 321 (Only 321) hi milti hai. Exam point: keval 321 (Only 321) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did industrialists in Victorian Britain prefer manual labour over machines?
qh: विक्टोरियाई ब्रिटेन में उद्योगपति मशीनों के बजाय हाथ के श्रम को प्राथमिकता क्यों देते थे?
o: श्रमिकों को राजा का समर्थन था
मानव श्रम सस्ता और प्रचुर मात्रा में उपलब्ध था (Cheap and abundant labour)
e: briten mein majaduron ki koi kami nahin thi, isalie unaki majaduri kam thi. udyogapati mahangi mashinon par paisa kharch nahin karana chahate the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki viktoriyai briten mein udyogapati mashinon ke bajay hath ke shram ko prathamikata kyon dete the? Isi karan se manav shram sasta aur prachur matra mein upalabdh tha (Cheap and abundant labour) sahi uttar hai. mashinein pratibandhit thin, shramikon ko raja ka samarthan tha, mashinein bijali nahin khati thin is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar manav shram sasta aur prachur matra mein upalabdh tha (Cheap and abundant labour) baithta hai. Exam point: manav shram sasta aur prachur matra mein upalabdh tha (Cheap and abundant labour) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which industry was seasonal in nature, needing labour only at specific times?
qh: कौन सा उद्योग मौसमी (Seasonal) प्रकृति का था, जिसमें वर्ष के कुछ ही समय मजदूरों की जरूरत होती थी?
o: गैस वर्क्स और ब्रुअरीज (Gas works and Breweries)
e: gais banane vale karakhanon aur sharabakhanon mein sardiyon ke samay kam ka bojh badh jata tha, isalie ve mausami majaduron par nirbhar the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki kaun sa udyog mausami (Seasonal) prakriti ka tha, jisamein varsh ke kuchh hi samay majaduron ki jarurat hoti thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par gais varks aur bruarij (Gas works and Breweries) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. koyala khanan, loha udyog, sona khanan ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar gais varks aur bruarij (Gas works and Breweries) hai. Exam point: gais varks aur bruarij (Gas works and... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What did hand-made goods symbolize for aristocrats in 19th-century Britain?
qh: 19वीं सदी के ब्रिटेन में 'अभिजात वर्ग' (Aristocrats) हाथ से बनी वस्तुओं को किसका प्रतीक मानते थे?
e: hath se bani vastuen vishishtata aur behatar phinish ka pratik thin, jabaki mashini mal ko keval niryat ke lie mana jata tha. Yahaan parishkrit aur vishishtata (Refinement and class) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Yahi wajah hai ki parishkrit aur vishishtata (Refinement and class) sahi hai. pichhadapan, garibi, videshi akraman is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan parishkrit aur vishishtata (Refinement and class) hi milti hai. Exam point: parishkrit aur vishishtata (Refinement and class) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who invented the Spinning Jenny?
qh: स्पिनिंग जेनी (Spinning Jenny) मशीन का आविष्कार किसने किया था?
e: jems haragrivs ne 1764 mein spining jeni banai, jisase katai ki prakriya tej ho gai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki spining jeni (Spinning Jenny) mashin ka avishkar kisane kiya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par jems haragrivs (James Hargreaves) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. richard arkarait, jorj stipheinsan, jems vat is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar jems haragrivs (James Hargreaves) hai. Exam point: jems haragrivs (James Hargreaves) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did women workers in Britain attack Spinning Jenny machines?
qh: ब्रिटेन में महिला कामगारों ने 'स्पिनिंग जेनी' मशीनों पर हमले क्यों किए?
o: बेरोजगारी के डर से (Fear of unemployment)
e: spining jeni ke ane se hath se katai karane vali mahilaon ka rojagar chhinane ka khatara paida ho gaya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki briten mein mahila kamagaron ne 'spining jeni' mashinon par hamale kyon kie? Isi karan se berojagari ke dar se (Fear of unemployment) sahi uttar hai. Galti ve shor karati thin, mashinein khataranak thin, ve bahut badai thin chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad berojagari ke dar se (Fear of unemployment) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: berojagari ke dar se (Fear of unemployment) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the paid servants appointed by the East India Company to supervise weavers called?
qh: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने बुनकरों पर नियंत्रण रखने के लिए जो वेतनभोगी कर्मचारी नियुक्त किए, उन्हें क्या कहा जाता था?
e: gumashta bunakaron ki nigarani karate, mal ikattha karate aur kapadae ki gunavatta ki janch karate the. Is prashn ka dayra gumashta (Gomastha) tak phaila hua hai. Isi baat se gumashta (Gomastha) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp jobar, majumadar, saudagar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad gumashta (Gomastha) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: gumashta (Gomastha) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which year was the first cotton mill established in Bombay?
qh: बंबई में पहली सूती कपड़ा मिल (Cotton Mill) किस वर्ष स्थापित हुई?
e: bharat ki pahali suti mil 1854 mein banbai mein lagi aur 1856 mein isamein utpadan shuru hua. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki banbai mein pahali suti kapada mil (Cotton Mill) kis varsh sthapit hui? Isi baat se 1854 sahi sabit hota hai. 1874, 1862, 1850 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1854 baithta hai. Exam point: 1854 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to Robert Malthus, at what rate does the population grow?
qh: रॉबर्ट माल्थस के सिद्धांत के अनुसार, जनसंख्या की वृद्धि किस दर से होती है?
e: malthas ke anusar bhojan ki apurti raikhik badhati hai jabaki janasankhya bahut tivr gati se (Exponentially) badhati hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki robart malthas ke siddhant ke anusar, janasankhya ki vriddhi kis dar se hoti hai? Isi karan se ghatankiy ya tivr (Exponential/Potential) sahi uttar hai. raikhik (Linear), sthir, koi vriddhi nahin anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ghatankiy ya tivr (Exponential/Potential) hi milti hai. Exam point: ghatankiy ya tivr (Exponential/Potential) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was 'Zollverein', established in 1834 at the initiative of Prussia?
qh: 1834 में प्रशा (Prussia) की पहल पर स्थापित 'ज़ोल्वेरिन' (Zollverein) क्या था?
e: jaolverin ek sima shulk sangh tha jisane tairiph badhaon ko khatm kiya aur mudraon ki sankhya 30 se ghatakar 2 kar di. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1834 mein prasha (Prussia) ki pahal par sthapit 'jaolverin' (Zollverein) kya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par ek sima shulk sangh (Customs Union) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. ek sainy gathabandhan, ek rajanitik dal, ek dharmik samuh in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ek sima shulk sangh (Customs Union) hi milti hai. Exam point: ek sima shulk sangh (Customs Union) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was employed by industrialists to get new recruits?
qh: औद्योगिक घरानों में नए मजदूरों की भर्ती के लिए किसे नियुक्त किया जाता था?
e: jobar aksar ek purana aur vishvasaniy karmachari hota tha jo ganvon se majaduron ko kam dilane ke lie lata tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki audyogik gharanon mein nae majaduron ki bharti ke lie kise niyukt kiya jata tha? Isi tathya par jobar (Jobber) tika hua hai. Galti gumashta, dalal, mainejar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jobar (Jobber) hi milti hai. Exam point: jobar (Jobber) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was India's first Jute Mill set up?
qh: भारत में पहली जूट मिल (Jute Mill) कहाँ स्थापित की गई थी?
e: bharat ki pahali jut mil 1855 mein bangal mein sthapit ki gai thi. Is sawaal mein bangal (Bengal) ki baat hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par bangal (Bengal) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - kanapur, madras, banbai - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab bangal (Bengal) hai. Exam point: bangal (Bengal) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Where was the goods brought for finishing before being sold in the international market?
qh: फिनिशिंग के लिए तैयार माल को अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार में भेजने से पहले कहाँ लाया जाता था?
e: saudagar sara mal ikattha kar landan late the jahan usaki antim phinishing hoti thi, isilie landan 'phinishing seintar' kahalaya. Is prashn ka vishay landan (London) hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par landan (London) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. emstardam, barlin, peris anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan landan (London) hi milti hai. Exam point: landan (London) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which last dynasty ruled China from 1644 to 1912?
qh: चीन में 1644 से 1912 तक किस अंतिम राजवंश ने शासन किया था?
e: kving rajavansh (jise manchu bhi kaha jata hai) chin ka antim shahi rajavansh tha, jise 1912 mein ganatantr ki sthapana ke sath hata diya gaya. Yah prashn kving rajavansh (manchu) se juda hai. Isi aadhar par kving rajavansh (manchu) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - ming rajavansh, tang rajavansh, han rajavansh - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kving rajavansh (manchu) hai. Exam point: kving rajavansh (manchu) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which 'Three Principles' were given by Dr. Sun Yat-sen for modern China?
qh: डॉ. सन यात-सेन ने आधुनिक चीन के निर्माण के लिए कौन से 'तीन सिद्धांत' दिए थे?
o: राष्ट्रवाद, लोकतंत्र और समाजवाद (Nationalism, Democracy, Socialism)
e: san yat-sen ke 'san min chui' siddhanton ka arth tha rashtravad (videshi satta se mukti), lokatantr aur samajavad (samanata). Prashn is baat par tika hai ki do. san yat-sen ne adhunik chin ke nirman ke lie kaun se 'tin siddhant' die the? Isliye antim jawab rashtravad, lokatantr aur samajavad (Nationalism, Democracy, Socialism) ke roop mein milta hai. ag, pahiya aur loha, shiksha, svasthy aur krishi, yuddh, sandhi aur vyapar in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab rashtravad, lokatantr aur samajavad (Nationalism, Democracy, Socialism) hai. Exam point: rashtravad, lokatantr aur samajavad (Nationalism, Democracy, Socialism) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which movement was launched by Mao in 1958 to modernize China's economy?
qh: माओ जेदांग ने 1958 में चीन की अर्थव्यवस्था को आधुनिक बनाने के लिए कौन सा आंदोलन चलाया?
e: is andolan ke tahat logon ko apane gharon ke pichhe bhattiyan lagakar stil banane ke lie protsahit kiya gaya tha. Yahaan gret lip phoravard (Great Leap Forward) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi karan se gret lip phoravard (Great Leap Forward) sahi uttar hai. phor modarnaijeshan, me phorth muvameint, sanskritik kranti mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad gret lip phoravard (Great Leap Forward) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: gret lip phoravard (Great Leap Forward) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the name of Japan's famous bullet train introduced in 1964?
qh: जापान की प्रसिद्ध बुलेट ट्रेन का क्या नाम है जिसकी शुरुआत 1964 में हुई?
e: shinkansen ya bulet tren japan ki unnat takanik aur vikas ka pratik mani jati hai. Yahaan shinkansen se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par shinkansen hi sahi baithta hai. Galti metro, eksapres, maiglev chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar shinkansen hi hai. Exam point: shinkansen - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which movement was launched in South Korea in the 1970s for rural development?
qh: दक्षिण कोरिया में 1970 के दशक में ग्रामीण विकास के लिए कौन सा आंदोलन चलाया गया?
e: semaul ya 'nyu vilej muvameint' ne koriya ke ganvon ko atmanirbhar aur adhunik banane mein madad ki. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki dakshin koriya mein 1970 ke dashak mein gramin vikas ke lie kaun sa andolan chalaya gaya? Isi karan se semaul andolan (New Village Movement) sahi uttar hai. nili kranti, kvit indiya, svadeshi andolan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se semaul andolan (New Village Movement) sahi hai. Exam point: semaul andolan (New Village Movement) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Where did Chiang Kai-shek flee and form his government after his defeat in 1949?
qh: चियांग काई-शेक 1949 में हारने के बाद भागकर कहाँ गए और अपनी सरकार बनाई?
e: kamyunist parti se harane ke bad chiyang kai-shek taivan chale gae aur vahan 'ripablik oph chaina' ki sthapana ki. Yah prashn taivan (Taiwan) se juda hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par taivan (Taiwan) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. hangakang, japan, makau alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab taivan (Taiwan) hai. Exam point: taivan (Taiwan) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which dynasty ruled Korea before the direct Japanese occupation in 1910?
qh: कोरिया के किस राजा ने 1910 में जापान के प्रत्यक्ष कब्जे से पहले शासन किया था?
e: koriya mein lanbe samay tak josen rajavansh ka shasan raha, jise japan ne 1910 mein samapt kar diya. Prashn yah batata hai ki koriya ke kis raja ne 1910 mein japan ke pratyaksh kabje se pahale shasan kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par josen rajavansh (Joseon Dynasty) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti miji rajavansh, kving rajavansh, ming rajavansh chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav josen rajavansh (Joseon Dynasty) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: josen rajavansh (Joseon Dynasty) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is meant by the 'Meiji Restoration' (1868) in Japan's modernization?
qh: जापान के आधुनिकीकरण में 'मीजी रिस्टोरेशन' (1868) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: सम्राट की सत्ता की पुनर्स्थापना (Restoration of Emperor to power)
e: 1868 mein shogun shasan ko samapt kar samrat (miji) ko phir se shasan ka keindr banaya gaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki japan ke adhunikikaran mein 'miji ristoreshan' (1868) ka kya arth hai? Isi tathya par samrat ki satta ki punarsthapana (Restoration of... tika hua hai. shogun ki satta ki bahali, bauddh dharm ka ant, japan ka vibhajan anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar samrat ki satta ki punarsthapana (Restoration of Emperor to power) hai. Exam point: samrat ki satta ki punarsthapana (Restoration of... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which region of China is famous for 'Dim Sum'?
qh: चीन के किस क्षेत्र का भोजन 'दिम सम' (Dim Sum) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: dakshini chin (kaintan) ka bhojan 'dim sam' ke rup mein jana jata hai jisaka shabdik arth hai 'dil ko chhuna'. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki chin ke kis kshetr ka bhojan 'dim sam' (Dim Sum) ke lie prasiddh hai? Yahi wajah hai ki kaintoni kshetr (Cantonese/South China) sahi hai. Galti uttari chin, peking, shanghai chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kaintoni kshetr (Cantonese/South China) hi milti hai. Exam point: kaintoni kshetr (Cantonese/South China) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who supported South Korea during the Korean War (1950-1953)?
qh: कोरियाई युद्ध (1950-1953) के दौरान दक्षिण कोरिया को किसका समर्थन प्राप्त था?
o: संयुक्त राष्ट्र और अमेरिका (UN and USA)
e: koriyai yuddh ek 'proksi vor' tha jahan dakshin ko amerika aur uttar ko kamyunist chin ka samarthan mila. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki koriyai yuddh (1950-1953) ke dauran dakshin koriya ko kisaka samarthan prapt tha? In tathyon ke chalte sanyukt rashtr aur amerika (UN and USA) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - japan, soviyat sangh, chin - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar sanyukt rashtr aur amerika (UN and USA) hi hai. Exam point: sanyukt rashtr aur amerika (UN and USA) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main purpose of the 'Cultural Revolution' launched in 1965?
qh: चीन में 1965 में शुरू हुई 'सांस्कृतिक क्रांति' (Cultural Revolution) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: पुरानी विचारधाराओं को खत्म कर माओ की सत्ता मजबूत करना (Eliminate critics of Mao)
e: mao ne apane virodhiyon ko kuchalane ke lie 'red gards' (chhatron) ke jarie yah kranti chalai thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki chin mein 1965 mein shuru hui 'sanskritik kranti' (Cultural Revolution) ka mukhy uddeshy kya tha? Isi karan se purani vicharadharaon ko khatm kar mao ki... sahi uttar hai. vyapar badhana, angreji sikhana, keval peinting banana ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab purani vicharadharaon ko khatm kar mao ki... hai. Exam point: purani vicharadharaon ko khatm kar mao ki satta majabut karana (Eliminate critics of Mao) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the Parliament of Japan called?
qh: जापान की संसद को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: japan ki sansad ka nam 'dait' hai, jo miji sanvidhan ke tahat sthapit ki gai thi. Yahaan dait (Diet) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Yahi wajah hai ki dait (Diet) sahi hai. Galti kangres, majalis, sinet chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan dait (Diet) hi milti hai. Exam point: dait (Diet) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: From where did the native people of North America originally come?
qh: उत्तरी अमेरिका के मूल निवासी (Native People) मूल रूप से कहाँ से आए थे?
e: mana jata hai ki lagabhag 30,000 sal pahale eshiya ke log bering stret (Bering Strait) ke raste uttari amerika pahunche the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki uttari amerika ke mul nivasi (Native People) mul rup se kahan se ae the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par eshiya (Asia) sahi nikalta hai. ostreliya, yurop, aphrika in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad eshiya (Asia) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: eshiya (Asia) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What name did Christopher Columbus give to the people of America when he discovered it in 1492?
qh: क्रिस्टोफर कोलंबस ने 1492 में जब अमेरिका की खोज की, तो उसने वहाँ के लोगों को क्या नाम दिया?
e: kolanbas bharat (India) khojane nikala tha, isalie jab vah amerika pahuncha to usane vahan ke logon ko galati se 'indiyans' samajh liya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kristophar kolanbas ne 1492 mein jab amerika ki khoj ki, to usane vahan ke logon ko kya nam diya? Isi tathya par red indiyans (Indians) tika hua hai. aphrikan, eborijin, amerikan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar red indiyans (Indians) hi hai. Exam point: red indiyans (Indians) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the belt made of shells, exchanged as a gift by North American natives, called?
qh: उत्तरी अमेरिका के मूल निवासियों द्वारा उपहार के रूप में दी जाने वाली वह बेल्ट क्या कहलाती थी जो 'शंख' से बनी होती थी?
e: vamapum belt rangin motiyon ya shankhon se bani hoti thi aur ise kabilon ke bich mitrata ka pratik mana jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki uttari amerika ke mul nivasiyon dvara upahar ke rup mein di jane vali vah belt kya kahalati thi jo 'shankh' se bani hoti thi? Isi aadhar par vamapum belt (Wampum Belt) chuna jaata hai. gold belt, silk belt, ledar belt in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad vamapum belt (Wampum Belt) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: vamapum belt (Wampum Belt) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which state was the main center of the 'Gold Rush' in the USA during the 1840s?
qh: 1840 के दशक में अमेरिका में 'गोल्ड रश' (Gold Rush) का मुख्य केंद्र कौन सा राज्य था?
e: kailiphorniya mein sone ke bhandar milane ki khabar se hajaron yuropiy log amerika ki or bhagane lage, jise 'gold rash' kaha gaya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1840 ke dashak mein amerika mein 'gold rash' (Gold Rush) ka mukhy keindr kaun sa rajy tha? Isliye antim jawab kailiphorniya (California) ke roop mein milta hai. nyuyork, teksas, jorjiya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar kailiphorniya (California) hai. Exam point: kailiphorniya (California) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the 'Trail of Tears' signify for the native Americans?
qh: अमेरिका के मूल निवासियों के लिए 'ट्रेल ऑफ टियर्स' (Trail of Tears) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: जबरन विस्थापन का दुखद रास्ता (Forced displacement)
e: 1830 ke dashak mein chiroki (Cherokee) kabile ko unaki jamin se jabaran hatakar registan ki or dhakela gaya, jisamein hajaron log mare gae. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki amerika ke mul nivasiyon ke lie 'trel oph tiyars' (Trail of Tears) ka kya arth hai? Isliye sahi nateeja jabaran visthapan ka dukhad rasta (Forced displacement) nikalta hai. vyapar ka marg, dharmik yatra, ek paryatan sthal ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jabaran visthapan ka dukhad rasta (Forced displacement) hi milti hai. Exam point: jabaran visthapan ka dukhad rasta (Forced displacement) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the term 'Aborigine' mean for the native people of Australia?
qh: ऑस्ट्रेलिया के मूल निवासियों के लिए 'एबोरिजिन' (Aborigine) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: शुरुआत से रहने वाले (From the beginning)
e: laitin mein 'Ab' ka arth 'se' aur 'Origin' ka arth 'shuruat' hota hai. ye ostreliya ke prachinatam rahavasi hain. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki ostreliya ke mul nivasiyon ke lie 'eborijin' (Aborigine) shabd ka kya arth hai? Isi tathya par shuruat se rahane vale (From the beginning) tika hua hai. bahar se ae log, ghudasavar, vyapari mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar shuruat se rahane vale (From the beginning) baithta hai. Exam point: shuruat se rahane vale (From the beginning) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What did the 'Terra Nullius' policy mean in Australia?
qh: ऑस्ट्रेलिया में 'टेरा नलियस' (Terra Nullius) सिद्धांत का क्या अर्थ था?
o: किसी की जमीन नहीं (Land belonging to no one)
e: yuropiy logon ne ostreliya ko 'tera naliyas' ghoshit kiya taki ve bina kisi triti ke mul nivasiyon ki jamin chhin sakein. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki ostreliya mein 'tera naliyas' (Terra Nullius) siddhant ka kya arth tha? Isliye antim jawab kisi ki jamin nahin (Land belonging to... ke roop mein milta hai. raja ki jamin, sabhi ki jamin, pavitr jamin is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kisi ki jamin nahin (Land belonging to no one) hi milti hai. Exam point: kisi ki jamin nahin (Land belonging to no one) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which day is celebrated in Australia every year on 26th May?
qh: ऑस्ट्रेलिया में हर साल 26 मई को कौन सा दिवस मनाया जाता है?
e: yah din un bachchon aur mul nivasiyon se maphi mangane ke lie manaya jata hai jin par yuropiy shasan ke dauran atyachar hue. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki ostreliya mein har sal 26 mai ko kaun sa divas manaya jata hai? Isi karan se neshanal sori de (National Sorry Day) sahi uttar hai. gold de, svatantrata divas, adivasi divas is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad neshanal sori de (National Sorry Day) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: neshanal sori de (National Sorry Day) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which two European powers influenced Canada during its establishment?
qh: कनाडा की स्थापना के समय वहाँ कौन सी दो यूरोपीय शक्तियों का प्रभाव था?
e: kanada mein shuruat mein phrans aur bad mein briten ka kabja raha, jisake karan vahan aj bhi do adhikarik bhashaen hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kanada ki sthapana ke samay vahan kaun si do yuropiy shaktiyon ka prabhav tha? Isi aadhar par british aur phreinch (British and French) chuna jaata hai. rusi aur ameriki, dach aur jarman, spen aur purtagal is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan british aur phreinch (British and French) hi milti hai. Exam point: british aur phreinch (British and French) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were 'Reservations' in the context of the USA?
qh: अमेरिका में 'रिजर्वेशन' (Reservations) किसे कहा गया?
o: मूल निवासियों के लिए छोटा और खराब इलाका (Small areas for natives)
e: netivs ko unaki upajau jamin se hatakar jin chhote aur shushk ilakon mein rahane ko majabur kiya gaya, unhein rijarveshan kaha gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki amerika mein 'rijarveshan' (Reservations) kise kaha gaya? jagir wo zameen thi jiski aay ka haq sarkar kisi adhikari ya sipahi ko deti thi. Isi karan se mul nivasiyon ke lie chhota aur kharab ilaka (Small areas for natives) sahi uttar hai. sainikon ka adda, hotal ki buking, amiron ki jagir ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar mul nivasiyon ke lie chhota aur kharab ilaka (Small areas for natives) baithta hai. Exam point: mul nivasiyon ke lie chhota aur kharab... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which US president suggested that the extermination of natives might be justified?
qh: किस अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ने कहा था कि 'अगर मूल निवासियों को मार भी दिया जाए तो गलत नहीं होगा'?
e: thomas jepharasan aur unake samakalin netaon ka manana tha ki asabhy mul nivasiyon ka khatm hona vikas ke lie jaruri hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki kis ameriki rashtrapati ne kaha tha ki 'agar mul nivasiyon ko mar bhi diya jae to galat nahin hoga'? Yahi wajah hai ki thomas jepharasan (Thomas Jefferson) sahi hai. Galti jorj vashingatan, obama, abraham linkan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan thomas jepharasan (Thomas Jefferson) hi milti hai. Exam point: thomas jepharasan (Thomas Jefferson) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What does the word 'Canberra', the capital of Australia, mean?
qh: ऑस्ट्रेलिया की राजधानी 'कैनबरा' (Canberra) शब्द का अर्थ क्या है?
e: mul nivasiyon ki bhasha mein kainabara ka arth 'milane ka sthan' hota hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki ostreliya ki rajadhani 'kainabara' (Canberra) shabd ka arth kya hai? Isi karan se milane ki jagah (Meeting Place) sahi uttar hai. pahadaon ki rani, samudr ka kinara, sone ki khan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav milane ki jagah (Meeting Place) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: milane ki jagah (Meeting Place) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The American Civil War (1861-1865) was based on which primary issue?
qh: 1861-1865 के बीच अमेरिका में हुआ 'सिविल वॉर' किस मुद्दे पर आधारित था?
e: uttari rajyon ne das pratha khatm karane ki mang ki jabaki dakshini rajy ise banae rakhana chahate the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1861-1865 ke bich amerika mein hua 'sivil vor' kis mudde par adharit tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par das pratha ya gulami (Slavery) hi sahi baithta hai. videshi vyapar, jamin ka vivad, sone ki khoj anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab das pratha ya gulami (Slavery) hai. Exam point: das pratha ya gulami (Slavery) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who are referred to as 'First Nations People' in Canada?
qh: कनाडा में 'फर्स्ट नेशंस पीपल' (First Nations People) किन्हें कहा जाता है?
o: कनाडा के मूल निवासी (Indigenous people of Canada)
e: yah shabd kanada ke un mul nivasiyon ke lie upayog kiya jata hai jo vahan yuropiy logon ke ane se pahale se rah rahe the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kanada mein 'pharst neshans pipal' (First Nations People) kinhein kaha jata hai? Isi karan se kanada ke mul nivasi (Indigenous people of Canada) sahi uttar hai. Galti sainik adhikari, yuropiy pravasi, charch ke padari chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar kanada ke mul nivasi (Indigenous people of Canada) hai. Exam point: kanada ke mul nivasi (Indigenous people of... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the European captain who first reached the coast of Australia in 1770?
qh: 1770 में ऑस्ट्रेलिया के तट पर सबसे पहले पहुँचने वाले यूरोपीय कैप्टन कौन थे?
e: kaiptan jems kuk ne sabase pahale ostreliya ke purvi tat ki khoj ki aur ise nyu sauth vels ka nam diya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1770 mein ostreliya ke tat par sabase pahale pahunchane vale yuropiy kaiptan kaun the? Isi karan se kaiptan jems kuk (Captain James Cook) sahi uttar hai. kolanbas, tasman, vasko di gama ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar kaiptan jems kuk (Captain James Cook) hi hai. Exam point: kaiptan jems kuk (Captain James Cook) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Why did Europeans mass slaughter the Bison in North America?
qh: उत्तरी अमेरिका में जंगली भैंसों (Bison) को यूरोपीय लोगों ने बड़े पैमाने पर क्यों मारा?
o: मूल निवासियों की आजीविका खत्म करने के लिए (To destroy native livelihood)
e: netivs puri tarah se baisan par nirbhar the, unhein khatm kar yuropiyanon ne netivs ko atmasamarpan ke lie majabur kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki uttari amerika mein jangali bhainson (Bison) ko yuropiy logon ne badae paimane par kyon mara? Isliye antim jawab mul nivasiyon ki ajivika khatm karane ke... ke roop mein milta hai. keval shauk ke lie, bimari se bachane ke lie, kheti karane ke lie ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar mul nivasiyon ki ajivika khatm karane ke... hi hai. Exam point: mul nivasiyon ki ajivika khatm karane ke lie (To destroy native livelihood) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which US state was the Cherokee tribe denied citizenship rights despite adopting European culture?
qh: अमेरिका के किस राज्य में 'चिरोकी' (Cherokee) कबीले को नागरिकता के अधिकार से वंचित रखा गया था?
e: jorjiya rajy ne chiroki kabile ko unake adhikaron se vanchit rakha aur unhein apani jamin chhodane par majabur kiya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki amerika ke kis rajy mein 'chiroki' (Cherokee) kabile ko nagarikata ke adhikar se vanchit rakha gaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par jorjiya (Georgia) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. nyuyork, alaska, kailiphorniya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab jorjiya (Georgia) hai. Exam point: jorjiya (Georgia) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: How was Australia initially used by the European (British) settlers?
qh: यूरोपियन सेटलर्स द्वारा ऑस्ट्रेलिया को शुरू में किस रूप में इस्तेमाल किया गया था?
o: सजायाफ्ता कैदियों की कॉलोनी (Penal Colony for convicts)
e: briten ne shuruat mein apane kaidiyon ko ostreliya bhejana shuru kiya taki ve vahan mehanat kar apana jivan bita sakein. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki yuropiyan setalars dvara ostreliya ko shuru mein kis rup mein istemal kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sajayaphta kaidiyon ki koloni (Penal Colony for... sahi nikalta hai. dharmik sthal, keval sone ki khan, paryatan keindr mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sajayaphta kaidiyon ki koloni (Penal Colony for convicts) hi milti hai. Exam point: sajayaphta kaidiyon ki koloni (Penal Colony for convicts) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who discovered the sea route to India in 1498?
qh: 1498 में भारत के लिए समुद्री रास्ते की खोज किसने की थी?
e: purtagali navik vasko di gama ne kep oph gud hop ke raste bharat pahunchane ka samudri rasta khoja. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 1498 mein bharat ke lie samudri raste ki khoj kisane ki thi? Isi tathya par vasko di gama (Vasco da Gama) tika hua hai. kolanbas, kaiptan kuk, amerigo vespusi mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar vasko di gama (Vasco da Gama) baithta hai. Exam point: vasko di gama (Vasco da Gama) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the significance of the 'Indian Reorganization Act' of 1934?
qh: 1934 के 'इंडियन रीऑर्गेनाइजेशन एक्ट' का क्या महत्व था?
o: उन्हें देश से निकाल दिया गया
नेटिव्स को जमीन खरीदने के अधिकार मिले (Right to buy land)
e: is ekt ke madhyam se amerika ke mul nivasiyon ko rijarveshan mein jamin kharidane aur nagarikata ke kuchh hak die gae. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1934 ke 'indiyan riorgenaijeshan ekt' ka kya mahatv tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par netivs ko jamin kharidane ke adhikar mile (Right to buy land) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. unaka dharm badal diya gaya, sare taiks badha die gae, unhein desh se nikal diya gaya mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan netivs ko jamin kharidane ke adhikar mile... hi milti hai. Exam point: netivs ko jamin kharidane ke adhikar mile... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which official language of Canada reflects French influence?
qh: कनाडा की वह कौन सी आधिकारिक भाषा है जो फ्रांस के प्रभाव को दर्शाती है?
e: kanada ke kyubek (Quebec) kshetr mein phransisi prabhav ke karan phreinch aj bhi vahan ki ek pramukh adhikarik bhasha hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kanada ki vah kaun si adhikarik bhasha hai jo phrans ke prabhav ko darshati hai? Isliye sahi nateeja phreinch (French) nikalta hai. jarman, spenish, angreji mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab phreinch (French) hai. Exam point: phreinch (French) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the 'New World' mean for the Europeans?
qh: यूरोपीय लोगों के लिए 'न्यू वर्ल्ड' (New World) से क्या तात्पर्य था?
e: amerika aur any nai khoji gai jaminon ko yuropiyanon ne 'nai duniya' ya nyu varld kaha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki yuropiy logon ke lie 'nyu varld' (New World) se kya tatpary tha? Isliye antim jawab amerika aur ostreliya (The Americas) ke roop mein milta hai. prachin sabhyataen, bharat aur chin, keval inglaind in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar amerika aur ostreliya (The Americas) hi hai. Exam point: amerika aur ostreliya (The Americas) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the primary reason for the sharp decline in the population of Australian natives in the 19th century?
qh: ऑस्ट्रेलिया के मूल निवासियों की जनसंख्या में 19वीं सदी में भारी गिरावट का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: यूरोपीय बीमारियाँ और विस्थापन (European diseases and displacement)
e: yuropiy logon ke sath ai bimariyon (jaise chechak) aur unaki hinsak nitiyon ne 90% mul nivasiyon ko khatm kar diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ostreliya ke mul nivasiyon ki janasankhya mein 19vin sadi mein bhari giravat ka mukhy karan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par yuropiy bimariyan aur visthapan (European diseases and... sahi nikalta hai. Vikalp samudri tuphan, keval apasi yuddh, sone ki kami bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar yuropiy bimariyan aur visthapan (European diseases and displacement) hi hai. Exam point: yuropiy bimariyan aur visthapan (European diseases and displacement) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which French philosopher praised American natives as being untouched by corrupt civilization?
qh: किस फ्रांसीसी दार्शनिक ने अमेरिका के मूल निवासियों को 'नेक जंगली' (Noble Savage) कहा था?
e: ruso ka manana tha ki ye log sabhyata ke bhrashtachar se dur aur shuddh hriday ke hain. Prashn yah batata hai ki kis phransisi darshanik ne amerika ke mul nivasiyon ko 'nek jangali' (Noble Savage) kaha tha? Isi tathya par jin jaik ruso (Jean-Jacques Rousseau) tika hua hai. monteskyu, karl marks, volteyar in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav jin jaik ruso (Jean-Jacques Rousseau) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: jin jaik ruso (Jean-Jacques Rousseau) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the primary early economic objective of Europeans in North America?
qh: उत्तरी अमेरिका में यूरोपीय लोगों के आने का सबसे पहला और मुख्य आर्थिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: मछली और फर का व्यापार (Fish and Fur trade)
e: shuruat mein phransisi aur british vyapari amerika mein machhali aur janavaron ki khal (Fur) ke vyapar ke lie ae the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki uttari amerika mein yuropiy logon ke ane ka sabase pahala aur mukhy arthik uddeshy kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par machhali aur phar ka vyapar (Fish and Fur trade) hi sahi baithta hai. relave banana, sona khojana, dharm prachar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad machhali aur phar ka vyapar (Fish and... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: machhali aur phar ka vyapar (Fish and Fur trade) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who invented the modern printing press in Germany around 1448?
qh: जर्मनी में आधुनिक प्रिंटिंग प्रेस का आविष्कार लगभग 1448 में किसने किया था?
e: johans gutenabarg ne dhatu ke aksharon vali pahali maikenikal printing pres vikasit ki, jisase jnan ka prasar tej hua. Prashn yah batata hai ki jarmani mein adhunik printing pres ka avishkar lagabhag 1448 mein kisane kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja johans gutenabarg (Johannes Gutenberg) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - albart dyur, martin luthar, koparanikas - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad johans gutenabarg (Johannes Gutenberg) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: johans gutenabarg (Johannes Gutenberg) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who started the 'Protestant Reformation' movement in Europe?
qh: यूरोप में 'प्रोटेस्टेंट सुधार' (Protestant Reformation) आंदोलन की शुरुआत किसने की थी?
e: jarman bhikshu martin luthar ne kaitholik charch ki buraiyon ke khilaph '95 thisis' likhi aur virodh shuru kiya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki yurop mein 'protesteint sudhar' (Protestant Reformation) andolan ki shuruat kisane ki thi? Isi tathya par martin luthar (Martin Luther) tika hua hai. thomas mor, irasmas, jon kelvin is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se martin luthar (Martin Luther) sahi hai. Exam point: martin luthar (Martin Luther) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which scientist first proposed that 'The Earth revolves around the Sun'?
qh: किस वैज्ञानिक ने सबसे पहले यह सिद्धांत दिया कि 'पृथ्वी सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमती है'?
e: koparanikas ne 'hiliyoseintrik' siddhant diya, jisane charch ki is manyata ko chunauti di ki prithvi brahmand ka keindr hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki kis vaijnanik ne sabase pahale yah siddhant diya ki 'prithvi sury ke charon or ghumati hai'? Isi karan se koparanikas (Copernicus) sahi uttar hai. nyutan, keplar, gaililiyo in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan koparanikas (Copernicus) hi milti hai. Exam point: koparanikas (Copernicus) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who translated the Bible into English and criticized the clergy?
qh: किसने बाइबल का अंग्रेजी में अनुवाद किया और पादरियों की आलोचना की?
e: viliyam tindal ne baibal ka anuvad kiya taki am log ise padh sakein aur charch ke niyantran se mukt hon. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kisane baibal ka angreji mein anuvad kiya aur padariyon ki alochana ki?
