Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par viliyam tindal (William Tyndale) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. ruso, thomas pen, martin luthar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan viliyam tindal (William Tyndale) hi milti hai. Exam point: viliyam tindal (William Tyndale) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who founded the 'Society of Jesus' in 1540?
qh: 1540 में 'सोसाइटी ऑफ जीसस' (Society of Jesus) की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: igneshiyas loyola ne kaitholik dharm ke bhitar sudhar aur shiksha ke prasar ke lie jesuit sangh ki sthapana ki. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1540 mein 'sosaiti oph jisas' (Society of Jesus) ki sthapana kisane ki thi? Isliye sahi nateeja igneshiyas loyola (Ignatius Loyola) nikalta hai. kansatenatain, martin luthar, bishap anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se igneshiyas loyola (Ignatius Loyola) sahi hai. Exam point: igneshiyas loyola (Ignatius Loyola) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was Isaac Newton's greatest contribution to science?
qh: आइजैक न्यूटन का विज्ञान के क्षेत्र में सबसे बड़ा योगदान क्या था?
e: nyutan ne gurutvakarshan aur gati ke niyamon ki khoj ki, jisane adhunik bhautiki ki ninv rakhi. Prashn yah batata hai ki aijaik nyutan ka vijnan ke kshetr mein sabase bada yogadan kya tha? Isi aadhar par gurutvakarshan ka siddhant (Theory of Gravitation) chuna jaata hai. hriday ki sanrachana, printing pres, bhap ka injan ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav gurutvakarshan ka siddhant (Theory of Gravitation) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: gurutvakarshan ka siddhant (Theory of Gravitation) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: With which instrument did Galileo confirm Copernicus's theory?
qh: गैलीलियो गैलीली ने किस यंत्र की मदद से कोपरनिकस के सिद्धांत की पुष्टि की?
e: gaililiyo ne durabin (teliskop) ka upayog karake akashiy pindon ka nirikshan kiya aur sauramandal ki nai samajh vikasit ki. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gaililiyo gailili ne kis yantr ki madad se koparanikas ke siddhant ki pushti ki? Isi karan se teliskop (Telescope) sahi uttar hai. maikroskop, tharmamitar, bairomitar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar teliskop (Telescope) baithta hai. Exam point: teliskop (Telescope) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What were 'Indulgences' sold by the Church?
qh: चर्च द्वारा बेचे जाने वाले 'इंडलजेंस' (Indulgence) या 'क्षमा पत्र' क्या थे?
o: पापों से मुक्ति का पत्र (Documents to free one from sins)
e: kaitholik charch paise lekar aise patr bechata tha jo dava karate the ki isase vyakti ke papon ka bojh khatm ho jaega. Prashn yah batata hai ki charch dvara beche jane vale 'indalajeins' (Indulgence) ya 'kshama patr' kya the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par papon se mukti ka patr (Documents to... sahi nikalta hai. shiksha ke praman patr, vyapar laiseins, shadi ka nimantran alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab papon se mukti ka patr (Documents to... hai. Exam point: papon se mukti ka patr (Documents to free one from sins) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What new information about the solar system did Kepler provide?
qh: केप्लर ने सौरमंडल के बारे में कौन सी नई जानकारी दी थी?
o: ग्रह सूर्य के चारों ओर अंडाकार पथ (Elliptical path) में घूमते हैं
e: keplar ne sabit kiya ki grahon ki kakshaen gol nahin balki andakar (Elliptical) hoti hain. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki keplar ne sauramandal ke bare mein kaun si nai janakari di thi? Isi tathya par grah sury ke charon or andakar path... tika hua hai. Vikalp sury thanda hai, grah sthir hain, prithvi chaukor hai bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar grah sury ke charon or andakar path (Elliptical path) mein ghumate hain hai. Exam point: grah sury ke charon or andakar path (Elliptical path) mein ghumate hain - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which countries did the earliest print technology (Hand Printing) originate?
qh: मुद्रण की सबसे पुरानी तकनीक (Hand Printing) की शुरुआत किन देशों में हुई थी?
e: mudran ki sabase purani takanik chin, japan aur koriya mein vikasit hui thi, jahan hathon se chhapai ki jati thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki mudran ki sabase purani takanik (Hand Printing) ki shuruat kin deshon mein hui thi? Isliye sahi nateeja chin, japan aur koriya nikalta hai. Vikalp jarmani, phrans aur itali, briten, amerika aur rus, bharat, chin aur misr bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar chin, japan aur koriya hai. Exam point: chin, japan aur koriya - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the feature of the traditional 'Accordion Book' printed in China?
qh: चीन में पारंपरिक रूप से मुद्रित 'एकार्डियन बुक' (Accordion Book) की क्या विशेषता थी?
o: इसे दोनों तरफ छापा गया था
इसे किनारे से सिलकर मोड़ा गया था (Stitched and folded)
e: chin ki paranparik ekardiyan buk kagaj ko ek taraph chhapakar use kinaron se silakar banai jati thi kyonki kagaj bahut patala tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki chin mein paranparik rup se mudrit 'ekardiyan buk' (Accordion Book) ki kya visheshata thi? Isi karan se ise kinare se silakar moda gaya tha (Stitched and folded) sahi uttar hai. yah dhatu ki bani thi, yah puri tarah rangin thi, ise donon taraph chhapa gaya tha mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad ise kinare se silakar moda gaya tha... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ise kinare se silakar moda gaya tha (Stitched and folded) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which is the oldest printed book of Japan?
qh: जापान की सबसे पुरानी मुद्रित पुस्तक कौन सी है?
e: 868 isvi mein chhapi 'buddhist dayamand sutr' japan ki sabase purani mudrit pustak hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki japan ki sabase purani mudrit pustak kaun si hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par hira sutr (Diamond Sutra) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti kuran, baibal, tripitak chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar hira sutr (Diamond Sutra) hi hai. Exam point: hira sutr (Diamond Sutra) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who brought the Woodblock printing technology from China to Europe?
qh: चीन से लकड़ी के ब्लॉक वाली छपाई (Woodblock Printing) की तकनीक यूरोप कौन लेकर गया था?
e: marko polo 1295 mein chin se vudablok printing ki takanik lekar itali laute, jahan se yah pure yurop mein phaili. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki chin se lakadai ke blok vali chhapai (Woodblock Printing) ki takanik yurop kaun lekar gaya tha? Isi tathya par marko polo (Marco Polo) tika hua hai. gutenabarg, vasko di gama, kolanbas is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad marko polo (Marco Polo) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: marko polo (Marco Polo) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the expensive writing material made from animal skin used for elites in Europe called?
qh: यूरोप में अमीरों के लिए लिखने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाले कीमती चर्मपत्र को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: abhijat varg ke log mudrit kitabon ko ghatiya manate the aur 'velam' (janavaron ki khal se bana charmapatr) par hath se likhi kitabon ko prathamikata dete the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki yurop mein amiron ke lie likhane ke lie istemal hone vale kimati charmapatr ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi karan se velam (Vellum) sahi uttar hai. shilalekh, kagaj, tadapatr alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar velam (Vellum) hai. Exam point: velam (Vellum) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who invented the modern printing press?
qh: आधुनिक प्रिंटिंग प्रेस का आविष्कार किसने किया था?
e: johans gutenabarg ne 1440 ke dashak mein jarmani ke strasabarg mein pahali printing pres vikasit ki thi. Is prashn ka vishay johans gutenabarg (Johannes Gutenberg) hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par johans gutenabarg (Johannes Gutenberg) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. irasmas, richard em ho, martin luthar anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar johans gutenabarg (Johannes Gutenberg) baithta hai. Exam point: johans gutenabarg (Johannes Gutenberg) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which was the first book printed by the Gutenberg press?
qh: गुटेनबर्ग प्रेस द्वारा मुद्रित पहली पुस्तक कौन सी थी?
e: gutenabarg ne apani mashin se sabase pahale baibal ki 180 pratiyan tin sal mein chhapi thin. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gutenabarg pres dvara mudrit pahali pustak kaun si thi? Isliye sahi nateeja baibal (Bible) nikalta hai. Galti dayamand sutr, 95 thisis, sanvad kaumudi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar baibal (Bible) hi hai. Exam point: baibal (Bible) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who criticized the Roman Catholic Church by writing '95 Theses'?
qh: '95 थीसिस' (95 Theses) लिखकर रोमन कैथोलिक चर्च की आलोचना किसने की थी?
e: martin luthar ne apani 95 thisis mein charch ki kuritiyon ki alochana ki, jisase 'protesteint sudhar' andolan shuru hua. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki '95 thisis' (95 Theses) likhakar roman kaitholik charch ki alochana kisane ki thi? Isi aadhar par martin luthar (Martin Luther) chuna jaata hai. ruso, lui sebestiyan marsiyar, menokiyo ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan martin luthar (Martin Luther) hi milti hai. Exam point: martin luthar (Martin Luther) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who called printing 'God's greatest gift'?
qh: किसने मुद्रण को 'ईश्वर की दी हुई महानतम देन' कहा था?
e: martin luthar mudran ke bahut badae prashansak the aur unhonne ise ishvar ka sabase bada upahar aur sabase badai den mana. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kisane mudran ko 'ishvar ki di hui mahanatam den' kaha tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par martin luthar (Martin Luther) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - mahatma gandhi, johans gutenabarg, ruso - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad martin luthar (Martin Luther) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: martin luthar (Martin Luther) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who was the Italian miller executed for reinterpreting the Bible message in the 16th century?
qh: 16वीं शताब्दी के इटली में बाइबल का नया अर्थ निकालकर चर्च को नाराज करने वाले किसान का क्या नाम था?
e: menokiyo ne sthaniy rup se upalabdh kitabon ko padhakar baibal ka naya arth nikala, jisake karan use dharmik adalat ne maut ki saja di. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 16vin shatabdi ke itali mein baibal ka naya arth nikalakar charch ko naraj karane vale kisan ka kya nam tha? Isliye antim jawab menokiyo (Menocchio) ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp valteyar, irasmas, gutenabarg bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar menokiyo (Menocchio) hi hai. Exam point: menokiyo (Menocchio) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What were the small, cheap books sold by pedlars in England called?
qh: इंग्लैंड में फेरीवालों द्वारा बेची जाने वाली सस्ती और छोटी किताबों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: inglaind mein ek paise mein bikane vali in chhoti kitabon ko 'chaipabuks' kaha jata tha aur inhein bechane valon ko 'chaipamain' kahate the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki inglaind mein pherivalon dvara bechi jane vali sasti aur chhoti kitabon ko kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par chaipabuks (Chapbooks) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti baibaliyothek blu, ullekh, panchang chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar chaipabuks (Chapbooks) baithta hai. Exam point: chaipabuks (Chapbooks) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was 'Bibliotheque Bleue' in France?
qh: फ्रांस में 'बाइबलियोथेक ब्लू' (Bibliotheque Bleue) क्या थी?
o: सस्ते कागज पर छपी छोटी नीली किताबें (Cheap blue books)
e: phrans mein kharab kagaj par chhapi aur nili jild vali sasti kitabon ko 'baibaliyothek blu' kaha jata tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki phrans mein 'baibaliyothek blu' (Bibliotheque Bleue) kya thi? Isi karan se saste kagaj par chhapi chhoti nili kitabein... sahi uttar hai. ek dharmik akhabar, ek vishal pustakalay, nile rang ki syahi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar saste kagaj par chhapi chhoti nili kitabein (Cheap blue books) hi hai. Exam point: saste kagaj par chhapi chhoti nili kitabein (Cheap blue books) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who started the publication of 'Sambad Kaumudi' in 1821?
qh: 1821 में 'संवाद कौमुदी' (Sambad Kaumudi) का प्रकाशन किसने शुरू किया था?
e: raja ramamohan ray ne samajik-dharmik sudharon par bahas karane ke lie 'sanvad kaumudi' ka prakashan shuru kiya tha. Yah prashn raja ramamohan ray (Raja Rammohun Roy) se juda hai. Isi tathya par raja ramamohan ray (Raja Rammohun Roy) tika hua hai. ishvar chandr vidyasagar, mahatma gandhi, bal gangadhar tilak ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se raja ramamohan ray (Raja Rammohun Roy) sahi hai. Exam point: raja ramamohan ray (Raja Rammohun Roy) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the Deoband Seminary publish thousands of fatwas in 1867?
qh: 1867 में देवबंद मदरसे ने फतवों के हजारों संस्करण क्यों छापे?
o: अंग्रेजों का समर्थन करने के लिए
हिन्दू धर्म की आलोचना के लिए
मुसलमानों को रोजमर्रा का मार्गदर्शन देने के लिए (To guide Muslims)
e: muslim vidvanon ne dar ke karan ki angrej dharm badal deinge, musalamanon ko islami acharan samajhane ke lie hajaron phatave jari kie. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1867 mein devaband madarase ne phatavon ke hajaron sanskaran kyon chhape? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par musalamanon ko rojamarra ka margadarshan dene ke... sahi nikalta hai. vyapar badhane ke lie, angrejon ka samarthan karane ke lie, hindu dharm ki alochana ke lie ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan musalamanon ko rojamarra ka margadarshan dene ke... hi milti hai. Exam point: musalamanon ko rojamarra ka margadarshan dene ke lie (To guide Muslims) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where was the first printed edition of Tulsidas's 'Ramcharitmanas' published in 1810?
qh: तुलसीदास की 'रामचरितमानस' का पहला मुद्रित संस्करण 1810 में कहाँ से प्रकाशित हुआ था?
e: ramacharitamanas ka pahala mudrit sanskaran 1810 mein kalakatta (ab kolakata) se bajar mein aya tha. Is sawaal mein kalakatta (Calcutta) ki baat hai. Isi aadhar par kalakatta (Calcutta) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - lakhanau, varanasi, banbai - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kalakatta (Calcutta) hai. Exam point: kalakatta (Calcutta) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who was the author of 'Aamar Jiban', published in 1876?
qh: 1876 में प्रकाशित 'अमर जीबन' (Aamar Jiban) की लेखिका कौन थी?
e: rashasundari devi ne apani atmakatha 'amar jiban' likhi, jo bangali bhasha mein prakashit pahali purn atmakatha thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1876 mein prakashit 'amar jiban' (Aamar Jiban) ki lekhika kaun thi? Isliye sahi nateeja rashasundari devi (Rashsundari Debi) nikalta hai. kailashabashini devi, pandita ramabai, tarabai shinde alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav rashasundari devi (Rashsundari Debi) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: rashasundari devi (Rashsundari Debi) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who wrote the book 'Gulamgiri' in 1871?
qh: 1871 में 'गुलामगिरी' (Gulamgiri) पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
e: jyotiba phule ne 'gulamagiri' mein jati vyavastha ke anyay aur nimn jati ke shoshan par likha tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1871 mein 'gulamagiri' (Gulamgiri) pustak kisane likhi thi? Isi karan se jyotiba phule sahi uttar hai. Vikalp gandhiji, i.vi. ramasvami nayakar, do. bi.ar. anbedakar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar jyotiba phule hai. Exam point: jyotiba phule - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which act imposed strict censorship on Indian vernacular newspapers?
qh: किस कानून ने भारतीय भाषाओं के अखबारों पर कड़ा सेंसरशिप लागू किया था?
e: 1878 ke varnakular pres ekt ne sarakar ko bharatiy bhashaon ke akhabaron mein chhapane vali riporton ko seinsar karane ka hak diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kis kanun ne bharatiy bhashaon ke akhabaron par kada seinsaraship lagu kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja varnakular pres ekt, 1878 (Vernacular Press Act) nikalta hai. arms ekt, raulet ekt, ilbart bil is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar varnakular pres ekt, 1878 (Vernacular Press Act) hi hai. Exam point: varnakular pres ekt, 1878 (Vernacular Press Act) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: About whom did Bal Gangadhar Tilak write with sympathy in his newspaper 'Kesari'?
qh: बाल गंगाधर तिलक ने अपने अखबार 'केसरी' में किसके बारे में सहानुभूति से लिखा था?

e: tilak ne 1907 mein panjab ke krantikariyon ke nirvasan par sahanubhutipurn lekh likhe, jisake lie unhein jel bheja gaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bal gangadhar tilak ne apane akhabar 'kesari' mein kisake bare mein sahanubhuti se likha tha? Isliye antim jawab panjab ke krantikariyon ke bare mein (Punjab... ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - british rani ke bare mein, mugal rajaon ke bare mein, kisanon ke rin ke bare mein - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav panjab ke krantikariyon ke bare mein (Punjab revolutionaries) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: panjab ke krantikariyon ke bare mein (Punjab revolutionaries) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who brought the first printing press to India?
qh: भारत में मुद्रण तकनीक (Printing Press) सबसे पहले किसके द्वारा लाई गई थी?
e: mudran mashin sabase pahale 16vin shatabdi mein gova mein purtagali dharmapracharakon ke sath bharat ai thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharat mein mudran takanik (Printing Press) sabase pahale kisake dvara lai gai thi? Exam point: purtagali dharmapracharakon dvara (Portuguese Missionaries) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who began editing the 'Bengal Gazette' in 1780?
qh: 1780 में 'बंगाल गजट' (Bengal Gazette) नामक साप्ताहिक पत्रिका का संपादन किसने शुरू किया?
e: jems ogastas hikki ne bangal gajat ka sanpadan shuru kiya, jo ek niji angreji saptahik patrika thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1780 mein 'bangal gajat' (Bengal Gazette) namak saptahik patrika ka sanpadan kisane shuru kiya? In tathyon ke chalte jems ogastas hikki (James Augustus Hickey) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - gangadhar bhattachary, raja ramamohan ray, voren hestings - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav jems ogastas hikki (James Augustus Hickey) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: jems ogastas hikki (James Augustus Hickey) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Why did Kashibaba write 'Chhote Aur Bade Ka Sawal'?
qh: कानपुर के मिल मजदूर काशीबाबा ने 'छोटे और बड़े का सवाल' क्यों लिखा था?
o: जाति और वर्गीय शोषण के संबंध को दिखाने के लिए (Link between caste and class)
धर्म का प्रचार करने के लिए
e: kashibaba ne 1938 mein is kitab ke jarie jati vyavastha aur milon mein hone vale vargiy shoshan ke bich ke sanbandh ko spasht kiya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kanapur ke mil majadur kashibaba ne 'chhote aur badae ka saval' kyon likha tha? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi baat se jati aur vargiy shoshan ke sanbandh ko dikhane ke lie (Link between caste and class) sahi sabit hota hai. kavitaen sunane ke lie, majaduri badhane ke lie, dharm ka prachar karane ke lie anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar jati aur vargiy shoshan ke sanbandh ko dikhane ke lie (Link between caste and class) hi hai. Exam point: jati aur vargiy shoshan ke sanbandh ko dikhane ke lie (Link between caste and class) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What improvement did Richard M. Hoe make in the field of printing in the late 19th century?
qh: 19वीं सदी के अंत में न्यूयॉर्क के 'रिचर्ड एम. हो' ने मुद्रण के क्षेत्र में क्या सुधार किया?

e: richard em. ho ne bijali se chalane vali belanakar pres ko purn kiya, jisase ek ghante mein 8000 panne chhape ja sakate the. Is prashn ka kendra belanakar pres (Cylindrical Press) ko purn kiya hai. Yahi wajah hai ki belanakar pres (Cylindrical Press) ko purn kiya sahi hai. Galti kagaj ka avishkar kiya, lakadai ke blok banae, rangin syahi banai chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar belanakar pres (Cylindrical Press) ko purn kiya hai. Exam point: belanakar pres (Cylindrical Press) ko purn kiya - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main drawback of handwritten Manuscripts?
qh: हस्तलिखित पांडुलिपियों (Manuscripts) की मुख्य कमी क्या थी?

वे केवल नीले रंग में थीं
e: pandulipiyan najuk hoti thin, unhein lana-le jana mushkil tha aur unhein taiyar karana bahut mahanga aur samay lene vala kam tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki hastalikhit pandulipiyon (Manuscripts) ki mukhy kami kya thi? Isi baat se ve najuk aur mahangi thin (Fragile and expensive) sahi sabit hota hai. ve keval nile rang mein thin, ve bahut bhari thin, ve bahut sasti thin ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se ve najuk aur mahangi thin (Fragile and expensive) sahi hai. Exam point: ve najuk aur mahangi thin (Fragile and... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the characteristic of the 'Battala' area in Bengal?
qh: बंगाल के 'बाटला' (Battala) क्षेत्र की क्या विशेषता थी?
o: वहाँ लोकप्रिय और सस्ती किताबों का बाजार था (Market for cheap popular books)
वहाँ केवल लकड़ी के सामान मिलते थे
e: madhy kalakatta ka batala kshetr lokapriy kitabon ke prakashan ka keindr tha, jahan log sasti aur sachitr kitabein kharid sakate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bangal ke 'batala' (Battala) kshetr ki kya visheshata thi? In tathyon ke chalte vahan lokapriy aur sasti kitabon ka bajar tha (Market for cheap popular books) hi sahi hai. vahan koi nahin rahata tha, vahan keval sarakari daphtar the, vahan keval lakadai ke saman milate the ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar vahan lokapriy aur sasti kitabon ka bajar tha (Market for cheap popular books) hi hai. Exam point: vahan lokapriy aur sasti kitabon ka bajar tha (Market for cheap popular books) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who created the first Cotton Mill?
qh: कॉटन मिल (Cotton Mill) का निर्माण सबसे पहले किसने किया था?
e: richard arkarait ne pahali kotan mil ki sthapana ki, jisase kapada utpadan ki puri prakriya ek hi chhat ke niche a gai. Yah prashn richard arkarait (Richard Arkwright) se juda hai. Galti jems vat (James Watt), nyukomen (Newcomen), maithyu boltan (Matthew Boulton) chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan richard arkarait (Richard Arkwright) hi milti hai. Exam point: richard arkarait (Richard Arkwright) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which was Britain's leading industrial sector up to the 1840s?
qh: 1840 के दशक तक ब्रिटेन का सबसे फलता-फूलता उद्योग कौन सा था?
e: audyogikaran ke pahale charan mein suti vastr (Cotton) udyog sabase bada udyog tha, jisake bad loha aur ispat udyog aya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 1840 ke dashak tak briten ka sabase phalata-phulata udyog kaun sa tha? Yahi wajah hai ki suti vastr (Cotton Textiles) sahi hai. loha aur ispat, koyala khanan, jahaj nirman in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav suti vastr (Cotton Textiles) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: suti vastr (Cotton Textiles) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: James Watt improved the steam engine produced by whom?
qh: जेम्स वाट ने किसके द्वारा बनाए गए भाप के इंजन (Steam Engine) में सुधार किया था?
e: jems vat ne nyukomen dvara banae gae bhap ke injan mein sudhar kiya aur 1781 mein ise peteint karaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki jems vat ne kisake dvara banae gae bhap ke injan (Steam Engine) mein sudhar kiya tha? Isliye antim jawab nyukomen (Newcomen) ke roop mein milta hai. richard arkarait, jems haragrivs, maithyu boltan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad nyukomen (Newcomen) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: nyukomen (Newcomen) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Whom did the East India Company appoint to supervise weavers?
qh: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने बुनकरों पर निगरानी रखने के लिए किसे नियुक्त किया था?
e: kanpani ne 'gumashta' namak vetanabhogi karmachari niyukt kie jo bunakaron ki nigarani karate aur mal ikattha karate the. Prashn yah batata hai ki ist indiya kanpani ne bunakaron par nigarani rakhane ke lie kise niyukt kiya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par gumashta (Gomastha) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. majumadar, jobar (Jobber), subedar anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar gumashta (Gomastha) hi hai. Exam point: gumashta (Gomastha) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was employed by industrialists to get new recruits?
qh: औद्योगिक घरानों में नए मजदूरों की भर्ती के लिए किसे रखा जाता था?
e: majaduron ki bharti ke lie udyogapati 'jobar' rakhate the, jo aksar koi purana aur vishvasaniy karmachari hota tha. Is prashn ka vishay jobar (Jobber) hai. Isliye antim jawab jobar (Jobber) ke roop mein milta hai. ejeint, gumashta, saudagar in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav jobar (Jobber) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: jobar (Jobber) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Where was India's first Jute Mill set up?
qh: भारत की पहली जूट मिल (Jute Mill) कहाँ स्थापित की गई थी?
e: bharat ki pahali jut mil 1855 mein bangal mein sthapit ki gai thi. Is sawaal mein bangal (Bengal) ki baat hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bangal (Bengal) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti banbai (Bombay), madras, kanapur chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bangal (Bengal) hi milti hai. Exam point: bangal (Bengal) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main reason for the decline of Manchester imports to India during WWI?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान मैनचेस्टर से भारत आने वाले आयात में गिरावट का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: कच्चा माल खत्म हो गया था
ब्रिटिश कारखाने सेना की जरूरतों के लिए उत्पादन कर रहे थे
e: yuddh ke dauran british milein yuddh samagri banane mein vyast thin, jisase bharatiy milon ko gharelu bajar mil gaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki pratham vishv yuddh ke dauran mainachestar se bharat ane vale ayat mein giravat ka mukhy karan kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja british karakhane sena ki jaruraton ke lie utpadan kar rahe the nikalta hai. Vikalp bharatiyon ne bahishkar kiya, jahaj dub gae the, kachcha mal khatm ho gaya tha bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar british karakhane sena ki jaruraton ke lie utpadan kar rahe the hi hai. Exam point: british karakhane sena ki jaruraton ke lie utpadan kar rahe the - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which technology was used to increase production in the handloom sector?
qh: हथकरघा (Handloom) क्षेत्र में उत्पादन बढ़ाने के लिए किस तकनीक का प्रयोग किया गया?
e: 20vin sadi mein phlai shatal (Fly Shuttle) ke ane se bunakaron ki utpadakata badhai aur ve milon se mukabala kar sake. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki hathakaragha (Handloom) kshetr mein utpadan badhane ke lie kis takanik ka prayog kiya gaya? Isliye sahi nateeja phlai shatal (Fly Shuttle) nikalta hai. Vikalp spining jeni, kanpyutar, stim injan bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se phlai shatal (Fly Shuttle) sahi hai. Exam point: phlai shatal (Fly Shuttle) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Why did Manchester industrialists put 'Made in Manchester' labels on cloth bundles?
qh: मैनचेस्टर के उद्योगपति अपने कपड़ों के बंडल पर 'मेड इन मैनचेस्टर' का लेबल क्यों लगाते थे?
o: गुणवत्ता का प्रतीक बनाने के लिए (Sign of quality)
e: lebal kharidaron ko mal ki gunavatta aur utpadak ke bare mein ashvast karane ke lie lagaya jata tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mainachestar ke udyogapati apane kapadaon ke bandal par 'med in mainachestar' ka lebal kyon lagate the? In tathyon ke chalte gunavatta ka pratik banane ke lie (Sign of quality) hi sahi hai. Galti taiks se bachane ke lie, sajavat ke lie, kimat batane ke lie chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se gunavatta ka pratik banane ke lie (Sign of quality) sahi hai. Exam point: gunavatta ka pratik banane ke lie (Sign of quality) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the main purpose of putting images of Indian gods and goddesses on labels and calendars?
qh: लेबल और कैलेंडरों पर भारतीय देवी-देवताओं की तस्वीरें लगाने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: विदेशी उत्पाद को भारतीयों के लिए परिचित बनाना (Making product familiar)
e: devi-devataon ki tasviron se aisa lagata tha ki utpad ko ishvariy svikriti prapt hai, jisase log use asani se kharidate the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki lebal aur kaileindaron par bharatiy devi-devataon ki tasvirein lagane ka mukhy uddeshy kya tha? Isliye antim jawab videshi utpad ko bharatiyon ke lie parichit... ke roop mein milta hai. dharm ka prachar karana, kala ka pradarshan, chitrakaron ko kam dena alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad videshi utpad ko bharatiyon ke lie parichit... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: videshi utpad ko bharatiyon ke lie parichit... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the famous entrepreneur of Bengal who earned wealth from China trade?
qh: चीन के साथ व्यापार करके पैसा कमाने वाले बंगाल के प्रसिद्ध उद्यमी कौन थे?
e: dvarakanath taigor ne chin ke sath vyapar mein nivesh kiya aur bangal mein kai audyogik udyam sthapit kie. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki chin ke sath vyapar karake paisa kamane vale bangal ke prasiddh udyami kaun the? In tathyon ke chalte dvarakanath taigor (Dwarkanath Tagore) hi sahi hai. ji.di. bidala, jamashedaji tata, dinasho petit is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan dvarakanath taigor (Dwarkanath Tagore) hi milti hai. Exam point: dvarakanath taigor (Dwarkanath Tagore) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why did aristocrats in 19th-century Britain prefer hand-made goods?
qh: 19वीं सदी के ब्रिटेन में 'अभिजात वर्ग' (Aristocrats) हाथ से बनी वस्तुओं को क्यों पसंद करते थे?
o: वे परिष्कृत और विशिष्टता का प्रतीक थीं (Sign of refinement)
e: hath se bani vastuen vishishtata aur behatar phinish ka pratik mani jati thin, jabaki mashini mal niryat ke lie tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 19vin sadi ke briten mein 'abhijat varg' (Aristocrats) hath se bani vastuon ko kyon pasand karate the? Yahi wajah hai ki ve parishkrit aur vishishtata ka pratik thin (Sign of refinement) sahi hai. mashinein kharab thin, ve sasti thin, majaduron ki madad ke lie is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se ve parishkrit aur vishishtata ka pratik thin (Sign of refinement) sahi hai. Exam point: ve parishkrit aur vishishtata ka pratik thin (Sign of refinement) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the name of the cotton mill established in Kanpur?
qh: कानपुर में स्थापित सूती मिल का क्या नाम था?
e: 1860 ke dashak mein kanapur mein elgin mil (Elgin Mill) ki shuruat hui thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kanapur mein sthapit suti mil ka kya nam tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par elgin mil (Elgin Mill) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. rilayans mil, tata mil, bidala mil is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan elgin mil (Elgin Mill) hi milti hai. Exam point: elgin mil (Elgin Mill) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is a Fly Shuttle?
qh: फ्लाई शटल (Fly Shuttle) क्या है?
o: बुनाई के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला यांत्रिक औजार (Mechanical device for weaving)
e: phlai shatal rassiyon aur puliyon ke jarie chalane vala ek yantrik aujar hai jisaka upayog bunai mein kiya jata hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki phlai shatal (Fly Shuttle) kya hai? Yahi wajah hai ki bunai ke lie istemal hone vala yantrik aujar (Mechanical device for weaving) sahi hai. ek naya havai jahaj, kheti ka aujar, katai ki mashin is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad bunai ke lie istemal hone vala yantrik aujar (Mechanical device for weaving) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bunai ke lie istemal hone vala yantrik aujar (Mechanical device for weaving) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which industry was boosted by the Swadeshi movement in early 20th-century India?
qh: 20वीं शताब्दी के प्रारंभ में भारत में स्वदेशी आंदोलन ने किस उद्योग को बढ़ावा दिया?
o: सूती वस्त्र और हथकरघा (Cotton and Handloom)
e: svadeshi andolan ne logon ko videshi kapadaon ke bahishkar aur bharatiy kapadaon (hathakaragha) ke upayog ke lie prerit kiya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 20vin shatabdi ke praranbh mein bharat mein svadeshi andolan ne kis udyog ko badhava diya? swadeshi ka matlab desi maal apnana tatha videshi maal ka bahishkar tha. Isi baat se suti vastr aur hathakaragha (Cotton and Handloom) sahi sabit hota hai. loha udyog, videshi kapada, rasayan udyog alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab suti vastr aur hathakaragha (Cotton and Handloom) hai. Exam point: suti vastr aur hathakaragha (Cotton and Handloom) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was London known as during the era of industrialization?
qh: लंदन को औद्योगिकीकरण के दौर में किस केंद्र के रूप में जाना जाता था?
e: adi-audyogikikaran ke dauran mal ki antim phinishing landan mein hoti thi, isalie ise phinishing seintar kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka vishay phinishing seintar (Finishing Centre) hai. Yahi wajah hai ki phinishing seintar (Finishing Centre) sahi hai. Vikalp utpadan keindr, krishi keindr, kachcha mal keindr bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se phinishing seintar (Finishing Centre) sahi hai. Exam point: phinishing seintar (Finishing Centre) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who supported James Watt in producing the new model of the steam engine?
qh: भाप के इंजन का नया मॉडल बनाने में जेम्स वाट का साथ किसने दिया था?
e: jems vat ke dost aur udyogapati maithyu boltan ne nae modal ka nirman kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bhap ke injan ka naya modal banane mein jems vat ka sath kisane diya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki maithyu boltan (Matthew Boulton) sahi hai. abraham darbi, thomas edisan, richard arkarait mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab maithyu boltan (Matthew Boulton) hai. Exam point: maithyu boltan (Matthew Boulton) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did Seth Hukumchand set up the first Indian jute mill in 1917?
qh: सेठ हुकुमचंद ने 1917 में कहाँ पहली भारतीय जूट मिल स्थापित की थी?
e: maravadai vyavasayi seth hukumachand ne 1917 mein kalakatta mein pahali bharatiy jut mil lagai thi. Yahaan kalakatta (Calcutta) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kalakatta (Calcutta) sahi nikalta hai. ahamadabad, banbai, indaur is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar kalakatta (Calcutta) hi hai. Exam point: kalakatta (Calcutta) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the main change in Indian exports by the end of the 19th century?
qh: 19वीं सदी के अंत तक भारत से निर्यात होने वाली वस्तुओं में मुख्य बदलाव क्या आया?
o: कच्चे कपास और अनाज का निर्यात बढ़ा (Export of raw cotton and grains)
e: british milon ke dabav ke karan bharat se taiyar kapadae ke bajay kachche mal (kapas, nil, aphim) ka niryat hone laga. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 19vin sadi ke ant tak bharat se niryat hone vali vastuon mein mukhy badalav kya aya? Isi karan se kachche kapas aur anaj ka niryat badha... sahi uttar hai. Galti keval mashinon ka niryat hua, niryat band ho gaya, taiyar kapadaon ka niryat badha chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar kachche kapas aur anaj ka niryat badha... hi hai. Exam point: kachche kapas aur anaj ka niryat badha (Export of raw cotton and grains) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did merchants give advances to artisans?
qh: सौदागर कारीगरों को अग्रिम पैसा (Advance) क्यों देते थे?
o: ताकि वे किसी और के लिए काम न कर सकें (To bind them)
e: agrim paisa ya karj dene se karigar saudagar ke lie kam karane ko badhy ho jate the aur apani upaj kisi aur ko nahin bech sakate the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki saudagar karigaron ko agrim paisa (Advance) kyon dete the? Isi tathya par taki ve kisi aur ke lie kam... tika hua hai. unaki madad ke lie, tyohar manane ke lie, upahar ke rup mein in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar taki ve kisi aur ke lie kam n kar sakein (To bind them) hi hai. Exam point: taki ve kisi aur ke lie kam... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The failure of which crop led to a terrible famine in Ireland in the 1840s?
qh: 1840 के दशक में आयरलैंड में किस फसल के खराब होने से भयानक अकाल पड़ा?
e: ayaralaind ke garib log alu par itane nirbhar the ki bimari ke karan alu ki phasal kharab hone se 'ayarish potaito phaimin' pada. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 1840 ke dashak mein ayaralaind mein kis phasal ke kharab hone se bhayanak akal pada? In tathyon ke chalte alu (Potato) hi sahi hai. Vikalp makka (Maize), chaval (Rice), gehun (Wheat) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan alu (Potato) hi milti hai. Exam point: alu (Potato) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which deadly disease spread in America during the Spanish conquest, devastating its population?
qh: स्पेनिश विजय के दौरान अमेरिका में कौन सी जानलेवा बीमारी फैली जिसने वहां की जनसंख्या को तबाह कर दिया?
e: spenish sainikon ne chechak (Smallpox) ke kitanuon ka upayog kiya, jisake khilaph amerikiyon mein pratirodhak kshamata nahin thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki spenish vijay ke dauran amerika mein kaun si janaleva bimari phaili jisane vahan ki janasankhya ko tabah kar diya? Isi tathya par chechak (Smallpox) tika hua hai. Vikalp haija (Cholera), pleg (Plague), maleriya (Malaria) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav chechak (Smallpox) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: chechak (Smallpox) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the main reason for the abolition of 'Corn Laws' in Britain?
qh: ब्रिटेन में 'कॉर्न लॉ' (Corn Law) को खत्म करने का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: औद्योगीकरण और शहरी निवासियों का दबाव
e: briten ke udyogapatiyon aur shahari nivasiyon ke dabav mein sarakar ne 'korn lo' ko khatm kiya taki anaj sasta ayat ho sake. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki briten mein 'korn lo' (Corn Law) ko khatm karane ka mukhy karan kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja audyogikaran aur shahari nivasiyon ka dabav nikalta hai. kisanon ka dabav, videshi yuddh, anaj ki kami anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad audyogikaran aur shahari nivasiyon ka dabav hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: audyogikaran aur shahari nivasiyon ka dabav - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which technology simplified the meat trade in the late 19th century?
qh: 19वीं शताब्दी के अंत में मांस के व्यापार को किस तकनीक ने आसान बना दिया?
e: rephrijereted jahajon ke ane se amerika se yurop tak phrojan mans bhejana sanbhav hua, jisase mans sasta ho gaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 19vin shatabdi ke ant mein mans ke vyapar ko kis takanik ne asan bana diya? Isi karan se rephrijereted jahaj (Refrigerated Ships) sahi uttar hai. stim injan, relave, teligram mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar rephrijereted jahaj (Refrigerated Ships) hi hai. Exam point: rephrijereted jahaj (Refrigerated Ships) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In 1885, European powers met in Berlin for the partition of which continent/country?
qh: 1885 में यूरोपीय शक्तियां किस देश के बंटवारे के लिए बर्लिन में मिली थीं?
e: 1885 mein badai yuropiy shaktiyon ne barlin mein milakar aphrika ka naksha khincha aur use apas mein bant liya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1885 mein yuropiy shaktiyan kis desh ke bantavare ke lie barlin mein mili thin? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par aphrika sahi nikalta hai. amerika, bharat, chin in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar aphrika hi hai. Exam point: aphrika - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the name of the deadly cattle disease that spread in Africa in the 1890s?
qh: अफ्रीका में 1890 के दशक में मवेशियों में फैलने वाली जानलेवा बीमारी का नाम क्या था?
e: rindarapest ya 'kaital pleg' ne aphrika ke 90% maveshiyon ko mar diya aur vahan ke logon ki ajivika chhin li. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki aphrika mein 1890 ke dashak mein maveshiyon mein phailane vali janaleva bimari ka nam kya tha? Isi baat se rindarapest (Rinderpest) sahi sabit hota hai. inphluenja, haija, smol poks ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab rindarapest (Rinderpest) hai. Exam point: rindarapest (Rinderpest) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: From which regions of India were indentured labourers mostly sent?
qh: अनुबंधित श्रमिक या 'गिरमिटिया मजदूर' (Indentured Labour) भारत के किन क्षेत्रों से सबसे अधिक भेजे गए?
e: bharat ke uttar pradesh, bihar, madhy bharat aur tamilanadu ke sukhe kshetron se giramitiya majadur sabase adhik bheje gae. Prashn yah batata hai ki anubandhit shramik ya 'giramitiya majadur' (Indentured Labour) bharat ke kin kshetron se sabase adhik bheje gae? Isliye sahi nateeja uttar pradesh aur bihar nikalta hai. Vikalp keral aur karnatak, panjab aur hariyana, gujarat aur maharashtr bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se uttar pradesh aur bihar sahi hai. Exam point: uttar pradesh aur bihar - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year was the Indentured Labour system abolished?
qh: अनुबंधित श्रम प्रणाली को किस वर्ष समाप्त कर दिया गया था?
e: bharatiy rashtravadi netaon ke virodh ke bad 1921 mein anubandhit shram pranali ko samapt kar diya gaya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki anubandhit shram pranali ko kis varsh samapt kar diya gaya tha? Isi aadhar par 1921 chuna jaata hai. 1910, 1947, 1914 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav 1921 hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 1921 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What change occurred in the economic status of the US during World War I?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान अमेरिका की आर्थिक स्थिति में क्या बदलाव आया?
e: yuddh ke dauran amerika ek antararashtriy karjadar (Debtor) se ek antararashtriy karjadata (Creditor) ban gaya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki pratham vishv yuddh ke dauran amerika ki arthik sthiti mein kya badalav aya? Isi karan se vah karjadata ban gaya (International Creditor) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - usane vyapar band kar diya, usaki arthavyavastha nasht ho gai, vah karjadar ban gaya - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar vah karjadata ban gaya (International Creditor) baithta hai. Exam point: vah karjadata ban gaya (International Creditor) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Henry Ford started mass production of cars using which method?
qh: हेनरी फोर्ड ने किस विधि का उपयोग करके कारों का बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन (Mass Production) शुरू किया?
e: henari phord ne shikago ke buchadakhane se prerit hokar 'aseinbali lain' vidhi ka upayog badae paimane par utpadan ke lie kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki henari phord ne kis vidhi ka upayog karake karon ka badae paimane par utpadan (Mass Production) shuru kiya? Isi aadhar par aseinbali lain (Assembly Line) chuna jaata hai. hath se bunai, roket sains, silk rut is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan aseinbali lain (Assembly Line) hi milti hai. Exam point: aseinbali lain (Assembly Line) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the Great Depression primarily begin?
qh: महामंदी (Great Depression) की शुरुआत मुख्य रूप से किस वर्ष हुई?
e: 1929 mein mahamandi shuru hui, jisase duniya ke adhikansh hisson mein utpadan, rojagar aur ay mein bhari giravat ai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki mahamandi (Great Depression) ki shuruat mukhy rup se kis varsh hui? Isliye sahi nateeja 1929 nikalta hai. Vikalp 1919, 1939, 1914 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 1929 hai. Exam point: 1929 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the Bretton Woods Conference held?
qh: ब्रिटेन वुड्स सम्मेलन (Bretton Woods Conference) किस वर्ष आयोजित किया गया था?
e: julai 1944 mein amerika ke nyu haimpashayar ke briten vuds mein antararashtriy maudrik aur vittiy sammelan ayojit hua. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki briten vuds sammelan (Bretton Woods Conference) kis varsh ayojit kiya gaya tha? Isi baat se 1944 sahi sabit hota hai. 1947, 1950, 1939 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1944 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1944 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which institutions are called the 'Twins' of Bretton Woods?
qh: ब्रिटेन वुड्स की 'जुड़वां संतान' (Twin Children) किन संस्थानों को कहा जाता है?
e: IMF (antararashtriy mudra kosh) aur varld baink ko briten vuds ki judavan santan mana jata hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki briten vuds ki 'judavan santan' (Twin Children) kin sansthanon ko kaha jata hai? Isi tathya par IMF aur varld baink tika hua hai. WTO aur NATO, UNESCO aur UNICEF, UN aur WHO alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan IMF aur varld baink hi milti hai. Exam point: IMF aur varld baink - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main objective of the formation of the group G-77 by developing nations?
qh: विकासशील देशों के समूह G-77 के गठन का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: नई अंतरराष्ट्रीय आर्थिक प्रणाली (NIEO) की मांग
e: vikasashil deshon ne apane sansadhanon par vastavik niyantran ke lie G-77 banaya aur NIEO ki mang ki. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki vikasashil deshon ke samuh G-77 ke gathan ka mukhy uddeshy kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja nai antararashtriy arthik pranali (NIEO) ki mang nikalta hai. Vikalp yuddh ladana, paryatan badhana, amerika ki madad karana bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se nai antararashtriy arthik pranali (NIEO) ki mang sahi hai. Exam point: nai antararashtriy arthik pranali (NIEO) ki mang - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What type of exchange rates was the Bretton Woods system based on?
qh: ब्रिटेन वुड्स व्यवस्था (Bretton Woods System) किस प्रकार की विनिमय दरों पर आधारित थी?
e: briten vuds vyavastha 'nishchit vinimay daron' (Fixed Exchange Rates) par adharit thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki briten vuds vyavastha (Bretton Woods System) kis prakar ki vinimay daron par adharit thi? Isi aadhar par nishchit vinimay dar (Fixed) chuna jaata hai. koi dar nahin, dolar mukt, tairati vinimay dar (Floating) alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar nishchit vinimay dar (Fixed) baithta hai. Exam point: nishchit vinimay dar (Fixed) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What is the main attraction for MNCs in China?
qh: चीन में बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों (MNCs) के लिए मुख्य आकर्षण क्या है?
e: chin mein majaduri bahut kam (Low Wages) hai, jo ise videshi bahurashtriy kanpaniyon ke lie ek akarshak nivesh sthal banati hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki chin mein bahurashtriy kanpaniyon (MNCs) ke lie mukhy akarshan kya hai? purana wo granth hain jismein devi-devtaon tatha rajaon ki kathayein milti hain. Isi aadhar par kam majaduri (Low Wages) chuna jaata hai. purana itihas, sasta kachcha mal, thanda mausam in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar kam majaduri (Low Wages) hi hai. Exam point: kam majaduri (Low Wages) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which major cash crop was exported from India in the 19th century?
qh: भारत से विदेशों को निर्यात की जाने वाली प्रमुख नकदी फसल (Cash Crop) 19वीं सदी में कौन सी थी?
e: 19vin sadi mein bharat se kachche kapas (Raw Cotton) aur nil (Indigo) ka badae paimane par niryat kiya gaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharat se videshon ko niryat ki jane vali pramukh nakadi phasal (Cash Crop) 19vin sadi mein kaun si thi? Yahi wajah hai ki kotan aur nil (Indigo) sahi hai. sabjiyan, phal, chaval is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se kotan aur nil (Indigo) sahi hai. Exam point: kotan aur nil (Indigo) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was the 'Hosay' festival celebrated?
qh: होसे (Hosay) मेला कहाँ मनाया जाता था?
e: trinidad mein muharram ke julus ko ek vishal utsav 'hose' mein badal diya gaya tha jisamein sabhi dharmon ke log shamil hote the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki hose (Hosay) mela kahan manaya jata tha? In tathyon ke chalte trinidad hi sahi hai. bharat, amerika, briten is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab trinidad hai. Exam point: trinidad - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which country did Britain have to borrow for its war expenses?
qh: ब्रिटेन को अपने युद्ध खर्चों के लिए किस देश से कर्ज लेना पड़ा था?
e: pratham vishv yuddh ke kharchon ko pura karane ke lie briten ne amerika se bhari karj liya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki briten ko apane yuddh kharchon ke lie kis desh se karj lena pada tha? Isliye antim jawab amerika (USA) ke roop mein milta hai. bharat, jarmani, phrans mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar amerika (USA) hi hai. Exam point: amerika (USA) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which country was called the 'Cradle of European Civilization'?
qh: किस देश को 'यूरोपीय सभ्यता का पालना' (Cradle of European Civilization) कहा जाता था?
e: yunan ko yuropiy sabhyata ka palana mana jata tha, jisase pure yurop ke log sahanubhuti rakhate the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kis desh ko 'yuropiy sabhyata ka palana' (Cradle of European Civilization) kaha jata tha? Isi baat se yunan (Greece) sahi sabit hota hai. phrans, jarmani, briten is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab yunan (Greece) hai. Exam point: yunan (Greece) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which country is considered the origin of noodles?
qh: नूडल्स (Noodles) का मूल स्थान कौन सा देश माना जाता है?
e: mana jata hai ki nudals chin se pashchim mein gae aur vahan spegeti ban gae. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki nudals (Noodles) ka mul sthan kaun sa desh mana jata hai? Isi karan se chin (China) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - amerika, itali, bharat - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab chin (China) hai. Exam point: chin (China) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the primary function of the IMF?
qh: IMF का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: सदस्य देशों के बाहरी लाभ और घाटे से निपटना
e: IMF apane sadasy deshon ke bahari adhishesh aur ghate se nipatane ke lie banaya gaya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki IMF ka mukhy kary kya hai? Isi karan se sadasy deshon ke bahari labh aur ghate se nipatana sahi uttar hai. Galti yuddh rokana, garibi hatana, shiksha sudhar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se sadasy deshon ke bahari labh aur ghate se nipatana sahi hai. Exam point: sadasy deshon ke bahari labh aur ghate se nipatana - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the original name of the World Bank?
qh: विश्व बैंक (World Bank) का मूल नाम क्या है?
e: varld baink ka mul nam 'intaraneshanal baink phor rikanstrakshan end devalapameint' (IBRD) hai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki vishv baink (World Bank) ka mul nam kya hai? Isi karan se IBRD sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - WHO, UNESCO, WTO - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar IBRD baithta hai. Exam point: IBRD - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi return to India from South Africa?
qh: महात्मा गांधी दक्षिण अफ्रीका से भारत किस वर्ष लौटे थे?
e: mahatma gandhi janavari 1915 mein dakshin aphrika se bharat laute the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mahatma gandhi dakshin aphrika se bharat kis varsh laute the? Isi karan se 1915 sahi uttar hai. Galti 1913, 1917, 1919 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se 1915 sahi hai. Exam point: 1915 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where did Gandhiji conduct his first successful Satyagraha in India?
qh: गांधीजी ने भारत में अपना पहला सफल सत्याग्रह कहाँ किया था?
e: 1917 mein gandhiji ne bihar ke chanparan mein damanakari nil bagan pranali ke khilaph pahala satyagrah kiya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gandhiji ne bharat mein apana pahala saphal satyagrah kahan kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par chanparan hi sahi baithta hai. kheda, ahamadabad, amritasar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar chanparan baithta hai. Exam point: chanparan - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which year was the Rowlatt Act passed?
qh: रौलेट एक्ट (Rowlatt Act) किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
e: raulet ekt 1919 mein parit kiya gaya tha, jisane sarakar ko bina trayal ke rajanitik kaidiyon ko do sal tak hirasat mein rakhane ki shakti di. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki raulet ekt (Rowlatt Act) kis varsh parit kiya gaya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki 1919 sahi hai. Galti 1920, 1918, 1917 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1919 hai. Exam point: 1919 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who held the command of 'Martial Law' in Amritsar during the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
qh: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड के समय अमृतसर में 'मार्शल लॉ' की कमान किसके हाथ में थी?
e: jaliyanvala bag hatyakand ke samay janaral dayar ne marshal lo ki kaman sanbhali thi aur nihatthi bhid par goliyan chalavai thin. Is prashn ka dayra martial tak phaila hua hai. martial law lagne par aam kanoon ki jagah sena ka kanoon chalta tha. Isliye sahi nateeja janaral dayar nikalta hai. Vikalp lord irvin, mauntabetan, viliyam beintik bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan janaral dayar hi milti hai. Exam point: janaral dayar - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the names of the 'Ali Brothers' who started the Khilafat Movement?
qh: खिलाफत आंदोलन शुरू करने वाले 'अली बंधुओं' के नाम क्या थे?
e: mohammad ali aur shaukat ali ne khalipha ki shaktiyon ki raksha ke lie khilaphat andolan shuru kiya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki khilaphat andolan shuru karane vale 'ali bandhuon' ke nam kya the? khilafat andolan turki ke khalifa ke samarthan mein chalaya gaya tha. Yahi wajah hai ki mohammad ali aur shaukat ali sahi hai. liyakat ali aur shaukat ali, mohammad ali aur jinna, shaukat ali aur abul kalam alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar mohammad ali aur shaukat ali hi hai. Exam point: mohammad ali aur shaukat ali - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who is the author of the book 'Hind Swaraj'?
qh: 'हिंद स्वराज' (Hind Swaraj) पुस्तक के लेखक कौन हैं?
e: mahatma gandhi ne 1909 mein 'hind svaraj' pustak likhi thi, jisamein unhonne asahayog ke vichar ko spasht kiya tha. Yah prashn swaraj se juda hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par mahatma gandhi sahi nikalta hai. javaharalal neharu, bal gangadhar tilak, subhash chandr bos alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar mahatma gandhi hai. Exam point: mahatma gandhi - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which Congress session was the Non-Cooperation Movement adopted?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन (Non-Cooperation Movement) को कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में अपनाया गया था?
e: asahayog andolan ko disanbar 1920 ke nagapur adhiveshan mein antim rup se apanaya gaya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki asahayog andolan (Non-Cooperation Movement) ko kangres ke kis adhiveshan mein apanaya gaya tha? Isi karan se nagapur (disanbar 1920) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - lahaur (1929), madras (1927), kalakatta (sitanbar 1920) - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav nagapur (disanbar 1920) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: nagapur (disanbar 1920) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who formed the Awadh Kisan Sabha during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
qh: असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान अवध किसान सभा का गठन किसने किया था?
e: javaharalal neharu aur baba ramachandr ne kisanon ki samasyaon ko sunane ke lie avadh kisan sabha ka gathan kiya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki asahayog andolan ke dauran avadh kisan sabha ka gathan kisane kiya tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isliye antim jawab javaharalal neharu aur baba ramachandr ke roop mein milta hai. mahatma gandhi, chittaranjan das, alluri sitaram raju mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar javaharalal neharu aur baba ramachandr hi hai. Exam point: javaharalal neharu aur baba ramachandr - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who led the tribal rebellion in the Gudem Hills of Andhra Pradesh?
qh: आंध्र प्रदेश की गुडेम पहाड़ियों में आदिवासी विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: alluri sitaram raju ne adivasiyon ke adhikaron ke lie gorilla yuddh ka netritv kiya tha. Is prashn ka vishay alluri sitaram raju hai. Yahi wajah hai ki alluri sitaram raju sahi hai. Vikalp baba ramachandr, siddhu murmu, birasa munda bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav alluri sitaram raju hi thehrta hai. Exam point: alluri sitaram raju - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The Inland Emigration Act of 1859 was related to whom?
qh: 1859 के 'इनलैंड इमिग्रेशन एक्ट' (Inland Emigration Act) का संबंध किससे था?
e: is kanun ke tahat bagan majaduron ko bina anumati ke chay baganon se bahar jane ki manahi thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1859 ke 'inalaind imigreshan ekt' (Inland Emigration Act) ka sanbandh kisase tha? Isi tathya par bagan majaduron se (Plantation Workers) tika hua hai. sainikon se, vyapariyon se, kisanon se is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad bagan majaduron se (Plantation Workers) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bagan majaduron se (Plantation Workers) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which incident led Gandhiji to withdraw the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1922?
qh: किस घटना के कारण गांधीजी ने 1922 में असहयोग आंदोलन वापस ले लिया था?
e: pharavari 1922 mein gorakhapur ke chauri-chaura mein hui hinsak ghatana ke bad gandhiji ne andolan vapas le liya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki kis ghatana ke karan gandhiji ne 1922 mein asahayog andolan vapas le liya tha? Isliye antim jawab chauri-chaura kand ke roop mein milta hai. dandi march, jaliyanvala bag, gandhi-irvin samajhauta in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad chauri-chaura kand hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: chauri-chaura kand - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who formed the 'Swaraj Party' in 1923?
qh: 1923 में 'स्वराज पार्टी' का गठन किसने किया था?
o: जवाहरलाल नेहरू और सुभाष चंद्र बोस
e: si.ar. das aur motilal neharu ne parishad ki rajaniti mein lautane ke lie svaraj parti banai thi. Yahaan swaraj se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. In tathyon ke chalte chittaranjan das aur motilal neharu hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - bhagat sinh aur sukhadev, gandhiji aur anbedakar, javaharalal neharu aur subhash chandr bos - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad chittaranjan das aur motilal neharu hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: chittaranjan das aur motilal neharu - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why was the Simon Commission opposed?
qh: साइमन कमीशन (Simon Commission) का विरोध क्यों किया गया था?
o: यह बहुत देरी से आया था
यह केवल मुसलमानों के लिए था
इसमें कोई भारतीय सदस्य नहीं था
e: saiman kamishan mein ek bhi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha, isalie 'saiman go baik' ke naron ke sath isaka virodh hua. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki saiman kamishan (Simon Commission) ka virodh kyon kiya gaya tha? In tathyon ke chalte isamein koi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - yah bahut deri se aya tha, isaka adhyaksh krur tha, yah keval musalamanon ke lie tha - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar isamein koi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha baithta hai. Exam point: isamein koi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under whose presidency was the resolution of 'Purna Swaraj' passed in the Lahore session of Dec 1929?
qh: दिसंबर 1929 के लाहौर अधिवेशन में किसकी अध्यक्षता में 'पूर्ण स्वराज' का प्रस्ताव पारित हुआ?
e: javaharalal neharu ki adhyakshata mein lahaur adhiveshan mein 'purn svaraj' ya purn svatantrata ki mang ki gai thi. Is prashn ka dayra swaraj tak phaila hua hai. swaraj apne desh ka raj yaani apni sarkar ka naara tha. Isliye antim jawab javaharalal neharu ke roop mein milta hai. motilal neharu, saradar patel, mahatma gandhi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar javaharalal neharu hi hai. Exam point: javaharalal neharu - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: From where did Gandhiji start his famous 'Dandi March'?
qh: गांधीजी ने अपनी प्रसिद्ध 'दांडी यात्रा' कहाँ से शुरू की थी?
e: gandhiji ne 12 march 1930 ko apane 78 svayansevakon ke sath sabaramati ashram se dandi yatra shuru ki thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki gandhiji ne apani prasiddh 'dandi yatra' kahan se shuru ki thi? Isliye antim jawab sabaramati ashram ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - dandi tat, ahamadabad mil, chanparan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad sabaramati ashram hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: sabaramati ashram - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which event marked the formal beginning of the Civil Disobedience Movement?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन (Civil Disobedience Movement) की औपचारिक शुरुआत किस घटना से हुई?
e: 6 aprail 1930 ko dandi mein namak banakar kanun todane ke sath hi savinay avajna andolan shuru hua. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki savinay avajna andolan (Civil Disobedience Movement) ki aupacharik shuruat kis ghatana se hui? civil disobedience mein kanoon todkar sarkari kaam rokne ki appeal thi. Isi tathya par namak kanun todana (Breaking Salt Law) tika hua hai. Galti saiman kamishan ka agaman, gandhi-irvin samajhauta, asahayog andolan ki shuruat chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar namak kanun todana (Breaking Salt Law) baithta hai. Exam point: namak kanun todana (Breaking Salt Law) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was known as the 'Frontier Gandhi'?
qh: किसे 'सीमांत गांधी' (Frontier Gandhi) के नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: khan abdul gaphphar khan gandhiji ke samarpit shishy the aur unhein simant gandhi kaha jata tha. Is sawaal mein khan abdul gaphphar khan ki baat hai. Isliye antim jawab khan abdul gaphphar khan ke roop mein milta hai. shaukat ali, mohammad ali jinna, aga khan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar khan abdul gaphphar khan hai. Exam point: khan abdul gaphphar khan - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: On which date did the Gandhi-Irwin Pact take place?
qh: गांधी-इर्विन समझौता (Gandhi-Irwin Pact) किस तारीख को हुआ था?
e: 5 march 1931 ko gandhi-irvin samajhaute ke tahat gandhiji ne dusare golamej sammelan mein bhag lene ki sahamati di. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gandhi-irvin samajhauta (Gandhi-Irwin Pact) kis tarikh ko hua tha? Isi baat se 5 march 1931 sahi sabit hota hai. 26 janavari 1930, 15 agast 1932, 12 march 1930 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar 5 march 1931 hai. Exam point: 5 march 1931 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which 'Round Table Conference' did Gandhiji participate?
qh: गांधीजी ने किस 'गोलमेज सम्मेलन' (Round Table Conference) में भाग लिया था?
e: gandhiji ne keval landan mein hue dvitiy golamej sammelan mein bhag liya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki gandhiji ne kis 'golamej sammelan' (Round Table Conference) mein bhag liya tha? In tathyon ke chalte dvitiy hi sahi hai. tritiy, pratham, tinon mein mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan dvitiy hi milti hai. Exam point: dvitiy - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who formed the 'Depressed Classes Association' in 1930?
qh: 1930 में 'डिप्रैस्ड क्लास एसोसिएशन' (Depressed Classes Association) का गठन किसने किया था?
e: do. bi.ar. anbedakar ne daliton ke utthan aur rajanitik adhikaron ke lie is esosieshan ka gathan kiya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1930 mein 'dipraisd klas esosieshan' (Depressed Classes Association) ka gathan kisane kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par do. bi.ar. anbedakar hi sahi baithta hai. mahatma gandhi, saradar patel, jyotiba phule in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav do. bi.ar. anbedakar hi thehrta hai. Exam point: do. bi.ar. anbedakar - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: When did the 'Poona Pact' take place between Gandhiji and Dr. Ambedkar?
qh: गांधीजी और डॉ. अंबेडकर के बीच 'पूना पैक्ट' (Poona Pact) कब हुआ था?
e: sitanbar 1932 mein hue puna paikt ke tahat daliton ko prantiy aur keindriy parishadon mein arakshit sitein di gain. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gandhiji aur do. anbedakar ke bich 'puna paikt' (Poona Pact) kab hua tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sitanbar 1932 hi sahi baithta hai. march 1931, sitanbar 1930, sitanbar 1931 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sitanbar 1932 hi milti hai. Exam point: sitanbar 1932 - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who created the first image of Bharat Mata?
qh: भारत माता की पहली छवि किसने बनाई थी?
e: bharat mata ki pahali chhavi bankim chandr chattopadhyay dvara banai gai thi, jinhonne 'vande mataram' git bhi likha tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki bharat mata ki pahali chhavi kisane banai thi? Isliye sahi nateeja bankim chandr chattopadhyay nikalta hai. nandalal bos, avanindranath taigor, ravindranath taigor in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar bankim chandr chattopadhyay hi hai. Exam point: bankim chandr chattopadhyay - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The famous song 'Vande Mataram' is part of which novel?
qh: प्रसिद्ध गीत 'वंदे मातरम' किस उपन्यास का हिस्सा है?
e: vande mataram bankim chandr chattopadhyay ke prasiddh upanyas 'anandamath' se liya gaya hai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki prasiddh git 'vande mataram' kis upanyas ka hissa hai? Yahi wajah hai ki anandamath sahi hai. gitanjali, godan, svaraj in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad anandamath hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: anandamath - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the symbol in the center of the 'Swaraj Flag' of 1921?
qh: 1921 के 'स्वराज ध्वज' (Swaraj Flag) के मध्य में क्या प्रतीक था?
e: 1921 mein gandhiji dvara dijain kie gae tirange ke bich mein 'charakha' tha, jo atmanirbharata ka pratik tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1921 ke 'svaraj dhvaj' (Swaraj Flag) ke madhy mein kya pratik tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par charakha (Spinning Wheel) sahi nikalta hai. kamal ka phul, ashok chakr, hilata hua suraj anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav charakha (Spinning Wheel) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: charakha (Spinning Wheel) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the British do to finance 'Defense Expenditure' in India during World War I?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान भारत में 'रक्षा व्यय' (Defense Expenditure) की भरपाई के लिए अंग्रेजों ने क्या किया?
o: कर बढ़ाए और आयकर शुरू किया (Raised taxes and started Income Tax)
e: yuddh ke kharch ko pura karane ke lie sima shulk badhaya gaya aur ayakar (Income Tax) ki shuruat ki gai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki pratham vishv yuddh ke dauran bharat mein 'raksha vyay' (Defense Expenditure) ki bharapai ke lie angrejon ne kya kiya? Isi karan se kar badhae aur ayakar shuru kiya (Raised taxes and started Income Tax) sahi uttar hai. svaraj diya, vetan badha diya, karj maph kiya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab kar badhae aur ayakar shuru kiya (Raised... hai. Exam point: kar badhae aur ayakar shuru kiya (Raised taxes and started Income Tax) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In 1848, how many series of prints were prepared by the French artist Frédéric Sorrieu?
qh: 1848 में फ्रांसीसी कलाकार फ्रेडरिक सोरय्यू ने कितने चित्रों की एक श्रृंखला बनाई थी?
e: phredarik sorayyu ne char chitron ki ek shrrinkhala banai jisamein unhonne 'lokatantrik aur samajik ganarajyon' ke apane sapane ko sakar kiya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1848 mein phransisi kalakar phredarik sorayyu ne kitane chitron ki ek shrrinkhala banai thi? In tathyon ke chalte 4 hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - 6, 2, 3 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 4 hi milti hai. Exam point: 4 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the Napoleonic Code (Civil Code) introduced?
qh: नेपोलियन की संहिता (Civil Code) को किस वर्ष लागू किया गया था?
e: 1804 ki nagarik sanhita, jise amataur par nepoliyan ki sanhita ke rup mein jana jata hai, ne janm par adharit visheshadhikaron ko samapt kar diya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki nepoliyan ki sanhita (Civil Code) ko kis varsh lagu kiya gaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1804 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti 1815, 1801, 1789 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1804 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1804 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who hosted the Congress of Vienna in 1815?
qh: वियना कांग्रेस (Congress of Vienna) की मेजबानी किसने की थी?
e: 1815 mein viyana kangres ki mejabani ostriyai chansalar dyuk metaranik ne ki thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki viyana kangres (Congress of Vienna) ki mejabani kisane ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par dyuk metaranik (Duke Metternich) sahi nikalta hai. guisep metsini (Giuseppe Mazzini), nepoliyan (Napoleon), viliyam pratham (William I) ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab dyuk metaranik (Duke Metternich) hai. Exam point: dyuk metaranik (Duke Metternich) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What type of government was established in France after the July Revolution of 1830?
qh: जुलाई 1830 के विद्रोह के बाद फ्रांस में किस प्रकार की सरकार स्थापित हुई?
e: julai 1830 ke vidroh ke bad borabon rajaon ko ukhad pheinka gaya aur lui philip ke sath ek sanvaidhanik rajatantr sthapit kiya gaya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki julai 1830 ke vidroh ke bad phrans mein kis prakar ki sarakar sthapit hui? Isi baat se sanvaidhanik rajatantr (Constitutional Monarchy) sahi sabit hota hai. purn rajatantr (Absolute Monarchy), tanashahi (Dictatorship), sainy shasan (Military Rule) is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad sanvaidhanik rajatantr (Constitutional Monarchy) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: sanvaidhanik rajatantr (Constitutional Monarchy) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who said, 'When France sneezes, the rest of Europe catches cold'?
qh: 'जब फ्रांस छींकता है, तो बाकी यूरोप को सर्दी जुकाम हो जाता है' यह कथन किसका है?
e: yah prasiddh kathan dyuk metaranik ka hai, jo yurop par phrans ke rajanitik prabhav ko darshata hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 'jab phrans chhinkata hai, to baki yurop ko sardi jukam ho jata hai' yah kathan kisaka hai? Isi tathya par metaranik (Metternich) tika hua hai. bismark, maitsini (Mazzini), gairibaldi (Garibaldi) anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar metaranik (Metternich) hai. Exam point: metaranik (Metternich) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which treaty recognized Greece as an independent nation?
qh: यूनान (Greece) को एक स्वतंत्र राष्ट्र के रूप में मान्यता देने वाली संधि कौन सी थी?
e: 1832 ki kustunatuniya (Constantinople) ki sandhi ne yunan ko ek svatantr rashtr ke rup mein manyata di. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki yunan (Greece) ko ek svatantr rashtr ke rup mein manyata dene vali sandhi kaun si thi? Isi karan se kustunatuniya ki sandhi (Treaty of Constantinople) sahi uttar hai. viyana ki sandhi (Treaty of Vienna), peris ki sandhi (Treaty of Paris), varsay ki sandhi (Treaty of Versailles) alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kustunatuniya ki sandhi (Treaty of Constantinople) hi milti hai. Exam point: kustunatuniya ki sandhi (Treaty of Constantinople) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who was the main architect of German unification?
qh: जर्मनी के एकीकरण का मुख्य वास्तुकार (Architect) कौन था?
e: oto von bismark prasha (Prussia) ke mukhyamantri the aur unhein jarmani ke ekikaran ka mukhy vastukar mana jata hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki jarmani ke ekikaran ka mukhy vastukar (Architect) kaun tha? Isi karan se oto von bismark (Otto von Bismarck) sahi uttar hai. hitalar (Hitler), viliyam pratham (William I), metsini (Mazzini) mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan oto von bismark (Otto von Bismarck) hi milti hai. Exam point: oto von bismark (Otto von Bismarck) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who led the 'Red Shirts' army during the unification of Italy?
qh: इटली के एकीकरण के दौरान 'लाल कुर्ती' (Red Shirts) सेना का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: guisep gairibaldi ne sashastr svayansevakon ki ek badai sankhya ka netritv kiya, jinhein 'red sharts' kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka dayra guisep gairibaldi (Giuseppe Garibaldi) tak phaila hua hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par guisep gairibaldi (Giuseppe Garibaldi) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. viktar imainuel (Victor Emmanuel), nepoliyan (Napoleon), kaivur (Cavour) anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan guisep gairibaldi (Giuseppe Garibaldi) hi milti hai. Exam point: guisep gairibaldi (Giuseppe Garibaldi) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who founded the secret society called 'Young Italy'?
qh: 'यंग इटली' (Young Italy) नामक गुप्त संगठन की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: guisep metsini ne marsile mein 'yang itali' aur barn mein 'yang yurop' ki sthapana ki thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 'yang itali' (Young Italy) namak gupt sangathan ki sthapana kisane ki thi? Yahi wajah hai ki guisep metsini (Giuseppe Mazzini) sahi hai. metaranik (Metternich), lui philip (Louis Philippe), bismark (Bismarck) is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad guisep metsini (Giuseppe Mazzini) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: guisep metsini (Giuseppe Mazzini) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who was proclaimed the German Emperor in 1871?
qh: 1871 में एकीकृत जर्मनी का सम्राट किसे घोषित किया गया?
e: janavari 1871 mein varsay mein hue ek samaroh mein prasha ke raja viliyam pratham ko jarmani ka samrat ghoshit kiya gaya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1871 mein ekikrit jarmani ka samrat kise ghoshit kiya gaya? Isi karan se kesar viliyam pratham (Kaiser William I) sahi uttar hai. viktar imainuel dvitiy (Victor Emmanuel II), nepoliyan III (Napoleon III), phredarik viliyam IV (Friedrich Wilhelm IV) is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kesar viliyam pratham (Kaiser William I) hai. Exam point: kesar viliyam pratham (Kaiser William I) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the name of the female allegory of the German nation?
qh: जर्मन राष्ट्र की महिला रूपक (Allegory) का नाम क्या है?
e: jarmeniya jarman rashtr ki rupak bani, jo balut ke patton ka mukut pahanati hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki jarman rashtr ki mahila rupak (Allegory) ka nam kya hai? Isliye sahi nateeja jarmeniya (Germania) nikalta hai. Galti marien (Marianne), britaniya (Britannia), libarti (Liberty) chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se jarmeniya (Germania) sahi hai. Exam point: jarmeniya (Germania) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the name of the female allegory of the French nation?
