qh: फ्रांसीसी राष्ट्र की महिला रूपक का नाम क्या था?
e: phrans mein rashtr ke vichar ko lokapriy banane ke lie 'marien' nam diya gaya, jo svatantrata aur ganatantr ke pratikon se yukt thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki phransisi rashtr ki mahila rupak ka nam kya tha? Isi aadhar par marien (Marianne) chuna jaata hai. Galti jarmeniya (Germania), viktoriya (Victoria), elijabeth (Elizabeth) chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar marien (Marianne) hai. Exam point: marien (Marianne) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was 'Zollverein' established by Prussia?
qh: प्रशा द्वारा स्थापित 'ज़ोल्वेरिन' (Zollverein) क्या था?
e: 1834 mein prasha ki pahal par ek sima shulk sangh 'jaolverin' sthapit kiya gaya tha jisane tairiph badhaon ko samapt kiya. Is prashn ka kendra ek sima shulk sangh (Customs Union) hai. Isi tathya par ek sima shulk sangh (Customs Union) tika hua hai. Vikalp ek rajanitik dal (Political Party), ek dharmik samuh (Religious Group), ek sainy gathabandhan (Military Alliance) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar ek sima shulk sangh (Customs Union) baithta hai. Exam point: ek sima shulk sangh (Customs Union) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: The Act of Union (1707) took place between which two countries?
qh: एक्ट ऑफ यूनियन (1707) किन दो देशों के बीच हुआ था?
e: ekt oph yuniyan (1707) inglaind aur skotalaind ke bich hua, jisase 'yunaited kingadam oph gret briten' ka gathan hua. Prashn yah batata hai ki ekt oph yuniyan (1707) kin do deshon ke bich hua tha? Isi aadhar par inglaind aur skotalaind chuna jaata hai. inglaind aur phrans, inglaind aur ayaralaind, itali aur jarmani anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar inglaind aur skotalaind hi hai. Exam point: inglaind aur skotalaind - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the inhabitants of the Balkan region broadly called?
qh: बाल्कन क्षेत्र (Balkan Region) के निवासियों को मुख्य रूप से क्या कहा जाता था?
e: balkan kshetr ke nivasiyon ko vyapak rup se 'slav' ke nam se jana jata tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki balkan kshetr (Balkan Region) ke nivasiyon ko mukhy rup se kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par slav (Slavs) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. englo (Anglos), jarman (Germans), kaitholik (Catholics) anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad slav (Slavs) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: slav (Slavs) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which empire controlled a large part of the Balkans for a long time?
qh: किस साम्राज्य ने लंबे समय तक बाल्कन क्षेत्र के बड़े हिस्से पर नियंत्रण रखा?
e: balkan ka ek bada hissa lanbe samay tak otoman samrajy ke niyantran mein tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kis samrajy ne lanbe samay tak balkan kshetr ke badae hisse par niyantran rakha? Isi aadhar par otoman samrajy (Ottoman Empire) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp prasha, british samrajy, rusi samrajy bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad otoman samrajy (Ottoman Empire) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: otoman samrajy (Ottoman Empire) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was proclaimed the king of united Italy in 1861?
qh: 1861 में एकीकृत इटली का राजा किसे घोषित किया गया?
e: 1861 mein viktar imainuel dvitiy ko ekikrit itali ka raja ghoshit kiya gaya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1861 mein ekikrit itali ka raja kise ghoshit kiya gaya? Isliye antim jawab viktar imainuel dvitiy (Victor Emmanuel II) ke roop mein milta hai. metsini (Mazzini), kaivur (Cavour), gairibaldi (Garibaldi) ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar viktar imainuel dvitiy (Victor Emmanuel II) hai. Exam point: viktar imainuel dvitiy (Victor Emmanuel II) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main language of the 'Aristocracy' in Europe?
qh: यूरोप में 'अभिजात वर्ग' (Aristocracy) की मुख्य भाषा क्या थी?
e: yurop ke unche vargon aur abhijat varg ke log kutaniti aur samajik karyon ke lie phreinch bhasha bolate the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki yurop mein 'abhijat varg' (Aristocracy) ki mukhy bhasha kya thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par phreinch (French) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti jarman, angreji, italiyan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar phreinch (French) hai. Exam point: phreinch (French) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In Sorrieu's print, what does the 'Statue of Liberty' carry in her hands?
qh: सोरय्यू के चित्र में 'स्वतंत्रता की प्रतिमा' के हाथ में क्या है?
e: svatantrata ki pratima ke ek hath mein jnanoday ki mashal aur dusare mein manushy ke adhikaron ka ghoshanapatr hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki sorayyu ke chitr mein 'svatantrata ki pratima' ke hath mein kya hai? Isi karan se mashal aur ghoshanapatr (Torch and Charter) sahi uttar hai. phul aur kitab, jhanda aur danda, talavar aur dhal ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar mashal aur ghoshanapatr (Torch and Charter) hi hai. Exam point: mashal aur ghoshanapatr (Torch and Charter) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the main objective of the Treaty of Vienna (1815)?
qh: 1815 की वियना संधि का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: नेपोलियन के बदलावों को बहाल करना
नेपोलियन के बदलावों को खत्म करना (Undo changes of Napoleon)
e: viyana sandhi ka mukhy uddeshy un adhikansh parivartanon ko khatm karana tha jo nepoliyan ke yuddhon ke dauran yurop mein ae the. Yahaan nepoliyan ke badalavon ko khatm karana (Undo changes of Napoleon) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi karan se nepoliyan ke badalavon ko khatm karana (Undo... sahi uttar hai. lokatantr lana, naya sanvidhan banana, nepoliyan ke badalavon ko bahal karana ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar nepoliyan ke badalavon ko khatm karana (Undo changes of Napoleon) hai. Exam point: nepoliyan ke badalavon ko khatm karana (Undo changes of Napoleon) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main objective of the Enclosure movement in England?
qh: इंग्लैंड में बाड़ाबंदी (Enclosure) आंदोलन का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: साझा जमीन को निजी संपत्ति में बदलना (To convert common land into private property)
e: badabandi ke madhyam se sanpann kisanon ne sajha jamin (Commons) ko gherakar apani niji sanpatti bana liya tha. Yah prashn sajha jamin ko niji sanpatti mein badalana (To convert common land into private property) se juda hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sajha jamin ko niji sanpatti mein badalana... sahi nikalta hai. jangalon ko bachana, garibon ko ghar dena, jhum kheti ko badhava dena ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar sajha jamin ko niji sanpatti mein badalana (To convert common land into private property) hai. Exam point: sajha jamin ko niji sanpatti mein badalana... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why were English farmers/labourers breaking machines in the 1830s?
qh: 1830 के दशक में इंग्लैंड के किसान मशीनों को क्यों तोड़ रहे थे?
o: वे नई तकनीक से डरते थे
मशीनों से उनकी रोजी-रोटी छिन गई थी (Loss of livelihood)
e: thresing mashinon ke ane se majaduron ka kam chhin gaya tha, jisase ve berojagar ho gae the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1830 ke dashak mein inglaind ke kisan mashinon ko kyon tod rahe the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par mashinon se unaki roji-roti chhin gai thi... sahi nikalta hai. ve nai takanik se darate the, mashinein bahut mahangi thin, mashinein kam nahin karati thin alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se mashinon se unaki roji-roti chhin gai thi (Loss of livelihood) sahi hai. Exam point: mashinon se unaki roji-roti chhin gai thi... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which crops were sown to increase soil fertility during enclosures in England?
qh: इंग्लैंड में बाड़ाबंदी के दौरान भूस्वामियों ने जमीन की उर्वरता बढ़ाने के लिए किन फसलों को बोना शुरू किया?
o: शलजम और तिपतिया घास (Turnip and Clover)
e: shalajam aur tipatiya ghas mitti mein naitrojan ki matra badhakar use upajau banate the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki inglaind mein badabandi ke dauran bhusvamiyon ne jamin ki urvarata badhane ke lie kin phasalon ko bona shuru kiya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par shalajam aur tipatiya ghas (Turnip and Clover) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. aphim aur nil, kapas aur jut, chaval aur gehun is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad shalajam aur tipatiya ghas (Turnip and Clover) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: shalajam aur tipatiya ghas (Turnip and Clover) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why were the American plains called the 'Bread Basket'?
qh: अमेरिका के घास के मैदानों को 'रोटी की टोकरी' (Bread Basket) क्यों कहा जाने लगा?
o: वहाँ गेहूं का भारी उत्पादन होने लगा (Massive wheat production)
e: jangalon aur ghas ke maidanon ko saph kar amerika duniya ka sabase bada gehun utpadak ban gaya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki amerika ke ghas ke maidanon ko 'roti ki tokari' (Bread Basket) kyon kaha jane laga? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par vahan gehun ka bhari utpadan hone laga (Massive wheat production) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. vahan rotiyan banti jati thin, vahan bahut sari bekari thin, vahan phal ugae jate the in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar vahan gehun ka bhari utpadan hone laga... hi hai. Exam point: vahan gehun ka bhari utpadan hone laga (Massive wheat production) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main cause of the 'Dust Bowl' in America in the 1930s?
qh: 1930 के दशक में अमेरिका में आए रेतीले तूफानों (Dust Bowl) का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: लगातार खेती से जमीन की ऊपरी परत का टूटना और घास का खत्म होना (Over-cultivation and loss of grass cover)
e: mitti ki upari parat ke dhile hone aur ghas khatm hone se tej havaon ne ret ke bhayankar tuphan paida kie. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1930 ke dashak mein amerika mein ae retile tuphanon (Dust Bowl) ka mukhy karan kya tha? Isi baat se lagatar kheti se jamin ki upari parat ka tutana aur ghas ka khatm hona (Over-cultivation and loss of grass cover) sahi sabit hota hai. samudri laharein, pedaon ki adhikata, bhukanp is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad lagatar kheti se jamin ki upari parat... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: lagatar kheti se jamin ki upari parat ka tutana aur ghas ka khatm hona (Over-cultivation and loss of grass cover) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the East India Company buy from China to sell in England in the 18th century?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी चीन से क्या खरीदकर इंग्लैंड में बेचती थी?
e: ist indiya kanpani chin se chay aur resham kharidati thi, jisaki inglaind mein bahut mang thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 18vin shatabdi mein ist indiya kanpani chin se kya kharidakar inglaind mein bechati thi? Isi aadhar par chay aur resham (Tea and Silk) chuna jaata hai. kapas aur nil, sona aur chandi, gehun aur makka anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad chay aur resham (Tea and Silk) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: chay aur resham (Tea and Silk) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What commodity did the British use to pay for tea trade with China?
qh: अंग्रेजों ने चीन के साथ चाय व्यापार के बदले में भुगतान करने के लिए किस वस्तु का सहारा लिया?
e: chin chay ke badale chandi leta tha, jisake vikalp ke rup mein angrejon ne avaidh aphim vyapar shuru kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki angrejon ne chin ke sath chay vyapar ke badale mein bhugatan karane ke lie kis vastu ka sahara liya? Isliye sahi nateeja aphim (Opium) nikalta hai. Galti chaval, loha, kapada chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se aphim (Opium) sahi hai. Exam point: aphim (Opium) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What were Indian peasants forced to grow after the British conquest of Bengal?
qh: भारत में बंगाल विजय के बाद अंग्रेजों ने किसानों को क्या उगाने के लिए मजबूर किया?
e: angrejon ne chin ko niryat karane ke lie bharatiy kisanon ko aphim ugane ke lie majabur kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharat mein bangal vijay ke bad angrejon ne kisanon ko kya ugane ke lie majabur kiya? Isliye sahi nateeja aphim (Opium) nikalta hai. masale, rabad, surajamukhi alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad aphim (Opium) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: aphim (Opium) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Whose mythical name was signed on threatening letters to farmers in the 1830s?
qh: 1831 में थ्रेसिंग मशीनों के विरुद्ध होने वाले दंगों में किसानों को मिलने वाले धमकी भरे पत्रों पर किसका नाम होता था?
e: kaiptan sving ek kalpanik nam tha jisaka upayog majaduron dvara mashinon ke virodh mein kiya gaya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1831 mein thresing mashinon ke viruddh hone vale dangon mein kisanon ko milane vale dhamaki bhare patron par kisaka nam hota tha? Isi karan se kaiptan sving (Captain Swing) sahi uttar hai. robin hud, mangal pande, bhagat sinh ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar kaiptan sving (Captain Swing) hai. Exam point: kaiptan sving (Captain Swing) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What system did the British use to persuade farmers to grow opium?
qh: अफीम की खेती के लिए अंग्रेजों ने किसानों को मनाने के लिए कौन सी व्यवस्था अपनाई?
e: garib kisanon ko karj (peshagi) ka lalach dekar aphim ki kheti ke jal mein phansaya jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki aphim ki kheti ke lie angrejon ne kisanon ko manane ke lie kaun si vyavastha apanai? In tathyon ke chalte agrim rakam ya rin dena (Advances/Loans) hi sahi hai. bij mupht dena, puraskar dena, mupht jamin dena is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se agrim rakam ya rin dena (Advances/Loans) sahi hai. Exam point: agrim rakam ya rin dena (Advances/Loans) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What were the original inhabitants of America called who were evicted by the British?
qh: अमेरिका के मूल निवासियों को क्या कहा जाता था जिन्हें अंग्रेजों ने उनकी जमीन से बेदखल किया?
e: ameriki mul nivasiyon (injaniya) ko pashchim ki or dhakel kar unaki jamin par kabja kiya gaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki amerika ke mul nivasiyon ko kya kaha jata tha jinhein angrejon ne unaki jamin se bedakhal kiya? Isi karan se red indiyans (Native Americans) sahi uttar hai. ostreliyai, maiksikan, blaik amerikan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad red indiyans (Native Americans) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: red indiyans (Native Americans) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did food prices skyrocket in England in the late 18th century?
qh: 18वीं सदी के अंत में इंग्लैंड में खाद्यान्न की कीमतें आसमान क्यों छूने लगी थीं?
o: फ्रांस के साथ युद्ध (War with France)
e: nepoliyan ke sath yuddh ke karan yurop se anaj ka ayat ruk gaya tha, jisase kimatein b gain. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 18vin sadi ke ant mein inglaind mein khadyann ki kimatein asaman kyon chhune lagi thin? Isi karan se phrans ke sath yuddh (War with France) sahi uttar hai. janasankhya ghatane ke karan, mashinon ke tutane ke karan, sukhe ke karan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad phrans ke sath yuddh (War with France) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: phrans ke sath yuddh (War with France) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the shared community land, forest, and water called in traditional societies?
qh: पारंपरिक समाजों में साझा सामुदायिक जल, जंगल और जमीन को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: komans vah jamin thi jis par pure ganv ka adhikar hota tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki paranparik samajon mein sajha samudayik jal, jangal aur jamin ko kya kaha jata tha? Isliye sahi nateeja komans (Commons) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - bagicha, badabandi, niji sanpatti - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan komans (Commons) hi milti hai. Exam point: komans (Commons) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Through which port was Indian opium mainly sent to China?
qh: भारतीय अफीम का व्यापार मुख्य रूप से किस बंदरगाह से चीन भेजा जाता था?
e: kolakata ke aphim ejeint aphim ko ikattha kar chin bhejane ki vyavastha karate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki bharatiy aphim ka vyapar mukhy rup se kis bandaragah se chin bheja jata tha? Isi baat se kolakata (Calcutta) sahi sabit hota hai. vishakhapattanam, surat, madras is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar kolakata (Calcutta) baithta hai. Exam point: kolakata (Calcutta) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which US President urged farmers to 'Grow more wheat, wheat will win the war'?
qh: किस अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ने किसानों से 'ज्यादा गेहूं उगाओ, गेहूं हमें युद्ध जिताएगा' का आह्वान किया?
e: pratham vishv yuddh ke dauran rashtrapati vilsan ne khadyann apurti ke lie yah nara diya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kis ameriki rashtrapati ne kisanon se 'jyada gehun ugao, gehun hamein yuddh jitaega' ka ahvan kiya? Isi karan se vilsan (Woodrow Wilson) sahi uttar hai. abraham linkan, thomas jepharasan, jorj vashingatan is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se vilsan (Woodrow Wilson) sahi hai. Exam point: vilsan (Woodrow Wilson) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In old times 'Maund' was used for weight, how many 'Seer' were in one Maund?
qh: पुराने समय में वजन की माप के लिए 'मन' (Maund) का उपयोग होता था, एक मन में कितने सेर होते थे?
e: ek man lagabhag 40 ser ke barabar hota tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki purane samay mein vajan ki map ke lie 'man' (Maund) ka upayog hota tha, ek man mein kitane ser hote the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 40 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - 20, 100, 10 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 40 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 40 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who invented the 'Reaper' in 1831 for wheat harvesting in America?
qh: अमेरिका के विशाल मैदानों में गेहूं की कटाई के लिए 1831 में 'रीपर' (Reaper) का आविष्कार किसने किया?
e: sairas maikakormik ke ripar ne katai ke kam ko bahut asan aur tej bana diya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki amerika ke vishal maidanon mein gehun ki katai ke lie 1831 mein 'ripar' (Reaper) ka avishkar kisane kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sairas maikakormik (Cyrus McCormick) hi sahi baithta hai. thomas jepharasan, jems vat, jorj stiphanasan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab sairas maikakormik (Cyrus McCormick) hai. Exam point: sairas maikakormik (Cyrus McCormick) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the impact of Enclosures on poor peasants?
qh: बाड़ाबंदी (Enclosure) आंदोलन के कारण गरीब किसानों पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ा?
o: वे अपनी रोजी-रोटी और साझा जमीन से वंचित हो गए (Displaced from their livelihood)
e: badabandi ke karan garibon se sajha jamin chhin gai aur ve kam ki talash mein shaharon ki or palayan karane lage. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki badabandi (Enclosure) andolan ke karan garib kisanon par kya prabhav pada? Isi karan se ve apani roji-roti aur sajha jamin se vanchit ho gae (Displaced from their livelihood) sahi uttar hai. Galti unhein nai jamin mili, ve amir ho gae, unhein mupht anaj mila chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad ve apani roji-roti aur sajha jamin se vanchit ho gae (Displaced from their livelihood) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ve apani roji-roti aur sajha jamin se vanchit ho gae (Displaced from their livelihood) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Why did the British continue the illegal opium trade in China?
qh: चीन में अफीम व्यापार को अवैध मानने के बावजूद अंग्रेज इसे क्यों जारी रखते थे?
o: चाय के व्यापार के लिए पैसा जुटाने हेतु (To fund the tea trade)
e: angrej aphim bechakar jo paisa kamate the, usase chin se chay kharidate the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki chin mein aphim vyapar ko avaidh manane ke bavajud angrej ise kyon jari rakhate the? Isi baat se chay ke vyapar ke lie paisa jutane hetu (To fund the tea trade) sahi sabit hota hai. davaiyan banane ke lie, chin se mitrata ke lie, chin ki bhalai ke lie is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan chay ke vyapar ke lie paisa jutane hetu (To fund the tea trade) hi milti hai. Exam point: chay ke vyapar ke lie paisa jutane hetu (To fund the tea trade) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What were the farmers of Ghazipur region in India mainly known for growing in the 19th century?
qh: 19वीं सदी में भारत के गाजीपुर क्षेत्र के किसान मुख्य रूप से किसकी खेती के लिए जाने जाते थे?
e: gajipur aur banaras ke ilake angrejon ke samay aphim utpadan ke mukhy keindr the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 19vin sadi mein bharat ke gajipur kshetr ke kisan mukhy rup se kisaki kheti ke lie jane jate the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par aphim (Opium) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - masale, kapas, nil - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan aphim (Opium) hi milti hai. Exam point: aphim (Opium) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the name of the pastoral community of Jammu and Kashmir that primarily rears sheep and goats?
qh: जम्मू-कश्मीर के उस चरवाहा समुदाय का नाम क्या है जो मुख्य रूप से भेड़ और बकरियाँ पालते हैं?
e: gurjar bakaraval samuday sardi aur garmi ke hisab se shivalik ki pahadaiyon aur kashmir ki unchi ghatiyon ke bich avajahi karate hain. Prashn yah batata hai ki jammu-kashmir ke us charavaha samuday ka nam kya hai jo mukhy rup se bhed aur bakariyan palate hain? Isliye sahi nateeja gurjar bakaraval (Gujjar Bakarwals) nikalta hai. sherapa, bhotiya, gaddi anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab gurjar bakaraval (Gujjar Bakarwals) hai. Exam point: gurjar bakaraval (Gujjar Bakarwals) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which pastoral community of Himachal Pradesh spends winters in Shivalik and summers in Lahaul-Spiti?
qh: हिमाचल प्रदेश का कौन सा चरवाहा समुदाय सर्दियों में शिवालिक की निचली पहाड़ियों और गर्मियों में लाहौल-स्पीति में समय बिताता है?
e: gaddi charavahe mausam ke anusar apani jagah badalate hain taki unake janavaron ko hamesha chara mil sake. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki himachal pradesh ka kaun sa charavaha samuday sardiyon mein shivalik ki nichali pahadaiyon aur garmiyon mein lahaul-spiti mein samay bitata hai? Isliye sahi nateeja gaddi nikalta hai. banjara, rayaka, dhanagar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan gaddi hi milti hai. Exam point: gaddi - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In Uttarakhand, to which dry forest areas do pastoralists move during winters?
qh: उत्तराखंड के गढ़वाल और कुमाऊँ क्षेत्र में सर्दियों में चरवाहे किन सूखे जंगलों की ओर चले जाते हैं?
e: sardiyon mein ye log bhabar ke sukhe jangalon mein rahate hain aur garmiyon mein bugyal ke unche ghas ke maidanon mein chale jate hain. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki uttarakhand ke gadhaval aur kumaun kshetr mein sardiyon mein charavahe kin sukhe jangalon ki or chale jate hain? Isliye sahi nateeja bhabar nikalta hai. tarai, shivalik, bugyal is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bhabar hi milti hai. Exam point: bhabar - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which pastoral community of Maharashtra is primarily involved in blanket-making and herding?
qh: महाराष्ट्र का वह कौन सा चरवाहा समुदाय है जो मुख्य रूप से कंबल और चादर बनाने और चरवाही का काम करता है?
e: dhanagar samuday manasun ke dauran maharashtr ke madhy pathar mein rahata hai aur aktubar ke bad konkan kshetr ki or chala jata hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki maharashtr ka vah kaun sa charavaha samuday hai jo mukhy rup se kanbal aur chadar banane aur charavahi ka kam karata hai? Isi baat se dhanagar (Dhangar) sahi sabit hota hai. kuruva, gola, rayaka is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar dhanagar (Dhangar) hai. Exam point: dhanagar (Dhangar) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What is the pastoral community that rears camels and sheep in the deserts of Rajasthan called?
qh: राजस्थान के रेगिस्तान में ऊँट और भेड़ पालने वाले चरवाहा समुदाय को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: rayaka samuday rajasthan mein rahata hai, jahan barish kam hone ke karan ve kheti ke sath-sath charavahi bhi karate hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki rajasthan ke registan mein unt aur bhed palane vale charavaha samuday ko kya kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par rayaka (Raika) hi sahi baithta hai. dhanagar, gaddi, banjara mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar rayaka (Raika) hi hai. Exam point: rayaka (Raika) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the British government pass the Criminal Tribes Act in India?
qh: अंग्रेजी सरकार ने भारत में 'अपराधी जनजाति अधिनियम' (Criminal Tribes Act) किस वर्ष पारित किया था?
e: 1871 mein angrejon ne kai ghumantu samudayon ko 'aparadhi janajati' ghoshit kar diya taki un par asani se niyantran rakha ja sake. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki angreji sarakar ne bharat mein 'aparadhi janajati adhiniyam' (Criminal Tribes Act) kis varsh parit kiya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki 1871 sahi hai. 1864, 1905, 1927 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1871 hai. Exam point: 1871 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which is the most famous pastoral community of Africa living in Kenya and Tanzania?
qh: अफ्रीका का सबसे प्रसिद्ध चरवाहा समुदाय कौन सा है जो पूर्वी अफ्रीका (केन्या और तंजानिया) में रहता है?
e: masai samuday paranparik rup se pashupalak hain, jinaki jamin ka bada hissa aupaniveshik kal mein chhin liya gaya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki aphrika ka sabase prasiddh charavaha samuday kaun sa hai jo purvi aphrika (kenya aur tanjaniya) mein rahata hai? Yahi wajah hai ki masai (Maasai) sahi hai. borana, berabers, somali in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab masai (Maasai) hai. Exam point: masai (Maasai) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which community's land was split by the international border between British Kenya and German Tanzania in 1885?
qh: 1885 में ब्रिटिश केन्या और जर्मन तंजानिया के बीच अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा खींचने से किस समुदाय का इलाका दो हिस्सों में बंट गया?
e: is vibhajan se masai samuday ke behatarin charagah angrejon aur jarmanon ke kabje mein chale gae. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1885 mein british kenya aur jarman tanjaniya ke bich antararashtriy sima khinchane se kis samuday ka ilaka do hisson mein bant gaya? Isi karan se masai (Maasai) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - rayaka, dhanagar, kuruva - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar masai (Maasai) hi hai. Exam point: masai (Maasai) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: The Maasai society was divided into which two social categories?
qh: मसाई समुदाय में सामाजिक व्यवस्था किन दो श्रेणियों में विभाजित थी?
o: वरिष्ठ जन और योद्धा (Elders and Warriors)
e: varishth jan (Elders) shasan chalate the aur yoddha (Warriors) samuday ki raksha karate the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki masai samuday mein samajik vyavastha kin do shreniyon mein vibhajit thi? In tathyon ke chalte varishth jan aur yoddha (Elders and Warriors) hi sahi hai. kisan aur majadur, raja aur praja, vyapari aur shilpi ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se varishth jan aur yoddha (Elders and Warriors) sahi hai. Exam point: varishth jan aur yoddha (Elders and Warriors) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What system did the colonial government use to collect grazing tax between 1850-1880?
qh: औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने चरागाहों पर टैक्स (चरवाही टैक्स) वसूलने के लिए 1850-1880 के बीच कौन सी व्यवस्था अपनाई थी?
e: angrej taiks vasulane ka kam boli lagakar thekedaron ko saunp dete the, jo charavahon se manamana lagan vasulate the. Prashn yah batata hai ki aupaniveshik sarakar ne charagahon par taiks (charavahi taiks) vasulane ke lie 1850-1880 ke bich kaun si vyavastha apanai thi? Yahi wajah hai ki thekedari pratha (Auctioning to Contractors) sahi hai. Galti upahar pranali, mupht charai, sidhi vasuli chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se thekedari pratha (Auctioning to Contractors) sahi hai. Exam point: thekedari pratha (Auctioning to Contractors) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On which Indonesian island did the Dutch implement forest management and control over pastoralists?
qh: इंडोनेशिया के किस द्वीप पर डच (Dutch) लोगों ने वन प्रबंधन और चरवाहों पर नियंत्रण लागू किया था?
e: java kabhi ghane jangalon se dhaka tha, jahan dach logon ne jangalon ko katakar rel aur jahaj ke lie lakadai prapt ki. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki indoneshiya ke kis dvip par dach (Dutch) logon ne van prabandhan aur charavahon par niyantran lagu kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par java sahi nikalta hai. borniyo, sumatra, bali alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab java hai. Exam point: java - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the people of Bastar rebel against the British in 1910?
qh: बस्तर के लोगों ने 1910 में अंग्रेजों के विरुद्ध विद्रोह क्यों किया?
e: jangalon ko arakshit ghoshit karane, kheti rokane aur begar karane jaise phaisalon ne bastar mein vidroh bhadakaya. Is sawaal mein uparokt sabhi (All of the above) ki baat hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par uparokt sabhi (All of the above) sahi nikalta hai. begar (mupht kam) ke karan, jangalon ke arakshan ke karan, bhari lagan ke karan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan uparokt sabhi (All of the above) hi milti hai. Exam point: uparokt sabhi (All of the above) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the process of movement of pastoralists from one place to another called?
qh: चरवाहों द्वारा एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर जाने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: roji-roti aur charagahon ki talash mein ek jagah se dusari jagah jane vale logon ko ghumantu kaha jata hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki charavahon dvara ek sthan se dusare sthan par jane ki prakriya ko kya kaha jata hai? Isi karan se ghumantugiri (Nomadism) sahi uttar hai. apravasan, nirvasan, sthalantaran is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad ghumantugiri (Nomadism) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ghumantugiri (Nomadism) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What are the high-altitude meadows in the mountain regions of Uttarakhand called?
qh: पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में ऊँचाई पर स्थित घास के मैदानों को उत्तराखंड में क्या कहा जाता है?
e: bugyal unche pahadaon par sthit makhamali ghas ke maidan hote hain jo garmiyon mein pashuon ke lie behatarin charagah banate hain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki pahadai kshetron mein unchai par sthit ghas ke maidanon ko uttarakhand mein kya kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bugyal (Bugyals) sahi nikalta hai. doab, tarai, bhabar mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bugyal (Bugyals) hi milti hai. Exam point: bugyal (Bugyals) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which continent are famous National Parks like Maasai Mara and Serengeti located?
qh: मसाई मार और सेरेन्गेटी (Serengeti) जैसे प्रसिद्ध नेशनल पार्क किस महाद्वीप में स्थित हैं?
e: ye neshanal park aphrika mein masai samuday ke purane charagahon par kabja karake banae gae the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki masai mar aur serengeti (Serengeti) jaise prasiddh neshanal park kis mahadvip mein sthit hain? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par aphrika (Africa) hi sahi baithta hai. yurop, ostreliya, eshiya is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab aphrika (Africa) hai. Exam point: aphrika (Africa) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the colonial government in India convert grazing lands into cultivated lands?
qh: भारत में औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने चरागाहों को खेती की जमीन में क्यों बदला?
o: कपास और जूट उगाने के लिए
जमीन को उपजाऊ बनाने के लिए
विकल्प A और B दोनों (Both A and B)
e: angrej kheti ko rajasv badhane aur audyogik kachcha mal prapt karane ka jariya manate the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki bharat mein aupaniveshik sarakar ne charagahon ko kheti ki jamin mein kyon badala? Isi aadhar par vikalp A aur B donon (Both A and B) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp jyada lagan (Tax) vasulane ke lie, kapas aur jut ugane ke lie, jamin ko upajau banane ke lie bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar vikalp A aur B donon (Both A and B) hi hai. Exam point: vikalp A aur B donon (Both A and B) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the Raika community leave their villages after the monsoon?
qh: रायका समुदाय के लोग मानसून के बाद अपने गाँव क्यों छोड़ देते थे?
o: चारागाह सूख जाने के कारण (Grazing lands drying up)
e: aktubar ke bad registan mein ghas khatm ho jati thi, isalie ve nae charagahon ki talash mein hariyana jaise rajyon ki or chale jate the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki rayaka samuday ke log manasun ke bad apane ganv kyon chhod dete the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par charagah sukh jane ke karan (Grazing lands drying up) hi sahi baithta hai. yuddh ke karan, tyohar manane ke lie, badh ke karan is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan charagah sukh jane ke karan (Grazing lands drying up) hi milti hai. Exam point: charagah sukh jane ke karan (Grazing lands... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who is remembered as the prominent leader of the Bastar rebellion (1910)?
qh: बस्तर विद्रोह (1910) के प्रमुख नेता के रूप में किसका नाम लिया जाता है?
e: gunda dhur ne bastar ke logon ko sangathit kiya tha, halanki unhein kabhi pakada nahin ja saka. Is prashn ka dayra gunda dhur tak phaila hua hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par gunda dhur hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. kanu, siddhu, birasa munda ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar gunda dhur hi hai. Exam point: gunda dhur - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the primary function of 'Warriors' in Maasai society?
qh: मसाई समाज में 'योद्धाओं' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: समुदाय की रक्षा और मवेशी छीनना (Protecting community and cattle raiding)
e: yoddhaon ka kam kabile ki raksha karana aur dusare samuhon ke maveshi chhinakar apani mardanagi sabit karana tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki masai samaj mein 'yoddhaon' ka mukhy kary kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par samuday ki raksha aur maveshi chhinana (Protecting community and cattle raiding) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti kheti karana, vyapar karana, mandir banana chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan samuday ki raksha aur maveshi chhinana (Protecting... hi milti hai. Exam point: samuday ki raksha aur maveshi chhinana (Protecting community and cattle raiding) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the impact of India's partition in 1947 on Raika pastoralists?
qh: 1947 में भारत के विभाजन का रायका चरवाहों पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ा?
o: वे अब सिंध (पाकिस्तान) नहीं जा सकते थे (Could not go to Sindh)
e: vibhajan ke bad nai antararashtriy sima ke karan rayaka ab sindh ki charai bhumi par nahin ja sakate the. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1947 mein bharat ke vibhajan ka rayaka charavahon par kya prabhav pada? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par ve ab sindh (pakistan) nahin ja sakate... sahi nikalta hai. Vikalp unhein mupht jamin mili, ve aur amir ho gae, unaka vyapar badh gaya bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar ve ab sindh (pakistan) nahin ja sakate the (Could not go to Sindh) baithta hai. Exam point: ve ab sindh (pakistan) nahin ja sakate... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the process of disappearance or cutting of forests called?
qh: वनों के लुप्त होने या काटने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: jangalon ke gayab hone ke proses ko diphoresteshan kaha jata hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki vanon ke lupt hone ya katane ki prakriya ko kya kaha jata hai? Isi karan se vanon ki katai (Deforestation) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp kheti (Cultivation), vilopan (Extinction), vanikaran (Afforestation) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se vanon ki katai (Deforestation) sahi hai. Exam point: vanon ki katai (Deforestation) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In the 1600s, what fraction of India's total land was under cultivation?
qh: 1600 के दशक में भारत की कुल भूमि के कितने भाग पर खेती होती थी?
e: 1600 ke samay bharat ke lagabhag 1/6 bhag par kheti hoti thi, jo aj badhakar lagabhag 1/2 ho gai hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1600 ke dashak mein bharat ki kul bhumi ke kitane bhag par kheti hoti thi? Isliye antim jawab 1/6 ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - 1/10, 1/2, 1/4 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 1/6 hai. Exam point: 1/6 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which crops did the British encourage for commercial profit in India?
qh: अंग्रेजों ने भारत में किन फसलों के उत्पादन को व्यावसायिक लाभ के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया?
e: angrejon ne kachcha mal prapt karane aur labh kamane ke lie jut, chini, gehun, kapas, chay aur kophi jaisi phasalon ko badhava diya. Is prashn ka kendra uparokt sabhi (All of the above) hai. Isi karan se uparokt sabhi (All of the above) sahi uttar hai. nil aur chay, jut aur kapas (Jute and Cotton), gehun aur ganna alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad uparokt sabhi (All of the above) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: uparokt sabhi (All of the above) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What were the wooden planks laid under railway tracks called?
qh: रेलवे लाइनों के नीचे लकड़ी के जो तख्ते बिछाए जाते थे, उन्हें क्या कहा जाता था?
e: relave patariyon ko apani jagah par rakhane ke lie bichhae gae lakadai ke takhton ko 'slipar' kaha jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki relave lainon ke niche lakadai ke jo takhte bichhae jate the, unhein kya kaha jata tha? In tathyon ke chalte slipar (Sleepers) hi sahi hai. bistar (Beds), bim (Beams), log (Logs) alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad slipar (Sleepers) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: slipar (Sleepers) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How many sleepers were required on average to lay 1 mile of railway track?
qh: 1 मील लंबी रेलवे पटरी बिछाने के लिए औसतन कितने स्लीपरों की आवश्यकता होती थी?
e: ek mil lanbi patari ke lie 1760 se 2000 sliparon ki jarurat hoti thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1 mil lanbi relave patari bichhane ke lie ausatan kitane sliparon ki avashyakata hoti thi? Isliye sahi nateeja 1760-2000 nikalta hai. Galti 1000-1500, 3000-4000, 500-1000 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar 1760-2000 hai. Exam point: 1760-2000 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was appointed as the first Inspector General of Forests in India?
qh: भारत का पहला 'इंस्पेक्टर जनरल ऑफ फॉरेस्ट' किसे नियुक्त किया गया था?
e: jarman visheshajn daitich braindis ko bharat ka pahala van mahanirikshak banaya gaya tha. Is prashn ka kendra daitich braindis (Dietrich Brandis) hai. Isi karan se daitich braindis (Dietrich Brandis) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp viliyam vards, lord riding, jorj yul bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar daitich braindis (Dietrich Brandis) baithta hai. Exam point: daitich braindis (Dietrich Brandis) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was the 'Imperial Forest Research Institute' established in 1906?
qh: 1906 में 'इंपीरियल फॉरेस्ट रिसर्च इंस्टीट्यूट' की स्थापना कहाँ की गई थी?
e: 1906 mein deharadun mein inpiriyal phorest risarch instityut ki sthapana hui thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1906 mein 'inpiriyal phorest risarch instityut' ki sthapana kahan ki gai thi? In tathyon ke chalte deharadun hi sahi hai. nainital, darjiling, shimala alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab deharadun hai. Exam point: deharadun - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the forest management method of planting one species of trees in straight rows called?
qh: वह वन प्रबंधन पद्धति जिसमें एक ही प्रजाति के पेड़ों को सीधी कतारों में लगाया जाता है, क्या कहलाती है?
e: ise planteshan kaha jata hai, jise angrej vaijnanik vaniki (Scientific Forestry) bhi kahate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki vah van prabandhan paddhati jisamein ek hi prajati ke pedaon ko sidhi kataron mein lagaya jata hai, kya kahalati hai? Isi aadhar par vriksharopan/planteshan (Plantation) chuna jaata hai. samajik vaniki, krishi vaniki, prakritik van alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar vriksharopan/planteshan (Plantation) baithta hai. Exam point: vriksharopan/planteshan (Plantation) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Under the Forest Act of 1878, what were the best forests called?
qh: 1878 के वन अधिनियम के तहत सबसे अच्छे जंगलों को क्या कहा गया?
e: 1878 ke adhiniyam ke anusar sabase achchhe vanon ko 'arakshit van' kaha gaya, jahan graminon ka pravesh varjit tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1878 ke van adhiniyam ke tahat sabase achchhe jangalon ko kya kaha gaya? Isi baat se arakshit van (Reserved Forests) sahi sabit hota hai. gramin van (Village Forests), sanrakshit van (Protected Forests), khule van anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se arakshit van (Reserved Forests) sahi hai. Exam point: arakshit van (Reserved Forests) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What is the method of clearing forests, sowing seeds in ashes, and shifting plots called?
qh: जंगलों को साफ करके, राख में बीज बोने और कुछ वर्षों बाद स्थान बदलने वाली खेती को क्या कहते हैं?
e: ise jhum kheti ya shiphting kaltiveshan kaha jata hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki jangalon ko saph karake, rakh mein bij bone aur kuchh varshon bad sthan badalane vali kheti ko kya kahate hain? Isi karan se jhum kheti/ghumantu kheti (Shifting Cultivation) sahi uttar hai. vyavasayik krishi, gahan krishi, sthayi krishi mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad jhum kheti/ghumantu kheti (Shifting Cultivation) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: jhum kheti/ghumantu kheti (Shifting Cultivation) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Why did the British ban shifting cultivation?
qh: अंग्रेजों ने झूम खेती (Shifting Cultivation) पर प्रतिबंध क्यों लगाया?
o: रेलवे के लिए इमारती लकड़ी की कमी का डर
जंगल में आग लगने का खतरा
e: angrejon ko laga ki isase kimati lakadai jal jaegi, relave ke lie lakadai kam hogi aur ghumate hue logon se taiks lena mushkil hoga. Yahaan uparokt sabhi (All of the above) se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi karan se uparokt sabhi (All of the above) sahi uttar hai. lagan vasulane mein kathinai, relave ke lie imarati lakadai ki kami ka dar, jangal mein ag lagane ka khatara anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar uparokt sabhi (All of the above) hi hai. Exam point: uparokt sabhi (All of the above) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who is remembered as the prominent leader of the Bastar rebellion (1910)?
qh: बस्तर विद्रोह (1910) के प्रमुख नेता के रूप में किसे याद किया जाता है?
e: bastar vidroh ka netritv gunda dhur ne kiya tha, jinhein angrej kabhi pakad nahin sake. Is prashn ka dayra gunda dhur tak phaila hua hai. Isi karan se gunda dhur sahi uttar hai. siddhu kanu, alluri sitaram raju, birasa munda is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar gunda dhur baithta hai. Exam point: gunda dhur - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What symbols did the people of Bastar use to spread the message of rebellion?
qh: बस्तर के लोगों ने विद्रोह का संदेश फैलाने के लिए किन प्रतीकों का उपयोग किया?
o: आम की टहनियाँ और मिर्च (Mango boughs and chillies)
e: ganvon mein vidroh ka sandesh dene ke lie am ki tahaniyan, mitti ka dhela, mirch aur tir bheje gae the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bastar ke logon ne vidroh ka sandesh phailane ke lie kin pratikon ka upayog kiya? Isliye antim jawab am ki tahaniyan aur mirch (Mango boughs... ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp nagadae, lal jhanda, kali patti bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan am ki tahaniyan aur mirch (Mango boughs and chillies) hi milti hai. Exam point: am ki tahaniyan aur mirch (Mango boughs and chillies) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which Indonesian island was chosen by the Dutch for forest management like the British?
qh: इंडोनेशिया के किस द्वीप को अंग्रेजों की तरह डच (Dutch) लोगों ने वन प्रबंधन के लिए चुना?
e: dach logon ne indoneshiya ke java dvip par van niyantran ke niyam lagu kie the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki indoneshiya ke kis dvip ko angrejon ki tarah dach (Dutch) logon ne van prabandhan ke lie chuna? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par java hi sahi baithta hai. bali, borniyo, sumatra in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar java hai. Exam point: java - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the name of the community of skilled woodcutters in Java?
qh: जावा में कुशल लकड़हारों और घुमंतू किसानों के समुदाय का नाम क्या था?
e: kalang samuday java ke kushal lakadahare the, jinake bina tik ki katai mushkil thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki java mein kushal lakadaharon aur ghumantu kisanon ke samuday ka nam kya tha? Isi karan se kalang (Kalangs) sahi uttar hai. banjara, munduku, dhurva mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab kalang (Kalangs) hai. Exam point: kalang (Kalangs) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who challenged the Dutch forest ownership in Java?
qh: जावा में डच शासन के खिलाफ विद्रोह करने वाले व्यक्ति का नाम क्या था?
e: surontiko samin ne tark diya ki rajy ne hava, pani aur lakadai nahin banai, isalie vah isaka malik nahin ho sakata. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki java mein dach shasan ke khilaph vidroh karane vale vyakti ka nam kya tha? Isi aadhar par surontiko samin chuna jaata hai. gunda dhur, birasa munda, alluri raju ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar surontiko samin hi hai. Exam point: surontiko samin - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the name of the policy under which the Dutch burnt everything before the Japanese arrived?
qh: डच लोगों द्वारा लागू की गई उस नीति का नाम क्या था जिसमें उन्होंने जापानी सेना के आने से पहले सब कुछ जला दिया?
e: dach ne 'skorchd arth polisi' apanai taki japani sena ko vahan ki ara milein aur tik ke latthe n mil sakein. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki dach logon dvara lagu ki gai us niti ka nam kya tha jisamein unhonne japani sena ke ane se pahale sab kuchh jala diya? In tathyon ke chalte skorchd arth polisi (Scorched Earth Policy) hi sahi hai. Vikalp sivil lo, satyagrah, nuremabarg lo bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se skorchd arth polisi (Scorched Earth Policy) sahi hai. Exam point: skorchd arth polisi (Scorched Earth Policy) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: How many tigers were hunted in India alone between 1875 and 1925?
qh: 1875 और 1925 के बीच अकेले भारत में कितने बाघों (Tigers) का शिकार किया गया?
e: angrejon ne jangali janavaron ko sabhy samaj ke lie khatara manakar 50 varshon mein 80,000 baghon ko mar dala. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1875 aur 1925 ke bich akele bharat mein kitane baghon (Tigers) ka shikar kiya gaya? Isi karan se 80,000 sahi uttar hai. 1,00,000, 10,000, 50,000 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab 80,000 hai. Exam point: 80,000 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The King of which state alone hunted 1157 tigers and 2000 leopards?
qh: किस राज्य के राजा ने अकेले 1157 बाघों और 2000 तेंदुओं का शिकार किया था?
e: saraguja ke maharaja ne 1957 tak akele itane badae paimane par shikar kiya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kis rajy ke raja ne akele 1157 baghon aur 2000 teinduon ka shikar kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par saraguja (Surguja) sahi nikalta hai. bastar, maisur, haidarabad anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar saraguja (Surguja) hi hai. Exam point: saraguja (Surguja) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the Dutch system of exempting rents in exchange for free labor in Java called?
qh: डच लोगों ने जावा में मुफ्त श्रम के बदले लगान माफी की जो प्रणाली लागू की, उसे क्या कहते थे?
e: ise 'bleindongadienasten' kaha jata tha, jisamein lakadaiyon ki dhulai ke lie graminon se mupht kam liya jata tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki dach logon ne java mein mupht shram ke badale lagan maphi ki jo pranali lagu ki, use kya kahate the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bleindongadienasten (Blandongdiensten) sahi nikalta hai. mahalavari, jadedi, raiyatavari alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se bleindongadienasten (Blandongdiensten) sahi hai. Exam point: bleindongadienasten (Blandongdiensten) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Bastar people believed their land was a gift from whom?
qh: बस्तर के लोग अपनी धरती को किसके उपहार के रूप में मानते थे?
e: bastar ke log manate the ki dharati ne unhein jamin di hai, isalie ve har tyauhar par use prasad chadhate the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki bastar ke log apani dharati ko kisake upahar ke rup mein manate the? Isi karan se dharati man (Earth) sahi uttar hai. raja ke, nadi ke, angrejon ke anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se dharati man (Earth) sahi hai. Exam point: dharati man (Earth) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was it called when forest guards demanded free food from villagers?
qh: वन रक्षकों और पुलिस द्वारा ग्रामीणों से मुफ्त भोजन माँगने को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: pulis aur van rakshak graminon ko dara-dhamaka kar aksar mupht bhojan ki mang karate the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki van rakshakon aur pulis dvara graminon se mupht bhojan mangane ko kya kaha jata tha? bhakti ishvar ke prati poorn prem tatha sharanagat ka marg tha. Isi tathya par utpidan (Harassment) tika hua hai. bhakti, sahayog, upahar anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab utpidan (Harassment) hai. Exam point: utpidan (Harassment) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What new approach was adopted by governments after the 1980s to save forests?
qh: 1980 के दशक के बाद वनों को बचाने के लिए सरकारों ने किस नई सोच को अपनाया?
o: स्थानीय समुदायों की भागीदारी (Involving local communities)
ग्रामीणों को पूरी तरह बाहर करना
e: sarakaron ne mahasus kiya ki sthaniy logon ko shamil kie bina jangalon ko nahin bachaya ja sakata. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1980 ke dashak ke bad vanon ko bachane ke lie sarakaron ne kis nai soch ko apanaya? Isi baat se sthaniy samudayon ki bhagidari (Involving local communities) sahi sabit hota hai. sirph mashinein lagana, graminon ko puri tarah bahar karana, sare ped kat dena alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar sthaniy samudayon ki bhagidari (Involving local communities) baithta hai. Exam point: sthaniy samudayon ki bhagidari (Involving local communities) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who used forest resources for non-timber products?
qh: जंगल की संपदा को 'नॉन-टिंबर' (Non-timber) उत्पादों के लिए कौन उपयोग करता था?
e: gramin log shahad, phal, patton aur davaon ke lie jangal ka upayog karate the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki jangal ki sanpada ko 'non-tinbar' (Non-timber) utpadon ke lie kaun upayog karata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sthaniy nivasi/gramin (Local Villagers) hi sahi baithta hai. british nevi, phorest dipartameint, relave thekedar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav sthaniy nivasi/gramin (Local Villagers) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: sthaniy nivasi/gramin (Local Villagers) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which 11-year-old German boy overheard his parents discussing suicide in 1945?
qh: 1945 में किस 11 वर्षीय जर्मन बच्चे ने अपने माता-पिता को आत्महत्या के विषय में चर्चा करते सुना था?
e: helamat ne apane pita (ek naji chikitsak) aur man ko yah charcha karate suna tha ki kya unhein pura parivar khatm kar lena chahie. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1945 mein kis 11 varshiy jarman bachche ne apane mata-pita ko atmahatya ke vishay mein charcha karate suna tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par helamat (Helmuth) sahi nikalta hai. hans, pitar, karl anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar helamat (Helmuth) hi hai. Exam point: helamat (Helmuth) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which main countries were part of the 'Axis Powers' during WWII?
qh: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध (WWII) के दौरान 'एक्सिस पावर्स' (Axis Powers) में मुख्य रूप से कौन से देश शामिल थे?
e: eksis shaktiyon ka netritv jarmani, itali aur japan kar rahe the. Yah prashn jarmani, itali, japan se juda hai. Isi karan se jarmani, itali, japan sahi uttar hai. jarmani, turki, ostriya, briten, phrans, rus, amerika, briten, chin is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab jarmani, itali, japan hai. Exam point: jarmani, itali, japan - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which international court was established after WWII to try Nazi war criminals?
qh: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के बाद नाजियों पर मुकदमा चलाने के लिए किस अंतरराष्ट्रीय कोर्ट की स्थापना की गई थी?
e: nuremabarg mein antararashtriy sainy nyayadhikaran ki sthapana yuddh aparadhiyon ko saja dene ke lie ki gai thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki dvitiy vishv yuddh ke bad najiyon par mukadama chalane ke lie kis antararashtriy kort ki sthapana ki gai thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par nuremabarg tribyunal (Nuremberg Tribunal) sahi nikalta hai. lig oph neshans, sanyukt rashtr, antararashtriy nyayalay (ICJ) is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se nuremabarg tribyunal (Nuremberg Tribunal) sahi hai. Exam point: nuremabarg tribyunal (Nuremberg Tribunal) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which community was targeted most by Nazi Germany under 'Crimes Against Humanity'?
qh: नाजी जर्मनी ने 'मानवता के खिलाफ अपराध' के तहत सबसे ज्यादा किस समुदाय को निशाना बनाया?
e: najiyon ne lagabhag 60 lakh yahudiyon (Jews) ki hatya ki thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki naji jarmani ne 'manavata ke khilaph aparadh' ke tahat sabase jyada kis samuday ko nishana banaya? In tathyon ke chalte yahudi (Jews) hi sahi hai. jipsi, polish, kamyunist alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar yahudi (Jews) baithta hai. Exam point: yahudi (Jews) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the meaning of the word 'Genocide'?
qh: 'जेनोसाइड' (Genocide) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: नस्लीय नरसंहार (Mass murder of a race/group)
e: jenosaid ka arth hai kisi khas nasl ya samuh ke logon ki badae paimane par hatya karana. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 'jenosaid' (Genocide) shabd ka kya arth hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par nasliy narasanhar (Mass murder of a race/group) sahi nikalta hai. ek vyakti ki hatya, yuddh ki ghoshana, atmahatya mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar nasliy narasanhar (Mass murder of a race/group) hai. Exam point: nasliy narasanhar (Mass murder of a race/group) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: By what name is the democratic government established in Germany after WWI known?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के बाद जर्मनी में स्थापित लोकतांत्रिक सरकार को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: pratham vishv yuddh ke bad vaimar mein neshanal aseinbali ki baithak hui aur ek lokatantrik sanvidhan banaya gaya. Is prashn ka dayra vaimar ripablik (Weimar Republic) tak phaila hua hai. Isi aadhar par vaimar ripablik (Weimar Republic) chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - phedaral jarmani, tisara raik, naji shasan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav vaimar ripablik (Weimar Republic) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: vaimar ripablik (Weimar Republic) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the name of the humiliating treaty imposed on Germany after WWI?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के बाद जर्मनी पर थोपी गई अपमानजनक संधि का नाम क्या था?
e: varsay ki sandhi ne jarmani ko arthik aur sainy rup se bahut kamajor kar diya tha. Is prashn ka kendra varsay ki sandhi (Treaty of Versailles) hai. Yahi wajah hai ki varsay ki sandhi (Treaty of Versailles) sahi hai. myunikh samajhauta, tripakshiy sandhi, peris ki sandhi ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav varsay ki sandhi (Treaty of Versailles) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: varsay ki sandhi (Treaty of Versailles) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the name of the major industrial region of Germany occupied by France in 1923?
qh: जर्मनी के उस महत्वपूर्ण औद्योगिक क्षेत्र का नाम क्या था जिसे फ्रांस ने 1923 में कब्जा लिया था?
e: jarmani dvara harjana n chukane par phrans ne usake koyala samriddh 'rur' kshetr par kabja kar liya tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki jarmani ke us mahatvapurn audyogik kshetr ka nam kya tha jise phrans ne 1923 mein kabja liya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par rur (Ruhr) hi sahi baithta hai. myunikh, barlin, bavariya ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se rur (Ruhr) sahi hai. Exam point: rur (Ruhr) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the situation of extreme price rise due to the collapse of the German 'Mark' called?
qh: जर्मन मुद्रा 'मार्क' का मूल्य गिरने से उपजी अत्यधिक महंगाई की स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: jab kimatein betahasha badh jati hain, to use haipar-inphleshan kaha jata hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki jarman mudra 'mark' ka muly girane se upaji atyadhik mahangai ki sthiti ko kya kaha jata hai? Isi baat se haipar-inphleshan (Hyperinflation) sahi sabit hota hai. mandi, arthik sudhar, diphleshan anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad haipar-inphleshan (Hyperinflation) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: haipar-inphleshan (Hyperinflation) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the Wall Street Exchange of USA crash?
qh: अमेरिका का 'वॉल स्ट्रीट एक्सचेंज' (Wall Street Exchange) किस वर्ष क्रैश हुआ था?
e: 1929 mein sheyar bajar girane se duniya bhar mein 'mahan arthik mandi' (Great Depression) ki shuruat hui. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki amerika ka 'vol strit eksacheinj' (Wall Street Exchange) kis varsh kraish hua tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1929 sahi nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - 1914, 1918, 1923 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1929 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1929 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the German Parliament called?
qh: जर्मनी के संसद को किस नाम से पुकारा जाता है?
e: jarmani ki sansad ka nam raikastaig (Reichstag) tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki jarmani ke sansad ko kis nam se pukara jata hai? Isi aadhar par raikastaig (Reichstag) chuna jaata hai. duama, lokasabha, kangres alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar raikastaig (Reichstag) hi hai. Exam point: raikastaig (Reichstag) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which country was Adolf Hitler born?
qh: एडोल्फ हिटलर का जन्म किस देश में हुआ था?
e: hitalar ka janm 1889 mein ostriya mein hua tha, lekin usane jarmani ko apani karmabhumi banaya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki edolph hitalar ka janm kis desh mein hua tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par ostriya (Austria) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - japan, itali, jarmani - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar ostriya (Austria) hai. Exam point: ostriya (Austria) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The party Hitler took control of was later known by what name?
qh: हिटलर ने जिस पार्टी की कमान संभाली, उसे बाद में किस नाम से जाना गया?
e: shuruat mein yah 'jarman varkars parti' thi, jisaka nam badalakar 'neshanal soshalist jarman varkars parti' (naji parti) rakha gaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki hitalar ne jis parti ki kaman sanbhali, use bad mein kis nam se jana gaya? In tathyon ke chalte naji parti (Nazi Party) hi sahi hai. lebar parti, soshal demokretik parti, kamyunist parti anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan naji parti (Nazi Party) hi milti hai. Exam point: naji parti (Nazi Party) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: When was Hitler offered the Chancellorship of Germany?
qh: हिटलर को जर्मनी का चांसलर (Chancellor) बनने का निमंत्रण कब दिया गया?
e: rashtrapati hindanabarg ne 30 janavari 1933 ko hitalar ko chansalaraship ophar ki thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki hitalar ko jarmani ka chansalar (Chancellor) banane ka nimantran kab diya gaya? Isi karan se 30 janavari 1933 sahi uttar hai. Galti 1923, 1929, 1945 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 30 janavari 1933 hi hai. Exam point: 30 janavari 1933 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Through which act was dictatorship established in Germany?
qh: किस प्रसिद्ध अधिनियम के जरिए जर्मनी में डिक्टेटरशिप (तानाशाही) स्थापित हुई?
e: 3 march 1933 ko parit 'inebaling ekt' ne hitalar ko sansad ko darakinar kar shasan karane ki shakti di. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki kis prasiddh adhiniyam ke jarie jarmani mein diktetaraship (tanashahi) sthapit hui? Isi baat se inebaling ekt (Enabling Act) sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - varsay ekt, phayar dikri, nuremabarg lo - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se inebaling ekt (Enabling Act) sahi hai. Exam point: inebaling ekt (Enabling Act) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the secret state police of Nazi Germany called?
qh: नाजी जर्मनी की गुप्तचर राज्य पुलिस को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: gistapo (Gestapo) najiyon ki khunkhar guptachar pulis thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki naji jarmani ki guptachar rajy pulis ko kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par gistapo (Gestapo) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. esaes (SS), sibiai, kejivi in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar gistapo (Gestapo) baithta hai. Exam point: gistapo (Gestapo) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which year did Hitler integrate Austria and Germany?
qh: हिटलर ने ऑस्ट्रिया और जर्मनी को किस वर्ष 'एक जन, एक साम्राज्य, एक नेता' के नारे के तहत मिलाया?
e: 1938 mein hitalar ne ostriya par kabja kar use jarmani mein mila liya tha. Is prashn ka kendra 1938 hai. Yahi wajah hai ki 1938 sahi hai. 1936, 1939, 1933 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1938 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1938 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein. Prashn chhota lage par iske peeche poora ek ghatna-kram tatha saal ka gyaan chhupa hota hai, isliye poora sandarbh dhyan mein rakhein.

qe: Attack on which country in Sept 1939 marked the beginning of WWII?
qh: सितंबर 1939 में किस देश पर हमले के साथ द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध की शुरुआत हुई?
e: jarmani dvara polaind par hamale ke bad phrans aur briten ne yuddh ki ghoshana kar di thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki sitanbar 1939 mein kis desh par hamale ke sath dvitiy vishv yuddh ki shuruat hui? Isi baat se polaind (Poland) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti phrans, briten, rus chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar polaind (Poland) hai. Exam point: polaind (Poland) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was at the top of Hitler's racial hierarchy?
qh: हिटलर की नस्लीय विचारधारा में सबसे ऊंचे पायदान पर कौन थे?
e: hitalar ke anusar nili ankhon vale nordik jarman ary sarvashreshth nasl the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki hitalar ki nasliy vicharadhara mein sabase unche payadan par kaun the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par nordik jarman ary (Nordic German Aryans) sahi nikalta hai. rashiyan, jipsi, yahudi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar nordik jarman ary (Nordic German Aryans) hi hai. Exam point: nordik jarman ary (Nordic German Aryans) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What name was given to the gas chambers used by Nazis to kill people?
qh: नाजियों द्वारा लोगों को मारने के लिए बनाए गए 'गैस चेंबर' को क्या नाम दिया गया था?
e: najiyon ne gais cheinbar ko chhalave ke lie 'sankraman mukti kshetr' (Disinfection Areas) kaha tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki najiyon dvara logon ko marane ke lie banae gae 'gais cheinbar' ko kya nam diya gaya tha? Isi aadhar par disainphekshan eriya (Disinfection Areas) chuna jaata hai. bankar, kiling phild, torchar rum alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad disainphekshan eriya (Disinfection Areas) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: disainphekshan eriya (Disinfection Areas) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which group did 10-year-old Nazi children have to join?
qh: 10 वर्ष की आयु के नाजी बच्चों को किस समूह में शामिल होना पड़ता था?
e: 10 sal ke bachchon ko jungavok mein shamil hona padata tha, jahan unhein naji vicharadhara sikhai jati thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 10 varsh ki ayu ke naji bachchon ko kis samuh mein shamil hona padata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par jungavok (Jungvolk) hi sahi baithta hai. naji sena, hitalar yuth, lebar sarvis in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab jungavok (Jungvolk) hai. Exam point: jungavok (Jungvolk) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the name of the organization for 14-year-old boys in Nazi Germany?
qh: नाजी जर्मनी में 14 वर्ष की आयु के लड़कों के संगठन का क्या नाम था?
e: 14 sal ki umr mein ladakon ko hitalar yuth join karana hota tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki naji jarmani mein 14 varsh ki ayu ke ladakon ke sangathan ka kya nam tha? Isi aadhar par hitalar yuth (Hitler Youth) chuna jaata hai. red kros, boy skauts, ary samaj mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad hitalar yuth (Hitler Youth) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: hitalar yuth (Hitler Youth) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which was the most infamous Nazi propaganda film against Jews?
qh: यहूदियों के प्रति नफरत फैलाने के लिए बनाई गई सबसे कुख्यात नाजी फिल्म कौन सी थी?
e: 'd itaranal jyu' philm ke madhyam se yahudiyon ki chhavi kharab ki gai thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki yahudiyon ke prati napharat phailane ke lie banai gai sabase kukhyat naji philm kaun si thi? Isi baat se d itaranal jyu (The Eternal Jew) sahi sabit hota hai. aryan blad, gret diktetar, naji praid in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab d itaranal jyu (The Eternal Jew) hai. Exam point: d itaranal jyu (The Eternal Jew) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the mass killing of people by Nazis known as?
qh: नाजियों द्वारा किए गए सामूहिक नरसंहार को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: yahudiyon ke samuhik katleam ko 'holokast' (mahadhvans) kaha jata hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki najiyon dvara kie gae samuhik narasanhar ko kis nam se jana jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par holokast (Holocaust) hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp svatantrata sangram, kranti, vishv yuddh bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan holokast (Holocaust) hi milti hai. Exam point: holokast (Holocaust) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The famous German car company 'Volkswagen' was started during whose rule?
qh: जर्मनी की प्रसिद्ध कार कंपनी 'फॉक्सवैगन' (Volkswagen) की शुरुआत किसके शासनकाल में हुई?
e: hitalar ke arthik punarnirman karyakram ke tahat 'pipuls kar' (Volkswagen) projekt shuru hua tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki jarmani ki prasiddh kar kanpani 'phoksavaigan' (Volkswagen) ki shuruat kisake shasanakal mein hui? Isi aadhar par hitalar (Hitler) chuna jaata hai. hindanabarg, bismark, kaisar viliyam alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad hitalar (Hitler) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: hitalar (Hitler) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which three main groups emerged for social reform in Europe after the French Revolution?
qh: फ्रांसीसी क्रांति के बाद यूरोप में समाज सुधार के लिए कौन से तीन मुख्य समूह उभरे?
o: उदारवादी, कट्टरपंथी और रूढ़िवादी (Liberals, Radicals, Conservatives)
e: samaj mein badalav ke vicharon ke adhar par logon ko libarals, redikals aur kanjaravetivs shreniyon mein banta gaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki phransisi kranti ke bad yurop mein samaj sudhar ke lie kaun se tin mukhy samuh ubhare? Isi aadhar par udaravadi, kattarapanthi aur rudhaivadi (Liberals, Radicals, Conservatives) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp sainik, padari aur kulin, kisan, majadur aur vyapari, raja, mantri aur darabari bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan udaravadi, kattarapanthi aur rudhaivadi (Liberals, Radicals, Conservatives) hi milti hai. Exam point: udaravadi, kattarapanthi aur rudhaivadi (Liberals, Radicals, Conservatives) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which group was against the uncontrolled power of dynastic rulers and wanted to safeguard individual rights?
qh: कौन सा समूह वंशानुगत शासकों की अनियंत्रित सत्ता के खिलाफ था और व्यक्तिगत अधिकारों की सुरक्षा चाहता था?
e: udaravadi (Liberals) ek nirvachit sansadiy sarakar aur svatantr nyayapalika ke pakshadhar the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kaun sa samuh vanshanugat shasakon ki aniyantrit satta ke khilaph tha aur vyaktigat adhikaron ki suraksha chahata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par udaravadi (Liberals) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. rudhaivadi, aristokret, kattarapanthi anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar udaravadi (Liberals) hi hai. Exam point: udaravadi (Liberals) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which statement is true regarding Liberals?
qh: उदारवादियों (Liberals) के संदर्भ में कौन सा कथन सही है?
o: वे सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार चाहते थे
वे महिलाओं के वोट के समर्थक थे
वे सभी संपत्तिहीनों को वोट देना चाहते थे
e: udaravadi lokatantravadi nahin the kyonki ve keval sanpattivan purushon ko hi vot dene ka adhikar dena chahate the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki udaravadiyon (Liberals) ke sandarbh mein kaun sa kathan sahi hai? Isi aadhar par ve lokatantravadi (Democrats) nahin the chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - ve sarvabhaumik vayask matadhikar chahate the, ve mahilaon ke vot ke samarthak the, ve sabhi sanpattihinon ko vot dena chahate the - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad ve lokatantravadi (Democrats) nahin the hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ve lokatantravadi (Democrats) nahin the - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Socialists were staunch opponents of which system?
qh: समाजवादी (Socialists) किस व्यवस्था के कट्टर विरोधी थे?
e: samajavadiyon ka manana tha ki niji sanpatti hi samaj ki sabhi buraiyon ki jad hai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki samajavadi (Socialists) kis vyavastha ke kattar virodhi the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par niji sanpatti (Private Property) hi sahi baithta hai. samanata, lokatantr, rajashahi in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab niji sanpatti (Private Property) hai. Exam point: niji sanpatti (Private Property) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who established the cooperative community called 'New Harmony'?
qh: 'न्यू हार्मनी' (New Harmony) नामक सहकारी समुदाय की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: robart ovan ek angreji nirmata the jinhonne amerika mein 'nyu harmani' namak sahakari samuday banaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 'nyu harmani' (New Harmony) namak sahakari samuday ki sthapana kisane ki thi? Isi aadhar par robart ovan (Robert Owen) chuna jaata hai. lui blank, karl marks, phredarik engels mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan robart ovan (Robert Owen) hi milti hai. Exam point: robart ovan (Robert Owen) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which thinker argued that industrial society is 'capitalist' and workers must overthrow it?
qh: किस विचारक ने तर्क दिया कि औद्योगिक समाज 'पूंजीवादी' है और मजदूरों को इसे उखाड़ फेंकना चाहिए?
e: karl marks ka manana tha ki majaduron ko ek samyavadi (Communist) samaj banana chahie jahan sanpatti par samaj ka niyantran ho. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kis vicharak ne tark diya ki audyogik samaj 'punjivadi' hai aur majaduron ko ise ukhad pheinkana chahie? Isliye sahi nateeja karl marks (Karl Marx) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - jar nikolas, lui blank, robart ovan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad karl marks (Karl Marx) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: karl marks (Karl Marx) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which international body did Socialists form in the 1870s to coordinate their efforts?
qh: समाजवादियों ने अपने प्रयासों के समन्वय के लिए 1870 के दशक में किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संस्था का गठन किया?
e: soshalist vicharon ke prachar ke lie 'dvitiy intaraneshanal' namak antarrashtriy sanstha banai gai thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki samajavadiyon ne apane prayason ke samanvay ke lie 1870 ke dashak mein kis antarrashtriy sanstha ka gathan kiya? Isi baat se dvitiy intaraneshanal (Second International) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti sanyukt rashtr, pratham intaraneshanal, lig oph neshans chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar dvitiy intaraneshanal (Second International) baithta hai. Exam point: dvitiy intaraneshanal (Second International) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who ruled the Russian Empire in 1914?
qh: 1914 में रूसी साम्राज्य पर किसका शासन था?
e: 1914 mein jar nikolas dvitiy rus ka nirankush shasak tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1914 mein rusi samrajy par kisaka shasan tha? Isi aadhar par jar nikolas dvitiy (Tsar Nicholas II) chuna jaata hai. lui XVI, stalin, lenin is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar jar nikolas dvitiy (Tsar Nicholas II) hi hai. Exam point: jar nikolas dvitiy (Tsar Nicholas II) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the commune of peasants in Russia called?
qh: रूस में खेती करने वाले किसानों के बीच प्रचलित कलेक्टिव (Commune) को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: rusi kisan samay-samay par apani jamin apane 'mir' (kayumun) ko saunp dete the, jo parivaron ki jarurat ke hisab se use bantata tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rus mein kheti karane vale kisanon ke bich prachalit kalektiv (Commune) ko kya kaha jata tha? In tathyon ke chalte mir hi sahi hai. duma, soviyat, kulak mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar mir hi hai. Exam point: mir - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: The Russian Social Democratic Workers Party split into which two groups?
qh: रूसी सोशल डेमोक्रेटिक वर्कर्स पार्टी (1898) किन दो समूहों में विभाजित हो गई थी?
e: lenin ke netritv vale samuh ko bolshevik aur dusare ko menshevik kaha gaya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki rusi soshal demokretik varkars parti (1898) kin do samuhon mein vibhajit ho gai thi? Isi karan se bolshevik aur menshevik (Bolsheviks and Mensheviks) sahi uttar hai. Galti punjivadi aur samajavadi, saphed aur lal, udaravadi aur kattarapanthi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad bolshevik aur menshevik (Bolsheviks and Mensheviks) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bolshevik aur menshevik (Bolsheviks and Mensheviks) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the leader of the Bolshevik group?
qh: बोल्शेविक (Bolshevik) समूह के नेता कौन थे?
e: lenin bolshevikon ke neta the aur ve parti mein kadae anushasan ke pakshadhar the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bolshevik (Bolshevik) samuh ke neta kaun the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par vladimir lenin hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp liyon trotski, joseph stalin, alekjeindar kerenski bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan vladimir lenin hi milti hai. Exam point: vladimir lenin - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the 'Bloody Sunday' incident occur in Russia?
