qh: रूस में 'खूनी रविवार' (Bloody Sunday) की घटना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: janavari 1905 mein padari gaipon ke netritv mein majaduron ke julus par pulis ke hamale ko khuni ravivar kaha jata hai. Is prashn ka dayra 1905 tak phaila hua hai. Yahi wajah hai ki 1905 sahi hai. Galti 1914, 1898, 1917 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1905 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1905 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: After the 1905 revolution, which elected consultative parliament did the Tsar allow?
qh: 1905 की क्रांति के बाद जार ने किस निर्वाचित परामर्शदाता संसद के गठन की अनुमति दी?
e: rus ki nirvachit paramarshadata sansad ko 'duma' kaha jata hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 1905 ki kranti ke bad jar ne kis nirvachit paramarshadata sansad ke gathan ki anumati di? Isliye antim jawab duma ke roop mein milta hai. kangres, sansad, soviyat mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar duma baithta hai. Exam point: duma - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Why was St. Petersburg renamed 'Petrograd' during WWI?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान सेंट पीटर्सबर्ग का नाम बदलकर 'पेट्रोग्राद' क्यों कर दिया गया?
o: सेंट पीटर्सबर्ग एक जर्मन नाम था
e: jarmani ke prati napharat ke karan rusiyon ne jarman nam 'seint pitarsabarg' ko badalakar 'petrograd' kar diya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki pratham vishv yuddh ke dauran seint pitarsabarg ka nam badalakar 'petrograd' kyon kar diya gaya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par seint pitarsabarg ek jarman nam tha hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp yah lenin ka shahar tha, yah sundar tha, yah jar ka adesh tha bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan seint pitarsabarg ek jarman nam tha hi milti hai. Exam point: seint pitarsabarg ek jarman nam tha - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the main outcome of the February Revolution (1917) in Russia?
qh: रूस में फरवरी क्रांति (1917) का मुख्य परिणाम क्या था?
e: pharavari kranti ke karan jar ko apani rajagaddi chhodani padai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki rus mein pharavari kranti (1917) ka mukhy parinam kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja rajashahi ka ant (Fall of Monarchy) nikalta hai. lenin ki satta, sanvidhan ka nirman, vishv yuddh ki samapti alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar rajashahi ka ant (Fall of Monarchy) hi hai. Exam point: rajashahi ka ant (Fall of Monarchy) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which three demands were included in Lenin's 'April Theses'?
qh: लेनिन की 'अप्रैल थीसिस' (April Theses) में कौन सी तीन मांगें शामिल थीं?
o: समानता हो, स्वतंत्रता हो, भाईचारा हो
राजा का शासन बना रहे, कर कम हों, प्रेस को आजादी मिले
युद्ध जारी रहे, ज़मीन कुलीनों की हो, बैंक निजी हों
युद्ध समाप्त हो, ज़मीन किसानों को मिले, बैंकों का राष्ट्रीयकरण हो
e: lenin ne yuddh samapti, bhumi hastantaran aur bainkon ke rashtriyakaran ki mang rakhi thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki lenin ki 'aprail thisis' (April Theses) mein kaun si tin mangein shamil thin? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par yuddh samapt ho, jamin kisanon ko mile, bainkon ka rashtriyakaran ho hi sahi baithta hai. samanata ho, svatantrata ho, bhaichara ho, raja ka shasan bana rahe, kar kam hon, pres ko ajadi mile, yuddh jari rahe, jamin kulinon ki ho, baink niji hon is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar yuddh samapt ho, jamin kisanon ko mile, bainkon ka rashtriyakaran ho hai. Exam point: yuddh samapt ho, jamin kisanon ko mile, bainkon ka rashtriyakaran ho - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which party's rule was established in Russia after the October Revolution (1917)?
qh: अक्टूबर क्रांति (1917) के बाद रूस में किस पार्टी का शासन स्थापित हुआ?
e: aktubar kranti ke bad bolshevikon ne satta sanbhali aur parti ka nam kamyunist parti rakh diya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki aktubar kranti (1917) ke bad rus mein kis parti ka shasan sthapit hua? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bolshevik parti (kamyunist parti) hi sahi baithta hai. libaral parti, rusi rudhaivadi parti, menshevik parti mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad bolshevik parti (kamyunist parti) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bolshevik parti (kamyunist parti) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who were called 'Reds' during the Russian Civil War?
qh: रूसी गृहयुद्ध (Civil War) के दौरान 'रेड्स' (Reds) किसे कहा जाता था?
e: bolshevikon ko 'reds', samajik krantikariyon ko 'grins' aur jar samarthakon ko 'vhaits' kaha jata tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki rusi grihayuddh (Civil War) ke dauran 'reds' (Reds) kise kaha jata tha? Isi aadhar par bolshevik (Bolsheviks) chuna jaata hai. jar ke samarthak, samajavadi krantikari, videshi senaen in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bolshevik (Bolsheviks) hi milti hai. Exam point: bolshevik (Bolsheviks) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: When were 'Five Year Plans' started under the planned economy in Soviet Russia?
qh: सोवियत रूस में नियोजित अर्थव्यवस्था के तहत 'पंचवर्षीय योजनाएं' (Five Year Plans) कब शुरू की गई थीं?
e: pahali panchavarshiy yojana 1927-1932 ke dauran lagu ki gai thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki soviyat rus mein niyojit arthavyavastha ke tahat 'panchavarshiy yojanaen' (Five Year Plans) kab shuru ki gai thin? Isi baat se 1927 sahi sabit hota hai. 1917, 1945, 1935 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 1927 hi hai. Exam point: 1927 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were well-to-do peasants called in Russia?
qh: रूस में संपन्न किसानों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: amir aur sanpann kisanon ko rus mein 'kulak' ke nam se jana jata tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki rus mein sanpann kisanon ko kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par kulak (Kulaks) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - majadur, samant, mir - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kulak (Kulaks) hi milti hai. Exam point: kulak (Kulaks) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was Stalin's 'Collectivisation' program?
qh: स्टालिन का 'सामूहिकीकरण' (Collectivisation) कार्यक्रम क्या था?
o: खेतों को मिलाकर बड़े सरकारी फार्म बनाना (Kolkhoz)
e: stalin ne chhote kheton ko milakar badae samuhik pharm 'kolkhoj' banane ki niti apanai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki stalin ka 'samuhikikaran' (Collectivisation) karyakram kya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par kheton ko milakar badae sarakari pharm banana (Kolkhoz) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti phaiktriyan lagana, majaduron ko vetan dena, yuddh ki taiyari chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad kheton ko milakar badae sarakari pharm banana... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kheton ko milakar badae sarakari pharm banana (Kolkhoz) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which year was the Soviet Union (USSR) formed?
qh: सोवियत संघ (USSR) का गठन किस वर्ष हुआ था?
e: rus aur usake adhin rajyon ko milakar disanbar 1922 mein soviyat sangh (USSR) banaya gaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki soviyat sangh (USSR) ka gathan kis varsh hua tha? In tathyon ke chalte 1922 hi sahi hai. 1924, 1920, 1917 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1922 baithta hai. Exam point: 1922 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the Russian Secret Police initially known as?
qh: रूस की गुप्तचर पुलिस (Secret Police) को शुरुआत में किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: bolshevikon ne virodhiyon ko dabane ke lie 'cheka' namak guptachar pulis banai thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki rus ki guptachar pulis (Secret Police) ko shuruat mein kis nam se jana jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par cheka hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. CBI, Gestapo, KGB ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar cheka hi hai. Exam point: cheka - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which Indian leader visited Soviet Russia and wrote about Soviet Socialism?
qh: किस भारतीय राजनेता ने सोवियत रूस की यात्रा की और 'सोवियत सोशलिज्म' पर लिखा था?
e: javaharalal neharu aur ravindranath taigor rusi kranti aur soviyat prayogon se bahut prabhavit the. Is sawaal mein javaharalal neharu (Jawaharlal Nehru) ki baat hai. Isi karan se javaharalal neharu (Jawaharlal Nehru) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - bhagat sinh, mahatma gandhi, saradar patel - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad javaharalal neharu (Jawaharlal Nehru) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: javaharalal neharu (Jawaharlal Nehru) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to which calendar did the October Revolution occur on 25 Oct 1917?
qh: रूस में अक्टूबर क्रांति किस कैलेंडर के अनुसार 25 अक्टूबर 1917 को हुई थी?
e: rus us samay juliyan kaileindar manata tha, jo gregoriyan kaileindar se 13 din pichhe tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki rus mein aktubar kranti kis kaileindar ke anusar 25 aktubar 1917 ko hui thi? Isliye antim jawab juliyan kaileindar (Julian Calendar) ke roop mein milta hai. hindu kaileindar, gregoriyan kaileindar, islami kaileindar anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad juliyan kaileindar (Julian Calendar) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: juliyan kaileindar (Julian Calendar) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: When did the attack on the Bastille fortress prison take place in Paris?
qh: पेरिस में बास्तील (Bastille) के किले की जेल पर हमला कब हुआ था?
e: 14 julai 1789 ko gussai bhid ne bastil ke kile par hamala kiya, jo raja ki nirankush shaktiyon ka pratik tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki peris mein bastil (Bastille) ke kile ki jel par hamala kab hua tha? Isi baat se 14 julai 1789 sahi sabit hota hai. 5 mai 1789, 20 jun 1789, 21 janavari 1793 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 14 julai 1789 hi hai. Exam point: 14 julai 1789 - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who was the King of France during the French Revolution?
qh: फ्रांसीसी क्रांति के समय फ्रांस का राजा कौन था?
e: kranti ke samay burbo (Bourbon) rajavansh ka lui XVI phrans ka shasak tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki phransisi kranti ke samay phrans ka raja kaun tha? Isliye sahi nateeja lui XVI nikalta hai. Galti lui XV, lui XIV, nepoliyan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad lui XVI hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: lui XVI - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Louis XVI was married to Marie Antoinette, the princess of which country?
qh: लुई XVI का विवाह किस देश की राजकुमारी मेरी एंतोएनेत (Marie Antoinette) से हुआ था?
e: lui XVI ka vivah ostriya ki rajakumari meri entoenet se hua tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki lui XVI ka vivah kis desh ki rajakumari meri entoenet (Marie Antoinette) se hua tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par ostriya hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. rus, briten, prashiya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad ostriya hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: ostriya - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which estate was responsible for paying taxes in French society?
qh: फ्रांसीसी समाज में कर (Tax) अदा करने की जिम्मेदारी किस एस्टेट की थी?
e: phrans mein keval tritiy estet ke log (kisan, vyapari, vakil adi) hi kar dete the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki phransisi samaj mein kar (Tax) ada karane ki jimmedari kis estet ki thi? Yahi wajah hai ki tritiy estet (Third Estate) sahi hai. sabhi estet, pratham estet (First Estate), dvitiy estet (Second Estate) ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar tritiy estet (Third Estate) hi hai. Exam point: tritiy estet (Third Estate) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the religious tax collected by the Church from peasants called?
qh: चर्च द्वारा किसानों से वसूला जाने वाला धार्मिक कर क्या कहलाता था?
e: charch kisanon se unaki upaj ka 1/10 hissa 'taid' (Tithe) ke rup mein leta tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki charch dvara kisanon se vasula jane vala dharmik kar kya kahalata tha? Isi baat se taid (Tithe) sahi sabit hota hai. stet, tail (Taille), libre anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab taid (Tithe) hai. Exam point: taid (Tithe) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the French currency 'Livre' discontinued?
qh: फ्रांस की मुद्रा 'लिब्रे' (Livre) को किस वर्ष समाप्त कर दिया गया था?
e: libre phrans ki purani mudra thi jise 1794 mein samapt kar diya gaya tha. Yahaan 1794 se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1794 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1789, 1804, 1791 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 1794 hai. Exam point: 1794 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein. Is vishay mein poochhe jaane wale anya bindu bhi isi tathya se jude hote hain, isliye ek baar samajh lene par kaee prashnon ke jawab aasan ho jate hain.

qe: What is a situation called when the basic means of livelihood are endangered?
qh: ऐसी स्थिति जब जीवित रहने के न्यूनतम साधन भी खतरे में पड़ जाते हैं, क्या कहलाती है?
e: ise 'sabasisteins kraisis' (Subsistence Crisis) kaha jata hai, jahan bhojan ki kami aur badhati kimaton se jivan khatare mein p ta hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki aisi sthiti jab jivit rahane ke nyunatam sadhan bhi khatare mein pad jate hain, kya kahalati hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sabasisteins kraisis (jinika sankat) hi sahi baithta hai. arthik mandi, akal, sukha is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar sabasisteins kraisis (jinika sankat) hi hai. Exam point: sabasisteins kraisis (jinika sankat) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who wrote the book 'Two Treatises of Government'?
qh: 'टू ट्रीटाइज़ ऑफ़ गवर्नमेंट' (Two Treatises of Government) पुस्तक के लेखक कौन थे?
e: jon lok ne apani pustak mein raja ke daiviy aur nirankush adhikaron ka khandan kiya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 'tu tritaij oph gavarnameint' (Two Treatises of Government) pustak ke lekhak kaun the? Yahi wajah hai ki jon lok sahi hai. monteskyu, jin jaik ruso, mirabyu in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar jon lok baithta hai. Exam point: jon lok - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who gave the idea of a democratic government through 'The Social Contract'?
qh: 'द सोशल कॉन्ट्रैक्ट' (The Social Contract) के माध्यम से लोकतांत्रिक सरकार का विचार किसने दिया?
e: ruso ne janata aur unake pratinidhiyon ke bich ek samajik anubandh (soshal kontraikt) par adharit sarakar ka prastav rakha tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 'd soshal kontraikt' (The Social Contract) ke madhyam se lokatantrik sarakar ka vichar kisane diya? In tathyon ke chalte jin jaik ruso hi sahi hai. nepoliyan, maiksimiliyan robespyer, jon lok ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab jin jaik ruso hai. Exam point: jin jaik ruso - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who proposed the division of power within the government in 'The Spirit of Laws'?
qh: 'द स्पिरिट ऑफ़ लॉज़' (The Spirit of Laws) में सत्ता के विभाजन (विधायिका, कार्यपालिका, न्यायपालिका) का सिद्धांत किसने दिया?
e: monteskyu ne shaktiyon ke prithakkaran (Separation of Powers) ka siddhant diya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki 'd spirit oph loj' (The Spirit of Laws) mein satta ke vibhajan (vidhayika, karyapalika, nyayapalika) ka siddhant kisane diya? Isliye sahi nateeja monteskyu (Montesquieu) nikalta hai. ruso, volteyar, jon lok alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan monteskyu (Montesquieu) hi milti hai. Exam point: monteskyu (Montesquieu) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When did the representatives of the Third Estate declare themselves as the 'National Assembly'?
qh: तृतीय एस्टेट के प्रतिनिधियों ने खुद को 'नेशनल असेंबली' कब घोषित किया था?
e: 20 jun 1789 ko varsay ke indor tenis kort mein jama hokar unhonne khud ko neshanal aseinbali ghoshit kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki tritiy estet ke pratinidhiyon ne khud ko 'neshanal aseinbali' kab ghoshit kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja 20 jun 1789 nikalta hai. 5 mai 1789, 14 julai 1789, 4 agast 1789 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 20 jun 1789 hai. Exam point: 20 jun 1789 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who wrote the influential pamphlet 'What is the Third Estate?'?
qh: 'तीसरा एस्टेट क्या है?' (What is the Third Estate?) नामक प्रभावशाली प्रचार पुस्तिका (पम्फलेट) किसने लिखी थी?
e: abe sie mul rup se ek padari (Priest) the jinhonne yah prasiddh pamphalet likha tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 'tisara estet kya hai?' (What is the Third Estate?) namak prabhavashali prachar pustika (pamphalet) kisane likhi thi? Isi baat se abe sie (Abbe Sieyes) sahi sabit hota hai. ruso, mirabyu, lui XVI mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab abe sie (Abbe Sieyes) hai. Exam point: abe sie (Abbe Sieyes) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who composed the national anthem of France, the 'Marseillaise'?
qh: फ्रांस के राष्ट्रगान 'मार्सिले' (Marseillaise) की रचना किसने की थी?
e: kavi rojet di' ail ne is deshabhakti git ki rachana ki thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki phrans ke rashtragan 'marsile' (Marseillaise) ki rachana kisane ki thi? Isi karan se rojet di' ail (Roget de L'Isle) sahi uttar hai. monteskyu, mirabyu, nepoliyan is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se rojet di' ail (Roget de L'Isle) sahi hai. Exam point: rojet di' ail (Roget de L'Isle) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which period is known as the 'Reign of Terror' in France?
qh: फ्रांस में 'आतंक का राज्य' (Reign of Terror) किस काल को कहा जाता है?
e: maiksimiliyan robespyer ke shasanakal (1793-1794) ko 'atank ka rajy' kaha jata hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki phrans mein 'atank ka rajy' (Reign of Terror) kis kal ko kaha jata hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1793-1794 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1789-1791, 1791-1792, 1795-1799 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 1793-1794 hai. Exam point: 1793-1794 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the Guillotine?
qh: गिलोटीन (Guillotine) क्या था?
o: सिर कलम करने वाली मशीन (Beheading device)
e: gilotin do khanbhon ke bich latakati ari vali mashin thi jisase aparadhi ka sir kat diya jata tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki gilotin (Guillotine) kya tha? Isi baat se sir kalam karane vali mashin (Beheading device) sahi sabit hota hai. ek kar, ek kila, ek rajanitik klab anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad sir kalam karane vali mashin (Beheading device) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: sir kalam karane vali mashin (Beheading device) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the members of the Jacobin Club called?
qh: जैकोबिन क्लब के सदस्यों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: ve bina ghutane vale kapadae (ni-brichej ke bina) pahanate the, isalie unhein 'sau-kulot' kaha gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki jaikobin klab ke sadasyon ko kya kaha jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki sau-kulot (Sans-culottes) sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - klarji, paduri, nobals - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad sau-kulot (Sans-culottes) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: sau-kulot (Sans-culottes) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which year did women in France win the right to vote?
qh: फ्रांस में महिलाओं को मतदान का अधिकार किस वर्ष प्राप्त हुआ?
e: lanbe sangharsh ke bad 1946 mein phrans ki mahilaon ko vot dene ka adhikar mila. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki phrans mein mahilaon ko matadan ka adhikar kis varsh prapt hua? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1946 sahi nikalta hai. 1791, 1914, 1848 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 1946 hi hai. Exam point: 1946 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who was Olympe de Gouges?
qh: ओलम्प दे गूज़ (Olympe de Gouges) कौन थी?
o: क्रांतिकारी महिला और लेखिका (Revolutionary woman and writer)
e: vah ek krantikari mahila thin jinhonne 'mahila evan nagarik adhikar ghoshanapatr' likha tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki olamp de guj (Olympe de Gouges) kaun thi? Yahi wajah hai ki krantikari mahila aur lekhika (Revolutionary woman and writer) sahi hai. ek rani, ek dasi, ek chitrakar in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar krantikari mahila aur lekhika (Revolutionary woman and... hi hai. Exam point: krantikari mahila aur lekhika (Revolutionary woman and writer) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: When was slavery finally abolished in the French colonies?
qh: फ्रांसीसी उपनिवेशों से दास प्रथा (Slavery) का अंतिम रूप से उन्मूलन कब हुआ?
e: 1848 mein phransisi upaniveshon se das pratha ko puri tarah samapt kar diya gaya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki phransisi upaniveshon se das pratha (Slavery) ka antim rup se unmulan kab hua? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1848 sahi nikalta hai. 1804, 1815, 1794 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 1848 hai. Exam point: 1848 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: When did Napoleon Bonaparte crown himself Emperor of France?
qh: नेपोलियन बोनापार्ट ने खुद को फ्रांस का सम्राट कब घोषित किया?
e: 1804 mein nepoliyan ne khud ko phrans ka samrat ghoshit kar padaosi deshon par vijay abhiyan shuru kiya. Is prashn ka kendra 1804 hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1804 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1815, 1799, 1789 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1804 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1804 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year was Napoleon defeated at the Battle of Waterloo?
qh: वाटरलू (Waterloo) की लड़ाई में नेपोलियन की हार कब हुई थी?
e: nepoliyan ki antim har 1815 mein vataralu ke yuddh mein hui thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki vataralu (Waterloo) ki ladai mein nepoliyan ki har kab hui thi? Isi baat se 1815 sahi sabit hota hai. Galti 1821, 1812, 1804 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav 1815 hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 1815 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is considered the most important legacy of the French Revolution?
qh: फ्रांसीसी क्रांति की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण विरासत (Legacy) क्या मानी जाती है?
o: स्वतंत्रता और लोकतांत्रिक अधिकारों के विचार (Ideas of Liberty and Democratic Rights)
e: svatantrata, samanata aur bandhutv ke vichar phransisi kranti ki sabase badai den hain. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki phransisi kranti ki sabase mahatvapurn virasat (Legacy) kya mani jati hai? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi karan se svatantrata aur lokatantrik adhikaron ke vichar (Ideas of Liberty and Democratic Rights) sahi uttar hai. Galti rajashahi, audyogik vikas, das pratha chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan svatantrata aur lokatantrik adhikaron ke vichar (Ideas... hi milti hai. Exam point: svatantrata aur lokatantrik adhikaron ke vichar (Ideas of Liberty and Democratic Rights) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Indian ruler responded to the ideas coming from revolutionary France?
qh: किस भारतीय शासक ने क्रांतिकारी फ्रांस के विचारों से प्रेरणा ली थी?
e: tipu sultan aur raja ramamohan ray ne phransisi kranti ke vicharon ka samarthan kiya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kis bharatiy shasak ne krantikari phrans ke vicharon se prerana li thi? Shivaji Maratha raj ke sansthapak the jinhone apne rajy mein vyavasthit sasan khada kiya. Isliye antim jawab tipu sultan ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp akabar, shivaji, maharana pratap bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan tipu sultan hi milti hai. Exam point: tipu sultan - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to the 1791 Constitution, who were 'Active Citizens'?
qh: फ्रांस के 1791 के संविधान के अनुसार 'सक्रिय नागरिक' (Active Citizens) कौन थे?
o: 25 वर्ष से ऊपर के पुरुष जो कर देते थे (Men above 25 who paid taxes)
e: sakriy nagarik keval ve purush the jo 25 varsh se badae the aur kam se kam 3 din ki majaduri ke barabar kar dete the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki phrans ke 1791 ke sanvidhan ke anusar 'sakriy nagarik' (Active Citizens) kaun the? Isi aadhar par 25 varsh se upar ke purush jo kar dete the (Men above 25 who paid taxes) chuna jaata hai. sabhi mahilaen, sabhi vayask purush, keval padari is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 25 varsh se upar ke purush jo kar dete the (Men above 25 who paid taxes) hi hai. Exam point: 25 varsh se upar ke purush jo kar dete the (Men above 25 who paid taxes) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Into how many 'Estates' was French society divided before the revolution?
qh: क्रांति से पहले फ्रांसीसी समाज कितने 'एस्टेट्स' में विभाजित था?
e: phransisi samaj tin estets (padari, kulin aur am janata) mein vibhajit tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kranti se pahale phransisi samaj kitane 'estets' mein vibhajit tha? Isliye sahi nateeja tin nikalta hai. Galti panch, char, do chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan tin hi milti hai. Exam point: tin - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the biggest challenge at the time of India's independence in August 1947?
qh: अगस्त 1947 में भारत की आजादी के समय सबसे बड़ी चुनौती क्या थी?
o: शरणार्थियों और रियासतों का एकीकरण (Refugees and Integration of States)
e: vibhajan ke karan 80 lakh sharanarthi bharat ae the aur 500 se adhik riyasaton ka vilay ek badai chunauti thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki agast 1947 mein bharat ki ajadi ke samay sabase badai chunauti kya thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sharanarthiyon aur riyasaton ka ekikaran (Refugees and... sahi nikalta hai. Vikalp shiksha ki kami, sadakon ka nirman, videshi vyapar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar sharanarthiyon aur riyasaton ka ekikaran (Refugees and... hi hai. Exam point: sharanarthiyon aur riyasaton ka ekikaran (Refugees and Integration of States) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: When did the Indian Constitution come into effect?
qh: भारतीय संविधान कब लागू हुआ?
e: bharatiy sanvidhan 26 janavari 1950 ko lagu hua tha. Is sawaal mein 26 janavari 1950 ki baat hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 26 janavari 1950 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 15 agast 1947, 30 janavari 1948, 26 navanbar 1949 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 26 janavari 1950 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 26 janavari 1950 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is the meaning of 'Universal Adult Franchise', a key feature of the Indian Constitution?
qh: भारतीय संविधान की मुख्य विशेषता 'यूनिवर्सल एडल्ट फ्रेंचाइजी' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: सभी वयस्क नागरिकों को वोट देने का अधिकार (Right to vote for all adult citizens)
e: isaka arth hai ki jati, dharm ya ling ke bhedabhav ke bina sabhi vayaskon ko matadan ka adhikar hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki bharatiy sanvidhan ki mukhy visheshata 'yunivarsal edalt phreinchaiji' ka kya arth hai? In tathyon ke chalte sabhi vayask nagarikon ko vot dene ka adhikar (Right to vote for all adult citizens) hi sahi hai. keval purushon ko vot dena, amiron ko vot dena, keval shikshiton ko vot dena is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se sabhi vayask nagarikon ko vot dene ka adhikar (Right to vote for all adult citizens) sahi hai. Exam point: sabhi vayask nagarikon ko vot dene ka adhikar (Right to vote for all adult citizens) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा की 'प्रारूप समिति' (Drafting Committee) के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: do. bi.ar. anbedakar prarup samiti ke adhyaksh the aur unhein bharatiy sanvidhan ka janak mana jata hai. Is prashn ka kendra constituent hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par bi.ar. anbedakar sahi nikalta hai. javaharalal neharu, rajeindr prasad, saradar patel mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar bi.ar. anbedakar hi hai. Exam point: bi.ar. anbedakar - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which was the first state in India to be formed on a linguistic basis?
qh: भाषा के आधार पर बनने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा था?
e: 1 aktubar 1953 ko telugu bhashiyon ke lie andhr pradesh ka gathan kiya gaya tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki bhasha ke adhar par banane vala bharat ka pahala rajy kaun sa tha? Isi baat se andhr pradesh sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp maharashtr, panjab, gujarat bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan andhr pradesh hi milti hai. Exam point: andhr pradesh - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Gandhian leader died due to a hunger strike demanding Andhra state?
qh: किस गांधीवादी नेता की मृत्यु आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य की मांग के दौरान भूख हड़ताल से हुई थी?
e: potti shriramulu ki 58 dinon ki bhukh hadatal ke bad mrityu ho gai thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kis gandhivadi neta ki mrityu andhr pradesh rajy ki mang ke dauran bhukh hadatal se hui thi? Isi baat se potti shriramulu (Potti Sriramulu) sahi sabit hota hai. saradar patel, ti.ti. krishnamachari, si. rajagopalachari in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad potti shriramulu (Potti Sriramulu) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: potti shriramulu (Potti Sriramulu) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is meant by the 'Mixed Economy' model in India?
qh: भारत में 'मिश्रित अर्थव्यवस्था' (Mixed Economy) मॉडल का क्या अर्थ है?
o: सरकारी और निजी दोनों क्षेत्रों की भागीदारी (Both state and private sector role)
e: isamein utpadan badhane aur rojagar paida karane mein sarakar aur niji kshetr donon ki bhumika hoti hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharat mein 'mishrit arthavyavastha' (Mixed Economy) modal ka kya arth hai? Isi karan se sarakari aur niji donon kshetron ki bhagidari... sahi uttar hai. keval sarakari kshetr, keval niji kshetr, krishi par pratibandh mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se sarakari aur niji donon kshetron ki bhagidari (Both state and private sector role) sahi hai. Exam point: sarakari aur niji donon kshetron ki bhagidari (Both state and private sector role) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the main focus of the Second Five-Year Plan (1956)?
qh: द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1956) में मुख्य रूप से किस पर जोर दिया गया था?
o: भारी उद्योग और बड़े बाँध (Heavy industries and large dams)
e: dusari yojana mein ispat jaise bhari udyogon aur badae bandhon ke nirman par vishesh dhyan diya gaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki dvitiy panchavarshiy yojana (1956) mein mukhy rup se kis par jor diya gaya tha? Isi aadhar par bhari udyog aur badae bandh (Heavy industries and large dams) chuna jaata hai. sirph prathamik shiksha, keval krishi, videshi paryatan ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav bhari udyog aur badae bandh (Heavy industries and large dams) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: bhari udyog aur badae bandh (Heavy industries and large dams) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What did 'Non-Alignment' mean in the context of India's foreign policy?
qh: भारत की विदेश नीति के संदर्भ में 'गुटनिरपेक्षता' (Non-Alignment) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: किसी भी सैन्य गुट में शामिल न होना (Not joining any military bloc)
e: isaka arth tha shit yuddh ke dauran donon pramukh guton (USA aur USSR) se tatasth rahana. Prashn yah batata hai ki bharat ki videsh niti ke sandarbh mein 'gutanirapekshata' (Non-Alignment) ka kya arth tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kisi bhi sainy gut mein shamil n hona (Not joining any military bloc) hi sahi baithta hai. rus ke sath rahana, yuddh ka samarthan, amerika ke sath rahana mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kisi bhi sainy gut mein shamil n hona (Not joining any military bloc) hai. Exam point: kisi bhi sainy gut mein shamil n hona (Not joining any military bloc) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which year was the Planning Commission established?
qh: योजना आयोग (Planning Commission) की स्थापना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
e: arthik vikas ki nitiyan banane ke lie 1950 mein yojana ayog ka gathan hua tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki yojana ayog (Planning Commission) ki sthapana kis varsh ki gai thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1950 hi sahi baithta hai. 1956, 1952, 1947 anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 1950 hi hai. Exam point: 1950 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which subjects fall under the 'Concurrent List' of the Indian Constitution?
qh: भारतीय संविधान की 'समवर्ती सूची' (Concurrent List) में कौन से विषय आते हैं?
e: samavarti suchi ke vishayon par keindr aur rajy donon kanun bana sakate hain. Is prashn ka vishay van aur krishi (Forest and Agriculture) hai. Isi tathya par van aur krishi (Forest and Agriculture) tika hua hai. Vikalp keval pulis, raksha aur videsh mamale, shiksha aur svasthy bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar van aur krishi (Forest and Agriculture) hi hai. Exam point: van aur krishi (Forest and Agriculture) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Dr. Ambedkar emphasized 'Economic and Social Democracy' to end which type of inequality?
qh: डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर ने किस प्रकार की असमानता को खत्म करने के लिए 'आर्थिक और सामाजिक लोकतंत्र' पर जोर दिया?
o: अमीर-गरीब और ऊंची-नीची जाति के बीच का अंतर
e: unaka manana tha ki bina samajik aur arthik samanata ke rajanitik lokatantr adhura hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki do. bi.ar. anbedakar ne kis prakar ki asamanata ko khatm karane ke lie 'arthik aur samajik lokatantr' par jor diya? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi karan se amir-garib aur unchi-nichi jati ke bich ka antar sahi uttar hai. Vikalp keval rajanitik, sainik shakti, videshi vyapar bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab amir-garib aur unchi-nichi jati ke bich ka antar hai. Exam point: amir-garib aur unchi-nichi jati ke bich ka antar - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In 1960, Bombay state was divided into which two states on a linguistic basis?
qh: 1960 में भाषाई आधार पर बंबई राज्य को किन दो राज्यों में विभाजित किया गया था?
e: marathi aur gujarati bhashiyon ke lie kramashah maharashtr aur gujarat banae gae. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 1960 mein bhashai adhar par banbai rajy ko kin do rajyon mein vibhajit kiya gaya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par maharashtr aur gujarat hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. uttar pradesh aur uttarakhand, panjab aur hariyana, bihar aur jharakhand anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad maharashtr aur gujarat hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: maharashtr aur gujarat - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year did the States Reorganisation Commission (SRC) submit its report?
qh: राज्य पुनर्गठन आयोग (SRC) ने अपनी रिपोर्ट किस वर्ष प्रस्तुत की थी?
e: SRC ne 1956 mein apani riport di thi, jisase rajyon ki simaon ka bhashai adhar par punargathan hua. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rajy punargathan ayog (SRC) ne apani riport kis varsh prastut ki thi? Isi baat se 1956 sahi sabit hota hai. 1953, 1960, 1950 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1956 baithta hai. Exam point: 1956 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the status of 'Untouchability' according to the Constitution in India?
qh: भारत में संविधान के अनुसार 'छुआछूत' (Untouchability) का क्या स्थान है?
o: इसे पूरी तरह समाप्त कर दिया गया है (Completely abolished)
e: sanvidhan ne asprishyata ko ek kalank manate hue ise puri tarah samapt kar diya hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bharat mein sanvidhan ke anusar 'chhuachhut' (Untouchability) ka kya sthan hai? Isi aadhar par ise puri tarah samapt kar diya gaya hai (Completely abolished) chuna jaata hai. yah kanuni hai, yah vaikalpik hai, yah keval ganvon mein hai mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar ise puri tarah samapt kar diya gaya... hi hai. Exam point: ise puri tarah samapt kar diya gaya hai (Completely abolished) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Between which two superpowers was the Cold War a conflict?
qh: शीत युद्ध (Cold War) किन दो महाशक्तियों के बीच का संघर्ष था?
o: अमेरिका और सोवियत संघ (USA and USSR)
e: yah amerika aur soviyat sangh ke bich vaicharik aur shakti ka sangharsh tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki shit yuddh (Cold War) kin do mahashaktiyon ke bich ka sangharsh tha? Isi aadhar par amerika aur soviyat sangh (USA and USSR) chuna jaata hai. bharat aur chin, japan aur jarmani, briten aur phrans anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav amerika aur soviyat sangh (USA and USSR) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: amerika aur soviyat sangh (USA and USSR) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the Bandung Conference (1955) related to?
qh: 1955 में आयोजित 'बांडुंग सम्मेलन' (Bandung Conference) किससे संबंधित था?
o: गुटनिरपेक्ष आंदोलन की नींव (Foundation of NAM)
e: eshiya aur aphrika ke deshon ke is sammelan ne gutanirapeksh andolan ka marg prashast kiya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1955 mein ayojit 'bandung sammelan' (Bandung Conference) kisase sanbandhit tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par gutanirapeksh andolan ki ninv (Foundation of NAM) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. khelakud, namak kanun, sati pratha ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar gutanirapeksh andolan ki ninv (Foundation of NAM) hi hai. Exam point: gutanirapeksh andolan ki ninv (Foundation of NAM) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What solution was reached after the debate on 'Hindi' in the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा में 'हिंदी' को लेकर हुए विवाद के बाद क्या समाधान निकाला गया?
o: हिंदी को आधिकारिक भाषा और अंग्रेजी को संपर्क भाषा माना गया
अंग्रेजी को बैन कर दिया गया
e: hindi ko rajabhasha (Official Language) aur angreji ko sanvad ke lie istemal karane ka phaisala hua. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki sanvidhan sabha mein 'hindi' ko lekar hue vivad ke bad kya samadhan nikala gaya? constituent assembly wo sabha thi jisne desh ka sanvidhan likha. In tathyon ke chalte hindi ko adhikarik bhasha aur angreji ko sanpark bhasha mana gaya hi sahi hai. ise rashtrabhasha banaya gaya, sanskrit ko rashtrabhasha banaya gaya, angreji ko bain kar diya gaya ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan hindi ko adhikarik bhasha aur angreji ko... hi milti hai. Exam point: hindi ko adhikarik bhasha aur angreji ko sanpark bhasha mana gaya - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who was the first Prime Minister and Foreign Minister of independent India?
qh: स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले प्रधानमंत्री और विदेश मंत्री कौन थे?
e: javaharalal neharu bharat ke pahale pradhanamantri the aur unhonne videsh niti bhi taiyar ki thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki svatantr bharat ke pahale pradhanamantri aur videsh mantri kaun the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par javaharalal neharu hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. saradar patel, do. rajeindr prasad, lal bahadur shastri ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se javaharalal neharu sahi hai. Exam point: javaharalal neharu - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What did 'Mira Behn', a follower of Gandhi, warn about?
qh: गांधीवादी विचारधारा की समर्थक 'मीरा बहन' ने किस चीज को लेकर चेतावनी दी थी?
o: पर्यावरण और प्रकृति का संतुलन (Environmental balance)
e: unhonne chetavani di thi ki prakriti ke niyamon ke viruddh vikas vinashakari ho sakata hai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki gandhivadi vicharadhara ki samarthak 'mira bahan' ne kis chij ko lekar chetavani di thi? Isi karan se paryavaran aur prakriti ka santulan (Environmental balance) sahi uttar hai. sainik hamala, sadak durghatanaen, janasankhya vriddhi is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar paryavaran aur prakriti ka santulan (Environmental balance) hi hai. Exam point: paryavaran aur prakriti ka santulan (Environmental balance) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In 1966, Punjab was divided into which two states on a linguistic basis?
qh: 1966 में भाषाई आधार पर पंजाब को किन दो राज्यों में बांटा गया?
e: 1966 mein panjabi bhashiyon ke lie panjab aur hindi bhashiyon ke lie hariyana banaya gaya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki 1966 mein bhashai adhar par panjab ko kin do rajyon mein banta gaya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par panjab aur hariyana hi sahi baithta hai. panjab aur himachal, panjab aur dilli, panjab aur rajasthan alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab panjab aur hariyana hai. Exam point: panjab aur hariyana - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which Indian leader played the most crucial role in the integration of princely states?
qh: रियासतों के एकीकरण में किस भारतीय नेता ने सबसे महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई?
e: saradar patel ne 500 se adhik riyasaton ko bharatiy sangh mein shamil hone ke lie manaya. Yahaan saradar vallabh bhai patel se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isliye sahi nateeja saradar vallabh bhai patel nikalta hai. Vikalp javaharalal neharu, maulana ajad, mahatma gandhi bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad saradar vallabh bhai patel hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: saradar vallabh bhai patel - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What is considered a major failure of India after 70+ years of independence?
qh: आजादी के 70 से अधिक वर्षों के बाद भारत की एक बड़ी असफलता क्या मानी जाती है?
o: अमीर और गरीब के बीच बढ़ती खाई (Growing gap between rich and poor)
e: desh mein aj bhi amiri aur garibi ke bich ka antar bahut bada hai aur kai samuhon ko saman adhikar nahin mile hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ajadi ke 70 se adhik varshon ke bad bharat ki ek badai asaphalata kya mani jati hai? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. In tathyon ke chalte amir aur garib ke bich badhati khai (Growing gap between rich and poor) hi sahi hai. Galti lokatantr ka bane rahana, paramanu shakti banana, mangal par pahunchana chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad amir aur garib ke bich badhati khai (Growing gap between rich and poor) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: amir aur garib ke bich badhati khai (Growing gap between rich and poor) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Where were the meetings of the Constituent Assembly primarily held?
qh: संविधान सभा की बैठकें मुख्य रूप से कहाँ आयोजित की गई थीं?
e: sanvidhan sabha ki adhikansh baithakein nai dilli mein ayojit hui thin. Is prashn ka vishay constituent hai. sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. In tathyon ke chalte nai dilli hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - munbai, kolakata, chennai - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan nai dilli hi milti hai. Exam point: nai dilli - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which state was the Bhilai Steel Plant established?
qh: भिलाई इस्पात संयंत्र (Bhilai Steel Plant) की स्थापना किस राज्य में हुई थी?
e: bhilai ispat sanyantr chhattisagadh mein sthit hai aur ise rus ki madad se banaya gaya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bhilai ispat sanyantr (Bhilai Steel Plant) ki sthapana kis rajy mein hui thi? Yahi wajah hai ki chhattisagadh sahi hai. odisha, jharakhand, bihar mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se chhattisagadh sahi hai. Exam point: chhattisagadh - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did Viceroy Curzon partition Bengal?
qh: वायसराय कर्जन ने बंगाल का विभाजन किस वर्ष किया था?
e: 1905 mein vayasaray karjan ne prashasanik suvidha ka bahana banakar bangal ka vibhajan kar diya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki vayasaray karjan ne bangal ka vibhajan kis varsh kiya tha? Isi tathya par 1905 tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - 1900, 1920, 1911 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1905 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1905 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: When did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre take place in Amritsar?
qh: जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड अमृतसर में कब हुआ था?
e: baisakhi ke din 13 aprail 1919 ko janaral dayar ne nihatthi bhid par goliyan chalavai thin. Is prashn ka kendra 13 aprail 1919 hai. Isi baat se 13 aprail 1919 sahi sabit hota hai. 26 janavari 1930, 10 mai 1857, 15 agast 1947 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 13 aprail 1919 hi milti hai. Exam point: 13 aprail 1919 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the purpose of the Vernacular Press Act of 1878?
qh: 1878 का वर्नाकुलर प्रेस एक्ट किस उद्देश्य से लाया गया था?
o: सरकार की आलोचना करने वालों को चुप कराना
e: yah kanun bharatiy bhashaon ke samachar patron par ankush lagane ke lie laya gaya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1878 ka varnakular pres ekt kis uddeshy se laya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par sarakar ki alochana karane valon ko chup karana hi sahi baithta hai. shiksha ko badhava dena, namak kanun lagu karana, vyapar badhana is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sarakar ki alochana karane valon ko chup karana hi milti hai. Exam point: sarakar ki alochana karane valon ko chup karana - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did the 'Surat Split' of Congress occur?
qh: कांग्रेस का 'सूरत विभाजन' किस वर्ष हुआ था जिसमें मॉडरेट्स और एक्सट्रीमिस्ट अलग हो गए?
e: 1907 ke surat adhiveshan mein kangres do guton (naram dal aur garam dal) mein bant gai thi. Yah prashn 1907 se juda hai. Isliye antim jawab 1907 ke roop mein milta hai. 1905, 1885, 1916 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se 1907 sahi hai. Exam point: 1907 - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai. Is vishay mein poochhe jaane wale anya bindu bhi isi tathya se jude hote hain, isliye ek baar samajh lene par kaee prashnon ke jawab aasan ho jate hain.

qe: Where was the Muslim League established in 1906?
qh: मुस्लिम लीग की स्थापना 1906 में कहाँ हुई थी?
e: muslim lig ki sthapana 1906 mein dhaka mein hui thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki muslim lig ki sthapana 1906 mein kahan hui thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par dhaka hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - aligadh, karachi, dilli - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan dhaka hi milti hai. Exam point: dhaka - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which bill proposed by Lord Ripon was strongly opposed by the Whites?
qh: लॉर्ड रिपन द्वारा प्रस्तावित किस बिल पर वाइट्स (अंग्रेजों) ने कड़ा विरोध किया था?
e: ilbart bil ke tahat bharatiy jajon ko angrejon par mukadama chalane ka adhikar diya jana tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki lord ripan dvara prastavit kis bil par vaits (angrejon) ne kada virodh kiya tha? Isi baat se ilbart bil (Ilbert Bill) sahi sabit hota hai. namak bil, pres ekt, arms ekt in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar ilbart bil (Ilbert Bill) hi hai. Exam point: ilbart bil (Ilbert Bill) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When was the Lucknow Pact signed between Congress and Muslim League?
qh: कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के बीच 'लखनऊ समझौता' (Lucknow Pact) कब हुआ था?
e: 1916 ke lakhanau adhiveshan mein donon dalon ke bich aitihasik samajhauta hua tha. Yah prashn 1916 se juda hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1916 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti 1907, 1935, 1920 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1916 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1916 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Why was the Simon Commission opposed in India in 1927?
qh: 1927 में साइमन कमीशन का भारत में विरोध क्यों हुआ था?
o: क्योंकि इसमें कोई भारतीय सदस्य नहीं था
e: saiman kamishan mein ek bhi bharatiy sadasy n hone ke karan isaka pure desh mein 'saiman go baik' ke naron se virodh hua. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1927 mein saiman kamishan ka bharat mein virodh kyon hua tha? Isliye antim jawab kyonki isamein koi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha ke roop mein milta hai. kyonki yah deri se aya, kyonki yah bahut mahanga tha, kyonki isake adhyaksh bure the is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar kyonki isamein koi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha hi hai. Exam point: kyonki isamein koi bharatiy sadasy nahin tha - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: When did the Second World War start?
qh: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध कब शुरू हुआ था?
e: dvitiy vishv yuddh 1939 mein shuru hua tha, jisaka bharatiy rashtriy andolan par gahara prabhav pada. Yahaan 1939 se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1939 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti 1945, 1914, 1918 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1939 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1939 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the main reason for conflict between Congress and Muslim League during independence?
qh: भारतीय स्वतंत्रता के समय कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के बीच मुख्य विवाद का कारण क्या था?
e: muslim lig dvara alag desh (pakistan) ki mang aur antatah vibhajan sabase bada vivad tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bharatiy svatantrata ke samay kangres aur muslim lig ke bich mukhy vivad ka karan kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par pakistan ki mang aur vibhajan sahi nikalta hai. bhasha, shiksha, namak ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar pakistan ki mang aur vibhajan hi hai. Exam point: pakistan ki mang aur vibhajan - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the practice of Sati officially banned?
qh: सती प्रथा पर आधिकारिक रूप से प्रतिबंध किस वर्ष लगाया गया था?
e: raja ram mohan roy ke prayason se 1829 mein sati pratha par pratibandh laga diya gaya tha. Yahaan 1829 se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1829 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - 1891, 1856, 1835 - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1829 baithta hai. Exam point: 1829 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar primarily fought for which reform?
qh: ईश्वरचंद्र विद्यासागर ने मुख्य रूप से किस सुधार के लिए संघर्ष किया?
e: ishvarachandr vidyasagar ke prayason se 1856 mein hindu vidhava punarvivah adhiniyam parit hua. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ishvarachandr vidyasagar ne mukhy rup se kis sudhar ke lie sangharsh kiya? Isi aadhar par vidhava vivah (Widow Remarriage) chuna jaata hai. sati pratha ka ant, bal vivah rokana, chhuachhut ka ant anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab vidhava vivah (Widow Remarriage) hai. Exam point: vidhava vivah (Widow Remarriage) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who wrote the book 'Gulamgiri' in 1873?
qh: 1873 में 'गुलामगिरी' पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
e: jyotirav phule ne 'gulamagiri' likhakar ameriki grihayuddh ke dason ki mukti aur bharat ki nimn jatiyon ke sangharsh ko jo a. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1873 mein 'gulamagiri' pustak kisane likhi thi? Yahi wajah hai ki jyotirav phule sahi hai. bi.ar. anbedakar, i.vi. ramasvami nayakar, shri narayan guru mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan jyotirav phule hi milti hai. Exam point: jyotirav phule - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who founded the 'Satyashodhak Samaj' in Maharashtra?
qh: महाराष्ट्र में 'सत्यशोधक समाज' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: jyotirav phule ne jatigat samanata ko badhava dene ke lie satyashodhak samaj ki sthapana ki thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki maharashtr mein 'satyashodhak samaj' ki sthapana kisane ki thi? Isi karan se jyotirav phule sahi uttar hai. savitribai phule, mahadev govind ranade, tarabai shinde is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad jyotirav phule hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: jyotirav phule - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which movement was started by B.R. Ambedkar in 1927?
qh: बी.आर. अंबेडकर ने 1927 में कौन सा आंदोलन शुरू किया था?
e: anbedakar ne jatigat purvagrahon ko chunauti dene ke lie 1927 mein mandir pravesh andolan shuru kiya tha. Is sawaal mein mandir pravesh andolan (Temple Entry Movement) ki baat hai. Isi baat se mandir pravesh andolan (Temple Entry Movement) sahi sabit hota hai. svadeshi andolan, khilaphat andolan, satyagrah is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar mandir pravesh andolan (Temple Entry Movement) hi hai. Exam point: mandir pravesh andolan (Temple Entry Movement) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who started the 'Self-Respect Movement' in South India?
qh: दक्षिण भारत में 'आत्म-सम्मान आंदोलन' (Self-Respect Movement) किसने शुरू किया?
e: i.vi. ramasvami nayakar, jinhein periyar bhi kaha jata hai, ne gair-brahmanon ke svabhiman ke lie yah andolan chalaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki dakshin bharat mein 'atm-samman andolan' (Self-Respect Movement) kisane shuru kiya? Isi karan se i.vi. ramasvami nayakar (periyar) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - shri narayan guru, jyotirav phule, vireshalingam pantulu - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan i.vi. ramasvami nayakar (periyar) hi milti hai. Exam point: i.vi. ramasvami nayakar (periyar) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who criticized social differences between men and women in the book 'Stri Purush Tulana'?
qh: 'स्त्री-पुरुष तुलना' पुस्तक लिखकर पुरुषों और महिलाओं के बीच सामाजिक अंतर की आलोचना किसने की?
e: tarabai shinde ne apani pustak 'stri-purush tulana' mein samaj ke dohare manadandon ki k i alochana ki. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 'stri-purush tulana' pustak likhakar purushon aur mahilaon ke bich samajik antar ki alochana kisane ki? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par tarabai shinde hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - begam rukaiya sakhavat husain, pandita ramabai, mumataj ali - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar tarabai shinde baithta hai. Exam point: tarabai shinde - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did Pandita Ramabai establish a Widow Home to shelter widows?
qh: पंडिता रमाबाई ने विधवाओं को आश्रय देने के लिए 'विधवा गृह' की स्थापना कहाँ की थी?
e: pandita ramabai ne pune mein ek vidhava grih ki sthapana ki, jahan pi it mahilaon ko svavalanbi banaya jata tha. Is prashn ka dayra pune tak phaila hua hai. Isliye antim jawab pune ke roop mein milta hai. Galti munbai, kolakata, madras chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar pune hi hai. Exam point: pune - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which year was the Child Marriage Restraint Act passed?
qh: बाल विवाह निषेध अधिनियम (Child Marriage Restraint Act) किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
e: 1929 mein yah adhiniyam parit hua, jisake anusar purushon ki nyunatam ayu 18 aur mahilaon ki 16 varsh tay ki gai. Is prashn ka dayra 1929 tak phaila hua hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1929 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1829, 1856, 1950 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1929 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1929 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj'?
qh: 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना किसके द्वारा की गई थी?
e: raja ram mohan roy ne 1830 mein brahm samaj ki sthapana ki, jo murti puja aur bali ke viruddh tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 'brahm samaj' ki sthapana kisake dvara ki gai thi? Isliye antim jawab raja ram mohan roy ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - keshavachandr sen, svami vivekanand, svami dayanand sarasvati - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav raja ram mohan roy hi thehrta hai. Exam point: raja ram mohan roy - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When did Swami Dayanand Saraswati found the 'Arya Samaj'?
qh: स्वामी दयानंद सरस्वती ने 'आर्य समाज' की स्थापना कब की थी?
e: 1875 mein ary samaj ki sthapana hui, jisane hindu dharm mein sudhar lane aur vido rimairij ka samarthan kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki svami dayanand sarasvati ne 'ary samaj' ki sthapana kab ki thi? Isi aadhar par 1875 chuna jaata hai. Vikalp 1867, 1830, 1897 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1875 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1875 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the prominent leader of Prarthana Samaj (1867)?
qh: प्रार्थना समाज (1867) के प्रमुख नेता कौन थे जिन्होंने सामाजिक सुधारों पर बल दिया?
o: आत्माराम पांडुरंग एवं महादेव गोविंद रानाडे
e: prarthana samaj ne jati bandhan to ne aur mahila shiksha ko badhava dene ka kam kiya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki prarthana samaj (1867) ke pramukh neta kaun the jinhonne samajik sudharon par bal diya? Isliye sahi nateeja atmaram pandurang evan mahadev govind ranade nikalta hai. ishvarachandr vidyasagar, saiyad ahamad khan, bakht khan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad atmaram pandurang evan mahadev govind ranade hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: atmaram pandurang evan mahadev govind ranade - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the founder of the Aligarh Movement?
qh: अलीगढ़ आंदोलन (Aligarh Movement) के संस्थापक कौन थे?
e: sar saiyad ahamad khan ne aligadh mein adhunik shiksha ko badhava dene ke lie yah andolan chalaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki aligadh andolan (Aligarh Movement) ke sansthapak kaun the? Isi tathya par sar saiyad ahamad khan tika hua hai. mumataj ali, navab vajid ali shah, mulana ajad ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar sar saiyad ahamad khan baithta hai. Exam point: sar saiyad ahamad khan - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year did Swami Vivekananda found the 'Ramakrishna Mission'?
qh: स्वामी विवेकानंद ने 'रामकृष्ण मिशन' की स्थापना किस वर्ष की थी?
e: vivekanand ne 1897 mein apane guru ke nam par samajik seva aur mukti ke lie is mishan ki sthapana ki. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki svami vivekanand ne 'ramakrishn mishan' ki sthapana kis varsh ki thi? Isi aadhar par 1897 chuna jaata hai. Vikalp 1893, 1875, 1901 bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se 1897 sahi hai. Exam point: 1897 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did the 'Singh Sabha Movement' start to reform Sikhism?
qh: सिख धर्म में सुधार के लिए 'सिंह सभा आंदोलन' कहाँ से शुरू हुआ था?
e: sinh sabha andolan ki shuruat 1873 mein amritasar se hui thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki sikh dharm mein sudhar ke lie 'sinh sabha andolan' kahan se shuru hua tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi karan se amritasar sahi uttar hai. Galti chandigadh, dilli, lahaur chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar amritasar baithta hai. Exam point: amritasar - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who ran the 'Satnami Movement' in Central India for leather workers?
qh: मध्य भारत में चमड़ा श्रमिकों की स्थिति सुधारने के लिए 'सतनामी आंदोलन' किसने चलाया?
e: guru ghasidas ne nimn jati ke logon aur ledar varkars ke utthan ke lie satanami andolan chalaya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki madhy bharat mein chamada shramikon ki sthiti sudharane ke lie 'satanami andolan' kisane chalaya? Yahi wajah hai ki guru ghasidas sahi hai. Galti jyotirav phule, haridas thakur, bi.ar. anbedakar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar guru ghasidas hi hai. Exam point: guru ghasidas - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which reformer worked among the 'Chandala cultivators' of Bengal?
qh: बंगाल के 'चांडाल कल्टीवेटर्स' के बीच काम करने वाले सुधारक कौन थे?
e: haridas thakur ne matua mahasangh ke madhyam se chandal samuday ki sthiti sudharane ke prayas kie. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bangal ke 'chandal kaltivetars' ke bich kam karane vale sudharak kaun the? Isi baat se haridas thakur sahi sabit hota hai. keshavachandr sen, svami vivekanand, raja ram mohan roy mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab haridas thakur hai. Exam point: haridas thakur - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which reformer gave the slogan 'One caste, one religion, one god'?
qh: किस सुधारक ने 'एक जाति, एक धर्म, एक ईश्वर' का नारा दिया था?
e: keral ke ejhava samuday se talluk rakhane vale shri narayan guru ne manavata ki ekata par jor diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kis sudharak ne 'ek jati, ek dharm, ek ishvar' ka nara diya tha? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi aadhar par shri narayan guru chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - raja ram mohan roy, periyar, jyotirav phule - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar shri narayan guru hai. Exam point: shri narayan guru - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which cities did Begum Rokeya open schools for Muslim girls?
qh: बेगम रुकैया सखावत हुसैन ने किन शहरों में मुस्लिम लड़कियों के लिए स्कूल खोले?
e: begam rukaiya ne patana aur kolakata mein ladakiyon ki shiksha ke lie skul sthapit kie. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki begam rukaiya sakhavat husain ne kin shaharon mein muslim ladakiyon ke lie skul khole? Isi aadhar par patana aur kolakata chuna jaata hai. bhopal aur indaur, munbai aur pune, dilli aur agara ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar patana aur kolakata hi hai. Exam point: patana aur kolakata - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which society was founded in Madras (1864) on the lines of Brahmo Samaj?
qh: ब्रह्म समाज की तर्ज पर मद्रास (चेन्नई) में 1864 में किस समाज की स्थापना हुई थी?
e: ved samaj ne jatigat bhedabhav ko samapt karane aur vidhava vivah ko badhava dene ke lie kam kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki brahm samaj ki tarj par madras (chennai) mein 1864 mein kis samaj ki sthapana hui thi? Isliye sahi nateeja ved samaj (Veda Samaj) nikalta hai. Vikalp prarthana samaj, satyashodhak samaj, ary samaj bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se ved samaj (Veda Samaj) sahi hai. Exam point: ved samaj (Veda Samaj) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which society was established by William Jones in Calcutta in 1784?
qh: विलियम जोंस ने 1784 में कोलकाता में किस संस्था की स्थापना की थी?
e: viliyam jons ne henari thomas kolabruk aur nethaniyal hailhed ke sath milakar eshiyatik sosaiti oph bangal ki sthapana ki. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki viliyam jons ne 1784 mein kolakata mein kis sanstha ki sthapana ki thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par eshiyatik sosaiti oph bangal hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. prarthana samaj, brahm samaj, ary samaj mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab eshiyatik sosaiti oph bangal hai. Exam point: eshiyatik sosaiti oph bangal - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was a Madrasa set up in 1781 to promote the study of Arabic and Persian?
qh: 1781 में अरबी और फारसी के अध्ययन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए मदरसा कहाँ खोला गया था?
e: muslim kanunon aur arabi-pharasi shiksha ke lie 1781 mein kolakata mein madarasa sthapit kiya gaya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1781 mein arabi aur pharasi ke adhyayan ko badhava dene ke lie madarasa kahan khola gaya tha? madrasa islami padhai ka school hota tha. Isi tathya par kolakata tika hua hai. munbai, dilli, banaras is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar kolakata hi hai. Exam point: kolakata - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where was the 'Hindu College' established in 1791 for the study of ancient Sanskrit texts?
qh: 1791 में प्राचीन संस्कृत ग्रंथों के अध्ययन के लिए 'हिंदू कॉलेज' की स्थापना कहाँ हुई थी?
e: banaras mein 1791 mein hindu kolej ki sthapana ki gai thi taki prachin sanskrit granthon ka adhyayan kiya ja sake. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 1791 mein prachin sanskrit granthon ke adhyayan ke lie 'hindu kolej' ki sthapana kahan hui thi? Isliye sahi nateeja banaras nikalta hai. madras, patana, surat mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar banaras hi hai. Exam point: banaras - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were those British officials called who respected Indian culture and languages?
qh: उन ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों को क्या कहा जाता था जो भारतीय संस्कृति और भाषाओं का सम्मान करते थे?
e: orientalist (Orientalists) ve log the jinhein eshiya ki bhasha aur sanskriti ka gahara jnan tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki un british adhikariyon ko kya kaha jata tha jo bharatiy sanskriti aur bhashaon ka samman karate the? Isliye antim jawab orientalist (prachyavadi) ke roop mein milta hai. englisist, injiniyar, mishanari mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar orientalist (prachyavadi) baithta hai. Exam point: orientalist (prachyavadi) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Thomas Babington Macaulay was a strong supporter of which type of education?
qh: थॉमस बैबिंगटन मैकाले किस प्रकार की शिक्षा के कट्टर समर्थक थे?
e: maikale ka manana tha ki angreji shiksha bharatiyon ko sabhy banane ka sabase achchha tarika hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki thomas baibingatan maikale kis prakar ki shiksha ke kattar samarthak the? Isi aadhar par angreji shiksha chuna jaata hai. vyavasayik shiksha, sanskrit shiksha, dharmik shiksha is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar angreji shiksha hi hai. Exam point: angreji shiksha - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which year was the English Education Act passed?
qh: अंग्रेजी शिक्षा अधिनियम (English Education Act) किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
e: maikale ke sujhavon ke adhar par 1835 mein angreji shiksha adhiniyam parit kiya gaya. Yahaan 1835 se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1835 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1813, 1829, 1854 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1835 baithta hai. Exam point: 1835 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein. Is baat ko nakshon tatha samay-rekha ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai tatha galti kam hoti hai.

qe: By what name is the educational dispatch sent by Charles Wood in 1854 known?
qh: 1854 में चार्ल्स वुड द्वारा भेजे गए शैक्षिक आलेख को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: 1854 ke niti patr ko 'vuds dispaich' kaha jata hai, jisane bharat mein shiksha niti ki ruparekha tay ki. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1854 mein charls vud dvara bheje gae shaikshik alekh ko kis nam se jana jata hai? Isliye antim jawab vuds dispaich (Wood's Despatch) ke roop mein milta hai. sarjeint yojana, maikale minat, hantar kamishan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar vuds dispaich (Wood's Despatch) baithta hai. Exam point: vuds dispaich (Wood's Despatch) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did Wood's Despatch (1854) primarily emphasize?
qh: वुड्स डिस्पैच (1854) ने मुख्य रूप से किस बात पर जोर दिया था?
e: vuds dispaich ne yuropiy shiksha ke vyavaharik aur arthik labhon par jor diya. Prashn yah batata hai ki vuds dispaich (1854) ne mukhy rup se kis bat par jor diya tha? Isliye antim jawab vyavaharik aur yuropiy shiksha ke roop mein milta hai. dharmik prachar, yuddh kaushal, sirph krishi shiksha mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan vyavaharik aur yuropiy shiksha hi milti hai. Exam point: vyavaharik aur yuropiy shiksha - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In the 1830s, William Adam prepared a report on pathshalas of which states?
qh: विलियम एडम ने 1830 के दशक में किन राज्यों की पाठशालाओं पर रिपोर्ट तैयार की थी?
e: viliyam edam ne bangal aur bihar ke jilon ka daura kar vahan ki sthaniy shiksha vyavastha par riport di thi. Is prashn ka dayra bangal aur bihar tak phaila hua hai. Isi karan se bangal aur bihar sahi uttar hai. keral aur karnatak, panjab aur hariyana, gujarat aur maharashtr is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se bangal aur bihar sahi hai. Exam point: bangal aur bihar - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to Adam's report, approximately how many pathshalas were in Bengal and Bihar?
qh: विलियम एडम की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, बंगाल और बिहार में लगभग कितनी पाठशालाएं थीं?
e: riport ke anusar vahan 1 lakh se adhik chhoti pathashalaen thin. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki viliyam edam ki riport ke anusar, bangal aur bihar mein lagabhag kitani pathashalaen thin? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1 lakh hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 10,000, 50,000, 5 lakh mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se 1 lakh sahi hai. Exam point: 1 lakh - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: After 1854, whom did the Company appoint to improve pathshalas?
qh: 1854 के बाद, कंपनी ने पाठशालाओं में सुधार के लिए किसे नियुक्त किया?
e: kanpani ne pratyek sarakari pandit ko 4-5 skulon ki dekharekh ki jimmedari di. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1854 ke bad, kanpani ne pathashalaon mein sudhar ke lie kise niyukt kiya? In tathyon ke chalte sarakari panditon ko hi sahi hai. sainikon ko, vyapariyon ko, injiniyaron ko alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan sarakari panditon ko hi milti hai. Exam point: sarakari panditon ko - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: According to Mahatma Gandhi, what has English education made Indians?
qh: महात्मा गांधी के अनुसार अंग्रेजी शिक्षा ने भारतीयों को क्या बना दिया है?
e: gandhi ji ka manana tha ki videshi shiksha ne bharatiyon ke man mein hinata ki bhavana paida kar unhein gulam bana diya hai. Is prashn ka vishay gulam (Enslaved) hai. Isi tathya par gulam (Enslaved) tika hua hai. Vikalp adhik shaktishali, vaijnanik, svatantr bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar gulam (Enslaved) hi hai. Exam point: gulam (Enslaved) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which language did Gandhi advocate as the medium of education?
qh: गांधी जी शिक्षा के माध्यम के रूप में किस भाषा के समर्थक थे?
e: gandhi ji chahate the ki shiksha ka madhyam bharatiy bhashaen hon taki am janata se judav bana rahe. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gandhi ji shiksha ke madhyam ke rup mein kis bhasha ke samarthak the? In tathyon ke chalte bharatiy bhashaen (Indian Languages) hi sahi hai. laitin, phreinch, angreji anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se bharatiy bhashaen (Indian Languages) sahi hai. Exam point: bharatiy bhashaen (Indian Languages) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which institution was founded by Rabindranath Tagore in 1901?
qh: रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर ने 1901 में किस संस्थान की स्थापना की थी?
e: taigor ne prakriti ke sannidhy mein shiksha dene ke lie shantiniketan ki sthapana ki. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki ravindranath taigor ne 1901 mein kis sansthan ki sthapana ki thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par shantiniketan hi sahi baithta hai. sabaramati ashram, banaras hindu vishvavidyalay, aligadh vishvavidyalay alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan shantiniketan hi milti hai. Exam point: shantiniketan - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: How far from Calcutta was Shantiniketan established?
qh: शांतिनिकेतन कोलकाता से लगभग कितनी दूर स्थापित किया गया था?
e: taigor ne shantiniketan ko kolakata ke shor-sharabe se 100 kilomitar dur ek gramin kshetr mein sthapit kiya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki shantiniketan kolakata se lagabhag kitani dur sthapit kiya gaya tha? Isliye antim jawab 100 kimi ke roop mein milta hai. 10 kimi, 1000 kimi, 500 kimi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav 100 kimi hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 100 kimi - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: According to Tagore, where should education be provided?
qh: टैगोर के अनुसार शिक्षा कहाँ दी जानी चाहिए?
e: taigor ka manana tha ki srijanatmak shiksha keval prakritik parivesh mein hi vikasit ho sakati hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki taigor ke anusar shiksha kahan di jani chahie? Isi karan se prakritik vatavaran mein sahi uttar hai. Galti band kamaron mein, videshi deshon mein, sirph karakhanon mein chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se prakritik vatavaran mein sahi hai. Exam point: prakritik vatavaran mein - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What was the main difference between Gandhi's and Tagore's views on education?
qh: महात्मा गांधी और टैगोर के शिक्षा संबंधी विचारों में मुख्य अंतर क्या था?
o: गांधी जी संगीत के विरोधी थे
गांधी पश्चिमी तकनीक के विरोधी थे, टैगोर उसे भारतीय परंपरा के साथ जोड़ना चाहते थे
दोनों में कोई अंतर नहीं था
e: gandhi ji mashinon aur takanik ke alochak the, jabaki taigor adhunik pashchimi vijnan ko bharatiy kala ke sath jodana chahate the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki mahatma gandhi aur taigor ke shiksha sanbandhi vicharon mein mukhy antar kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par gandhi pashchimi takanik ke virodhi the, taigor use bharatiy paranpara ke sath jodana chahate the hi sahi baithta hai. taigor angreji ke virodhi the, gandhi ji sangit ke virodhi the, donon mein koi antar nahin tha is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar gandhi pashchimi takanik ke virodhi the, taigor use bharatiy paranpara ke sath jodana chahate the hai. Exam point: gandhi pashchimi takanik ke virodhi the, taigor use bharatiy paranpara ke sath jodana chahate the - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the literal meaning of 'Shantiniketan'?
qh: 'शांतिनिकेतन' का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
e: shantiniketan ka arth hai 'shanti ka nivas'. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki 'shantiniketan' ka shabdik arth kya hai? Yahi wajah hai ki shanti ka nivas (Abode of Peace) sahi hai. Galti phulon ka bagicha, kala ka keindr, jnan ka ghar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav shanti ka nivas (Abode of Peace) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: shanti ka nivas (Abode of Peace) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a key feature of ancient 'pathshalas'?
qh: प्राचीन समय की 'पाठशालाओं' की एक प्रमुख विशेषता क्या थी?
e: purani pathashalaon mein n koi nishchit phis thi, n kitabein aur n hi kada anushasan; sab kuchh bahut lachila tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki prachin samay ki 'pathashalaon' ki ek pramukh visheshata kya thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par lachilapan (Flexibility) sahi nikalta hai. mahangi phis, salana pariksha, kathor anushasan anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan lachilapan (Flexibility) hi milti hai. Exam point: lachilapan (Flexibility) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On what type of education did Christian missionaries emphasize in India?
qh: ईसाई मिशनरियों ने भारत में किस प्रकार की शिक्षा पर बल दिया था?
e: mishanariyon ka manana tha ki shiksha ka uddeshy logon ke naitik charitr mein sudhar karana hona chahie. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki isai mishanariyon ne bharat mein kis prakar ki shiksha par bal diya tha? Isi karan se naitik shiksha (Moral Education) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - sainik shiksha, rajanitik shiksha, sirph vyaparik shiksha - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan naitik shiksha (Moral Education) hi milti hai. Exam point: naitik shiksha (Moral Education) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: By what name did Britain come to be known during the Industrial Revolution?
qh: औद्योगिक क्रांति के दौरान ब्रिटेन को किस नाम से जाना जाने लगा?
o: संसार की कार्यशाला (Workshop of the World)
संसार का बाजार (Market of the World)
संसार का बैंक (Bank of the World)
संसार का बगीचा (Garden of the World)
e: badae paimane par mashini utpadan ke karan briten ko 'varkashop oph d varld' kaha gaya. Is sawaal mein sansar ki karyashala (Workshop of the World) ki baat hai.
