Isliye sahi nateeja sansar ki karyashala (Workshop of the World) nikalta hai. Galti sansar ka bajar (Market of the World), sansar ka baink (Bank of the World), sansar ka bagicha (Garden of the World) chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar sansar ki karyashala (Workshop of the World) hi hai. Exam point: sansar ki karyashala (Workshop of the World) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the world's largest producer of cotton textiles before the 1750s?
qh: 1750 के दशक से पहले दुनिया में सूती कपड़े का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक कौन था?
e: british vijay se pahale bharat duniya mein suti kapadae ka sabase bada aur behatarin utpadak tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 1750 ke dashak se pahale duniya mein suti kapadae ka sabase bada utpadak kaun tha? Isi aadhar par bharat chuna jaata hai. inglaind, japan, chin mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bharat hi milti hai. Exam point: bharat - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which fine-woven cloth was named after the city of 'Mosul' in Iraq?
qh: इराक के 'मोसुल' शहर के नाम पर किस महीन बुनावट वाले कपड़े का नाम पड़ा?
e: yuropiy vyapariyon ne sabase pahale irak ke mosul mein barik bharatiy kapada dekha, jise unhonne 'masalin' kaha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki irak ke 'mosul' shahar ke nam par kis mahin bunavat vale kapadae ka nam pada? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par malamal/masalin (Muslin) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp chintj (Chintz), khadi, kailiko (Calico) bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad malamal/masalin (Muslin) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: malamal/masalin (Muslin) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did all cotton textiles come to be called in Europe, named after the Calicut coast of Kerala?
qh: केरल के कालीकट तट के नाम पर सभी सूती कपड़ों को यूरोप में क्या कहा जाने लगा?
e: purtagali kalikat se suti kapada vapas le gae, jise bad mein 'kailiko' kaha jane laga. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki keral ke kalikat tat ke nam par sabhi suti kapadaon ko yurop mein kya kaha jane laga? Isi tathya par kailiko (Calico) tika hua hai. shalu, patola, muslim is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar kailiko (Calico) hai. Exam point: kailiko (Calico) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which cloth, derived from the Hindi word 'Chhint', was in high demand in Europe?
qh: हिंदी के 'छींट' शब्द से निकले किस कपड़े की यूरोप में बहुत मांग थी?
e: chintj (Chintz) shabd hindi ke 'chhint' se aya hai, jisaka arth rangin phulon vali dijain vala kapada hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki hindi ke 'chhint' shabd se nikale kis kapadae ki yurop mein bahut mang thi? Isliye sahi nateeja chintj (Chintz) nikalta hai. kosa, bandhana, malamal is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan chintj (Chintz) hi milti hai. Exam point: chintj (Chintz) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which act was passed by the British government in 1720 to ban the use of Indian cotton textiles?
qh: 1720 में ब्रिटिश सरकार ने भारतीय सूती कपड़ों के उपयोग पर प्रतिबंध लगाने के लिए कौन सा अधिनियम पारित किया?
e: british udyogon ko bachane ke lie 1720 mein 'kailiko adhiniyam' parit kar bharatiy kapadaon par pratibandh lagaya gaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1720 mein british sarakar ne bharatiy suti kapadaon ke upayog par pratibandh lagane ke lie kaun sa adhiniyam parit kiya? Isi aadhar par kailiko adhiniyam (Calico Act) chuna jaata hai. audyogik adhiniyam, vyapar adhiniyam, suti adhiniyam is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar kailiko adhiniyam (Calico Act) hai. Exam point: kailiko adhiniyam (Calico Act) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who invented the 'Spinning Jenny' in 1764?
qh: 1764 में 'स्पिनिंग जेनी' (Spinning Jenny) का आविष्कार किसने किया था?
e: jon ke ne 1764 mein spining jeni ka avishkar kiya, jisane katai ki gati badha di. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1764 mein 'spining jeni' (Spinning Jenny) ka avishkar kisane kiya tha? Isi baat se jon ke (John Kaye) sahi sabit hota hai. jems vat, thomas bel, richard arkarait anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav jon ke (John Kaye) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: jon ke (John Kaye) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Where was the first cotton mill of India established in 1854?
qh: भारत की पहली सूती मिल (Cotton Mill) 1854 में कहाँ स्थापित की गई थी?
e: bharat ki pahali saphal suti mil 1854 mein bombe (ab munbai) mein sthapit hui thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bharat ki pahali suti mil (Cotton Mill) 1854 mein kahan sthapit ki gai thi? Isliye sahi nateeja banbai (munbai) nikalta hai. kolakata, kanapur, ahamadabad ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se banbai (munbai) sahi hai. Exam point: banbai (munbai) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Tipu Sultan's sword was made of which special steel?
qh: मैसूर के शासक टीपू सुल्तान की तलवार किस विशेष स्टील से बनी थी?
e: tipu sultan ki talavar 'butj stil' se bani thi, jisamein karban ki matra bahut adhik thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki maisur ke shasak tipu sultan ki talavar kis vishesh stil se bani thi? Isliye antim jawab butj stil (Wootz Steel) ke roop mein milta hai. dhalava loha, mridu ispat, stenales stil anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab butj stil (Wootz Steel) hai. Exam point: butj stil (Wootz Steel) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which famous European scientist studied the properties of Indian Wootz steel for 4 years?
qh: किस प्रसिद्ध यूरोपीय वैज्ञानिक ने भारतीय बूट्ज़ स्टील की विशेषताओं का 4 वर्षों तक अध्ययन किया?
e: bijali ke avishkarak maikal phairade ne 1818-1822 tak bharatiy butj stil par adhyayan kiya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki kis prasiddh yuropiy vaijnanik ne bharatiy butj stil ki visheshataon ka 4 varshon tak adhyayan kiya? Isliye sahi nateeja maikal phairade (Michael Faraday) nikalta hai. lui pashchar, albart ainstin, aijaik nyutan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad maikal phairade (Michael Faraday) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: maikal phairade (Michael Faraday) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: For what work was the 'Agarias' community famous in central India?
qh: मध्य भारत में 'अगरिया' (Agarias) समुदाय किस काम के लिए प्रसिद्ध था?
e: agariya samuday ke log loha galane ke kam mein atyadhik kushal the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki madhy bharat mein 'agariya' (Agarias) samuday kis kam ke lie prasiddh tha? Isi baat se loha galana (Iron Smelting) sahi sabit hota hai. kapada bunana, machhali pakadana, kheti karana alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad loha galana (Iron Smelting) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: loha galana (Iron Smelting) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year did Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) start producing steel?
qh: टाटा आयरन एंड स्टील कंपनी (TISCO) ने किस वर्ष स्टील का उत्पादन शुरू किया?
e: tisko (TISCO) ne jamashedapur mein 1912 mein stil ka utpadan shuru kiya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki tata ayaran end stil kanpani (TISCO) ne kis varsh stil ka utpadan shuru kiya? In tathyon ke chalte 1912 hi sahi hai. 1904, 1947, 1854 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1912 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1912 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which global event gave the biggest boost to the Iron and Steel industry in India?
qh: भारत में आयरन एंड स्टील उद्योग को किस वैश्विक घटना से सबसे अधिक बढ़ावा मिला?
e: pratham vishv yuddh ke dauran briten se ayat band hone ke karan bharatiy relave ne tisko se rel patariyan kharidin. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki bharat mein ayaran end stil udyog ko kis vaishvik ghatana se sabase adhik badhava mila? Isi karan se pratham vishv yuddh (First World War) sahi uttar hai. Galti rusi kranti, ameriki grihayuddh, phransisi kranti chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad pratham vishv yuddh (First World War) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: pratham vishv yuddh (First World War) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: By whom was the work of 'spinning' mainly done in cotton textile production?
qh: सूती कपड़ा उत्पादन में 'कताई' (Spinning) का कार्य मुख्य रूप से किसके द्वारा किया जाता था?
e: bharat mein katai (Spinning) ka kam paranparik rup se mahilaon dvara charakhe aur takali par kiya jata tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki suti kapada utpadan mein 'katai' (Spinning) ka kary mukhy rup se kisake dvara kiya jata tha? Isi aadhar par mahilaon dvara chuna jaata hai. purushon dvara, bachchon dvara, mashinon dvara in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan mahilaon dvara hi milti hai. Exam point: mahilaon dvara - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a specialist who dyed cloth called in India?
qh: कपड़ों को रंगने वाले विशेषज्ञ को भारत में क्या कहा जाता था?
e: dhage ya kapadae ko rangane vale vyakti ko 'rangarej' kaha jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kapadaon ko rangane vale visheshajn ko bharat mein kya kaha jata tha? Isi tathya par rangarej (Rangrez) tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - bunakar, chhipigar, agariya - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar rangarej (Rangrez) hi hai. Exam point: rangarej (Rangrez) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Whose help did 'Chhipigars' take to make printed cloth?
qh: छपाई वाले कपड़े बनाने के लिए 'छिपीगर' (Chhipigars) किसकी सहायता लेते थे?
e: chhipigar lakadai ke thappon (blocks) ka upayog karake kapadaon par dijain chhapate the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki chhapai vale kapadae banane ke lie 'chhipigar' (Chhipigars) kisaki sahayata lete the? Isi tathya par thappon/blok ki (Wooden Blocks) tika hua hai. Vikalp brash ki, mashinon ki, rasayanon ki bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se thappon/blok ki (Wooden Blocks) sahi hai. Exam point: thappon/blok ki (Wooden Blocks) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the name of the famous weaver community of Bengal?
qh: बंगाल के प्रसिद्ध बुनकर समुदाय का नाम क्या था?
e: bangal ke prasiddh bunakar samuday ko 'tanti' kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki bangal ke prasiddh bunakar samuday ka nam kya tha? Isliye antim jawab tanti ke roop mein milta hai. Galti sale, koshti, julahe chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar tanti baithta hai. Exam point: tanti - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was a main reason for the decline of the Indian iron smelting industry in the late 19th century?
qh: 19वीं सदी के अंत में भारतीय लोहा गलाने वाले उद्योगों (Iron Smelting) के पतन का एक मुख्य कारण क्या था?
e: nae van kanunon ke karan bunakaron ko lakadai aur koyale ke lie jangalon mein jane se rok diya gaya. Yah prashn nae van kanun (New Forest Laws) se juda hai. Isi aadhar par nae van kanun (New Forest Laws) chuna jaata hai. koyale ki kami, lohe ki mang mein kami, pani ki kami ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan nae van kanun (New Forest Laws) hi milti hai. Exam point: nae van kanun (New Forest Laws) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Jamshedpur city is situated on the banks of which river, where TISCO is located?
qh: जमशेदपुर शहर किस नदी के किनारे बसा है, जहाँ टिस्को (TISCO) स्थित है?
e: tisko ki sthapana suvarnarekha nadi ke kinare sakachi (jamashedapur) mein ki gai thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki jamashedapur shahar kis nadi ke kinare basa hai, jahan tisko (TISCO) sthit hai? In tathyon ke chalte suvarnarekha (Subarnarekha) hi sahi hai. ganga, narmada, yamuna in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav suvarnarekha (Subarnarekha) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: suvarnarekha (Subarnarekha) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What emerged as a symbol of Swadeshi during the Indian national movement?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के दौरान स्वदेशी के प्रतीक के रूप में क्या उभरा?
e: mahatma gandhi ne videshi kapadaon ka bahishkar kiya aur khadi ko rashtriyata ka pratik banaya. Is prashn ka vishay swadeshi hai. swadeshi ka matlab desi maal apnana tatha videshi maal ka bahishkar tha. Yahi wajah hai ki khadi sahi hai. jins, resham, poliestar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad khadi hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: khadi - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which new act was passed by the British Parliament after the 1857 revolt?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के बाद ब्रिटिश संसद ने कौन सा नया अधिनियम पारित किया?
e: 1858 ke adhiniyam ke tahat satta ist indiya kanpani se british kraun ko hastantarit kar di gai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 1857 ke vidroh ke bad british sansad ne kaun sa naya adhiniyam parit kiya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 1858 ka bharat sarakar adhiniyam hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 1919 ka adhiniyam, 1935 ka adhiniyam, 1861 ka adhiniyam anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1858 ka bharat sarakar adhiniyam hi milti hai. Exam point: 1858 ka bharat sarakar adhiniyam - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the designation of the Governor General changed to after the revolt?
qh: विद्रोह के बाद गवर्नर जनरल का पदनाम बदलकर क्या कर दिया गया?
e: 1858 ke adhiniyam ke bad gavarnar janaral ko vayasaray (kraun ka niji pratinidhi) kaha jane laga. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki vidroh ke bad gavarnar janaral ka padanam badalakar kya kar diya gaya? Isi tathya par vayasaray tika hua hai. pradhanamantri, rashtrapati, sachiv in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se vayasaray sahi hai. Exam point: vayasaray - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which regions was the recruitment of soldiers increased after 1857?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के बाद ब्रिटिश सेना में किन क्षेत्रों से सैनिकों की भर्ती बढ़ाई गई?
e: vidroh ke bad avadh aur bihar ke bajay vaphadar mane jane vale gorakha, sikh aur pathanon ki bharti badhai gai. Yahaan gorakha, sikh aur pathan se juda tathya poochha gaya hai. Isi aadhar par gorakha, sikh aur pathan chuna jaata hai. madhy bharat, bihar aur avadh, dakshin bharat in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad gorakha, sikh aur pathan hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: gorakha, sikh aur pathan - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What benefit did the British offer in 1850 for those converting to Christianity?
qh: अंग्रेजों ने 1850 में ईसाई धर्म अपनाने वालों के लिए कौन सा लाभ दिया?
e: 1850 ke kanun ne isai dharm apanane valon ke lie apane purvajon ki sanpatti pana asan bana diya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki angrejon ne 1850 mein isai dharm apanane valon ke lie kaun sa labh diya? In tathyon ke chalte sanpatti ka adhikar hi sahi hai. taiks mein chhut, sarakari naukari, shiksha mein chhut anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar sanpatti ka adhikar hi hai. Exam point: sanpatti ka adhikar - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: When did the British pass laws to stop the practice of Sati?
qh: सती प्रथा को रोकने के लिए अंग्रेजों ने कब कानून बनाया था?
e: angrejon ne bharat mein samajik sudhar ke tahat 1829 mein sati pratha ko rokane ke lie kanun banaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki sati pratha ko rokane ke lie angrejon ne kab kanun banaya tha? Isi aadhar par 1829 chuna jaata hai. Galti 1856, 1858, 1857 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1829 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1829 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which region was Birsa Munda born in the mid-1870s?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा का जन्म 1870 के दशक के मध्य में किस क्षेत्र में हुआ था?
e: birasa munda ka janm chhota nagapur ke munda janajati ke parivar mein hua tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki birasa munda ka janm 1870 ke dashak ke madhy mein kis kshetr mein hua tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par chhota nagapur (Chhota Nagpur) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. bastar, nilagiri, andaman alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se chhota nagapur (Chhota Nagpur) sahi hai. Exam point: chhota nagapur (Chhota Nagpur) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In tribal terminology, for whom was the term 'Dikus' used?
qh: जनजातीय शब्दावली में 'डिकु' (Dikus) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
e: adivasi log angrejon, vyapariyon aur sahukaron jaise bahari logon ko 'diku' kahate the, jinhein ve apani samasyaon ka karan manate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki janajatiy shabdavali mein 'diku' (Dikus) shabd ka prayog kisake lie kiya jata tha? In tathyon ke chalte bahari log (Outsiders) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - devata, sthaniy mukhiya, jangali janavar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab bahari log (Outsiders) hai. Exam point: bahari log (Outsiders) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: By what other name is 'Jhum Cultivation' known?
qh: 'झूम खेती' (Jhum Cultivation) को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: jhum kheti ya sthanantari krishi mein jangalon ko katakar aur jalakar rakh ko urvarak ke rup mein upayog kiya jata hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki 'jhum kheti' (Jhum Cultivation) ko aur kis nam se jana jata hai? In tathyon ke chalte sthanantari krishi (Shifting Cultivation) hi sahi hai. sthayi krishi, nahari sinchai, bagavani anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab sthanantari krishi (Shifting Cultivation) hai. Exam point: sthanantari krishi (Shifting Cultivation) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What is the method of sowing seeds in Jhum cultivation called where seeds are scattered on the ground?
qh: झूम खेती में बीज बोने की उस विधि को क्या कहा जाता है जिसमें बीजों को जमीन पर छिड़क दिया जाता है?
e: jhum kaltivetar hal chalane ke bajay bijon ko jamin par bikher dete the, jise brodakasting kaha jata hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki jhum kheti mein bij bone ki us vidhi ko kya kaha jata hai jisamein bijon ko jamin par chhidak diya jata hai? Isi karan se brodakasting (Broadcasting) sahi uttar hai. Galti plaing, narsari, driling chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab brodakasting (Broadcasting) hai. Exam point: brodakasting (Broadcasting) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which tribal group in the forests of Odisha was known as 'Hunters and Gatherers'?
qh: ओडिशा के जंगलों में रहने वाला कौन सा जनजातीय समूह 'शिकारी और संग्राहक' (Hunters & Gatherers) के रूप में जाना जाता था?
e: odisha ke khond log toliyon mein shikar karate the aur kand-mul v phal ikattha karate the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki odisha ke jangalon mein rahane vala kaun sa janajatiy samuh 'shikari aur sangrahak' (Hunters & Gatherers) ke rup mein jana jata tha? Isi karan se khond (Khonds) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - bhil, munda, santhal - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab khond (Khonds) hai. Exam point: khond (Khonds) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which flowers were used by local weavers and leather workers for dyeing clothes?
qh: स्थानीय बुनकर और चमड़ा श्रमिक कपड़ों की रंगाई के लिए किन फूलों का उपयोग करते थे?
e: adivasi log jangalon se kusum aur palash ke phul ikattha kar bunakaron ko bechate the jinaka upayog rang banane mein hota tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki sthaniy bunakar aur chamada shramik kapadaon ki rangai ke lie kin phulon ka upayog karate the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par kusum aur palash (Kusum & Palash) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. surajamukhi, gulab aur geinda, kamal in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kusum aur palash (Kusum & Palash) hi milti hai. Exam point: kusum aur palash (Kusum & Palash) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which tribe in Central India considered themselves 'children of the forest' and felt it below dignity to work as laborers?
qh: मध्य भारत की वह कौन सी जनजाति थी जो खुद को 'जंगल की संतान' मानती थी और मजदूरी करना अपमान समझती थी?
e: baiga janajati ke log keval jangal ki upaj par jivit rahana chahate the aur dusaron ke kheton mein kam karana unake lie apamanajanak tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki madhy bharat ki vah kaun si janajati thi jo khud ko 'jangal ki santan' manati thi aur majaduri karana apaman samajhati thi? Isi karan se baiga (Baigas) sahi uttar hai. gond, santhal, gaddi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad baiga (Baigas) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: baiga (Baigas) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which tribal groups did British officials consider more 'civilized' than hunter-gatherers?
qh: ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों ने किन जनजातीय समूहों को शिकारी-संग्राहकों की तुलना में अधिक 'सभ्य' माना?
e: angrej un janajatiyon ko adhik sabhy manate the jo ek jagah basakar kheti karate the, jaise gond aur santhal. Prashn yah batata hai ki british adhikariyon ne kin janajatiy samuhon ko shikari-sangrahakon ki tulana mein adhik 'sabhy' mana? Isliye sahi nateeja gond aur santhal (Gonds & Santhals) nikalta hai. naga aur jarava, munda aur santhal, bhil aur baiga in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad gond aur santhal (Gonds & Santhals) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: gond aur santhal (Gonds & Santhals) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the impact on the powers of Tribal Chiefs during British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान जनजातीय मुखियाओं (Tribal Chiefs) की शक्तियों पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ा?
o: उनकी प्रशासनिक शक्तियाँ खत्म हो गईं (Administrative powers were lost)
e: angrejon ke adhin mukhiyaon ke pas jamin ka malikana hak to raha, lekin unaki prashasanik aur kanun banane ki shakti chhin gai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki british shasan ke dauran janajatiy mukhiyaon (Tribal Chiefs) ki shaktiyon par kya prabhav pada? In tathyon ke chalte unaki prashasanik shaktiyan khatm ho gain (Administrative powers were lost) hi sahi hai. Vikalp ve svatantr raja ban gae, unaki shaktiyan badh gain, koi prabhav nahin pada bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan unaki prashasanik shaktiyan khatm ho gain (Administrative... hi milti hai. Exam point: unaki prashasanik shaktiyan khatm ho gain (Administrative powers were lost) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the British declare forests as 'Reserved Forests'?
qh: अंग्रेजों ने जंगलों को 'आरक्षित वन' (Reserved Forests) क्यों घोषित किया?
o: कीमती लकड़ी (जैसे इमारती लकड़ी) प्राप्त करने के लिए (To produce timber)
खेती को बढ़ावा देने के लिए
e: arakshit vanon se angrej apani jaruraton, jaise relave slipar banane ke lie, kimati lakadai prapt karana chahate the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki angrejon ne jangalon ko 'arakshit van' (Reserved Forests) kyon ghoshit kiya? Isi aadhar par kimati lakadai (jaise imarati lakadai) prapt karane ke lie (To produce timber) chuna jaata hai. adivasiyon ke rahane ke lie, janavaron ke shikar ke lie, kheti ko badhava dene ke lie alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad kimati lakadai (jaise imarati lakadai) prapt karane... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: kimati lakadai (jaise imarati lakadai) prapt karane... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What new arrangement did the British start to get labor in forests for making railway sleepers?
qh: रेलवे स्लीपर बनाने के लिए वनों में काम करने हेतु अंग्रेजों ने किस नई व्यवस्था की शुरुआत की?
e: angrejon ne adivasiyon ko jangal ke chhote hisson par kheti ki anumati di, basharte ve van vibhag ke lie sasta shram upalabdh karaen. inhein 'van gram' kaha gaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki relave slipar banane ke lie vanon mein kam karane hetu angrejon ne kis nai vyavastha ki shuruat ki? Isi aadhar par van gram (Forest Villages) basae chuna jaata hai. Vikalp majaduri badha di, mashinon ka prayog kiya, sena bulai bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav van gram (Forest Villages) basae hi thehrta hai. Exam point: van gram (Forest Villages) basae - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: At what price did silk traders buy cocoons from the Santhals of Hazaribagh in the 18th century?
qh: रेशम के व्यापारियों ने 18वीं शताब्दी में हजारीबाग के संधालों से रेशम के कीड़े (Cocoons) किस दाम पर खरीदे थे?
o: बहुत कम दाम पर (Very low price)
e: vyapari adivasiyon ko 3-4 rupaye dekar hajaron kokun kharidate the aur unhein 5 guna jyada kimat par bechate the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki resham ke vyapariyon ne 18vin shatabdi mein hajaribag ke sandhalon se resham ke kidae (Cocoons) kis dam par kharide the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par bahut kam dam par (Very low price) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp vastu vinimay dvara, bahut unche dam par, sone ke badale bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan bahut kam dam par (Very low price) hi milti hai. Exam point: bahut kam dam par (Very low price) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: To which dangerous places did the tribals of Bihar and Jharkhand have to go in search of work?
qh: बिहार और झारखंड के आदिवासियों को काम की तलाश में किन खतरनाक स्थानों पर जाना पड़ा?
o: चाय बागान और कोयला खदानों में (Tea plantations & Coal mines)
e: adivasiyon ko asam ke chay baganon aur bihar ki koyala khadanon mein thekedaron ke madhyam se kam karane ke lie majabur kiya gaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bihar aur jharakhand ke adivasiyon ko kam ki talash mein kin khataranak sthanon par jana pada? Isi baat se chay bagan aur koyala khadanon mein (Tea plantations & Coal mines) sahi sabit hota hai. videshi yatraon par, keval sarakari daphtaron mein, sophtaveyar kanpaniyon mein is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav chay bagan aur koyala khadanon mein (Tea plantations & Coal mines) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: chay bagan aur koyala khadanon mein (Tea plantations & Coal mines) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which imaginary era did Birsa Munda refer to as the 'Golden Age' or 'Satyug'?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा ने किस काल्पनिक युग को 'स्वर्ण युग' या 'सतयुग' (Age of Truth) कहा था?
o: आदिवासियों के गौरवशाली अतीत को (Glorious tribal past)
e: birasa munda ek aise atit ki bat karate the jab munda log prakriti ke sath shanti se rahate the aur bahari logon (diku) ka hastakshep nahin tha. Is prashn ka dayra adivasiyon ke gauravashali atit ko (Glorious tribal past) tak phaila hua hai. Isliye sahi nateeja adivasiyon ke gauravashali atit ko (Glorious tribal past) nikalta hai. bhavishy ke audyogik yug ko, british kal, mugal kal in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar adivasiyon ke gauravashali atit ko (Glorious tribal past) baithta hai. Exam point: adivasiyon ke gauravashali atit ko (Glorious tribal past) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: When and why was Birsa Munda first arrested by the British government?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा को ब्रिटिश सरकार ने पहली बार कब और क्यों गिरफ्तार किया था?
o: 1895 में दंगा भड़काने के आरोप में (1895 for Rioting)
e: 1895 mein birasa munda ko danga bhadakane ke arop mein giraphtar kiya gaya aur unhein 2 sal ki jel hui. Is prashn ka vishay 1895 mein danga bhadakane ke arop mein (1895 for Rioting) hai. Isliye antim jawab 1895 mein danga bhadakane ke arop mein... ke roop mein milta hai. 1857 mein vidroh ke lie, 1947 mein chori ke lie, 1900 mein vyapar ke lie ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 1895 mein danga bhadakane ke arop mein... hi hai. Exam point: 1895 mein danga bhadakane ke arop mein (1895 for Rioting) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Whom did Birsa's followers want to destroy as symbols of 'Diku' and European power?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा के अनुयायी 'डिकु' और 'यूरोपीय' शक्ति के प्रतीक के रूप में किसे नष्ट करना चाहते थे?
e: birasa ne apane anuyayiyon se kaha ki unhein ravan (diku aur yuropiy) ko nasht kar apane samrajy ki sthapana karani hai. Is prashn ka dayra ravan (Ravana) tak phaila hua hai. Yahi wajah hai ki ravan (Ravana) sahi hai. jangalon ko, nadiyon ko, apane hi ganvon ko mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar ravan (Ravana) hi hai. Exam point: ravan (Ravana) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the color of the flag of Birsa Munda's movement?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा के आंदोलन का प्रतीक झंडा किस रंग का था?
e: birasa munda ke vidroh ke dauran 'birasa raj' ke pratik ke rup mein saphed jhanda laharaya gaya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki birasa munda ke andolan ka pratik jhanda kis rang ka tha? Isi aadhar par saphed (White) chuna jaata hai. lal, pila, hara ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan saphed (White) hi milti hai. Exam point: saphed (White) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When and how did Birsa Munda die?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा की मृत्यु कब और किस कारण हुई?
e: 1900 mein birasa munda ki jel mein haija hone ke karan mrityu ho gai thi. Is prashn ka dayra 1900 mein haija (Cholera) ke karan tak phaila hua hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1900 mein haija (Cholera) ke karan sahi nikalta hai. Galti 1947 mein budhape se, 1895 mein yuddh mein, 1920 mein phansi se chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1900 mein haija (Cholera) ke karan hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1900 mein haija (Cholera) ke karan - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was a significant outcome of Birsa Munda's revolt?
qh: बिरसा मुंडा के विद्रोह का एक महत्वपूर्ण परिणाम क्या था?
o: ब्रिटिश सरकार ने आदिवासियों की जमीन न हड़पने के कानून बनाए (Laws protecting tribal land)
e: is andolan ke karan british sarakar ko aise kanun banane padae jisase diku log adivasiyon ki jamin asani se n hadap sakein. Prashn yah batata hai ki birasa munda ke vidroh ka ek mahatvapurn parinam kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja british sarakar ne adivasiyon ki jamin n hadapane ke kanun banae (Laws protecting tribal land) nikalta hai. adivasiyon ne kheti chhod di, sabhi adivasi isai ban gae, angrej bharat chhodakar chale gae ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar british sarakar ne adivasiyon ki jamin n hadapane ke kanun banae (Laws protecting tribal land) baithta hai. Exam point: british sarakar ne adivasiyon ki jamin n hadapane ke kanun banae (Laws protecting tribal land) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What caused the 'Songram Sangma' revolt in Assam in 1906?
qh: 1906 में असम में हुआ 'सोनग्राम संगमा' (Songram Sangma) विद्रोह किस कारण हुआ था?
o: दमनकारी वन कानूनों के विरोध में (Against colonial forest laws)
e: adivasiyon ne british van kanunon ke khilaph virodh kiya, jisake parinamasvarup 1906 mein asam mein sonagram sangama vidroh hua. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1906 mein asam mein hua 'sonagram sangama' (Songram Sangma) vidroh kis karan hua tha? Isi karan se damanakari van kanunon ke virodh mein (Against... sahi uttar hai. shiksha ki kami, akal ke karan, vyapar ke lie is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar damanakari van kanunon ke virodh mein (Against colonial forest laws) hai. Exam point: damanakari van kanunon ke virodh mein (Against colonial forest laws) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: When did the Mughal Emperor formally appoint the East India Company as the Diwan of Bengal?
qh: मुगल सम्राट ने ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी को बंगाल का 'दीवान' औपचारिक रूप से कब नियुक्त किया था?
e: 12 agast 1765 ko mugal samrat shah alam dvitiy ne robart klaiv ko bangal ki divani saunpi, jisase kanpani ko rajasv vasuli ka kanuni adhikar mil gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mugal samrat ne ist indiya kanpani ko bangal ka 'divan' aupacharik rup se kab niyukt kiya tha? Isi karan se 12 agast 1765 (12 August 1765) sahi uttar hai. Galti 26 janavari 1950, 15 agast 1947, 10 mai 1857 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 12 agast 1765 (12 August 1765) hai. Exam point: 12 agast 1765 (12 August 1765) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the primary meaning of becoming a 'Diwan' during British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान 'दीवान' (Diwan) बनने का मुख्य अर्थ क्या था?
o: मुख्य वित्तीय प्रशासक बनना (Chief Financial Administrator)
e: divan ke rup mein kanpani apane niyantran vale bhu-bhag ke arthik mamalon ki mukhy shasak ban gai thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki british shasan ke dauran 'divan' (Diwan) banane ka mukhy arth kya tha? In tathyon ke chalte mukhy vittiy prashasak banana (Chief Financial Administrator) hi sahi hai. vyaparik dut banana, dharmik guru banana, keval sena ka netritv karana ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar mukhy vittiy prashasak banana (Chief Financial Administrator) hi hai. Exam point: mukhy vittiy prashasak banana (Chief Financial Administrator) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which revenue system was introduced in Bengal by Lord Cornwallis in 1793?
qh: 1793 में लॉर्ड कार्नवालिस द्वारा बंगाल में कौन सी राजस्व व्यवस्था लागू की गई थी?
e: sthayi bandobast ke tahat rajasv ki rashi sthayi rup se tay kar di gai thi, jise bhavishy mein kabhi nahin badhaya jana tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki 1793 mein lord karnavalis dvara bangal mein kaun si rajasv vyavastha lagu ki gai thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par sthayi bandobast (Permanent Settlement) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. mahalavari vyavastha, ijaradari pratha, raiyatavadai vyavastha in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav sthayi bandobast (Permanent Settlement) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: sthayi bandobast (Permanent Settlement) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under the Permanent Settlement, who was responsible for collecting revenue?
qh: स्थायी बंदोबस्त (Permanent Settlement) के तहत राजस्व संग्रह करने की जिम्मेदारी किसे दी गई थी?
o: राजाओं और तालुकेदारों को (Rajas & Talukdars as Zamindars)
e: sthayi bandobast ke tahat rajaon aur talukedaron ko 'jamindar' ke rup mein manyata di gai aur unhein kisanon se lagan vasulane ka kam saunpa gaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki sthayi bandobast (Permanent Settlement) ke tahat rajasv sangrah karane ki jimmedari kise di gai thi? sthayi bandobast mein lagaan ki rashi hamesha ke liye tay kar di gayi thi. Isliye sahi nateeja rajaon aur talukedaron ko (Rajas & Talukdars as Zamindars) nikalta hai. videshi vyapariyon ko, sidhe sarakari adhikariyon ko, kisanon ko in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar rajaon aur talukedaron ko (Rajas & Talukdars as Zamindars) baithta hai. Exam point: rajaon aur talukedaron ko (Rajas & Talukdars... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which new revenue system was introduced in the North-Western Provinces by Holt Mackenzie in 1822?
qh: 1822 में होल्ट मैकेंजी द्वारा उत्तर-पश्चिमी प्रांतों में कौन सी नई राजस्व प्रणाली लागू की गई?
e: mahalavari vyavastha mein 'mahal' (ganv ya ganvon ka samuh) ko ek ikai mana gaya aur rajasv ka samay-samay par sanshodhan kiya jana tay hua. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 1822 mein holt maikeinji dvara uttar-pashchimi pranton mein kaun si nai rajasv pranali lagu ki gai? mahalwari bandobast mein lagaan gaon ke mukhiya tatha poore mahal se liya jaata tha. Isi aadhar par mahalavari vyavastha (Mahalwari System) chuna jaata hai. raiyatavadai vyavastha, sthayi bandobast, nil kheti is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad mahalavari vyavastha (Mahalwari System) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: mahalavari vyavastha (Mahalwari System) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the term 'Mahal' mean in the Mahalwari system?
qh: महालवारी व्यवस्था में 'महाल' (Mahal) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: एक गाँव या गाँवों का समूह (A village or group of villages)
e: british rajasv rikord mein ek ganv ya ganvon ke samuh ko 'mahal' kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki mahalavari vyavastha mein 'mahal' (Mahal) shabd ka kya arth hai? mahalwari bandobast mein lagaan gaon ke mukhiya tatha poore mahal se liya jaata tha. Isi tathya par ek ganv ya ganvon ka samuh (A... tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - rajasv adhikari, ek mahal ya kila, ek bada raja - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar ek ganv ya ganvon ka samuh (A village or group of villages) hai. Exam point: ek ganv ya ganvon ka samuh (A village or group of villages) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the name of the revenue system developed by Thomas Munro in South India?
qh: दक्षिण भारत में थॉमस मुनरो द्वारा विकसित राजस्व व्यवस्था का नाम क्या था?
e: raiyatavadai vyavastha mein rajasv ka sidha samajhauta 'raiyaton' (kisanon) ke sath kiya gaya, kyonki vahan paranparik jamindar nahin the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki dakshin bharat mein thomas munaro dvara vikasit rajasv vyavastha ka nam kya tha? ryotwari bandobast mein lagaan seedhe kisaan se wasool kiya jaata tha. Isliye antim jawab raiyatavadai vyavastha (Ryotwari System) ke roop mein milta hai. Galti mahalavari, jamindari vyavastha, sthayi bandobast chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad raiyatavadai vyavastha (Ryotwari System) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: raiyatavadai vyavastha (Ryotwari System) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: For whom is the term 'Ryot' used in the Ryotwari system?
qh: रैयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था में 'रैयत' (Ryot) शब्द किसके लिए प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: raiyat shabd ka arth kisan ya khetihar hai, jinase angrej sidhe lagan vasulate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki raiyatavadai vyavastha mein 'raiyat' (Ryot) shabd kisake lie prayukt hota hai? ryotwari bandobast mein lagaan seedhe kisaan se wasool kiya jaata tha. Isi baat se khetihar ya kisan (Cultivators/Peasants) sahi sabit hota hai. sainik, badae jamindar, sarakari adhikari is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav khetihar ya kisan (Cultivators/Peasants) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: khetihar ya kisan (Cultivators/Peasants) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Approximately how many people died in the terrible famine of 1770 in Bengal?
qh: 1770 में बंगाल में आए भीषण अकाल (Famine) में लगभग कितने लोगों की मृत्यु हुई थी?
e: 1770 ke akal mein bangal ki lagabhag ek-tihai abadi (1 karod log) khatm ho gai thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki 1770 mein bangal mein ae bhishan akal (Famine) mein lagabhag kitane logon ki mrityu hui thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1 karod (10 million) hi sahi baithta hai. 50 lakh, 5 karod, 1 lakh alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1 karod (10 million) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1 karod (10 million) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which climatic zone do Indigo plants primarily grow?
qh: नील (Indigo) के पौधे मुख्य रूप से किस जलवायु क्षेत्र में उगते हैं?
e: nil ke paudhe mukhy rup se ushn katibandhiy (Tropical) kshetron mein ugate hain, yahi karan tha ki bharatiy nil ki yurop mein bahut mang thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki nil (Indigo) ke paudhe mukhy rup se kis jalavayu kshetr mein ugate hain? Isi baat se ushn katibandh (Tropics) sahi sabit hota hai. dhruviy kshetr, registani kshetr, shitoshn katibandh (Temperate) is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar ushn katibandh (Tropics) baithta hai. Exam point: ushn katibandh (Tropics) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which plant did European cloth producers use as a substitute for Indigo?
qh: यूरोपीय कपड़ा उत्पादक नील के विकल्प के रूप में किस पौधे का उपयोग करते थे?
e: vod (Woad) shitoshn kshetron mein ugata tha, lekin isase milane vala rang phika aur dal hota tha, jabaki nil ka rang chamakadar nila hota tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki yuropiy kapada utpadak nil ke vikalp ke rup mein kis paudhe ka upayog karate the? Isi karan se vod (Woad) sahi uttar hai. patasan, kapas, tanbaku alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar vod (Woad) hi hai. Exam point: vod (Woad) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What were the two main systems of indigo cultivation?
qh: नील की खेती के दो मुख्य तरीके कौन से थे?
e: nij kheti mein bagan malik khud jamin kharidakar ya kiraye par lekar kheti karavate the, jabaki raiyati mein kisanon se jabaran anubandh karaya jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki nil ki kheti ke do mukhy tarike kaun se the? Isliye antim jawab nij aur raiyati (Nij and Ryoti) ke roop mein milta hai. mahalavari aur raiyatavadai, sarakari aur niji, sthayi aur asthayi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar nij aur raiyati (Nij and Ryoti) hai. Exam point: nij aur raiyati (Nij and Ryoti) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the main problem faced by planters in 'Nij' cultivation of indigo?
qh: नील की 'निज' (Nij) खेती में बागान मालिकों को मुख्य रूप से किस समस्या का सामना करना पड़ता था?
o: उपजाऊ भूमि और मजदूरों की कमी (Lack of fertile land & labor)
e: nil ki kheti ke lie badae bhukhandon ki jarurat thi aur majaduron ki jarurat usi samay padati thi jab ve chaval ki kheti mein vyast hote the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki nil ki 'nij' (Nij) kheti mein bagan malikon ko mukhy rup se kis samasya ka samana karana padata tha? Isliye sahi nateeja upajau bhumi aur majaduron ki kami (Lack of fertile land & labor) nikalta hai. pani ki adhikata, bij ki kami, taiks n hona ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se upajau bhumi aur majaduron ki kami (Lack of fertile land & labor) sahi hai. Exam point: upajau bhumi aur majaduron ki kami (Lack of fertile land & labor) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: When did the 'Blue Rebellion' or Indigo Revolt begin?
qh: नील विद्रोह या 'ब्लू रिबेलियन' (Blue Rebellion) कब शुरू हुआ था?
e: march 1859 mein bangal ke hajaron raiyaton ne nil ki kheti karane se inakar kar diya aur bagan malikon ke viruddh vidroh kar diya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki nil vidroh ya 'blu ribeliyan' (Blue Rebellion) kab shuru hua tha? Isliye antim jawab 1859 ke roop mein milta hai. 1885, 1857, 1917 in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 1859 hi milti hai. Exam point: 1859 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: During the Indigo revolt, what were the agents of planters called, who were often beaten by peasants?
qh: नील विद्रोह के दौरान बागान मालिकों के एजेंटों को क्या कहा जाता था जिनकी किसान पिटाई कर देते थे?
e: gumashta ve ejeint the jo lagan vasulane ate the. vidroh ke dauran kisanon ne unhein pitana shuru kar diya tha. Is prashn ka kendra gumashta (Gomasthas) hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par gumashta (Gomasthas) hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp patavari, subedar, daroga bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav gumashta (Gomasthas) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: gumashta (Gomasthas) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which commission was set up by the British government to investigate the indigo revolt?
qh: नील विद्रोह की जांच के लिए ब्रिटिश सरकार ने किस आयोग का गठन किया था?
e: nil ayog ne bagan malikon ko doshi paya aur mana ki nil ki kheti raiyaton ke lie labhakari nahin hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki nil vidroh ki janch ke lie british sarakar ne kis ayog ka gathan kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par nil ayog (Indigo Commission) hi sahi baithta hai. hantar ayog, torch kamishan, saiman kamishan ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab nil ayog (Indigo Commission) hai. Exam point: nil ayog (Indigo Commission) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: After indigo production collapsed in Bengal, where did planters shift their attention?
qh: बंगाल में नील उत्पादन धराशायी होने के बाद बागान मालिकों ने अपना ध्यान किस क्षेत्र की ओर स्थानांतरित किया?
e: bangal mein vidroh ke bad bagan malik bihar chale gae, jahan bad mein chanparan andolan hua. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki bangal mein nil utpadan dharashayi hone ke bad bagan malikon ne apana dhyan kis kshetr ki or sthanantarit kiya? Yahi wajah hai ki bihar sahi hai. Vikalp panjab, gujarat, maharashtr bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad bihar hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: bihar - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Where did Mahatma Gandhi start his first Satyagraha against indigo planters in 1917?
qh: 1917 में महात्मा गांधी ने नील बागान मालिकों के खिलाफ अपना पहला सत्याग्रह कहाँ शुरू किया था?
e: gandhiji ne bihar ke chanparan ka daura kiya aur vahan ke nil kisanon ki samasyaon ko lekar andolan shuru kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 1917 mein mahatma gandhi ne nil bagan malikon ke khilaph apana pahala satyagrah kahan shuru kiya tha? satyagraha satya tatha ahimsa par tika jan-sangharsh ka tarika tha. Isliye antim jawab chanparan (Champaran) ke roop mein milta hai. ahamadabad, kheda, chauri-chaura ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav chanparan (Champaran) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: chanparan (Champaran) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: After the death of which Sikh King did the British annex Punjab?
qh: सिखों के किस राजा की मृत्यु के बाद अंग्रेजों ने पंजाब का अधिग्रहण किया था?
e: maharaja ranajit sinh ke jivit rahane tak angrej panjab par kabja nahin kar pae the, unaki mrityu (1839) ke bad do yuddhon ke bad panjab ko hadap liya gaya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki sikhon ke kis raja ki mrityu ke bad angrejon ne panjab ka adhigrahan kiya tha? Isi baat se maharaja ranajit sinh (Maharaja Ranjit Singh) sahi sabit hota hai. banda bahadur, guru gobind sinh, dilip sinh anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan maharaja ranajit sinh (Maharaja Ranjit Singh) hi milti hai. Exam point: maharaja ranajit sinh (Maharaja Ranjit Singh) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Governor-General annexed many Indian states under the 'Doctrine of Lapse'?
qh: किस गवर्नर-जनरल ने 'व्यपगत का सिद्धांत' या 'विलय नीति' (Doctrine of Lapse) के तहत कई भारतीय राज्यों को हड़पा था?
e: lord dalahauji ne is niti ka upayog jhansi, satara aur sanbalapur jaise rajyon ko british samrajy mein milane ke lie kiya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki kis gavarnar-janaral ne 'vyapagat ka siddhant' ya 'vilay niti' (Doctrine of Lapse) ke tahat kai bharatiy rajyon ko hadapa tha? doctrine of lapse ke tehat bina asli waris wali riyasat angrezi raj mein mil jaati thi. Isi baat se lord dalahauji (Lord Dalhousie) sahi sabit hota hai. lord beintik, voren hestings, lord karnavalis anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab lord dalahauji (Lord Dalhousie) hai. Exam point: lord dalahauji (Lord Dalhousie) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which Queen of England did the East India Company acquire a charter to trade with the East in 1600?
qh: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने 1600 में इंग्लैंड की किस महारानी से पूर्व के साथ व्यापार करने का चार्टर (इजाजतनामा) हासिल किया था?
e: maharani elijabeth pratham ne kanpani ko purv mein vyapar karane ka ekadhikar diya, jisase inglaind ki koi dusari kanpani unake sath hod nahin kar sakati thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki ist indiya kanpani ne 1600 mein inglaind ki kis maharani se purv ke sath vyapar karane ka chartar (ijajatanama) hasil kiya tha? In tathyon ke chalte maharani elijabeth pratham (Queen Elizabeth I) hi sahi hai. maharani viktoriya, maharani ain, maharani mairi anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad maharani elijabeth pratham (Queen Elizabeth I) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: maharani elijabeth pratham (Queen Elizabeth I) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who discovered the sea route to India before the East India Company's arrival?
qh: ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के आने से पहले भारत के समुद्री रास्तों की खोज किसने की थी?
e: purtagali khoji yatri vasko di gama ne 1498 mein pahali bar bharat tak pahunchane ke samudri marg ki khoj ki thi. Yah prashn vasko di gama (Vasco da Gama) se juda hai. In tathyon ke chalte vasko di gama (Vasco da Gama) hi sahi hai. kristophar kolanbas, robart klaiv, kaiptan kuk is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar vasko di gama (Vasco da Gama) hi hai. Exam point: vasko di gama (Vasco da Gama) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: On the banks of which river was the first English factory established in 1651?
qh: पहली इंग्लिश फैक्ट्री 1651 में किस नदी के किनारे स्थापित की गई थी?
e: pahali inglish phaiktri bangal mein hugali nadi ke kinare shuru hui thi, jahan se kanpani ke vyapari (jinhein phaiktars kaha jata tha) kam karate the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki pahali inglish phaiktri 1651 mein kis nadi ke kinare sthapit ki gai thi? Isliye antim jawab hugali nadi (River Hugli) ke roop mein milta hai. narmada nadi, ganga nadi, yamuna nadi in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab hugali nadi (River Hugli) hai. Exam point: hugali nadi (River Hugli) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Between whom was the Battle of Plassey fought in 1757?
qh: प्लासी का युद्ध (Battle of Plassey) 1757 में किसके बीच लड़ा गया था?
o: सिराजुद्दौला और रॉबर्ट क्लाइव (Sirajuddaula & Robert Clive)
e: robart klaiv ke netritv mein kanpani ki sena ne bangal ke navab sirajuddaula ke khilaph plasi ka yuddh lada aur jit hasil ki. Yah prashn sirajuddaula aur robart klaiv (Sirajuddaula & Robert Clive) se juda hai. Isi karan se sirajuddaula aur robart klaiv (Sirajuddaula & Robert... sahi uttar hai. mir kasim aur klaiv, akabar aur british, haidar ali aur dalahauji anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar sirajuddaula aur robart klaiv (Sirajuddaula & Robert Clive) hi hai. Exam point: sirajuddaula aur robart klaiv (Sirajuddaula & Robert Clive) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the main reason for Sirajuddaula's defeat, involving betrayal by which of his commanders?
qh: सिराजुद्दौला की हार का मुख्य कारण उसके किस सेनापति द्वारा किया गया विश्वासघात था?
e: mir japhar ne apani tukadai ke sath yuddh mein hissa nahin liya kyonki robart klaiv ne use sirajuddaula ko hatakar navab banane ka lalach diya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki sirajuddaula ki har ka mukhy karan usake kis senapati dvara kiya gaya vishvasaghat tha? Isliye antim jawab mir japhar (Mir Jafar) ke roop mein milta hai. mir kasim, ray durlabh, jagat seth ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab mir japhar (Mir Jafar) hai. Exam point: mir japhar (Mir Jafar) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: When was the Battle of Buxar fought?
qh: बक्सर का युद्ध (Battle of Buxar) कब लड़ा गया था?
e: mir kasim ko harane ke lie angrejon ne 1764 mein baksar ka yuddh lada, jisake bad kanpani ko bangal ki divani adhikar mile. Is prashn ka dayra 1764 tak phaila hua hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1764 sahi nikalta hai. 1757, 1782, 1761 ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav 1764 hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 1764 - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In 1765, the Mughal Emperor appointed the East India Company to which position?
qh: 1765 में मुगल सम्राट ने ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी को किस पद पर नियुक्त किया?
e: divan niyukt hone ke bad kanpani ko bangal ke vishal rajasv sansadhanon par niyantran mil gaya. Prashn yah batata hai ki 1765 mein mugal samrat ne ist indiya kanpani ko kis pad par niyukt kiya? Isliye antim jawab bangal ka divan (Diwan of Bengal) ke roop mein milta hai. vajair-e-ajam, rajadut, sainik gavarnar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab bangal ka divan (Diwan of Bengal) hai. Exam point: bangal ka divan (Diwan of Bengal) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was known as the 'Tiger of Mysore'?
qh: 'शेर-ए-मैसूर' के नाम से किसे जाना जाता था?
e: tipu sultan ko unaki bahaduri ke karan 'sher-e-maisur' kaha jata tha. unhonne angrejon ke vyaparik hiton ko kadai chunauti di thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki 'sher-e-maisur' ke nam se kise jana jata tha? Isi karan se tipu sultan sahi uttar hai. ranajit sinh, nana phadanavis, haidar ali mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar tipu sultan hi hai. Exam point: tipu sultan - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which year did Tipu Sultan die while defending his capital?
qh: टीपू सुल्तान की मृत्यु अपनी राजधानी की रक्षा करते हुए किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: maisur ke sath chauthi jang (shrirangapattanam ki jang) mein 1799 mein tipu sultan viragati ko prapt hue. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki tipu sultan ki mrityu apani rajadhani ki raksha karate hue kis varsh hui thi? Isliye sahi nateeja 1799 nikalta hai. 1801, 1785, 1792 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 1799 baithta hai. Exam point: 1799 - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Why was the Maratha dream of ruling from Delhi shattered after their defeat in the Third Battle of Panipat (1761)?
qh: पानीपत की तीसरी लड़ाई (1761) में मराठों की हार के बाद उनका दिल्ली से शासन चलाने का सपना क्यों टूट गया?
o: अहमद शाह अब्दाली से हार के कारण (Defeat by Ahmad Shah Abdali)
e: 1761 mein ahamad shah abdali se mili har ne marathon ki shakti ko kamajor kar diya aur uttar bharat par unake varchasv ko khatm kar diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki panipat ki tisari ladai (1761) mein marathon ki har ke bad unaka dilli se shasan chalane ka sapana kyon tut gaya? Yahi wajah hai ki ahamad shah abdali se har ke karan (Defeat by Ahmad Shah Abdali) sahi hai. mugalon ke karan, antarik vidroh, sikhon ke karan mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan ahamad shah abdali se har ke karan... hi milti hai. Exam point: ahamad shah abdali se har ke karan... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Governor-General primarily implemented the 'Subsidiary Alliance' system?
qh: 'सहायक संधि' (Subsidiary Alliance) की व्यवस्था को मुख्य रूप से किस गवर्नर-जनरल ने लागू किया था?
e: lord velejali ne sahayak sandhi ke jarie bharatiy rajyon ko kanpani ki sena ke kharch par nirbhar bana diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 'sahayak sandhi' (Subsidiary Alliance) ki vyavastha ko mukhy rup se kis gavarnar-janaral ne lagu kiya tha? subsidiary alliance mein desi riyasat apni raksha ke liye angrezi sena ka kharch deti thi tatha bina anumati videsh niti nahi chala sakti thi. Isliye antim jawab lord richard velejali (Richard Wellesley) ke roop mein milta hai. lord dalahauji, voren hestings, lord karnavalis mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad lord richard velejali (Richard Wellesley) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: lord richard velejali (Richard Wellesley) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which policy did Lord Dalhousie devise to annex Indian states?
qh: लॉर्ड डलहौजी ने राज्यों को हड़पने के लिए किस नीति का प्रतिपादन किया था?
o: विलय नीति या व्यपगत का सिद्धांत (Doctrine of Lapse)
e: vilay niti (Doctrine of Lapse) ke anusar, yadi kisi shasak ki mrityu bina purush varis ke hoti thi, to usaki riyasat kanpani ka hissa ban jati thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki lord dalahauji ne rajyon ko hadapane ke lie kis niti ka pratipadan kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par vilay niti ya vyapagat ka siddhant (Doctrine... sahi nikalta hai. sahayak sandhi, dvaidh shasan, pairamauntasi mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se vilay niti ya vyapagat ka siddhant (Doctrine of Lapse) sahi hai. Exam point: vilay niti ya vyapagat ka siddhant (Doctrine of Lapse) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: On what basis was Jhansi annexed into the British Empire?
qh: झांसी का विलय ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य में किस आधार पर किया गया था?
o: वारिस न होने के कारण (Doctrine of Lapse)
e: jhansi ke raja ki mrityu ke bad unaka koi purush varis n hone ke karan dalahauji ne 'vilay niti' ke tahat ise hadap liya tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki jhansi ka vilay british samrajy mein kis adhar par kiya gaya tha? doctrine of lapse ke tehat bina asli waris wali riyasat angrezi raj mein mil jaati thi. Isi karan se varis n hone ke karan (Doctrine of Lapse) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp kushasan ka arop, yuddh mein har, svechchha se bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar varis n hone ke karan (Doctrine of Lapse) baithta hai. Exam point: varis n hone ke karan (Doctrine of Lapse) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On what basis was Awadh annexed in 1856?
qh: अवध का विलय 1856 में किस आधार पर किया गया था?
e: angrejon ne tark diya ki ve navab ke kushasan se janata ko ajad karane ke lie avadh ka adhigrahan kar rahe hain. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki avadh ka vilay 1856 mein kis adhar par kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kushasan ka arop (Allegation of Misgovernment) hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - sahayak sandhi, koi varis n hona, vilay niti - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se kushasan ka arop (Allegation of Misgovernment) sahi hai. Exam point: kushasan ka arop (Allegation of Misgovernment) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What did the term 'Presidency' mean during British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान 'प्रेसिडेन्सी' (Presidency) शब्द का क्या अर्थ था?
e: british ilakon ko mote taur par prashasanik ikaiyon mein banta gaya tha jinhein presidensi kaha jata tha (bangal, madras aur bombe). Sawaal is baat ka hai ki british shasan ke dauran 'presidensi' (Presidency) shabd ka kya arth tha? Isi baat se mukhy prashasanik ikaiyan (Main administrative units) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti skul, sainik chhavani, dharmik keindr chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se mukhy prashasanik ikaiyan (Main administrative units) sahi hai. Exam point: mukhy prashasanik ikaiyan (Main administrative units) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Under the Regulating Act of 1773, which new institution was established in India?
qh: 1773 के रेगुलेटिंग एक्ट के तहत भारत में किस नए संस्थान की स्थापना की गई?
e: 1773 ke reguleting ekt ke tahat kolakata mein ek nae sarvochch nyayalay (Supreme Court) ki sthapana ki gai thi. Is sawaal mein sarvochch nyayalay (Supreme Court) ki baat hai. Isliye sahi nateeja sarvochch nyayalay (Supreme Court) nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - pulis vibhag, rijarv baink, sansad - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab sarvochch nyayalay (Supreme Court) hai. Exam point: sarvochch nyayalay (Supreme Court) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the term 'Sepoy' mean in the British army?
qh: ब्रिटिश सेना में 'सिपाही' (Sepoy) शब्द का क्या अर्थ था?
e: sipahi shabd bharatiy shabd 'sipahi' se bana tha, jo kanpani ki sena mein paidal sainik (Infantry) ke rup mein kam karate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki british sena mein 'sipahi' (Sepoy) shabd ka kya arth tha? sepoy angrezi sena ka desi sipahi hota tha. Isi karan se paidal sainik (Foot soldier) sahi uttar hai. rasoiya, adhikari, keval ghudasavar is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan paidal sainik (Foot soldier) hi milti hai. Exam point: paidal sainik (Foot soldier) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What did the 'Policy of Paramountcy' initiated by Lord Hastings claim?
qh: लॉर्ड हेस्टिंग्स द्वारा शुरू की गई 'सर्वोच्चता की नीति' (Policy of Paramountcy) का क्या दावा था?
o: कंपनी की सत्ता सर्वोपरि है (Company's authority was paramount)
e: is niti ke tahat kanpani ne dava kiya ki usaki satta sarvochch hai, isalie vah kisi bhi bharatiy rajy ka adhigrahan karane ke lie hakadar hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki lord hestings dvara shuru ki gai 'sarvochchata ki niti' (Policy of Paramountcy) ka kya dava tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par kanpani ki satta sarvopari hai (Company's authority was paramount) hi sahi baithta hai. sabako saman adhikar, vyapar keval bharatiy kareinge, mugal raja hi sarvashreshth hai is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab kanpani ki satta sarvopari hai (Company's authority... hai. Exam point: kanpani ki satta sarvopari hai (Company's authority was paramount) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which brave Queen took up arms against the British in Kittur (Karnataka)?
qh: किस साहसी रानी ने 'कित्तूर' (कर्नाटक) में अंग्रेजों के खिलाफ हथियार उठाए और आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किया?
e: jab angrejon ne kittur ke chhote se rajy ko kabje mein lene ki koshish ki, to rani chennamma ne vidroh kar diya. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki kis sahasi rani ne 'kittur' (karnatak) mein angrejon ke khilaph hathiyar uthae aur andolan ka netritv kiya? Isi aadhar par rani chennamma chuna jaata hai. Galti jijabai, begam hajarat mahal, rani lakshmibai chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab rani chennamma hai. Exam point: rani chennamma - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why did the Company need more Muskets and Matchlocks in the late 18th century?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी के उत्तरार्ध में कंपनी को 'मस्कट' (Musket) और 'मैचलॉक' (Matchlock) की अधिक आवश्यकता क्यों पड़ने लगी?
o: युद्ध तकनीक में बदलाव के कारण (Change in warfare technology)
e: bandukon (maskat) aur barud ke prayog (maichalok) ke badhate chalan ke karan paidal sena adhik mahatvapurn ho gai thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki 18vin shatabdi ke uttarardh mein kanpani ko 'maskat' (Musket) aur 'maichalok' (Matchlock) ki adhik avashyakata kyon padane lagi? Isi aadhar par yuddh takanik mein badalav ke karan (Change in warfare technology) chuna jaata hai. Galti sajavat ke lie, upahar dene ke lie, shikar ke lie chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar yuddh takanik mein badalav ke karan (Change in warfare technology) baithta hai. Exam point: yuddh takanik mein badalav ke karan (Change... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why is it wrong to consider history only as synonymous with dates?
qh: इतिहास को केवल 'तारीखों का पर्याय' मानना क्यों गलत है?
o: क्योंकि तारीखें याद करना कठिन है
क्योंकि इतिहास में केवल राजा होते हैं
क्योंकि इतिहास प्रक्रियाओं और तुलनाओं के बारे में है (History is about processes and comparisons)
e: itihas keval tarikhon ka sankalan nahin hai, balki yah samay ke sath ane vale badalavon, 'pahale' aur 'bad' ki tulana aur vikas ki prakriyaon ko samajhane ka vishay hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki itihas ko keval 'tarikhon ka paryay' manana kyon galat hai? Isi baat se kyonki itihas prakriyaon aur tulanaon ke bare mein hai (History is about processes and comparisons) sahi sabit hota hai. kyonki tarikhein yad karana kathin hai, kyonki itihas mein keval raja hote hain, kyonki tarikhein badalati rahati hain anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar kyonki itihas prakriyaon aur tulanaon ke bare mein hai (History is about processes and comparisons) baithta hai. Exam point: kyonki itihas prakriyaon aur tulanaon ke bare mein hai (History is about processes and comparisons) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: James Mill divided Indian history into which three periods in his 1817 book?
qh: जेम्स मिल ने 1817 में अपनी पुस्तक 'A History of British India' में भारतीय इतिहास को किन तीन कालखंडों में विभाजित किया था?
e: skotish arthashastri jems mil ne dharm ke adhar par itihas ko hindu, muslim aur british kal mein banta tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki jems mil ne 1817 mein apani pustak 'A History of British India' mein bharatiy itihas ko kin tin kalakhandon mein vibhajit kiya tha? Isi aadhar par hindu, muslim, british chuna jaata hai. prachin, madhyakalin, adhunik, mugal, maratha, angreji, vaidik, aupaniveshik, svatantr in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar hindu, muslim, british baithta hai. Exam point: hindu, muslim, british - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is the main criticism of James Mill's classification of history?
qh: जेम्स मिल के इतिहास के वर्गीकरण की मुख्य आलोचना क्या है?
o: यह धर्म के आधार पर पक्षपाती था (It was biased based on religion)
यह केवल दक्षिण भारत पर केंद्रित था
e: alochakon ka manana hai ki keval shasak ke dharm ke adhar par pure daur ko paribhashit karana galat hai, kyonki samaj mein any dharmon ke log bhi sath rahate the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki jems mil ke itihas ke vargikaran ki mukhy alochana kya hai? Isi tathya par yah dharm ke adhar par pakshapati tha... tika hua hai. Vikalp isamein tarikhein nahin thin, yah keval dakshin bharat par keindrit tha, yah bahut chhota tha bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar yah dharm ke adhar par pakshapati tha (It was biased based on religion) baithta hai. Exam point: yah dharm ke adhar par pakshapati tha... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Into which three parts did later historians divide Indian history instead of Mill's classification?
qh: इतिहासकारों ने जेम्स मिल के वर्गीकरण के बदले भारतीय इतिहास को किन तीन भागों में बाँटा?
e: itihasakaron ne vaijnanik adhar par ise prachin, madhyakalin aur adhunik kal mein vibhajit kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki itihasakaron ne jems mil ke vargikaran ke badale bharatiy itihas ko kin tin bhagon mein banta? Isi baat se prachin, madhyakalin, adhunik (Ancient, Medieval, Modern) sahi sabit hota hai. Galti hindu, isai, bauddh, aupaniveshik, svatantr, ganarajy, prachin, samantavadi, lokatantrik chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad prachin, madhyakalin, adhunik (Ancient, Medieval, Modern) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: prachin, madhyakalin, adhunik (Ancient, Medieval, Modern) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is meant by 'Colonial' rule or period?
qh: 'औपनिवेशिक' (Colonial) शासन या काल से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: एक देश का दूसरे देश पर राजनीतिक, आर्थिक और सामाजिक दबदबा (Dominance of one country over another)
e: jab ek desh dusare desh ko jitata hai aur vahan ke samajik, arthik aur rajanitik dhanche par apana niyantran kar leta hai, to use aupaniveshikaran kahate hain. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki 'aupaniveshik' (Colonial) shasan ya kal se kya tatpary hai? Isi aadhar par ek desh ka dusare desh par rajanitik, arthik aur samajik dabadaba (Dominance of one country over another) chuna jaata hai. Galti shantipurn vyapar ka kal, keval dharmik parivartan, svatantrata ka kal chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar ek desh ka dusare desh par rajanitik, arthik aur samajik dabadaba (Dominance of one country over another) hi hai. Exam point: ek desh ka dusare desh par rajanitik, arthik aur samajik dabadaba (Dominance of one country over another) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was the first Governor-General of India?
qh: भारत के पहले गवर्नर-जनरल (Governor-General) कौन थे?
e: voren hestings 1773 mein bharat ke pahale gavarnar-janaral bane the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bharat ke pahale gavarnar-janaral (Governor-General) kaun the? Isi karan se voren hestings (Warren Hastings) sahi uttar hai. lord dalahauji, lord mauntabetan, robart klaiv mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se voren hestings (Warren Hastings) sahi hai. Exam point: voren hestings (Warren Hastings) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Who was the last Viceroy of British India?
qh: ब्रिटिश भारत के अंतिम वायसराय (Viceroy) कौन थे?
e: lord mauntabetan british shasan ke dauran bharat ke antim vayasaray the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki british bharat ke antim vayasaray (Viceroy) kaun the? Isi karan se lord mauntabetan (Lord Mountbatten) sahi uttar hai. lord iravin, lord karjan, lord kening in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se lord mauntabetan (Lord Mountbatten) sahi hai. Exam point: lord mauntabetan (Lord Mountbatten) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were specifically created in British administration to preserve records?
qh: ब्रिटिश प्रशासन में रिकॉर्ड्स को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए विशेष रूप से क्या बनाए गए थे?
e: mahatvapurn dastavejon ko surakshit rakhane ke lie rikord rum, arkaivs (abhilekhagar) aur myujiyam banae gae the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki british prashasan mein rikords ko surakshit rakhane ke lie vishesh rup se kya banae gae the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par abhilekhagar aur sangrahalay (Archives and Museums) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. keval baink, skul, sainik kainp in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar abhilekhagar aur sangrahalay (Archives and Museums) hi hai. Exam point: abhilekhagar aur sangrahalay (Archives and Museums) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: When was the National Archives of India established?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय अभिलेखागार (National Archives of India) कब स्थापित किया गया था?
e: 1920 ke dashak mein nai dilli ke nirman ke samay rashtriy abhilekhagar aur sangrahalay vayasaray ke mahal ke pas banae gae the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bharatiy rashtriy abhilekhagar (National Archives of India) kab sthapit kiya gaya tha? Isi tathya par 1920 ke dashak mein (1920s) tika hua hai. 1857, 1990, 1947 alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 1920 ke dashak mein (1920s) hi hai. Exam point: 1920 ke dashak mein (1920s) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the experts who prepared beautiful copies of documents called?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान महत्वपूर्ण दस्तावेजों की नकल सुंदर लिखावट में तैयार करने वाले विशेषज्ञों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: khushanavis ya sulekhanavis aise log hote the jo bahut sundar dhang se chijein likhate the. Prashn yah batata hai ki british shasan ke dauran mahatvapurn dastavejon ki nakal sundar likhavat mein taiyar karane vale visheshajnon ko kya kaha jata tha? Isi karan se khushanavis ya kailigraphist (Calligraphists) sahi uttar hai. Galti manasabadar, jamindar, subedar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan khushanavis ya kailigraphist (Calligraphists) hi milti hai. Exam point: khushanavis ya kailigraphist (Calligraphists) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which process was considered very important for effective administration under British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश शासन में देश के प्रभावी प्रशासन के लिए किस प्रक्रिया को बहुत महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता था?
e: angrejon ka manana tha ki kisi desh par shasan karane ke lie use sahi dhang se janana jaruri hai, isalie unhonne vistrit sarvekshan karavae. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki british shasan mein desh ke prabhavi prashasan ke lie kis prakriya ko bahut mahatvapurn mana jata tha? Isi aadhar par sarvekshan (Surveys) chuna jaata hai. Vikalp nrity pratiyogita, keval vyapar, keval yuddh bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar sarvekshan (Surveys) hai. Exam point: sarvekshan (Surveys) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: At what intervals did the Census start being conducted in India?
qh: भारत में जनगणना (Census) प्रत्येक कितने वर्षों के अंतराल पर आयोजित की जाने लगी?
e: 19vin sadi ke akhir se har 10 sal mein janaganana ki jane lagi, jisamein janasankhya, jati aur dharm ke ankadae jutae jate the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bharat mein janaganana (Census) pratyek kitane varshon ke antaral par ayojit ki jane lagi? Yahi wajah hai ki 10 varsh (10 years) sahi hai. 15 varsh, 2 varsh, 5 varsh anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 10 varsh (10 years) hai. Exam point: 10 varsh (10 years) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What information do we NOT get from the 'Official Records' of the British era?
qh: ब्रिटिश काल के 'आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड्स' (Official Records) से हमें क्या जानकारी नहीं मिलती?
o: आम जनता के विचार और पीड़ा (Thoughts and struggles of common people)
e: adhikarik rikord keval yah batate hain ki adhikari kya sochate the, ve am bharatiyon, kisanon aur adivasiyon ki asal sthiti nahin batate. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki british kal ke 'adhikarik rikords' (Official Records) se hamein kya janakari nahin milati? Isi tathya par am janata ke vichar aur pida (Thoughts... tika hua hai. bhumi sarvekshan, sainik kharch, gavarnar ke phaisale mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab am janata ke vichar aur pida (Thoughts and struggles of common people) hai. Exam point: am janata ke vichar aur pida (Thoughts and struggles of common people) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which non-official sources provide an Indian perspective on history?
qh: इतिहास के उन सोतों का नाम बताइए जो 'गैर-आधिकारिक' (Non-official) होते हुए भी भारतीय नजरिया देते हैं?
o: डायरियाँ, तीर्थयात्रियों के वृत्तांत और आत्मकथाएँ (Diaries, accounts of pilgrims & autobiographies)
e: logon ki dayariyan, atmakathaen aur netaon ke bhashan hamein us samay ka asal 'bharatiy drishtikon' dete hain. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki itihas ke un soton ka nam bataie jo 'gair-adhikarik' (Non-official) hote hue bhi bharatiy najariya dete hain? Isi tathya par dayariyan, tirthayatriyon ke vrittant aur atmakathaen (Diaries,... tika hua hai. Vikalp keval sarakari phailein, sainikon ke padak, keval janaganana riport bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan dayariyan, tirthayatriyon ke vrittant aur atmakathaen (Diaries, accounts of pilgrims & autobiographies) hi milti hai. Exam point: dayariyan, tirthayatriyon ke vrittant aur atmakathaen (Diaries,... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: With which values is the 'Modern Period' associated in the West?
qh: इतिहास में 'आधुनिक काल' (Modern Period) को पश्चिम में किन मूल्यों से जोड़कर देखा जाता है?
o: विज्ञान, लोकतंत्र, मुक्ति और समानता (Science, Democracy, Liberty & Equality)
e: pashchim mein adhunik kal ka matalab tark, vijnan, lokatantr aur svatantrata ki pragati ka daur mana jata hai. Is prashn ka kendra vijnan, lokatantr, mukti aur samanata (Science, Democracy, Liberty & Equality) hai. Isliye sahi nateeja vijnan, lokatantr, mukti aur samanata (Science, Democracy, Liberty & Equality) nikalta hai. yuddh aur lutapat, andhavishvas, keval rajashahi mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav vijnan, lokatantr, mukti aur samanata (Science, Democracy, Liberty & Equality) hi thehrta hai. Exam point: vijnan, lokatantr, mukti aur samanata (Science, Democracy,... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why were Revenue Surveys conducted during British rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश काल में 'राजस्व सर्वेक्षण' (Revenue Surveys) क्यों किए जाते थे?
o: टैक्स और भूमि की उत्पादकता जानने के लिए (To determine tax and land productivity)
केवल सैनिकों की गिनती के लिए
e: ganvon mein rajasv sarvekshan ke jarie dharati ki satah, mitti ki gunavatta aur phasalon ki janakari jutai jati thi taki taiks tay ho sake. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki british kal mein 'rajasv sarvekshan' (Revenue Surveys) kyon kie jate the? Isi karan se taiks aur bhumi ki utpadakata janane ke lie (To determine tax and land productivity) sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - dharm parivartan ke lie, keval naksha banane ke lie, keval sainikon ki ginati ke lie - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar taiks aur bhumi ki utpadakata janane ke lie (To determine tax and land productivity) baithta hai. Exam point: taiks aur bhumi ki utpadakata janane ke lie (To determine tax and land productivity) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which type of surveys collected information about flora and fauna?
qh: किस प्रकार के सर्वेक्षणों में पेड़-पौधों और जानवरों की जानकारी जुटाई जाती थी?
o: वनस्पतिक और प्राणी वैज्ञानिक सर्वेक्षण (Botanical and Zoological surveys)
e: vanaspatik (Botanical) aur prani vaijnanik (Zoological) sarvekshanon ke madhyam se prakritik sanpada ka deta jutaya jata tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kis prakar ke sarvekshanon mein ped-paudhon aur janavaron ki janakari jutai jati thi? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi tathya par vanaspatik aur prani vaijnanik sarvekshan (Botanical and... tika hua hai. puratatv sarvekshan, sainik sarvekshan, van sarvekshan anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar vanaspatik aur prani vaijnanik sarvekshan (Botanical and Zoological surveys) baithta hai. Exam point: vanaspatik aur prani vaijnanik sarvekshan (Botanical and Zoological surveys) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What negative view did James Mill express about Indian society?
