qh: जेम्स मिल ने भारतीय समाज के बारे में क्या नकारात्मक विचार दिया था?
o: एशियाई समाज सभ्यता के मामले में यूरोप से बहुत पीछे था (Asian societies were lower in civilization than Europe)
भारत की शिक्षा व्यवस्था सर्वश्रेष्ठ थी
e: mil ka manana tha ki bharat mein keval dharmik bhedabhav aur andhavishvas hai aur use sabhy banane ke lie british shasan jaruri hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki jems mil ne bharatiy samaj ke bare mein kya nakaratmak vichar diya tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par eshiyai samaj sabhyata ke mamale mein yurop se bahut pichhe tha (Asian societies were lower in civilization than Europe) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. bharat bahut amir tha, bharat mein purn lokatantr tha, bharat ki shiksha vyavastha sarvashreshth thi ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan eshiyai samaj sabhyata ke mamale mein yurop se bahut pichhe tha (Asian societies were lower in civilization than Europe) hi milti hai. Exam point: eshiyai samaj sabhyata ke mamale mein yurop... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which two words are most used for comparison in history?
qh: इतिहास में तुलना करने के लिए हम किन दो शब्दों का सबसे अधिक प्रयोग करते हैं?
e: itihas mein ham hamesha 'pahale' ki sthiti aur 'bad' mein hue badalavon ki tulana karate hain. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki itihas mein tulana karane ke lie ham kin do shabdon ka sabase adhik prayog karate hain? Isi tathya par pahale aur bad (Before and After) tika hua hai. upar aur niche, din aur rat, sahi aur galat is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar pahale aur bad (Before and After) hai. Exam point: pahale aur bad (Before and After) - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Why is it hard to learn about tribals and peasants from 'Official Records'?
qh: इतिहासकारों के अनुसार आदिवासियों और किसानों के जीवन के बारे में जानना 'आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड्स' से कठिन क्यों है?
o: क्योंकि आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड केवल अधिकारियों के हितों को दर्शाते हैं (Records reflect only official interests)
क्योंकि वे रिकॉर्ड मौजूद नहीं हैं
क्योंकि आदिवासी लिखना नहीं जानते थे
e: adhikarik rikords se keval prashasan ki janakari milati hai, samaj ke nichale tabake ki vyatha aur unake sangharshon ka vivaran vahan nahin milata. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki itihasakaron ke anusar adivasiyon aur kisanon ke jivan ke bare mein janana 'adhikarik rikords' se kathin kyon hai? Yahi wajah hai ki kyonki adhikarik rikord keval adhikariyon ke hiton ko darshate hain (Records reflect only official interests) sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - kyonki rikords jal gae the, kyonki ve rikord maujud nahin hain, kyonki adivasi likhana nahin janate the - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan kyonki adhikarik rikord keval adhikariyon ke hiton ko darshate hain (Records reflect only official interests) hi milti hai. Exam point: kyonki adhikarik rikord keval adhikariyon ke hiton ko darshate hain (Records reflect only official interests) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which country did the Industrial Revolution begin in the second half of the 18th century?
qh: औद्योगिक क्रांति 18वीं शताब्दी के उत्तरार्ध में सबसे पहले किस देश में शुरू हुई?
e: Industrial Revolution ki shuruat Britain me hui, jahan koyla, loha tatha steam power ke saath karkhane lagaane ki suvidha sabse pehle bani. Wahan naye aavishkar, samundari vyapar se mila punji tatha khuli mehnat ki vyavastha ne milkar badi machine wale utpadan ko janm diya. France, Germany, Russia in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Britain hai. Exam point: Britain - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein. Tathya ko vyakti, sthan tatha saal ke saath jodkar padhne se yaad rakhna aasan hota hai tatha vikalpon ka bhram door hota hai.

qe: Which 1764 machine that spun several threads at once became a symbol of the Industrial Revolution's textile leap?
qh: 1764 की वह कौन सी मशीन जो एक साथ कई धागे कातती थी, औद्योगिक क्रांति में वस्त्र उत्पादन की छलांग का प्रतीक बनी?
e: Spinning Jenny ne ek hi samay me kai dhage katkar kapda banane ki raftaar kai guna badha di, isliye sasti tatha zyada matra me kapda bana. Yahi machine Britain ke kapda udyog ko duniya me sabse aage le gayi tatha bade karkhanon ka raasta khola. Baaki vikalp - Steam locomotive, Power loom, Telegraph - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yahi sahi uttar Spinning Jenny hai. Exam point: Spinning Jenny - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye. Aise prashnon mein sahi vikalp wahi hota hai jo prashn ke kaal tatha kshetra se poora mel khata hai, baaki vikalp anya ghatnaon se aa jaate hain.

qe: What was the main effect of the Industrial Revolution on Indian handicrafts in the 19th century?
qh: 19वीं शताब्दी में औद्योगिक क्रांति का भारतीय हस्तशिल्प पर मुख्य प्रभाव क्या रहा?
o: Cheap machine-made British cloth ruined Indian handicrafts
e: Machine se bane saste videshi kapde ke aane par desi bunna tatha hath-kargha gir gaya, isliye karigaron ke haath se kaam chhut gaya tatha deindustrialisation hui. Sath hi desi daulat lagatar videsh jaane lage, jise drain theory ke naam se samjhaya jaata hai. Galti Indian handicrafts expanded rapidly, Handicraft exports doubled, Indian weavers got British machinery chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Cheap machine-made British cloth ruined Indian handicrafts hai. Exam point: Cheap machine-made British cloth ruined Indian handicrafts - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The ideals of liberty, equality and fraternity that inspired Indian nationalists came from which revolution?
qh: स्वतंत्रता, समानता तथा बंधुत्व के वे आदर्श जिन्होंने भारतीय राष्ट्रवादियों को प्रेरित किया, किस क्रांति से आए?
e: French Revolution ne svatantrata, samanta tatha bandhutva ke naare diye, jo bharat ke rashtravadi netaon tatha sanvidhan ke mool aadarshon me jhalakte hain. Isi kranti ne satta janata ki ichha se judne ki soch duniya bhar me pahuncha di. American Civil War, Russian Revolution, Meiji Restoration in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab French Revolution (1789) hai. Exam point: French Revolution (1789) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The Renaissance of the 14th-17th centuries first began in which Italian city?
qh: 14वीं-17वीं शताब्दी का पुनर्जागरण सबसे पहले इटली के किस नगर में शुरू हुआ?
e: Renaissance ki shuruat Florence se hui, jahan Medici jaise dhanvan vyapariyon ne kalakaron tatha vidwanon ko khula sahara diya. Wahan chitrakala, murtikala tatha manav-vad wale vichar phale, jinhone aage chalkar vigyan tatha khoj ke yug ka raasta banaya. Venice, Rome, Naples is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Sabhi baaton ke baad Florence hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Florence - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein. Pariksha mein isi vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf se tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: Who was the chief author of the American Declaration of Independence (1776)?
qh: अमेरिकी स्वतंत्रता की घोषणा (1776) का मुख्य लेखक कौन था?
e: Declaration of Independence ka pehla draft Thomas Jefferson ne likha, jismein svatantrata tatha manav-adhikar ke vichar saaf the. Is ghoshna-patr ne aage ki krantiyon tatha bharat ke rashtravadi andolan dono ko vichardhara ka aadhar diya. Vikalp George Washington, Benjamin Franklin, Abraham Lincoln bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Thomas Jefferson hi milti hai. Exam point: Thomas Jefferson - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which leader, along with V.P. Menon, led the integration of the princely states into independent India?
qh: स्वतंत्र भारत में रियासतों के एकीकरण का नेतृत्व किस नेता ने वी.पी. मेनन के साथ किया?
e: Sardar Patel tatha unke sahayak V.P. Menon ne teenon jaisi riyason ko samjhauta tatha himmat ke bal par bharat me milaya, isliye desh ki rajniti ek suutra me baandhi ja saki. Isi kaam ke liye Patel ko bharat ka loha purush kaha jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - Rajendra Prasad, C. Rajagopalachari, B.R. Ambedkar - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isi wajah se Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel sahi hai. Exam point: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The first linguistic reorganisation of an Indian state on the basis of language created which state in 1953?
qh: भाषा के आधार पर पहला राज्य पुनर्गठन किस राज्य के निर्माण के साथ 1953 में हुआ?
e: Potti Sriramulu ke lambe anshan ke baad 1953 me telugu bhasha ke logon ke liye Andhra State bana, isliye bhasha ke aadhar par rajya banane ki maang khul gayi. Isi raaste par 1956 me States Reorganisation Act se kai naye rajy bane. Gujarat, Punjab, Maharashtra in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Andhra State hai. Exam point: Andhra State - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein. Prashn chhota lage par iske peeche poora ek ghatna-kram tatha saal ka gyaan chhupa hota hai, isliye poora sandarbh dhyan mein rakhein.

qe: Who conducted India's first general elections of 1951-52 as the first Chief Election Commissioner?
qh: भारत के पहले आम चुनाव (1951-52) का संचालन पहले मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त के रूप में किसने किया?
e: Sukumar Sen pehle mukhya chunav aayukt the jinhone 1951-52 ke pehle aam chunav kra, jab itni badi aabadi ke liye chunav ki koi purani reet nahi thi. Unki mehnat se mat-petiyon, matdan-kendron tatha chunav-sabhaon ka poora dhaancha khada hua. T.N. Seshan, S.Y. Quraishi, M.S. Gill in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Sukumar Sen hi milti hai. Exam point: Sukumar Sen - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: The First Five Year Plan of India (1951-56) gave the highest priority to which sector?
qh: भारत की पहली पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-56) में सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता किस क्षेत्र को दी गई?
e: Pehli panchavarshiya yojana ka jor kheti tatha sinchai par tha, kyunki us samay khaane ke saaman ki bhari kami tatha mahngai sabse badi samasya thi. Iske liye Harrod-Domar model par aadharit aay-punji ka hisaab use kiya gaya tatha badi nadi sinchai pariyojnaon ki shuruat hui. Heavy industry, Foreign trade, Services ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Agriculture and irrigation baithta hai. Exam point: Agriculture and irrigation - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.
